@[expose] public section

universe u

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type u}



def isCutVertex (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ (a b : V) (ha : a ≠ v) (hb : b ≠ v),
    G.Reachable a b ∧ ¬ (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩

namespace Subgraph

variable {G : SimpleGraph V}


structure IsBlock (B : G.Subgraph) : Prop where

  connected : B.Connected

  noCutVertex (v : B.verts) : ¬ B.coe.isCutVertex v

  maximal (K : G.Subgraph) (hK : K.Connected)
    (hcut : ∀ v : K.verts, ¬ K.coe.isCutVertex v) (hBK : B ≤ K) : K ≤ B


def IsBlock.ofConnected {B : G.Subgraph} (hconnected : B.Connected)
    (hcut : ∀ v : B.verts, ¬ B.coe.isCutVertex v)
    (hmaximal : ∀ (K : G.Subgraph), K.Connected →
      (∀ v : K.verts, ¬ K.coe.isCutVertex v) → B ≤ K → K ≤ B) : B.IsBlock where
  connected := hconnected
  noCutVertex := hcut
  maximal := hmaximal

end Subgraph


inductive BlockCutVertex (G : SimpleGraph V) : Type u where

  | block (B : G.Subgraph) (hB : B.IsBlock)

  | cut (v : V) (hv : G.isCutVertex v)


def blockCutGraph (G : SimpleGraph V) : SimpleGraph (BlockCutVertex G) :=
  SimpleGraph.fromRel fun x y ↦
    match x, y with
    | .block B _, .cut v _ => v ∈ B.verts
    | _, _ => False

end SimpleGraph

namespace Set

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]




def IsPolyhedral (s : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : Fin m → ℝ),
    ∀ y, y ∈ s ↔ ∀ i, a i y ≤ b i


theorem isPolyhedral_iff (s : Set E) :
    IsPolyhedral s ↔
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : Fin m → ℝ),
        ∀ y, y ∈ s ↔ ∀ i, a i y ≤ b i := by

  rfl


theorem IsPolyhedral.convex {s : Set E} (hs : IsPolyhedral s) :
    Convex ℝ s := by

  obtain ⟨m, a, b, hmem⟩ := (isPolyhedral_iff s).mp hs
  have hinter : s = ⋂ i, {y | a i y ≤ b i} := by
    ext y
    simpa only [mem_iInter, mem_setOf_eq] using hmem y
  rw [hinter]

  refine convex_iInter fun i ↦ ?_
  exact (convex_Iic (b i)).linear_preimage (a i).toLinearMap

end Set

private lemma existsPositiveLinearFactor {U V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (C : PointedCone ℝ V) (ℓ : U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ u, B u ∈ C → 0 ≤ ℓ u)
    (hcofinal : ∀ y, ∃ u, B u + y ∈ C) :
    ∃ g : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, g.comp B = ℓ ∧ ∀ y ∈ C, 0 ≤ g y := by

  have hker : B.ker ≤ ℓ.ker := by
    intro u hu
    have hBu := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hu
    have hp : 0 ≤ ℓ u := hpos u (hBu.symm ▸ C.zero_mem)
    have hneg : B (-u) ∈ C := by
      simpa only [map_neg, hBu, neg_zero] using C.zero_mem
    have hn : 0 ≤ ℓ (-u) := hpos (-u) hneg
    rw [map_neg] at hn
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (le_antisymm (neg_nonneg.mp hn) hp)
  let f : B.range →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (B.ker.liftQ ℓ hker).comp B.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
  have hf (u : U) : f (B.rangeRestrict u) = ℓ u := by
    exact congrArg (B.ker.liftQ ℓ hker)
      (B.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image u (B.mem_range_self u))

  let pmap : V →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ := ⟨B.range, f⟩
  have hpmap : ∀ y : pmap.domain, (y : V) ∈ C → 0 ≤ pmap y := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := B.surjective_rangeRestrict y
    intro hy
    exact (hpos u hy).trans_eq (hf u).symm
  have hdense : ∀ y, ∃ z : pmap.domain, (z : V) + y ∈ C := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hcofinal y
    exact ⟨B.rangeRestrict u, hu⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := riesz_extension C pmap hpmap hdense
  refine ⟨g, ?_, hgpos⟩
  ext u
  exact (hg (B.rangeRestrict u)).trans (hf u)


private lemma existsPositiveLinearFactorOfCofinalCone {U V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (C : PointedCone ℝ V) (ℓ : U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ u, B u ∈ C → 0 ≤ ℓ u)
    (hcofinal : ∀ y ∈ B.range ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ (C : Set V),
      ∃ u, B u + y ∈ C) :
    ∃ g : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, g.comp B = ℓ ∧ ∀ y ∈ C, 0 ≤ g y := by

  let S := B.range ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ (C : Set V)
  let BS : U →ₗ[ℝ] S := B.codRestrict S (fun u ↦ (le_sup_left : B.range ≤ S) (B.mem_range_self u))
  have hdense : ∀ y : S, ∃ u, BS u + y ∈ C.comap S.subtype := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hcofinal y y.property
    exact ⟨u, hu⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := existsPositiveLinearFactor BS (C.comap S.subtype) ℓ hpos hdense

  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := g.exists_extend
  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext u
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hG (BS u)).trans (LinearMap.congr_fun hg u)
  · intro y hy
    have hyS : y ∈ S := (le_sup_right : Submodule.span ℝ (C : Set V) ≤ S) (Submodule.subset_span hy)
    have heq := LinearMap.congr_fun hG ⟨y, hyS⟩
    exact (hgpos ⟨y, hyS⟩ hy).trans_eq heq.symm


private lemma memPointedHullOfConvex {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    {s : Set V} (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hzero : 0 ∈ s) {y : V} :
    y ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ s ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ z ∈ s, r • z = y := by

  have hpointed : (ConvexCone.hull ℝ s).Pointed := ConvexCone.subset_hull hzero
  have hle : PointedCone.hull ℝ s ≤ (ConvexCone.hull ℝ s).toPointedCone hpointed :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr ConvexCone.subset_hull
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact (ConvexCone.mem_hull_of_convex hs).mp (hle hy)
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (PointedCone.hull ℝ s).smul_mem hr.le (PointedCone.subset_hull hz)


private lemma nonnegOnPreimageTranslatedCone {U V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (ℓ : U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Set V) (a : U)
    (hs : Convex ℝ s) (ha : B a ∈ s)
    (hpos : ∀ u, B (u + a) ∈ s → 0 ≤ ℓ u) :
    ∀ u, B u ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ ((fun p ↦ p - B a) '' s) → 0 ≤ ℓ u := by

  have hc : Convex ℝ ((fun p ↦ p - B a) '' s) := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hs.translate (-B a)
  have hz : (0 : V) ∈ (fun p ↦ p - B a) '' s := ⟨B a, ha, sub_self _⟩
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, heq⟩ := (memPointedHullOfConvex hc hz).mp hu
  have hpull : B (r⁻¹ • u + a) = p := by
    rw [map_add, map_smul, ← heq, inv_smul_smul₀ hr.ne', sub_add_cancel]

  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ (r⁻¹ • u) := hpos _ (hpull.symm ▸ hp)
  have hscaled := mul_nonneg hr.le hnonneg
  simpa only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_mul]
    using hscaled


private lemma coneCofinalOfNegativeGenerators {U V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℝ U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (s : Set V)
    (hneg : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ u, B u - y ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ s) :
    ∀ y ∈ B.range ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ (PointedCone.hull ℝ s : Set V),
      ∃ u, B u + y ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ s := by
  let C := PointedCone.hull ℝ s

  have habsorb : ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ s,
      ∃ u v, B u + y ∈ C ∧ B v - y ∈ C := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hneg y hy
      refine ⟨0, v, ?_, hv⟩
      rw [map_zero, zero_add]
      exact Submodule.subset_span hy
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, 0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [map_zero, add_zero] using C.zero_mem
      · simpa only [map_zero, sub_zero] using C.zero_mem
    | add y z _ _ ihy ihz =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv⟩ := ihy
      obtain ⟨u', v', hu', hv'⟩ := ihz
      refine ⟨u + u', v + v', ?_, ?_⟩
      · have heq : B (u + u') + (y + z) = (B u + y) + (B u' + z) := by
          rw [map_add]
          abel
        rw [heq]
        exact C.add_mem hu hu'
      · have heq : B (v + v') - (y + z) = (B v - y) + (B v' - z) := by
          rw [map_add]
          abel
        rw [heq]
        exact C.add_mem hv hv'
    | smul a y _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv⟩ := ih
      by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
      · refine ⟨a • u, a • v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [map_smul, smul_add] using C.smul_mem ha hu
        · simpa only [map_smul, smul_sub] using C.smul_mem ha hv
      · have hna : 0 ≤ -a := neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_ge ha)
        refine ⟨(-a) • v, (-a) • u, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have heq : B ((-a) • v) + a • y = (-a) • (B v - y) := by
            simp only [smul_sub, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, map_neg, map_smul]
          rw [heq]
          exact C.smul_mem hna hv
        · have heq : B ((-a) • u) - a • y = (-a) • (B u + y) := by
            simp only [smul_add, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, map_neg, map_smul]
          rw [heq]
          exact C.smul_mem hna hu

  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (C : Set V) ≤ Submodule.span ℝ s :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (PointedCone.hull_le_span ℝ s)
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨v, _, hv, _⟩ := habsorb c (hspan hc)
  refine ⟨v - u, ?_⟩
  have heq : B (v - u) + (B u + c) = B v + c := by
    rw [map_sub]
    abel
  rwa [heq]

variable {E : Type u} {F : Type v}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma memFiniteConicalHull {t : Finset F} {x : F} :
    x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) ↔
      ∃ f : F → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ t, 0 ≤ f y) ∧ ∑ y ∈ t, f y • y = x := by
  classical

  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨f, _, hfx⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp hx
    exact ⟨fun y ↦ (f y : ℝ), fun y _ ↦ (f y).property, hfx⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)).sum_mem
      (fun y hy ↦ (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)).smul_mem (hf y hy)
        (Submodule.subset_span hy))

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma existsPositiveRelationOfDependent {t : Finset F}
    (hdep : ¬LinearIndepOn ℝ id (t : Set F)) :
    ∃ g : F → ℝ, (∑ y ∈ t, g y • y = 0) ∧ ∃ y ∈ t, 0 < g y := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨g, hg, y, hy, hgy⟩ := not_linearIndepOn_finset_iff.mp hdep
  simp only [id_eq] at hg
  by_cases hpos : 0 < g y
  · exact ⟨g, hg, y, hy, hpos⟩
  · refine ⟨fun z ↦ -g z, ?_, y, hy, neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) hgy)⟩
    simpa only [neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_zero] using congrArg Neg.neg hg

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma memConicalHullEraseOfDependent [DecidableEq F] {t : Finset F}
    (hdep : ¬LinearIndepOn ℝ id (t : Set F)) {x : F}
    (hx : x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)) :
    ∃ y ∈ t, x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (↑(t.erase y) : Set F) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfx⟩ := memFiniteConicalHull.mp hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, y, hy, hgy⟩ := existsPositiveRelationOfDependent hdep

  let positive := t.filter (fun z ↦ 0 < g z)
  have hne : positive.Nonempty := ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, hgy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmin⟩ := positive.exists_min_image (fun z ↦ f z / g z) hne
  have hit : i ∈ t := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hgi : 0 < g i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  let k : F → ℝ := fun z ↦ f z - f i / g i * g z
  have hki : k i = 0 := by
    simp only [k, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgi.ne', sub_self]
  have hkismul : k i • i = 0 := by
    rw [hki, zero_smul]
  refine ⟨i, hit, memFiniteConicalHull.mpr ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro z hz
    have hzt : z ∈ t := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz).2
    dsimp only [k]
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    by_cases hgz : 0 < g z
    · exact (le_div_iff₀ hgz).mp (hmin z (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzt, hgz⟩))
    · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (div_nonneg (hf i hit) hgi.le)
        (le_of_not_gt hgz)).trans (hf z hzt)
  ·
    calc
      ∑ z ∈ t.erase i, k z • z = ∑ z ∈ t, k z • z :=
        Finset.sum_erase _ hkismul
      _ = ∑ z ∈ t, (f z - f i / g i * g z) • z := rfl
      _ = x := by
        simp only [sub_smul, mul_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum,
          hg, smul_zero, sub_zero, hfx]

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma existsIndependentConicalGenerators (t : Finset F) {x : F}
    (hx : x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)) :
    ∃ u : Finset F, u ⊆ t ∧ LinearIndepOn ℝ id (u : Set F) ∧
      x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (u : Set F) := by
  classical

  induction t using Finset.strongInductionOn with
  | _ t ih =>
    by_cases hind : LinearIndepOn ℝ id (t : Set F)
    · exact ⟨t, Finset.Subset.refl t, hind, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := memConicalHullEraseOfDependent hind hx
    obtain ⟨u, hut, huind, hxu⟩ := ih (t.erase y) (Finset.erase_ssubset hy) hxy
    exact ⟨u, hut.trans (Finset.erase_subset y t), huind, hxu⟩

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma isClosedIndependentConicalHull (t : Finset F)
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℝ id (t : Set F)) :
    IsClosed (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) : Set F) := by
  classical

  let L := Fintype.linearCombination ℝ (fun y : t ↦ (y : F))
  have hinj : Function.Injective L := hind.fintypeLinearCombination_injective
  have hclosed : IsClosed {c : t → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i} := by
    simp only [Set.setOf_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter (fun i ↦ isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i))
  have himage : (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) : Set F) =
      L '' {c : t → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset'.mp hx
      exact ⟨fun i ↦ (c i : ℝ), fun i ↦ (c i).property, hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)).sum_mem
        (fun i _ ↦ (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F)).smul_mem (hc i)
          (Submodule.subset_span i.property))
  rw [himage]
  exact (L.isClosedEmbedding_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hinj)).isClosedMap _ hclosed

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma isClosedFiniteConicalHull (t : Finset F) :
    IsClosed (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) : Set F) := by
  classical

  let pieces := t.powerset.filter (fun u : Finset F ↦ LinearIndepOn ℝ id (u : Set F))
  have heq : (PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) : Set F) =
      ⋃ u ∈ pieces, (PointedCone.hull ℝ (u : Set F) : Set F) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨u, hut, hind, hxu⟩ := existsIndependentConicalGenerators t hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hut, hind⟩, hxu⟩⟩
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨u, hxu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      obtain ⟨hu, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxu
      have hut := Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).1
      exact Submodule.span_mono hut hx
  rw [heq]
  apply pieces.finite_toSet.isClosed_biUnion
  intro u hu
  exact isClosedIndependentConicalHull u (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2


private lemma supportNonposOnActiveDirections {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (L : ι → F →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : F) (ℓ : F →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, L i p ≤ b i)
    (hsupport : ∀ q, (∀ i, L i q ≤ b i) → ℓ q ≤ ℓ p)
    (d : F) (hd : ∀ i, L i p = b i → L i d ≤ 0) : ℓ d ≤ 0 := by
  classical

  have hi : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 0, 0 ≤ t → L i (p + t • d) ≤ b i := by
    intro i
    by_cases ha : L i p = b i
    · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro t ht
      rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ha]
      exact add_le_of_nonpos_right (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht (hd i ha))
    · have hstrict : L i (p + (0 : ℝ) • d) < b i := by
        simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using lt_of_le_of_ne (hp i) ha
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ L i (p + t • d)) :=
        (L i).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous.comp
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
      have hlt := Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hstrict hc.continuousAt
      filter_upwards [hlt] with t ht
      exact fun _ ↦ ht.le
  have hall : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 0, ∀ i, 0 ≤ t → L i (p + t • d) ≤ b i :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr hi

  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hall
  have ht : δ / 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) δ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (half_pos hδ)]
    linarith
  have hle := hsupport (p + (δ / 2) • d) (fun i ↦ hball ht i (half_pos hδ).le)
  rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hle
  have hprod : δ / 2 * ℓ d ≤ 0 := by linarith
  exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right hprod (half_pos hδ)


private lemma existsActiveHalfspaceMultipliers {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (L : ι → F →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : F) (ℓ : F →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, L i p ≤ b i)
    (hsupport : ∀ q, (∀ i, L i q ≤ b i) → ℓ q ≤ ℓ p) :
    ∃ α : {i // L i p = b i} → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) ∧
      ℓ = ∑ i : {i // L i p = b i}, α i • L i := by
  classical
  let n : ι → F := fun i ↦ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm (L i).toContinuousLinearMap
  let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm ℓ.toContinuousLinearMap
  let t : Finset F := Finset.univ.image (fun i : {i // L i p = b i} ↦ n i)
  have hn (i : ι) (z : F) : inner ℝ (n i) z = L i z := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
  have hw (z : F) : inner ℝ w z = ℓ z := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply

  have hmem : w ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F) := by
    by_contra hnot
    let K : ProperCone ℝ F := ⟨PointedCone.hull ℝ (t : Set F), isClosedFiniteConicalHull t⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hwy⟩ := K.hyperplane_separation' hnot
    have hdir : ∀ i, L i p = b i → L i (-y) ≤ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      have hnormal : n i ∈ K := Submodule.subset_span
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
      have hnonneg := hy (n i) hnormal
      rw [hn] at hnonneg
      rw [map_neg]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr hnonneg
    have hle := supportNonposOnActiveDirections L b p ℓ hp hsupport (-y) hdir
    rw [map_neg] at hle
    rw [hw] at hwy
    linarith

  have hset : (t : Set F) = Set.range (fun i : {i // L i p = b i} ↦ n i) := by
    simp only [t, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ]
  rw [hset] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp hmem
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (c i : ℝ), fun i ↦ (c i).property, ?_⟩
  ext z
  have hsum := congrArg (fun a : F ↦ inner ℝ a z) hc
  simpa only [sum_inner, ← Nonneg.coe_smul, real_inner_smul_left, hn, hw,
    LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hsum.symm


private lemma existsActiveHalfspaceMultipliersOfFiniteDimensional {U : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup U] [NormedSpace ℝ U] [FiniteDimensional ℝ U]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (L : ι → U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : U) (ℓ : U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, L i p ≤ b i)
    (hsupport : ∀ q, (∀ i, L i q ≤ b i) → ℓ q ≤ ℓ p) :
    ∃ α : {i // L i p = b i} → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) ∧
      ℓ = ∑ i : {i // L i p = b i}, α i • L i := by

  let euclidean : U ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ U)) :=
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq finrank_euclideanSpace_fin.symm

  let e := euclidean.toLinearEquiv
  have hpe : ∀ i, ((L i).comp e.symm.toLinearMap) (e p) ≤ b i := by
    intro i
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hp i
  have hse : ∀ q, (∀ i, ((L i).comp e.symm.toLinearMap) q ≤ b i) →
      (ℓ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap) q ≤ (ℓ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap) (e p) := by
    intro q hq
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hsupport (e.symm q) hq
  have hcert := existsActiveHalfspaceMultipliers (fun i ↦ (L i).comp e.symm.toLinearMap)
    b (e p) (ℓ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap) hpe hse
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hcert
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hsum⟩ := hcert

  have hactive (i : ι) : L i p = b i ↔ L i (e.symm (e p)) = b i := by
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
  let activeEquiv := Equiv.subtypeEquivRight hactive
  have horiginal : ℓ = ∑ i : {i // L i (e.symm (e p)) = b i}, α i • L i := by
    ext z
    simpa only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      using LinearMap.congr_fun hsum (e z)
  have hterm (i : {i // L i p = b i}) :
      α (activeEquiv i) • L i = α (activeEquiv i) • L (activeEquiv i) := rfl
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ α (activeEquiv i), fun i ↦ hα (activeEquiv i), ?_⟩
  exact horiginal.trans (Fintype.sum_equiv activeEquiv _ _ hterm).symm


private lemma existsLinearSupportOfHalfspacePreimage {U V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup U] [NormedSpace ℝ U] [FiniteDimensional ℝ U]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : U →ₗ[ℝ] V) (L : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (a : U) (ℓ : U →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, L i (B a) ≤ b i)
    (hsupport : ∀ u, (∀ i, L i (B u) ≤ b i) → ℓ a ≤ ℓ u) :
    ∃ g : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, g.comp B = ℓ ∧
      ∀ y, (∀ i, L i y ≤ b i) → 0 ≤ g (y - B a) := by

  have hupper : ∀ u, (∀ i, L i (B u) ≤ b i) → (-ℓ) u ≤ (-ℓ) a := by
    intro u hu
    simpa only [LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_le_neg_iff] using hsupport u hu
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hsum⟩ := existsActiveHalfspaceMultipliersOfFiniteDimensional
    (fun i ↦ (L i).comp B) b a (-ℓ) ha hupper
  let g := -∑ i : {i // (L i).comp B a = b i}, α i • L i
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext u
    have heq := LinearMap.congr_fun hsum u
    simpa only [g, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, neg_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg heq.symm
  · intro y hy

    simp only [g, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_nonneg]
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_sub]
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro i _
    have hbound : L i y ≤ L i (B a) := (hy i).trans_eq i.property.symm
    simpa only [mul_sub] using
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hα i) (sub_nonpos.mpr hbound)

private lemma extrapolationMemAffineSpan {s : Set F} {q y : F}
    (hq : q ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) (t : ℝ) :
    q + t • (q - y) ∈ affineSpan ℝ s := by

  simpa only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using
    (affineSpan ℝ s).smul_vsub_vadd_mem t
      (subset_affineSpan ℝ s hq) (subset_affineSpan ℝ s hy) (subset_affineSpan ℝ s hq)

private lemma existsPositiveExtrapolation {s : Set F} {q y : F}
    (hq : q ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ s) (hy : y ∈ s) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ q + t • (q - y) ∈ s := by

  obtain ⟨q', hq', heq⟩ := mem_intrinsicInterior.mp hq
  let c : ℝ → affineSpan ℝ s := fun t ↦
    ⟨q + t • (q - y), extrapolationMemAffineSpan (intrinsicInterior_subset hq) hy t⟩
  have hc : Continuous c :=
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).subtype_mk _
  have heqzero : c 0 = q' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [c, zero_smul, add_zero] using heq.symm
  have hc0 : c 0 ∈ interior ((↑) ⁻¹' s : Set (affineSpan ℝ s)) := heqzero.symm ▸ hq'
  have hnb := hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hc0)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnb
  refine ⟨δ / 2, half_pos hδ, ?_⟩
  have ht : δ / 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) δ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (half_pos hδ)]
    linarith
  have ht' : c (δ / 2) ∈ interior ((↑) ⁻¹' s : Set (affineSpan ℝ s)) := hball ht
  have htmem : c (δ / 2) ∈ ((↑) ⁻¹' s : Set (affineSpan ℝ s)) := interior_subset ht'
  exact htmem


private def translatedEpigraphCone (h : F → EReal) (y : F) : PointedCone ℝ (F × ℝ) :=
  PointedCone.hull ℝ ((fun p ↦ p - (y, (h y).toReal)) '' EReal.epigraph h)

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma sub_mem_translatedEpigraphCone (h : F → EReal) (y : F) {p : F × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ EReal.epigraph h) :
    p - (y, (h y).toReal) ∈ translatedEpigraphCone h y := by

  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma epigraphConeCofinalOfIntrinsicInterior (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hqual : ∃ z : E, A z ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (EReal.effectiveDomain h)) (x : E) :
    ∀ y ∈ (A.prodMap (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)).range ⊔
      Submodule.span ℝ (translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) : Set (F × ℝ)),
      ∃ u : E × ℝ, (A u.1, u.2) + y ∈ translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) := by

  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hqual
  apply coneCofinalOfNegativeGenerators (A.prodMap LinearMap.id)
    ((fun p ↦ p - (A x, (h (A x)).toReal)) '' EReal.epigraph h)
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hpdom : p.1 ∈ EReal.effectiveDomain h :=
    ((EReal.mem_epigraph h p).mp hp).trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top p.2)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεdom⟩ := existsPositiveExtrapolation hz₀ hpdom
  let q := A z₀ + ε • (A z₀ - p.1)
  let r := (h (A x)).toReal
  let t := (h q).toReal
  have hqepi : (q, t) ∈ EReal.epigraph h := EReal.le_coe_toReal (ne_top_of_lt hεdom)

  let u : E × ℝ := ((z₀ - x) + ε⁻¹ • (z₀ - x), p.2 - r + ε⁻¹ * (t - r))
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  have hgen : (q, t) - (A x, r) ∈ translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) :=
    sub_mem_translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) hqepi
  have heq : (A u.1, u.2) - (p - (A x, r)) = ε⁻¹ • ((q, t) - (A x, r)) := by
    ext
    · simp only [u, q, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.smul_fst,
        map_add, map_sub, map_smul, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hε.ne', one_smul]
      abel
    · simp only [u, Prod.snd_sub, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
  exact Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem heq
    ((translatedEpigraphCone h (A x)).smul_mem (inv_nonneg.mpr hε.le) hgen)

private lemma memSubdifferentialIffEpigraphSupport (f : F → EReal) (x v : F)
    (htop : f x ≠ ⊤) (hbot : f x ≠ ⊥) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      ∀ p ∈ EReal.epigraph f, (f x).toReal + inner ℝ v (p.1 - x) ≤ p.2 := by

  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro hv p hp
    have hle := (hv p.1).trans ((EReal.mem_epigraph f p).mp hp)
    rw [← EReal.coe_toReal htop hbot, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hle
    exact hle
  · intro hv y

    by_cases hybot : f y = ⊥
    · have hp : (y, (f x).toReal + inner ℝ v (y - x) - 1) ∈ EReal.epigraph f := by
        simp only [EReal.mem_epigraph, hybot, bot_le]
      have hle := hv _ hp
      dsimp only at hle
      linarith
    by_cases hytop : f y = ⊤
    · rw [hytop]
      exact le_top
    have hp : (y, (f y).toReal) ∈ EReal.epigraph f := EReal.le_coe_toReal hytop
    have hle := EReal.coe_le_coe (hv _ hp)
    simpa only [EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_toReal htop hbot,
      EReal.coe_toReal hytop hybot] using hle

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma subdifferentialEqEmptyOfEqTop (f : F → EReal) (x : F)
    (hx : f x = ⊤) (hfinite : ∃ z, f z < ⊤) :
    EReal.subdifferential f x = ∅ := by

  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hfinite
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hle := (EReal.mem_subdifferential f x v).mp hv z
  rw [hx, EReal.top_add_coe] at hle
  exact (not_le_of_gt hz) hle


private lemma existsAdjointSubgradientOfLinearSupport (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (x v : E) (htop : h (A x) ≠ ⊤) (hbot : h (A x) ≠ ⊥)
    (g : (F × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hfactor : ∀ p : E × ℝ, g (A p.1, p.2) = p.2 - inner ℝ v p.1)
    (hsupport : ∀ p ∈ EReal.epigraph h,
      0 ≤ g (p - (A x, (h (A x)).toReal))) :
    ∃ w ∈ EReal.subdifferential h (A x), A.adjoint w = v := by

  let φ : F →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := -g.comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ F ℝ)
  let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm φ.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hinner (y : F) : inner ℝ w y = -g (y, 0) :=
    InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
  have hvert (t : ℝ) : g (0, t) = t := by
    simpa only [map_zero, inner_zero_right, sub_zero] using hfactor (0, t)
  have hform (p : F × ℝ) : g p = p.2 - inner ℝ w p.1 := by
    have hadd : g p = g (p.1, 0) + g (0, p.2) := by
      simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, Prod.mk.eta] using
        g.map_add (p.1, 0) (0, p.2)
    rw [hadd, hvert, hinner]
    ring
  refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·
    rw [memSubdifferentialIffEpigraphSupport h (A x) w htop hbot]
    intro p hp
    have hle := hsupport p hp
    rw [hform] at hle
    simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, inner_sub_right] at hle
    rw [inner_sub_right]
    linarith
  ·
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro z
    rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, hinner]
    have hz := hfactor (z, 0)
    dsimp only at hz
    linarith


private noncomputable def epigraphSupportGap (v : E) : (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.snd ℝ E ℝ - (innerₗ E v).comp (LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ)

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in

private lemma epigraphSupportGap_apply (v : E) (p : E × ℝ) :
    epigraphSupportGap v p = p.2 - inner ℝ v p.1 := by

  rfl

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] in

private lemma subgradientNonnegOnEpigraphConePreimage (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ (EReal.epigraph h)) (x v : E)
    (htop : h (A x) ≠ ⊤) (hbot : h (A x) ≠ ⊥)
    (hv : v ∈ EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x) :
    ∀ u : E × ℝ, (A u.1, u.2) ∈ translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) →
      0 ≤ epigraphSupportGap v u := by

  refine nonnegOnPreimageTranslatedCone (A.prodMap LinearMap.id) (epigraphSupportGap v)
    (EReal.epigraph h) (x, (h (A x)).toReal) hconvex (EReal.le_coe_toReal htop) ?_
  intro u hu
  have hbound := (memSubdifferentialIffEpigraphSupport (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x v htop hbot).mp hv
    (u.1 + x, u.2 + (h (A x)).toReal) hu
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at hbound
  rw [epigraphSupportGap_apply]
  linarith




theorem subdifferentialCompLinearSubset (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ (EReal.epigraph h))
    (h_ne_bot : ∀ y, h y ≠ ⊥) (hdom : (EReal.effectiveDomain h).Nonempty) (x : E) :
    A.adjoint '' EReal.subdifferential h (A x) ⊆
      EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x := by

  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential] at hw ⊢
  intro z
  simpa only [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, map_sub] using hw (A z)




theorem subdifferentialCompLinear (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ (EReal.epigraph h))
    (h_ne_bot : ∀ y, h y ≠ ⊥) (hdom : (EReal.effectiveDomain h).Nonempty)
    (hqual : ∃ z : E, A z ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (EReal.effectiveDomain h)) (x : E) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x =
      A.adjoint '' EReal.subdifferential h (A x) := by

  by_cases htop : h (A x) = ⊤
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hqual
    have hzdom : A z ∈ EReal.effectiveDomain h := intrinsicInterior_subset hz
    have hzfinite : h (A z) < ⊤ := hzdom
    rw [subdifferentialEqEmptyOfEqTop (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x htop ⟨z, hzfinite⟩,
      subdifferentialEqEmptyOfEqTop h (A x) htop ⟨A z, hzfinite⟩, Set.image_empty]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ (subdifferentialCompLinearSubset h A hconvex h_ne_bot hdom x)
  intro v hv

  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := existsPositiveLinearFactorOfCofinalCone
    (A.prodMap LinearMap.id) (translatedEpigraphCone h (A x)) (epigraphSupportGap v)
    (subgradientNonnegOnEpigraphConePreimage h A hconvex x v htop (h_ne_bot (A x)) hv)
    (epigraphConeCofinalOfIntrinsicInterior h A hqual x)
  apply existsAdjointSubgradientOfLinearSupport h A x v htop (h_ne_bot (A x)) g
  · intro p
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      epigraphSupportGap_apply] using LinearMap.congr_fun hg p
  ·
    intro p hp
    exact hgpos _ (sub_mem_translatedEpigraphCone h (A x) hp)




theorem subdifferentialCompLinearOfPolyhedral (h : F → EReal) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ (EReal.epigraph h))
    (h_ne_bot : ∀ y, h y ≠ ⊥) (hdom : (EReal.effectiveDomain h).Nonempty)
    (hpoly : EReal.IsPolyhedral h)
    (hfeas : ∃ z : E, A z ∈ EReal.effectiveDomain h) (x : E) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x =
      A.adjoint '' EReal.subdifferential h (A x) := by

  by_cases htop : h (A x) = ⊤
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hfeas
    rw [subdifferentialEqEmptyOfEqTop (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x htop ⟨z, hz⟩,
      subdifferentialEqEmptyOfEqTop h (A x) htop ⟨A z, hz⟩, Set.image_empty]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ (subdifferentialCompLinearSubset h A hconvex h_ne_bot hdom x)
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨k, L, b, hepi⟩ := hpoly
  let B := A.prodMap (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
  let a : E × ℝ := (x, (h (A x)).toReal)
  have ha : ∀ i, L i (B a) ≤ b i := (hepi (B a)).mp (EReal.le_coe_toReal htop)
  have hs : ∀ u, (∀ i, L i (B u) ≤ b i) → epigraphSupportGap v a ≤ epigraphSupportGap v u := by
    intro u hu
    have hbound := (memSubdifferentialIffEpigraphSupport (fun z ↦ h (A z)) x v
      htop (h_ne_bot (A x))).mp hv u ((hepi (B u)).mpr hu)
    rw [epigraphSupportGap_apply, epigraphSupportGap_apply]
    simp only [a, inner_sub_right] at hbound ⊢
    linarith

  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := existsLinearSupportOfHalfspacePreimage B L b a (epigraphSupportGap v) ha hs
  apply existsAdjointSubgradientOfLinearSupport h A x v htop (h_ne_bot (A x)) g
  · intro p
    simpa only [B, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      epigraphSupportGap_apply] using LinearMap.congr_fun hg p
  · intro p hp
    exact hgpos p ((hepi p).mp hp)

private lemma idealSmulQuotientNeTop {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] {I : Ideal R} {z : R} (hz : z ∈ I)
    (hI : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) ≠ ⊤) :
    I • (⊤ : Submodule R (QuotSMulTop z M)) ≠ ⊤ := by

  intro h
  have hpull := congrArg (Submodule.comap (Submodule.mkQ _)) h
  apply hI
  simpa [Submodule.comap_smul_top_of_surjective I _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _),
    Submodule.smul_mono_left ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem I).mpr hz),
    ← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul] using hpull


private lemma existsRegularSequenceOnQuotient {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [Small.{v} R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ)
    (hI : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤) {z : R} (hz : z ∈ I)
    (hreg : IsSMulRegular M z)
    (hseq : ∃ ys : List R, ys.length = n + 1 ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ys, y ∈ I) ∧ IsRegular M ys) :
    ∃ zs : List R, zs.length = n ∧ (∀ y ∈ zs, y ∈ I) ∧
      IsRegular (QuotSMulTop z M) zs := by
  let N := ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))
  have hsupp : Module.support R N = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I := by
    rw [(Shrink.linearEquiv R _).support_eq, Module.support_eq_zeroLocus,
      Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
  obtain ⟨ys, hlen, hmem, hys⟩ := hseq
  have hext := ModuleCat.subsingleton_ext_of_exists_isRegular I N hsupp.subset
    (ModuleCat.of R M) hI ys hmem hys
  have hshort : (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex (ModuleCat.of R M) z).ShortExact :=
    hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact

  have hquot : ∀ i < n, Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext N (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop z M)) i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi₀ : i < ys.length := by omega
    have hi₁ : i + 1 < ys.length := by omega
    have zero₀ := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (hext i hi₀)
    have zero₁ := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (hext (i + 1) hi₁)
    exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero <|
      CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' N
          hshort) i (i + 1) rfl)
        (zero₀.eq_zero_of_src _) (zero₁.eq_zero_of_tgt _)

  exact ModuleCat.exists_isRegular_of_exists_subsingleton_ext I n
    (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop z M))
    (idealSmulQuotientNeTop hz hI.ne).lt_top N hsupp hquot


private lemma memAnnihilatorQuotSMulTop {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (z : R) :
    z ∈ Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop z M) := by

  rw [Module.mem_annihilator]
  intro q
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (z • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) q
  rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul m z ⊤ (Submodule.mem_top)


private lemma ofListConsLeTailSupQuotientAnnihilator {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (x : R) (xs : List R) {t : R}
    (ht : t ∈ Ideal.ofList xs) :
    Ideal.ofList (x :: xs) ⊔ Module.annihilator R M ≤
      Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M) := by

  rw [Ideal.ofList_cons]
  refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ le_sup_left) ?_
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    have hz := (le_sup_right : Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M) ≤
      Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M))
      (memAnnihilatorQuotSMulTop (M := M) (x + t))
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using
      (Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M)).sub_mem
        hz ((le_sup_left : Ideal.ofList xs ≤
          Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M)) ht)
  · exact (LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_surjective (R := R) _
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective ( (x + t) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))).trans le_sup_right


private lemma spanSingletonAddSup {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x : R)
    (J : Ideal R) {t : R} (ht : t ∈ J) :
    Ideal.span {x + t} ⊔ J = Ideal.span {x} ⊔ J := by

  apply le_antisymm
  · refine sup_le ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ?_) le_sup_right
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton x)))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right ht)
  · refine sup_le ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ?_) le_sup_right
    have h := (Ideal.span {x + t} ⊔ J).sub_mem
      (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (x + t))))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right ht)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using h


private lemma isRegularConsOfAddMemTail {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] (x : R) (xs : List R) {t : R}
    (ht : t ∈ Ideal.ofList xs) (h : IsRegular M ((x + t) :: xs)) :
    IsRegular M (x :: xs) := by

  have hlast := IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm h
    (List.perm_append_comm : ([x + t] ++ xs).Perm (xs ++ [x + t]))
  have hweak := (isWeaklyRegular_append_iff M xs [x + t]).mp hlast.toIsWeaklyRegular
  have hreg := (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ (x + t)).mp hweak.2
  rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem] at hreg
  have hx : IsSMulRegular (M ⧸ (Ideal.ofList xs • ⊤ : Submodule R M)) x := by
    rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
    intro m hm
    apply hreg m
    rw [add_smul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hm (Submodule.smul_mem_smul ht Submodule.mem_top)
  have hwlast := (isWeaklyRegular_append_iff M xs [x]).mpr
    ⟨hweak.1, (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ x).mpr hx⟩

  have hideal : Ideal.ofList (xs ++ [x]) = Ideal.ofList ((x + t) :: xs) := by
    rw [Ideal.ofList_append, Ideal.ofList_singleton, Ideal.ofList_cons,
      spanSingletonAddSup x (Ideal.ofList xs) ht, sup_comm]
  have hlast' : IsRegular M (xs ++ [x]) :=
    ⟨hwlast, hideal.symm ▸ h.top_ne_smul⟩
  exact IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hlast'
    (List.perm_append_comm : (xs ++ [x]).Perm ([x] ++ xs))


private lemma existsAddAvoidingPrimes {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (S : Finset (Ideal R))
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ S, p.IsPrime)
    (hanti : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≤ q → q ≤ p)
    (x : R) (J : Ideal R) (havoid : ∀ p ∈ S, ¬ (Ideal.span {x} ⊔ J ≤ p)) :
    ∃ t ∈ J, ∀ p ∈ S, x + t ∉ p := by
  classical
  let good := S.filter (fun p => x ∉ p)
  let bad := S.filter (fun p => x ∈ p)
  let K := J ⊓ good.inf id

  have hK : ∀ p ∈ bad, ¬ K ≤ p := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hpS, hxp⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    rw [(hprime p hpS).inf_le]
    rintro (hJ | hgood)
    · exact havoid p hpS (sup_le ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem p).mpr hxp) hJ)
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := (hprime p hpS).inf_le'.mp hgood
      obtain ⟨hqS, hxq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
      exact hxq (hanti q hqS p hpS hqp hxp)
  have hnot : ¬ ((K : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ (bad : Set (Ideal R)), (p : Set R)) := by
    intro hsub
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hle⟩ := (Ideal.subset_union_prime_finite bad.finite_toSet
      (f := id) ⊥ ⊥ (fun p hp _ _ => hprime p (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1)).mp hsub
    exact hK p hp hle
  obtain ⟨t, htK, htavoid⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnot
  refine ⟨t, htK.1, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hsum
  by_cases hxp : x ∈ p
  · have htp : t ∈ p := by
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using p.sub_mem hsum hxp
    exact htavoid (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hxp⟩, htp⟩⟩)
  · have hpgood : p ∈ good := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hxp⟩
    have hle : good.inf id ≤ p := Finset.inf_le hpgood
    have htp : t ∈ p := hle htK.2
    apply hxp
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using p.sub_mem hsum htp



private lemma existsRegularAddOfRegularMemSupAnnihilator {R M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] (x : R) (J : Ideal R)
    (h : ∃ y ∈ (Ideal.span {x} ⊔ J) ⊔ Module.annihilator R M,
      IsSMulRegular M y) : ∃ t ∈ J, IsSMulRegular M (x + t) := by
  classical
  let A := associatedPrimes R M
  have hfin : A.Finite := associatedPrimes.finite R M
  let S := hfin.toFinset.filter (fun p => Maximal (· ∈ A) p)
  have hmem : ∀ p ∈ S, Maximal (· ∈ A) p := by
    intro p hp
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ S, p.IsPrime := fun p hp => (hmem p hp).1.isPrime
  have hanti : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≤ q → q ≤ p := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    exact (hmem p hp).2 (hmem q hq).1 hpq
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hreg⟩ := h
  have hyavoid : ∀ p ∈ A, y ∉ p := by
    intro p hp hyp
    have hunion : y ∈ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R M, (p : Set R) :=
      Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hp, hyp⟩⟩
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular] at hunion
    exact hunion hreg
  have havoid : ∀ p ∈ S, ¬ (Ideal.span {x} ⊔ J ≤ p) := by
    intro p hp hle
    have hann : Module.annihilator R M ≤ p := by
      simpa only [Submodule.annihilator_top] using (hmem p hp).1.annihilator_le
    exact hyavoid p (hmem p hp).1 ((sup_le hle hann) hy)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htranslate⟩ := existsAddAvoidingPrimes S hprime hanti x J havoid
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩

  by_contra hnot
  have hunion : x + t ∈ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R M, (p : Set R) := by
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular]
    exact hnot
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hunion
  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hq⟩ := hfin.exists_le_maximal hp
  have hqS : q ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hq.1, hq⟩
  exact htranslate q hqS (hpq hxp)



private lemma properSupAnnihilatorSmulLt {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Nontrivial M] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    (I ⊔ Module.annihilator R M) • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤ := by

  have hann : Module.annihilator R M ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    exact not_subsingleton M (Module.annihilator_eq_top_iff.mp h)
  have hle : I ⊔ Module.annihilator R M ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    sup_le (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hI) (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hann)
  exact (Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
    (hle.trans (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _))).symm.lt_top



private lemma isRegularOfExistsInOfListSupAnnihilator {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Small.{v} R] (xs : List R) :
    ∀ (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M],
      Ideal.ofList xs ≠ ⊤ →
      (∃ ys : List R, ys.length = xs.length ∧
        (∀ y ∈ ys, y ∈ Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Module.annihilator R M) ∧ IsRegular M ys) →
      IsRegular M xs := by

  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro M _ _ _ _ hseq
    obtain ⟨ys, hlen, _, hys⟩ := hseq
    have heq : ys = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hlen
    simpa only [heq] using hys
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro M _ _ _ hproper hseq
    obtain ⟨ys, hlen, hmem, hys⟩ := hseq
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
    | cons y ys =>


      letI : Nontrivial M := hys.nontrivial
      have hyreg := (isRegular_cons_iff M y ys).mp hys
      simp only [Ideal.ofList_cons] at hmem
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hzreg⟩ := existsRegularAddOfRegularMemSupAnnihilator x
        (Ideal.ofList xs) ⟨y, hmem y List.mem_cons_self, hyreg.1⟩
      have hI : ((Ideal.span {x} ⊔ Ideal.ofList xs) ⊔ Module.annihilator R M) •
          (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤ := by
        simpa only [Ideal.ofList_cons] using
          properSupAnnihilatorSmulLt (M := M) (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)) hproper
      have hzmem : x + t ∈ (Ideal.span {x} ⊔ Ideal.ofList xs) ⊔
          Module.annihilator R M := Ideal.mem_sup_left <|
        Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton x)))
          (Ideal.mem_sup_right ht)

      obtain ⟨zs, hzlen, hzmems, hzs⟩ := existsRegularSequenceOnQuotient M
        ((Ideal.span {x} ⊔ Ideal.ofList xs) ⊔ Module.annihilator R M) xs.length hI
        hzmem hzreg ⟨y :: ys, hlen, hmem, hys⟩
      have hle := ofListConsLeTailSupQuotientAnnihilator (M := M) x xs ht
      rw [Ideal.ofList_cons] at hle
      have htailproper : Ideal.ofList xs ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro htop
        apply hproper
        rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, htop, sup_top_eq]
      have htail := ih (QuotSMulTop (x + t) M) htailproper
        ⟨zs, hzlen, fun z hz => hle (hzmems z hz), hzs⟩

      exact isRegularConsOfAddMemTail x xs ht (IsRegular.cons hzreg htail)




theorem isRegular_of_exists_ofList {R : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (xs : List R) (hproper : Ideal.ofList xs ≠ ⊤)
    (hcontains : ∃ ys : List R, ys.length = xs.length ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ys, y ∈ Ideal.ofList xs) ∧ IsRegular M ys) :
    IsRegular M xs := by

  apply (ULift.moduleEquiv.isRegular_congr xs).mp
  apply isRegularOfExistsInOfListSupAnnihilator xs (ULift.{u} M) hproper
  obtain ⟨ys, hlen, hmem, hys⟩ := hcontains
  exact ⟨ys, hlen, fun y hy => Ideal.mem_sup_left (hmem y hy),
    (ULift.moduleEquiv.isRegular_congr ys).mpr hys⟩

theorem nhdsKer_eq_iff_exists_sInter {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (s : Set X) :
    nhdsKer s = s ↔ ∃ U : Set (Set X), (∀ V ∈ U, IsOpen V) ∧ s = ⋂₀ U := by
  constructor
  · intro h

    refine ⟨{V | IsOpen V ∧ s ⊆ V}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun V hV ↦ hV.1
    · exact h.symm.trans (nhdsKer_def s)
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩

    refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ subset_nhdsKer
    exact Set.subset_sInter fun V hV ↦
      nhdsKer_minimal (Set.sInter_subset_of_mem hV) (hU V hV)




#check IsOpen.nhdsKer_eq
#check nhdsKer_eq_of_t1Space



theorem nhdsKer_singleton_false_ne : nhdsKer ({False} : Set Prop) ≠ {False} := by

  rw [nhdsKer_singleton_eq_ker_nhds, nhds_false, Filter.ker_top]
  intro h
  have hTrue : True ∈ ({False} : Set Prop) := h ▸ Set.mem_univ True
  exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hTrue).mp trivial



theorem t1Space_iff_forall_nhdsKer_eq (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    T1Space X ↔ ∀ s : Set X, nhdsKer s = s := by
  constructor
  · intro h

    exact fun s ↦ nhdsKer_eq_of_t1Space s
  · intro h

    refine t1Space_iff_specializes_imp_eq.mpr ?_
    intro x y hxy
    have hx : x ∈ nhdsKer {y} := mem_nhdsKer_singleton.mpr hxy
    simpa only [h {y}, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx

private lemma coePosMulLeCoePosMulIff (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (a b : EReal) :
    (c : EReal) * a ≤ (c : EReal) * b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  constructor
  · intro h

    have hcancel := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h
      (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr (inv_pos.mpr hc).le)
    simpa only [← mul_assoc, ← EReal.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne',
      EReal.coe_one, one_mul] using hcancel
  · intro h

    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hc.le)

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]


private lemma smulMemSubdifferentialPosMulIff (f : E → EReal) (x v : E)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    c • v ∈ EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ (c : EReal) * f z) x ↔
      v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x := by

  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential, EReal.mem_subdifferential]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro z
  rw [real_inner_smul_left, EReal.coe_mul,
    ← EReal.left_distrib_of_nonneg_of_ne_top (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
      (EReal.coe_ne_top c), coePosMulLeCoePosMulIff c hc]


private lemma subdifferentialZero (x : E) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : EReal)) x = ({0} : Set E) := by
  ext v
  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hv

    apply real_inner_self_nonpos.mp
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, zero_add, EReal.coe_zero] using hv (x + v)
  · rintro rfl

    intro z
    simp only [inner_zero_left, EReal.coe_zero, zero_add, le_refl]

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]



theorem subdifferentialPosMul (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) (hc : 0 < c) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ (c : EReal) * f z) x =
      c • EReal.subdifferential f x := by

  ext v
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hc.ne',
    ← smulMemSubdifferentialPosMulIff f x (c⁻¹ • v) c hc]
  simp only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]



theorem subdifferentialZeroMul (f : E → EReal) (x : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hsub : (EReal.subdifferential f x).Nonempty) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun z ↦ (0 : EReal) * f z) x =
      (0 : ℝ) • EReal.subdifferential f x := by

  simpa only [zero_mul, Set.zero_smul_set hsub, Set.singleton_zero] using
    subdifferentialZero x

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)




def componentBipartiteGraph (S : Set V) :
    SimpleGraph (S ⊕ (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :=
  fromRel fun x y ↦
    match x, y with
    | Sum.inl s, Sum.inr C => ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ G.Adj s c
    | _, _ => False



theorem componentBipartiteGraph_adj (S : Set V) (s : S)
    (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :
    (G.componentBipartiteGraph S).Adj (Sum.inl s) (Sum.inr C) ↔
      ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ G.Adj s c := by

  simp only [componentBipartiteGraph, fromRel_adj, or_false]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro heq
      cases heq
    · exact h


theorem isBipartiteWith_componentBipartiteGraph (S : Set V) :
    (G.componentBipartiteGraph S).IsBipartiteWith
      (Set.range Sum.inl) (Set.range Sum.inr) := by

  constructor
  · refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩ ⟨C, hC⟩
    cases hC
  · intro x y hxy
    cases x with
    | inl s =>
      cases y with
      | inl t =>
        simp only [componentBipartiteGraph, fromRel_adj, or_self, and_false] at hxy
      | inr C => exact Or.inl ⟨⟨s, rfl⟩, ⟨C, rfl⟩⟩
    | inr C =>
      cases y with
      | inl s => exact Or.inr ⟨⟨C, rfl⟩, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
      | inr D =>
        simp only [componentBipartiteGraph, fromRel_adj, or_self, and_false] at hxy



def matchableToComponents (S : Set V) : Prop :=
  ∃ M : (G.componentBipartiteGraph S).Subgraph,
    M.IsMatching ∧ Set.range Sum.inl ⊆ M.support



private lemma existsMatchingCoveringLeft_iff_exists_embedding {α β : Type*}
    (H : SimpleGraph (α ⊕ β))
    (hH : H.IsBipartiteWith (Set.range Sum.inl) (Set.range Sum.inr)) :
    (∃ M : H.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ Set.range Sum.inl ⊆ M.support) ↔
      ∃ f : α ↪ β, ∀ a, H.Adj (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr (f a)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hM, hcover⟩

    have neighbors (a : α) : ∃ b : β, M.Adj (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr b) := by
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (M.mem_support).mp (hcover ⟨a, rfl⟩)
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hH.mem_of_mem_adj ⟨a, rfl⟩ (M.adj_sub hw)
      exact ⟨b, hw⟩
    choose f hf using neighbors

    have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro a a' haa'
      have hedge : M.Adj (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr (f a')) := haa' ▸ hf a
      exact Sum.inl_injective (hM.eq_of_adj_right hedge (hf a'))
    exact ⟨⟨f, hinj⟩, fun a ↦ M.adj_sub (hf a)⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩


    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun a ↦ (Sum.inr (f a) : α ⊕ β)) :=
      Sum.inr_injective.comp f.injective
    let e := (Equiv.Set.rangeInl α β).trans (Equiv.ofInjective _ hinj)
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range (Sum.inl : α → α ⊕ β))
        (Set.range (fun a ↦ (Sum.inr (f a) : α ⊕ β))) := by
      refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
      cases hb
    have hadj : ∀ v : Set.range (Sum.inl : α → α ⊕ β), H.Adj v (e v) := by
      rintro ⟨_, a, rfl⟩
      simpa [e] using hf a
    obtain ⟨M, hverts, hM⟩ :=
      Subgraph.IsMatching.exists_of_disjoint_sets_of_equiv hdisj e hadj
    refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩

    rw [hM.support_eq_verts, hverts]
    exact Set.subset_union_left



theorem matchableToComponents_iff_exists_embedding (S : Set V) :
    G.matchableToComponents S ↔
      ∃ f : S ↪ (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent,
        ∀ s : S, ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ (f s).supp ∧ G.Adj s c := by

  simpa only [matchableToComponents, componentBipartiteGraph_adj] using
    existsMatchingCoveringLeft_iff_exists_embedding (G.componentBipartiteGraph S)
      (G.isBipartiteWith_componentBipartiteGraph S)


theorem matchableToComponents_empty : G.matchableToComponents (∅ : Set V) := by

  refine ⟨⊥, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact False.elim hv
  · rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact False.elim s.property

end SimpleGraph

private lemma memNormSubdifferentialIff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x v : E) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential (fun y : E ↦ (‖y‖ : EReal)) x ↔
      ‖v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ inner ℝ v x = ‖x‖ := by

  simp only [EReal.mem_subdifferential, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff,
    inner_sub_right]
  constructor
  · intro h

    have hzero := h 0
    have htwo := h ((2 : ℝ) • x)
    simp only [inner_zero_right, norm_zero] at hzero
    simp only [inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_two : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)] at htwo
    have hcontact : inner ℝ v x = ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hv := h v
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hcontact] at hv
    have hvle : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
    exact ⟨hvle, hcontact⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, hcontact⟩ z

    have hbound := real_inner_le_norm v z
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (norm_nonneg z)
    rw [hcontact]
    linarith



theorem euclideanNorm_subdifferentiableAt_all {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    EReal.subdifferentiableAt (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ (‖y‖ : EReal)) x := by

  refine Set.nonempty_def.mpr ?_
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    refine ⟨0, (memNormSubdifferentialIff 0 0).mpr ?_⟩
    simp only [norm_zero, zero_le_one, inner_zero_left, and_self]
  · have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
    refine ⟨‖x‖⁻¹ • x, (memNormSubdifferentialIff x _).mpr ?_⟩
    constructor
    · simp [norm_smul, hnorm]
    · simp [inner_smul_left, hnorm, pow_two]


private lemma absoluteValueNotDifferentiableAtZero :
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (abs : ℝ → ℝ) 0 := by

  intro h
  have hpos : deriv abs (0 : ℝ) = 1 :=
    (uniqueDiffOn_Ici _ _ Set.self_mem_Ici).eq_deriv _ h.hasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
      ((hasDerivWithinAt_id _ _).congr_of_mem
        (fun _ hy ↦ abs_of_nonneg hy) Set.self_mem_Ici)
  have hneg : deriv abs (0 : ℝ) = -1 :=
    (uniqueDiffOn_Iic _ _ Set.self_mem_Iic).eq_deriv _ h.hasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
      ((hasDerivWithinAt_neg _ _).congr_of_mem
        (fun _ hy ↦ abs_of_nonpos hy) Set.self_mem_Iic)
  linarith


private lemma normDifferentiableAtNonzero {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x : E) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E ↦ ‖y‖) x := by

  have hinner : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E ↦ inner ℝ y y) x :=
    ((isBoundedBilinearMap_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)).differentiableAt (x, x)).comp
      (f := fun y : E ↦ (y, y)) x (differentiableAt_id.prodMk differentiableAt_id)
  have hnonzero : inner ℝ x x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)
  simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] using
    hinner.sqrt hnonzero



theorem euclideanNorm_differentiableAt_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ ‖y‖) x ↔ x ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h hx
    subst x

    have hline : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ t • EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 : ℝ)) 0 :=
      differentiableAt_id.smul_const _
    have hbase : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ ‖y‖)
        ((0 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [zero_smul] using h
    have hcomp := hbase.comp (f := fun t : ℝ ↦
      t • EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 : ℝ)) 0 hline
    apply absoluteValueNotDifferentiableAtZero
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, norm_smul, PiLp.norm_single, norm_one,
      mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hcomp
  · exact normDifferentiableAtNonzero x



theorem euclideanNorm_subdifferential_zero (n : ℕ) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ (‖y‖ : EReal)) 0 =
      {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ‖v‖ ≤ 1} := by

  ext v
  simp only [memNormSubdifferentialIff, inner_zero_right, norm_zero,
    and_true, Set.mem_setOf_eq]



theorem euclideanNorm_subdifferential_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    EReal.subdifferential (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ (‖y‖ : EReal)) x =
      {‖x‖⁻¹ • x} := by

  ext v
  rw [memNormSubdifferentialIff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
  have hpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, hc⟩
    have hbound := real_inner_le_norm v x
    have hvone : ‖v‖ = 1 := by nlinarith
    have hinner : inner ℝ v x = ‖v‖ * ‖x‖ := by rw [hc, hvone, one_mul]
    have halign : ‖x‖ • v = ‖v‖ • x := inner_eq_norm_mul_iff_real.mp hinner
    rw [hvone, one_smul] at halign
    calc
      v = ‖x‖⁻¹ • (‖x‖ • v) := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnorm, one_smul]
      _ = ‖x‖⁻¹ • x := congrArg (fun y ↦ ‖x‖⁻¹ • y) halign
  · intro hv
    subst v
    constructor
    · simp [norm_smul, hnorm]
    · simp [inner_smul_left, hnorm, pow_two]

namespace Chebyshev


private def signedCoordinateVectors (n : ℕ) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
  Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∪
    Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ -EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))


private lemma signedCoordinateSupport {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∀ z a, a ∈ signedCoordinateVectors n → inner ℝ a z ≤ norm z hn) ∧
      (∀ z, ∃ a ∈ signedCoordinateVectors n, norm z hn = inner ℝ a z) := by
  constructor
  · intro z a ha

    have hz := (norm_le_iff z hn (norm z hn)).mp le_rfl
    rcases ha with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul] using
        (le_abs_self (z i)).trans (hz i)
    · simpa only [inner_neg_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul] using
        (neg_le_abs (z i)).trans (hz i)
  · intro z

    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'
      (s := Finset.univ) ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ (fun i : Fin n ↦ |z i|)
    have hmax : norm z hn = |z i| := hi
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ z i
    · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i 1, Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hsign] using hmax
    · refine ⟨-EuclideanSpace.single i 1, Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa only [inner_neg_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul,
        abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hsign)] using hmax


private lemma normPositive {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : x ≠ 0) : 0 < norm x hn := by

  by_contra h
  have hcoords := (norm_le_iff x hn 0).mp (le_of_not_gt h)
  apply hx
  ext i
  exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm (hcoords i) (abs_nonneg _))


private lemma activeSignedCoordinateRange {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    signedCoordinateVectors n ∩ {v | inner ℝ v x = norm x hn} =
      Set.range (fun i : {j : Fin n // |x j| = norm x hn} ↦
        Real.sign (x i.1) • EuclideanSpace.single i.1 (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hnorm := normPositive hn x hx
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, hc⟩

    rcases hv with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hc
      have hpos : 0 < x i := by linarith
      have hactive : |x i| = norm x hn := by rwa [abs_of_pos hpos]
      refine ⟨⟨i, hactive⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Real.sign_of_pos hpos, one_smul]
    · simp only [inner_neg_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hc
      have hneg : x i < 0 := by linarith
      have hactive : |x i| = norm x hn := by rwa [abs_of_neg hneg]
      refine ⟨⟨i, hactive⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Real.sign_of_neg hneg, neg_one_smul]
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩

    rcases lt_trichotomy (x i.1) 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
    · simp only [Real.sign_of_neg hneg, neg_one_smul]
      refine ⟨Or.inr ⟨i.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, inner_neg_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left,
        map_one, one_mul, abs_of_neg hneg] using i.property
    · have hactive := i.property
      rw [hzero, abs_zero] at hactive
      linarith
    · simp only [Real.sign_of_pos hpos, one_smul]
      refine ⟨Or.inl ⟨i.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left,
        map_one, one_mul, abs_of_pos hpos] using i.property

end Chebyshev



theorem chebyshevNorm_subdifferential_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    EReal.subdifferential
        (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ (Chebyshev.norm y hn : EReal)) 0 =
      convexHull ℝ
        (Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∪
          Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ -EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) := by

  have hfinite : (Chebyshev.signedCoordinateVectors n).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_range _).union (Set.finite_range _)
  obtain ⟨hbound, hattain⟩ := Chebyshev.signedCoordinateSupport hn
  ext v
  rw [EReal.memFiniteSupportSubdifferentialIff _ hfinite _ hbound hattain]
  simp [Chebyshev.signedCoordinateVectors, inner_zero_right, Chebyshev.norm]




theorem chebyshevNorm_subdifferential_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    EReal.subdifferential
        (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ (Chebyshev.norm y hn : EReal)) x =
      convexHull ℝ (Set.range
        (fun i : {j : Fin n // |x j| = Chebyshev.norm x hn} ↦
          Real.sign (x i.1) • EuclideanSpace.single i.1 (1 : ℝ))) := by

  have hfinite : (Chebyshev.signedCoordinateVectors n).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_range _).union (Set.finite_range _)
  obtain ⟨hbound, hattain⟩ := Chebyshev.signedCoordinateSupport hn
  have hface :
      convexHull ℝ (Chebyshev.signedCoordinateVectors n) ∩
          {v | inner ℝ v x = Chebyshev.norm x hn} =
        convexHull ℝ (Chebyshev.signedCoordinateVectors n ∩
          {v | inner ℝ v x = Chebyshev.norm x hn}) :=
    convexHullInterLevelSet _ ((innerₗ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).flip x) _ (hbound x)
  rw [Chebyshev.activeSignedCoordinateRange hn x hx] at hface
  ext v
  rw [EReal.memFiniteSupportSubdifferentialIff _ hfinite _ hbound hattain]

  exact Set.ext_iff.mp hface v

namespace Metric



noncomputable def projection {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : H) : H :=
  Classical.choose
    (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hCne hCclosed.isComplete hCconvex x)


theorem projection_mem {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty) (hCclosed : IsClosed C)
    (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : H) :
    projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x ∈ C := by

  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hCne hCclosed.isComplete hCconvex x)).1


theorem dist_projection_eq_infDist {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : H) :
    dist x (projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x) = infDist x C := by

  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, infDist_eq_iInf, projection] using
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hCne hCclosed.isComplete hCconvex x)).2


theorem projection_unique {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty) (hCclosed : IsClosed C)
    (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x y : H) (hy : y ∈ C)
    (hmin : dist x y = infDist x C) :
    y = projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x := by

  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hp_mem : p ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hp_min : ‖x - p‖ = ⨅ w : C, ‖x - w‖ :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hCne hCclosed.isComplete hCconvex x)).2
  have hy_min : ‖x - y‖ = ⨅ w : C, ‖x - w‖ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, infDist_eq_iInf] using hmin
  have hp_var :=
    (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hCconvex hp_mem).mp hp_min
  have hy_var :=
    (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hCconvex hy).mp hy_min
  have hxy_nonneg : 0 ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (y - p) := by
    have hp_sub : p - y = -(y - p) := by abel
    have hneg : inner ℝ (x - y) (p - y) = -inner ℝ (x - y) (y - p) := by
      rw [hp_sub, inner_neg_right]
    linarith [hy_var p hp_mem, hneg]
  have hx_decomp : x - p = (x - y) + (y - p) := by
    abel
  have hsum : inner ℝ (x - p) (y - p) =
      inner ℝ (x - y) (y - p) + inner ℝ (y - p) (y - p) := by
    rw [hx_decomp, inner_add_left]
  have hsq_nonpos : inner ℝ (y - p) (y - p) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith [hp_var y hy, hsum]
  have hsq_zero : inner ℝ (y - p) (y - p) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm hsq_nonpos real_inner_self_nonneg
  have hdiff_zero : y - p = 0 := inner_self_eq_zero.mp hsq_zero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff_zero

end Metric

      h.linear_image (LinearMap.fst ℝ H ℝ)

variable {V : Type u} {E : Type v}


private def leavingEdges (G : Graph V E) (A : Set V) : Set E :=
  {e | ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∉ A, G.IsLink e x y}


private lemma leavingEdgesSubset (G : Graph V E) (A : Set V) :
    G.leavingEdges A ⊆ G.edgeSet := by

  rintro e ⟨x, _, y, _, hxy⟩
  exact hxy.edge_mem


private lemma memOfReachableDeleteLeavingEdges (G : Graph V E) (A : Set V)
    {x y : V} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.deleteEdges (G.leavingEdges A)).Adj x y)
    (hx : x ∈ A) : y ∈ A := by

  induction h with
  | refl => exact hx
  | @tail y z _ hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hyz
    by_contra hz
    exact he.2 ⟨y, ih, z, hz, he.1⟩


private lemma edgeConnectivityLeLeavingEdgesNcard (G : Graph V E)
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite) {m : ℕ} (h_connected : G.IsEdgeConnected m)
    (A : Set V) (h_inside : (G.vertexSet ∩ A).Nonempty)
    (h_outside : (G.vertexSet \ A).Nonempty) : m ≤ (G.leavingEdges A).ncard := by

  by_contra hcard
  obtain ⟨x, hxG, hxA⟩ := h_inside
  obtain ⟨y, hyG, hyA⟩ := h_outside
  have hreach := (G.isEdgeConnected_iff_deleteEdges h_edges m).mp h_connected
    (G.leavingEdges A) (G.leavingEdgesSubset A) (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hcard) x hxG y hyG
  exact hyA (G.memOfReachableDeleteLeavingEdges A hreach hxA)


private lemma leavingEdgesSubsetCrossEdges (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet)
    {A : Set V} (hA : A ∈ P.parts) : G.leavingEdges A ⊆ G.crossEdges P := by

  rintro e ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩
  refine ⟨x, y, hxy, ?_⟩
  intro hrel
  exact hy ((hrel.forall hA).mp hx)


private lemma leavingEdgePartsSubset (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet)
    {e : E} {x y : V} (hxy : G.IsLink e x y) :
    {A : Set V | A ∈ P.parts ∧ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A} ⊆ {P.partOf x, P.partOf y} := by

  rintro A ⟨hA, z, hz, w, _, hzw⟩
  rcases hzw.left_eq_or_eq hxy with hzx | hzy
  · exact Or.inl (P.eq_partOf_of_mem hA (hzx ▸ hz))
  · exact Or.inr (P.eq_partOf_of_mem hA (hzy ▸ hz))



private lemma edgeConnectivityLePartCut (G : Graph V E)
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite) {m : ℕ} (h_connected : G.IsEdgeConnected m)
    (P : Partition G.vertexSet) (hfinite : P.parts.Finite)
    (hparts : 1 < P.parts.ncard) {A : Set V} (hA : A ∈ P.parts) :
    m ≤ (G.leavingEdges A).ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := P.nonempty_of_mem hA
  have hcard : 1 < hfinite.toFinset.card := by
    rwa [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfinite]
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBA⟩ := hfinite.toFinset.exists_mem_ne hcard A
  have hBP : B ∈ P.parts := hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hB
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := P.nonempty_of_mem hBP
  have hyA : y ∉ A := by
    intro hyA
    exact hBA (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem hBP hA hy hyA)
  exact G.edgeConnectivityLeLeavingEdgesNcard h_edges h_connected A
    ⟨x, P.subset_of_mem hA hx, hx⟩ ⟨y, P.subset_of_mem hBP hy, hyA⟩



private lemma edgeConnectivityMulPartsLeTwiceCrossEdges (G : Graph V E)
    (h_vertices : G.vertexSet.Finite) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    {m : ℕ} (h_connected : G.IsEdgeConnected m) (P : Partition G.vertexSet)
    (hparts : 1 < P.parts.ncard) :
    m * P.parts.ncard ≤ 2 * (G.crossEdges P).ncard := by
  classical
  have hfinite : P.parts.Finite := h_vertices.powerset.subset (fun _ hA ↦ P.subset_of_mem hA)
  have hcross : (G.crossEdges P).Finite := h_edges.subset (G.crossEdges_subset P)

  have hlower (A : Set V) (hA : A ∈ hfinite.toFinset) :
      m ≤ (hcross.toFinset.bipartiteAbove (fun A e ↦ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A) A).card := by
    have hAP : A ∈ P.parts := hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hA
    have hcut := h_edges.subset (G.leavingEdgesSubset A)
    have habove : hcross.toFinset.bipartiteAbove (fun A e ↦ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A) A =
        hcut.toFinset := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨And.right, fun he ↦ ⟨G.leavingEdgesSubsetCrossEdges P hAP he, he⟩⟩
    rw [habove, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hcut]
    exact G.edgeConnectivityLePartCut h_edges h_connected P hfinite hparts hAP

  have hupper (e : E) (he : e ∈ hcross.toFinset) :
      (hfinite.toFinset.bipartiteBelow (fun A e ↦ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A) e).card ≤ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, _⟩ := hcross.mem_toFinset.mp he
    have hsub : hfinite.toFinset.bipartiteBelow (fun A e ↦ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A) e ⊆
        {P.partOf x, P.partOf y} := by
      intro A hA
      obtain ⟨hAP, hcut⟩ := (Finset.mem_bipartiteBelow _).mp hA
      have hmem := G.leavingEdgePartsSubset P hxy ⟨hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hAP, hcut⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Finset.mem_insert,
        Finset.mem_singleton] using hmem
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans Finset.card_le_two
  have hcount := Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul (fun A e ↦ e ∈ G.leavingEdges A) hlower hupper
  simpa only [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfinite,
    ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hcross, Nat.mul_comm] using hcount

end Graph





theorem Graph.existsSpanningTrees {V : Type u} {E : Type v} (G : Graph V E)
    (h_vertices : G.vertexSet.Finite) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (h_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (h_connected : G.IsEdgeConnected (2 * k)) :
    ∃ T : Fin k → Graph V E,
      (∀ i, (T i).IsSpanningSubgraph G ∧ (T i).IsTree) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (T i).edgeSet (T j).edgeSet) := by

  apply (G.nashWilliamsTutte h_vertices h_edges h_nonempty k hk).mpr
  intro P
  by_cases hparts : P.parts.ncard ≤ 1
  · simp only [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hparts, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_le]
  · have hcount := G.edgeConnectivityMulPartsLeTwiceCrossEdges h_vertices h_edges
      h_connected P (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hparts)

    have hbound : k * P.parts.ncard ≤ (G.crossEdges P).ncard := by
      rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hcount
      exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hcount (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (Nat.sub_le P.parts.ncard 1)).trans hbound

lemma existsPositiveSmulMemOfInterior {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {S : Set E} (hS : (0 : E) ∈ interior S) (e : E) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t • e ∈ S := by

  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ t • e) := continuous_id.smul continuous_const
  have hnhds : S ∈ nhds ((0 : ℝ) • e) := by
    simpa only [zero_smul] using mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hS
  have hn : {t : ℝ | t • e ∈ S} ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) := by
    exact hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hnhds
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨ε / 2, half_pos hε, hball ?_⟩
  simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (half_pos hε)]
    using half_lt_self hε



lemma existsLinearMinorantOfInteriorProjection {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (C : Set (E × ℝ)) (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hzero : 0 ∈ C)
    (hproj : (0 : E) ∈ interior (Prod.fst '' C))
    (hvertical : ∀ r : ℝ, (0, r) ∈ C → 0 ≤ r) :
    ∃ L : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ p ∈ C, L p.1 ≤ p.2 := by
  let K := ConvexCone.hull ℝ C
  have hKzero : K.Pointed := ConvexCone.subset_hull hzero
  let F := LinearPMap.snd (⊥ : Submodule ℝ E) (⊤ : Submodule ℝ ℝ)

  have hnonneg : ∀ p : F.domain, (p : E × ℝ) ∈ K.toPointedCone hKzero → 0 ≤ F p := by
    rintro ⟨⟨y, r⟩, hp⟩ hk
    have hy : y = 0 := hp.1
    subst y
    rcases (ConvexCone.mem_hull_of_convex hC).mp hk with
      ⟨t, ht, ⟨qy, qr⟩, hq, heq⟩
    have hfirst : t • qy = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hqy : qy = 0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hfirst).resolve_left ht.ne'
    subst qy
    have hheight : t * qr = r := congrArg Prod.snd heq
    simpa only [F, LinearPMap.snd_apply, ← hheight] using
      mul_nonneg ht.le (hvertical qr hq)

  have hdense : ∀ p : E × ℝ, ∃ a : F.domain,
      (a : E × ℝ) + p ∈ K.toPointedCone hKzero := by
    rintro ⟨y, r⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ⟨qy, qr⟩, hq, hqy⟩ := existsPositiveSmulMemOfInterior hproj y
    dsimp only at hqy
    refine ⟨⟨(0, t⁻¹ * qr - r), ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, Submodule.mem_top⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have heq : (0, t⁻¹ * qr - r) + (y, r) = t⁻¹ • (qy, qr) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add, Prod.smul_mk, hqy,
          inv_smul_smul₀ ht.ne']
      · exact sub_add_cancel _ _
    rw [heq]
    exact K.smul_mem (inv_pos.mpr ht) (ConvexCone.subset_hull hq)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := riesz_extension (K.toPointedCone hKzero) F hnonneg hdense
  have hvertical' (r : ℝ) : g (0, r) = r :=
    hg ⟨(0, r), ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, Submodule.mem_top⟩⟩

  refine ⟨-g.comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have h := hgpos p (ConvexCone.subset_hull hp)
  have heq : g p = g (p.1, 0) + p.2 := by
    calc
      g p = g ((p.1, 0) + (0, p.2)) := by simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk,
        add_zero, zero_add, Prod.eta]
      _ = g (p.1, 0) + p.2 := by rw [map_add, hvertical']
  simp only [LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.inl_apply]
  rw [heq, add_comm] at h
  exact neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.mpr h

end ConvexAnalysis

    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E : Type v) [MeasurableSpace E] [AddCommMonoid E] where

  step : ℕ → Ω → E

  independent : iIndepFun step μ

  identDistrib_step_zero (k : ℕ) : IdentDistrib (step k) (step 0) μ μ

  [MeasurableSpace E] [AddCommMonoid E]


def ofIID (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ℕ → Ω → E)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hIdent : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (X k) (X 0) μ μ)
    (hDiscrete : ∀ k, (Set.range (X k)).Countable) : RandomWalk μ E where
  step := X
  measurable_step := hMeas
  independent := hIndep
  identDistrib_step_zero := hIdent
  countable_range_step := hDiscrete


theorem ofIID_step (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ℕ → Ω → E)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hIdent : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (X k) (X 0) μ μ)
    (hDiscrete : ∀ k, (Set.range (X k)).Countable) :
    (ofIID μ X hMeas hIndep hIdent hDiscrete).step = X := by

  rfl

variable {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]


def position (w : RandomWalk μ E) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : E :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, w.step k ω


theorem position_apply (w : RandomWalk μ E) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    w.position n ω = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, w.step k ω := by

  rfl


theorem position_zero (w : RandomWalk μ E) (ω : Ω) : w.position 0 ω = 0 := by

  simp only [position_apply, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]


theorem position_succ (w : RandomWalk μ E) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    w.position (n + 1) ω = w.position n ω + w.step n ω := by

  simp only [position_apply, Finset.sum_range_succ]


theorem iid_spec (w : RandomWalk μ E) :
    iIndepFun w.step μ ∧ ∀ k, IdentDistrib (w.step k) (w.step 0) μ μ := by

  exact ⟨w.independent, w.identDistrib_step_zero⟩


theorem discrete_spec (w : RandomWalk μ E) (k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (w.step k) ∧ (Set.range (w.step k)).Countable := by

  exact ⟨w.measurable_step k, w.countable_range_step k⟩

private lemma EReal.lineSlopeNegParameter {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x y : E) (t : ℝ) :
    (f (x + (-t) • y) - f x) / ((-t : ℝ) : EReal) =
      -((f (x + t • (-y)) - f x) / (t : EReal)) := by

  rw [neg_smul, smul_neg, EReal.coe_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv,
    EReal.inv_neg, mul_neg]


private lemma EReal.rightLineDerivIffLeftLineSlope {E : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] {f : E → EReal} {d : EReal} {x y : E} :
    HasRightLineDerivAt f d x (-y) ↔
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))
        (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (-d)) := by

  have negLeft : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ -t) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝[>] 0) := by
    refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [neg_zero] using
        (continuous_neg.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
      exact Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (neg_pos.mpr (Set.mem_Iio.mp ht))
  have negRight : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ -t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[<] 0) := by
    refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [neg_zero] using
        (continuous_neg.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
      exact Set.mem_Iio.mpr (neg_neg_of_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mp ht))

  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [HasRightLineDerivAt, Function.comp_def, lineSlopeNegParameter, neg_neg] using
      (h.comp negLeft).neg
  · intro h
    simpa only [HasRightLineDerivAt, Function.comp_def, lineSlopeNegParameter, neg_neg] using
      (h.comp negRight).neg




theorem hasRightLineDerivAt_iff (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥) :
    HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y ↔
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 d) := by

  rfl



theorem tendstoLeftLineSlope (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    (h : HasRightLineDerivAt f d x (-y)) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))
      (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (-d)) := by

  exact EReal.rightLineDerivIffLeftLineSlope.mp h




theorem tendstoLineSlope_iff (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    (h : HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))
        (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 d) ↔ HasRightLineDerivAt f (-d) x (-y) := by

  rw [EReal.rightLineDerivIffLeftLineSlope, neg_neg]
  constructor
  · intro htwo
    exact htwo.mono_left (nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE 0)
  · intro hleft

    rw [← nhdsLT_sup_nhdsGT]
    exact hleft.sup h




theorem hasRightLineDerivAt_of_differentiableAt (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    {g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ}
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z ↦ (g z : EReal))) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    HasRightLineDerivAt f (inner ℝ (gradient g x) y : EReal) x y := by

  have hline : HasLineDerivAt ℝ g (inner ℝ (gradient g x) y) x y := by
    simpa only [inner_gradient_left] using hg.hasFDerivAt.hasLineDerivAt y

  exact (EReal.hasRightLineDerivAt_congr hfg).mpr hline.erealRight




theorem tendstoLineSlope_of_differentiableAt (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    {g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ}
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z ↦ (g z : EReal))) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))
      (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (inner ℝ (gradient g x) y : EReal)) := by

  have hright := hasRightLineDerivAt_of_differentiableAt hx_top hx_bot hfg hg (y := y)
  have hreverse := hasRightLineDerivAt_of_differentiableAt hx_top hx_bot hfg hg (y := -y)

  apply (tendstoLineSlope_iff hx_top hx_bot hright).mpr
  simpa only [inner_neg_right, EReal.coe_neg] using hreverse



theorem rightLineDeriv_eq_inner_gradient (hx_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (hx_bot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    {g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ}
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z ↦ (g z : EReal))) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    rightLineDeriv f x y = (inner ℝ (gradient g x) y : EReal) := by

  exact (hasRightLineDerivAt_of_differentiableAt hx_top hx_bot hfg hg).rightLineDeriv
