private lemma countP_eq_card_filter {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (l : List α) (hl : l.Nodup) (p : α → Bool) :
    l.countP p = (l.toFinset.filter (fun a ↦ p a)).card := by

  rw [← List.toFinset_filter, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (hl.filter p),
    List.countP_eq_length_filter]



private lemma existsNonemptyClosedTrailOfEvenDegrees {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hne : G ≠ ⊥) (heven : ∀ v, Even (G.neighborSet v).ncard) :
    ∃ (v : V) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsTrail ∧ ¬ p.Nil := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := G.ne_bot_iff_exists_adj.mp hne
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl h => exact isEmptyElim a
  | inr h =>

    obtain ⟨u, v, p, hp, hmax⟩ := Walk.exists_isTrail_forall_isTrail_length_le_length G
    have covered (w : V) (huw : G.Adj u w) : s(u, w) ∈ p.edges := by
      by_contra hn
      have hn' : s(w, u) ∉ p.edges := by simpa only [Sym2.eq_swap] using hn
      have hm := hmax w v (p.cons huw.symm) (hp.cons huw.symm hn')
      simp only [Walk.length_cons] at hm
      omega
    have incidence : p.edges.toFinset.filter (fun e ↦ u ∈ e) = G.incidenceFinset u := by
      ext e
      induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
      | _ x y =>
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, List.mem_toFinset, mem_incidenceFinset,
          mk'_mem_incidenceSet_iff, Sym2.mem_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hedge, hu⟩
          exact ⟨G.mem_edgeSet.mp (p.edges_subset_edgeSet hedge), hu⟩
        · rintro ⟨hxy, rfl | rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨covered y hxy, Or.inl rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨Sym2.eq_swap ▸ covered x hxy.symm, Or.inr rfl⟩
    have countDegree : p.edges.countP (fun e ↦ u ∈ e) = (G.neighborSet u).ncard := by
      rw [countP_eq_card_filter p.edges hp.edges_nodup]
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      rw [incidence, G.card_incidenceFinset_eq_degree, degree_eq_ncard_neighbors]
    have huv : u = v := by
      by_contra huv
      have parity := (hp.even_countP_edges_iff u).mp (countDegree ▸ heven u)
      exact (parity huv).1 rfl
    have hpositive : 0 < p.length := by
      have hsingle : (Walk.cons hab Walk.nil).IsTrail := by simp
      have hm := hmax a b (Walk.cons hab Walk.nil) hsingle
      simpa only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] using
        (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm)

    subst v
    exact ⟨u, p, hp, Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpositive⟩




private lemma existsPermOfRegularRelation {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (r : V → V → Prop) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hout : ∀ x, ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = k)
    (hin : ∀ y, ({x | r x y} : Set V).ncard = k) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm V, ∀ x, r x (e x) := by
  classical
  let t : V → Finset V := fun x ↦ {y | r x y}.toFinset

  have hall (s : Finset V) : s.card ≤ (s.biUnion t).card := by
    have above (x : V) (hx : x ∈ s) :
        (s.biUnion t).bipartiteAbove r x = t x := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove, Finset.mem_biUnion,
        t, Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨x, hx, h⟩, h⟩⟩
    have below (y : V) : s.bipartiteBelow r y ⊆ {x | r x y}.toFinset := by
      intro x hx
      exact Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ((Finset.mem_bipartiteBelow r).mp hx).2
    have bound := Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul r
      (s := s) (t := s.biUnion t) (m := k) (n := k)
      (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun y _ ↦ ?_)
    · exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right bound hk
    · rw [above x hx, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
      exact (hout x).ge
    · rw [← hin y, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
      exact Finset.card_le_card (below y)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hrel⟩ :=
    (Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective' t).mp hall

  exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective f hf.bijective_of_finite, fun x ↦ Set.mem_toFinset.mp (hrel x)⟩




private lemma neighborFinset_fromRel_perm {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (e : Equiv.Perm V) (hfix : ∀ x, e x ≠ x) (v : V) :
    (fromRel (fun x y ↦ e x = y)).neighborFinset v = {e v, e.symm v} := by
  classical

  ext w
  simp only [mem_neighborFinset, fromRel_adj, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, h | h⟩
    · exact Or.inl h.symm
    · exact Or.inr ((e.eq_symm_apply).mpr h)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨(hfix v).symm, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨fun h ↦ hfix v ((e.eq_symm_apply).mp h), Or.inr (e.apply_symm_apply v)⟩



private lemma ncard_pair_fiber {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (l : List (V × V)) (hl : l.Nodup) (x : V) :
    ({y | (x, y) ∈ l} : Set V).ncard = l.countP (fun z ↦ z.1 = x) := by
  classical
  let m := l.filter (fun z ↦ z.1 = x)

  have hm : (m.map Prod.snd).Nodup := by
    refine (hl.filter _).map_on ?_
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at ha hb
    exact Prod.ext (ha.2.trans hb.2.symm) hab
  have hf : (m.map Prod.snd).toFinset = {y | (x, y) ∈ l}.toFinset := by
    ext y
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
      simp only [m, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hab
      exact hab.2 ▸ hab.1
    · intro h
      have hm : (x, y) ∈ m := by simp only [m, List.mem_filter, h, decide_true, and_self]
      exact ⟨(x, y), hm, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← hf, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hm,
    List.length_map, List.countP_eq_length_filter]



private lemma countP_swap_fst {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V]
    (l : List (V × V)) (x : V) :
    (l.map Prod.swap).countP (fun z ↦ z.1 = x) = l.countP (fun z ↦ z.2 = x) := by

  rw [List.countP_map]
  congr 1



private lemma ncard_neighbors_eq_outgoing_add_incoming {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : V → V → Prop)
    (hasym : ∀ x y, r x y → ¬ r y x)
    (hadj : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y ↔ r x y ∨ r y x) (x : V) :
    (G.neighborSet x).ncard = ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard + ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard := by

  have hset : G.neighborSet x = {y | r x y} ∪ {y | r y x} :=
    Set.ext (hadj x)
  have hd : Disjoint {y | r x y} {y | r y x} := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    exact fun y hxy hyx ↦ hasym x y hxy hyx
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_union_eq hd]



private lemma Walk.IsTrail.existsBalancedOrientation {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V} {p : G.Walk v v} (hp : p.IsTrail) :
    ∃ r : V → V → Prop,
      (∀ x y, r x y → ¬ r y x) ∧
      (∀ x y, p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.Adj x y ↔ r x y ∨ r y x) ∧
      (∀ x, ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard ∧
        (p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.neighborSet x).ncard = 2 * ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard) := by
  classical
  let l := p.darts.map Dart.toProd
  let r : V → V → Prop := fun x y ↦ (x, y) ∈ l
  have hnodup : p.darts.Nodup := hp.edges_nodup.of_map Dart.edge
  have hl : l.Nodup := hnodup.map Dart.toProd_injective

  have hasym (x y : V) (hxy : r x y) : ¬ r y x := by
    intro hyx
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hde⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxy
    obtain ⟨d', hd', hde'⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hyx
    have hreverse : d = d'.symm := by
      apply Dart.ext
      exact hde.trans (congrArg Prod.swap hde').symm
    have heq : d.edge = d'.edge :=
      (congrArg Dart.edge hreverse).trans (Dart.edge_symm d')
    have he := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hp.edges_nodup hd hd' heq
    have hpair : (x, y) = (y, x) := hde.symm.trans ((congrArg Dart.toProd he).trans hde')
    have hne : x ≠ y := by
      have hdadj := d.adj
      have hx := congrArg Prod.fst hde
      have hy := congrArg Prod.snd hde
      rw [hx, hy] at hdadj
      exact hdadj.ne
    exact hne (congrArg Prod.fst hpair)
  have hadj (x y : V) : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.Adj x y ↔ r x y ∨ r y x := by

    rw [Subgraph.spanningCoe_adj, ← Subgraph.mem_edgeSet, p.mem_edges_toSubgraph]
    simp only [Walk.edges, List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, hd, he⟩
      rcases dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff.mp he with he | he
      · exact Or.inl (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨d, hd, he⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨d, hd, he⟩)
    · rintro (h | h)
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
        exact ⟨d, hd, dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff.mpr (Or.inl he)⟩
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
        exact ⟨d, hd, dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff.mpr (Or.inr he)⟩
  have balance (x : V) : ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard := by

    have hs : ({y | r y x} : Set V) = {y | (x, y) ∈ l.map Prod.swap} := by
      ext y
      simp only [r, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_map]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨(y, x), h, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h, he⟩
        cases he
        exact h
    rw [hs, ncard_pair_fiber l hl, ncard_pair_fiber _ (hl.map Prod.swap_injective)]
    rw [countP_swap_fst]
    have hc := (p.tail_support_perm_dropLast_support).symm.countP_eq (fun y ↦ y = x)
    simpa only [← p.map_fst_darts, ← p.map_snd_darts, List.countP_map,
      l, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using hc
  refine ⟨r, hasym, hadj, fun x ↦ ⟨balance x, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [ncard_neighbors_eq_outgoing_add_incoming _ r hasym hadj, ← balance x, two_mul]



private lemma ncard_neighbors_sdiff_add {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G C : SimpleGraph V) (hle : C ≤ G) (x : V) :
    ((G \ C).neighborSet x).ncard + (C.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet x).ncard := by
  classical

  have hset : (G \ C).neighborSet x ∪ C.neighborSet x = G.neighborSet x := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact h.1
      · exact hle h
    · intro h
      by_cases hc : C.Adj x y
      · exact Or.inr hc
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hc⟩
  have hd : Disjoint ((G \ C).neighborSet x) (C.neighborSet x) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    exact fun y h hy ↦ h.2 hy
  rw [← Set.ncard_union_eq hd, hset]



private lemma asymmetricBalancedUnion {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (r s : V → V → Prop)
    (hr : ∀ x y, r x y → ¬ r y x) (hs : ∀ x y, s x y → ¬ s y x)
    (hdis : ∀ x y, r x y → ¬ (s x y ∨ s y x))
    (hbr : ∀ x, ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard)
    (hbs : ∀ x, ({y | s x y} : Set V).ncard = ({y | s y x} : Set V).ncard) :
    (∀ x y, (r x y ∨ s x y) → ¬ (r y x ∨ s y x)) ∧
    (∀ x, ({y | r x y ∨ s x y} : Set V).ncard =
      ({y | r y x ∨ s y x} : Set V).ncard) := by

  constructor
  · intro x y hxy hyx
    rcases hxy with h | h
    · rcases hyx with h' | h'
      · exact hr x y h h'
      · exact hdis x y h (Or.inr h')
    · rcases hyx with h' | h'
      · exact hdis y x h' (Or.inr h)
      · exact hs x y h h'
  · intro x
    have hout : Disjoint {y | r x y} {y | s x y} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      exact fun y h h' ↦ hdis x y h (Or.inl h')
    have hin : Disjoint {y | r y x} {y | s y x} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      exact fun y h h' ↦ hdis y x h (Or.inl h')

    exact (Set.ncard_union_eq hout).trans
      ((congrArg₂ Nat.add (hbr x) (hbs x)).trans (Set.ncard_union_eq hin).symm)




private lemma existsBalancedOrientationOfEvenDegrees {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (heven : ∀ v, Even (G.neighborSet v).ncard) :
    ∃ r : V → V → Prop,
      (∀ x y, r x y → ¬ r y x) ∧
      (∀ x y, G.Adj x y ↔ r x y ∨ r y x) ∧
      (∀ x, ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard ∧
        (G.neighborSet x).ncard = 2 * ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard) := by
  classical

  generalize hn : G.edgeSet.ncard = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing G with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hzero : G = ⊥
    · subst G
      refine ⟨fun _ _ ↦ False, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [false_implies, implies_true]
      · simp only [bot_adj, or_self, implies_true]
      · intro x
        simp only [Set.setOf_false, Set.ncard_empty, mul_zero, neighborSet_bot, and_self]
    · obtain ⟨v, p, hp, hpn⟩ := existsNonemptyClosedTrailOfEvenDegrees G hzero heven
      let C := p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe
      have hle : C ≤ G := p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe_le
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hsadj, hsdeg⟩ := hp.existsBalancedOrientation
      have hcpos : 0 < C.edgeSet.ncard := by
        rw [Set.ncard_pos, edgeSet_nonempty]
        intro hc
        have hedge : p.edges = [] := by
          apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
          intro e he
          have hec : e ∈ C.edgeSet := p.mem_edges_toSubgraph.mpr he
          simp only [hc, edgeSet_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hec
        have hlen : p.length = 0 := by
          simpa only [Walk.length_edges, List.length_nil] using congrArg List.length hedge
        exact hpn (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlen)
      have hcard : (G \ C).edgeSet.ncard < n := by
        have hsub := edgeSet_mono hle
        have hadd := Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hsub
        rw [← edgeSet_sdiff] at hadd
        omega
      have hremain (x : V) : Even ((G \ C).neighborSet x).ncard := by
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := heven x
        have hsum := ncard_neighbors_sdiff_add G C hle x
        have hc : (C.neighborSet x).ncard = 2 * ({y | s x y} : Set V).ncard := (hsdeg x).2
        refine ⟨m - ({y | s x y} : Set V).ncard, ?_⟩
        omega
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hradj, hrdeg⟩ := ih _ hcard (G \ C) hremain rfl
      have hdis (x y : V) (hxy : r x y) : ¬ (s x y ∨ s y x) := by
        have hrem := (hradj x y).mpr (Or.inl hxy)
        exact fun hsxy ↦ hrem.2 ((hsadj x y).mpr hsxy)
      obtain ⟨hasym, hbalance⟩ := asymmetricBalancedUnion r s hr hs hdis
        (fun x ↦ (hrdeg x).1) (fun x ↦ (hsdeg x).1)
      have hadj (x y : V) : G.Adj x y ↔
          (r x y ∨ s x y) ∨ (r y x ∨ s y x) := by
        have hpartition : G.Adj x y ↔ (G \ C).Adj x y ∨ C.Adj x y := by
          constructor
          · intro hxy
            by_cases hc : C.Adj x y
            · exact Or.inr hc
            · exact Or.inl ⟨hxy, hc⟩
          · rintro (hxy | hxy)
            · exact hxy.1
            · exact hle hxy
        rw [hpartition, hradj, hsadj]
        tauto

      refine ⟨fun x y ↦ r x y ∨ s x y, hasym, hadj, fun x ↦ ⟨hbalance x, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [ncard_neighbors_eq_outgoing_add_incoming _ _ hasym hadj, ← hbalance x, two_mul]

end SimpleGraph

theorem SimpleGraph.existsTwoFactor {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree (2 * k)) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G ∧ H.IsRegularOfDegree 2 := by
  classical

  have regular (v : V) : (G.neighborSet v).ncard = 2 * k := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.degree_eq_ncard_neighbors] using hreg.degree_eq v
  have heven (v : V) : Even (G.neighborSet v).ncard := by
    rw [regular v]
    exact even_two_mul k
  obtain ⟨r, hasym, hadj, hdegree⟩ :=
    SimpleGraph.existsBalancedOrientationOfEvenDegrees G heven
  have hout (x : V) : ({y | r x y} : Set V).ncard = k := by
    have hd := (hdegree x).2
    rw [regular x] at hd
    omega
  have hin (x : V) : ({y | r y x} : Set V).ncard = k :=
    (hdegree x).1.symm.trans (hout x)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := SimpleGraph.existsPermOfRegularRelation r hk hout hin

  have hfix (x : V) : e x ≠ x := by
    intro h
    have hx := he x
    rw [h] at hx
    exact hasym x x hx hx
  have hdistinct (x : V) : e x ≠ e.symm x := by
    intro h
    have hx := he (e x)
    have hee : e (e x) = x := (congrArg e h).trans (e.apply_symm_apply x)
    rw [hee] at hx
    exact hasym x (e x) (he x) hx
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun x y ↦ e x = y), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    rcases h.2 with h | h
    · exact (hadj x y).mpr (Or.inl (h ▸ he x))
    · exact (hadj x y).mpr (Or.inr (h ▸ he y))
  · intro x
    have hc := (congrArg Finset.card
      (SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_fromRel_perm e hfix x)).trans
      (Finset.card_pair (hdistinct x))
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, SimpleGraph.coe_neighborFinset] at hc
    rw [SimpleGraph.degree_eq_ncard_neighbors]
    exact hc

def lpGradient {n : ℕ} (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [Fact (1 ≤ q)]
    (f : PiLp p (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ) → ℝ)
    (x : PiLp p (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)) : PiLp q (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ) :=
  WithLp.toLp q (fun i => fderiv ℝ f x (PiLp.single p i (1 : ℝ)))



theorem lpGradient_apply {n : ℕ} (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [Fact (1 ≤ q)]
    (f : PiLp p (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ) → ℝ)
    (x : PiLp p (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)) (i : Fin n) :
    lpGradient p q f x i = fderiv ℝ f x (PiLp.single p i (1 : ℝ)) := by

  simp only [lpGradient, PiLp.toLp_apply]

private lemma SimpleGraph.existsAdjacentOutsideFinset
    {W : Type v} [Fintype W] {G : SimpleGraph W} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (s : Finset W) {x : W} (hx : x ∈ s) (hcard : s.card ≤ G.degree x) :
    ∃ y, G.Adj x y ∧ y ∉ s := by
  classical

  by_contra h
  have hsub : G.neighborFinset x ⊆ s := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hyout
    exact h ⟨y, (G.mem_neighborFinset x y).mp hy, hyout⟩
  have hproper : G.neighborFinset x ⊂ s := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    exact G.notMem_neighborFinset_self x (heq.symm ▸ hx)
  have hlt := Finset.card_lt_card hproper
  rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hlt
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hcard) hlt


private lemma SimpleGraph.injectiveOfFreshExtension
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v} {z : V} {f : ({z}ᶜ : Set V) → W} {F : V → W}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hagree : ∀ x : ({z}ᶜ : Set V), F x = f x)
    (hfresh : F z ∉ Set.range f) : Function.Injective F := by
  classical

  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hx : x = z
  · subst x
    by_cases hy : y = z
    · exact hy.symm
    · have hyval := hagree ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact False.elim (hfresh ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyval.symm.trans hxy.symm⟩)
  · by_cases hy : y = z
    · subst y
      have hxval := hagree ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact False.elim (hfresh ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxval.symm.trans hxy⟩)
    · have hrestricted : f ⟨x, hx⟩ = f ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
        (hagree ⟨x, hx⟩).symm.trans (hxy.trans (hagree ⟨y, hy⟩))
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hf hrestricted)


private lemma SimpleGraph.mapAdjOfLeafExtension
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v} {T : SimpleGraph V} {G : SimpleGraph W} {z : V}
    (u : ({z}ᶜ : Set V)) (hleaf : ∀ x, T.Adj z x → x = (u : V))
    (f : (T.induce {z}ᶜ) →g G) {F : V → W}
    (hagree : ∀ x : ({z}ᶜ : Set V), F x = f x)
    (hnew : G.Adj (F z) (f u)) : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, T.Adj x y → G.Adj (F x) (F y) := by
  classical

  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hx : x = z
  · subst x
    rw [hleaf y hxy, hagree u]
    exact hnew
  · by_cases hy : y = z
    · subst y
      rw [hleaf x hxy.symm, hagree u]
      exact hnew.symm
    · have hmap := f.map_adj (v := ⟨x, hx⟩) (w := ⟨y, hy⟩) hxy
      rwa [← hagree ⟨x, hx⟩, ← hagree ⟨y, hy⟩] at hmap


private lemma SimpleGraph.isContainedOfLeafExtension
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v} {T : SimpleGraph V} {G : SimpleGraph W} {z : V}
    (u : ({z}ᶜ : Set V)) (hleaf : ∀ x, T.Adj z x → x = (u : V))
    (f : SimpleGraph.Copy (T.induce {z}ᶜ) G) {w : W}
    (hw : G.Adj (f u) w) (hfresh : w ∉ Set.range f) : T ⊑ G := by
  classical

  let F : V → W := Function.extend Subtype.val f (fun _ ↦ w)
  have hagree (x : ({z}ᶜ : Set V)) : F x = f x :=
    Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply f (fun _ ↦ w) x
  have hz : ¬∃ x : ({z}ᶜ : Set V), (x : V) = z := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact x.property hx
  have hvalue : F z = w := Function.extend_apply' f (fun _ ↦ w) z hz
  have hnew : G.Adj (F z) (f u) := by
    rw [hvalue]
    exact hw.symm
  have hfreshF : F z ∉ Set.range f := by
    rwa [hvalue]

  exact ⟨⟨⟨F, fun h ↦ SimpleGraph.mapAdjOfLeafExtension u hleaf f.toHom hagree hnew h⟩,
    SimpleGraph.injectiveOfFreshExtension f.injective hagree hfreshF⟩⟩




public theorem SimpleGraph.IsTree.isContained_of_minDegree
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {T : SimpleGraph V} {G : SimpleGraph W} [Nonempty W] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hT : T.IsTree) (hdegree : Fintype.card V - 1 ≤ G.minDegree) : T ⊑ G := by
  classical

  revert hdegree
  revert hT
  refine Fintype.induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial
    (P := fun V _ ↦ ∀ T : SimpleGraph V, T.IsTree →
      Fintype.card V - 1 ≤ G.minDegree → T ⊑ G) V ?_ ?_ T
  · intro V _ _ T _ _
    have hbot : T = ⊥ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hbot]
    refine SimpleGraph.IsContained.bot.mpr ?_
    exact (Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance : Fintype.card V ≤ 1).trans
      (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr Fintype.card_pos)
  · intro V _ _ ih T hT hdegree
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hT.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial
    obtain ⟨u, hzu, hparent⟩ := SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hz
    have humem : u ∈ ({z}ᶜ : Set V) := hzu.ne.symm
    let parent : ({z}ᶜ : Set V) := ⟨u, humem⟩
    have hdeleted : (T.induce {z}ᶜ).IsTree :=
      ⟨hT.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hz, hT.isAcyclic.induce _⟩
    have hcard : Fintype.card ({z}ᶜ : Set V) = Fintype.card V - 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.card_compl_set, Fintype.card_unique (α := ({z} : Set V))]
    have hsmaller : Fintype.card ({z}ᶜ : Set V) < Fintype.card V :=
      Fintype.card_subtype_lt (Set.notMem_compl_iff.mpr (Set.mem_singleton z))
    have hdegreeDeleted : Fintype.card ({z}ᶜ : Set V) - 1 ≤ G.minDegree := by
      rw [hcard]
      omega
    obtain ⟨f⟩ := ih ({z}ᶜ : Set V) hsmaller (T.induce {z}ᶜ) hdeleted hdegreeDeleted

    let occupied : Finset W := Finset.univ.image f
    have hparentMem : f parent ∈ occupied := Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨parent, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    have hoccupied : occupied.card = Fintype.card V - 1 := by
      dsimp only [occupied]
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective (f := f) _ f.injective, Finset.card_univ, hcard]
    have hbound : occupied.card ≤ G.degree (f parent) := by
      rw [hoccupied]
      exact hdegree.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree _)
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwout⟩ := SimpleGraph.existsAdjacentOutsideFinset occupied hparentMem hbound
    have hfresh : w ∉ Set.range f := by
      rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact hwout (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ _, hx⟩)
    exact SimpleGraph.isContainedOfLeafExtension parent hparent f hw hfresh

private lemma cardBiUnionOfUniformParts (P : Finpartition s) {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : ∀ b ∈ P.parts, b.card = n) (T : Finset (Finset α))
    (hT : T ⊆ P.parts) : (T.biUnion id).card = T.card * n := by

  rw [Finset.card_biUnion (P.disjoint.subset hT)]
  exact Finset.sum_const_nat (fun b hb ↦ hcard b (hT hb))


private lemma cardPartsEqOfUniformParts (P Q : Finpartition s) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hP : ∀ b ∈ P.parts, b.card = n)
    (hQ : ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, b.card = n) : P.parts.card = Q.parts.card := by

  have hcount : P.parts.card * n = Q.parts.card * n := by
    calc
      P.parts.card * n = (P.parts.biUnion id).card :=
        (cardBiUnionOfUniformParts P hP _ (Finset.Subset.refl _)).symm
      _ = (Q.parts.biUnion id).card := by rw [P.biUnion_parts, Q.biUnion_parts]
      _ = Q.parts.card * n := cardBiUnionOfUniformParts Q hQ _ (Finset.Subset.refl _)
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hcount.le hn)
    (Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hcount.ge hn)


private lemma cardLeIntersectionNeighbors (P Q : Finpartition s) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hP : ∀ b ∈ P.parts, b.card = n)
    (hQ : ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, b.card = n) (A : Finset P.parts) :
    A.card ≤ (A.biUnion (fun b ↦ Q.parts.filter
      (fun c ↦ (b.val ∩ c).Nonempty))).card := by
  classical
  let T := A.image Subtype.val
  let N := A.biUnion (fun b ↦ Q.parts.filter (fun c ↦ (b.val ∩ c).Nonempty))
  have hT : T ⊆ P.parts := by
    rintro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    exact a.property
  have hN : N ⊆ Q.parts := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨b, _, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hc
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbc).1

  have hcover : T.biUnion id ⊆ N.biUnion id := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hxb⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := Q.exists_mem (P.subset a.property hxb)
    have hneighbor : c ∈ N :=
      Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hc, ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hxb, hxc⟩⟩⟩⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨c, hneighbor, hxc⟩

  have hcount : A.card * n ≤ N.card * n := by
    calc
      A.card * n = T.card * n := by
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective A Subtype.coe_injective]
      _ = (T.biUnion id).card := (cardBiUnionOfUniformParts P hP T hT).symm
      _ ≤ (N.biUnion id).card := Finset.card_le_card hcover
      _ = N.card * n := cardBiUnionOfUniformParts Q hQ N hN
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hcount hn


private lemma existsCommonTransversalOfMatching (P Q : Finpartition s)
    (f : P.parts → Finset α) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hmatch : ∀ b, f b ∈ Q.parts ∧ (b.val ∩ f b).Nonempty)
    (honto : ∀ c ∈ Q.parts, ∃ b, f b = c) :
    ∃ r : Finset α, r ⊆ s ∧ ∀ b ∈ P.parts ∪ Q.parts, (r ∩ b).card = 1 := by
  classical

  have hchoice : ∀ b : P.parts, ∃ x, x ∈ b.val ∧ x ∈ f b := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hmatch b).2
    exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mp hx⟩
  choose x hxP hxQ using hchoice
  let r := Finset.univ.image x
  refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact P.subset b.property (hxP b)
  · intro c hc
    apply Finset.card_eq_one_iff_existsUnique.mpr
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hc with hcP | hcQ
    · let b : P.parts := ⟨c, hcP⟩
      refine ⟨x b, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨?_, hxP b⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, Finset.mem_univ b, rfl⟩
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨hyr, hyc⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hy
        obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hyr

        have hab : a = b := Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_parts a.property hcP (hxP a) hyc)
        exact congrArg x hab
    · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := honto c hcQ
      refine ⟨x b, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨?_, hxQ b⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, Finset.mem_univ b, rfl⟩
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨hyr, hyc⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hy
        obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hyr

        have hab : a = b := hf (Q.eq_of_mem_parts (hmatch a).1 (hmatch b).1 (hxQ a) hyc)
        exact congrArg x hab

end Finpartition




theorem Finpartition.exists_commonTransversal {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    {s : Finset α} (P Q : Finpartition s) (k : ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ b ∈ P.parts, (b.card : ℤ) = k)
    (hQ : ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, (b.card : ℤ) = k) :
    ∃ r : Finset α, r ⊆ s ∧ ∀ b ∈ P.parts ∪ Q.parts, (r ∩ b).card = 1  := by
  classical

  by_cases hs : s = ∅
  · have hPe : P.parts = ∅ := P.parts_eq_empty_iff.mpr hs
    have hQe : Q.parts = ∅ := Q.parts_eq_empty_iff.mpr hs
    refine ⟨∅, Finset.empty_subset s, ?_⟩
    simp only [hPe, hQe, Finset.union_self, Finset.notMem_empty, false_implies, implies_true]
  ·
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs
    obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, hab₀⟩ := P.exists_mem ha
    have hn : 0 < b₀.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a, hab₀⟩
    have hPn : ∀ b ∈ P.parts, b.card = b₀.card := by
      intro b hb
      exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp ((hP b hb).trans (hP b₀ hb₀).symm)
    have hQn : ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, b.card = b₀.card := by
      intro b hb
      exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp ((hQ b hb).trans (hP b₀ hb₀).symm)

    obtain ⟨f, hf, hmem⟩ :=
      (Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective'
        (fun b : P.parts ↦ Q.parts.filter (fun c ↦ (b.val ∩ c).Nonempty))).mp
        (Finpartition.cardLeIntersectionNeighbors P Q hn hPn hQn)
    have hmatch : ∀ b, f b ∈ Q.parts ∧ (b.val ∩ f b).Nonempty := by
      intro b
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mp (hmem b)

    have himage : Finset.univ.image f = Q.parts := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
      · intro c hc
        obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
        exact (hmatch b).1
      · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hf, Finset.card_univ,
          Fintype.card_coe]
        exact (Finpartition.cardPartsEqOfUniformParts P Q hn hPn hQn).ge
    have honto : ∀ c ∈ Q.parts, ∃ b, f b = c := by
      intro c hc
      rw [← himage] at hc
      obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
      exact ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact Finpartition.existsCommonTransversalOfMatching P Q f hf hmatch honto

structure StrongConvex (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) : Prop where

  modulus_pos : 0 < σ

  onDomain : StrongConvexOn {x | f x ≠ ⊤} σ (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0)

namespace StrongConvex

variable {σ : ℝ} {f : E → WithTop ℝ}



def ofStrongConvexOn (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hf : StrongConvexOn {x | f x ≠ ⊤} σ (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0)) :
    StrongConvex σ f :=
  { modulus_pos := hσ, onDomain := hf }



theorem ofStrongConvexOn_spec (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hf : StrongConvexOn {x | f x ≠ ⊤} σ (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0)) :
    (ofStrongConvexOn hσ hf).modulus_pos = hσ ∧
      (ofStrongConvexOn hσ hf).onDomain = hf := by

  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩



theorem iff_onDomain : StrongConvex σ f ↔
    0 < σ ∧ StrongConvexOn {x | f x ≠ ⊤} σ (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.modulus_pos, h.onDomain⟩
  · rintro ⟨hσ, hf⟩
    exact ofStrongConvexOn hσ hf


theorem convexDom (h : StrongConvex σ f) : Convex ℝ {x | f x ≠ ⊤} := by

  exact h.onDomain.1



theorem le (h : StrongConvex σ f) {x y : E} (hx : f x ≠ ⊤) (hy : f y ≠ ⊤)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    f (t • x + (1 - t) • y) ≤
      WithTop.some (t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f y).untopD 0 -
        σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) := by


  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
  have ht1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith [ht.2]
  have hsum : t + (1 - t) = 1 := by ring

  have hz : t • x + (1 - t) • y ∈ {z | f z ≠ ⊤} :=
    convex_iff_add_mem.mp h.convexDom hx hy ht0 ht1 hsum

  have hreal := h.onDomain.2 hx hy ht0 ht1 hsum
  have hreal' : (f (t • x + (1 - t) • y)).untopD 0 ≤
      t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f y).untopD 0 -
        σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (f (t • x + (1 - t) • y)).untopD 0 ≤
          t • (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) • (f y).untopD 0 -
            t * (1 - t) * (σ / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) := by
        simpa only [StrongConvexOn, UniformConvexOn] using hreal
      _ = t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f y).untopD 0 -
          σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        ring

  exact (untopD_le_iff (a := 0) hz).1 hreal'

end StrongConvex

end WithTop

theorem offspringPGF_eval (z : ℝ) :
    offspringPGF.eval z = (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * z + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * z ^ 2 := by

  simp only [offspringPGF, eval_add, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_pow]




theorem secondGenerationExpansion :
    offspringPGF.comp offspringPGF =
      C (11 / 16 : ℝ) + C (1 / 8 : ℝ) * X + C (9 / 64 : ℝ) * X ^ 2 +
        C (1 / 32 : ℝ) * X ^ 3 + C (1 / 64 : ℝ) * X ^ 4 := by

  intro z

  simp only [offspringPGF_eval, eval_add, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_pow]
  ring

      (match n with
        | 0 => (11 / 16 : ℝ)
        | 1 => 1 / 8
        | 2 => 9 / 64
        | 3 => 1 / 32
        | 4 => 1 / 64
        | _ => 0) := by

  rw [secondGenerationExpansion]
  rcases n with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | n
  all_goals
    norm_num [coeff_add, coeff_C, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C_mul_X_pow]

private lemma matchingEncardLeCover {V : Type u} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {M : G.Subgraph} {C : Set V} (hM : M.IsMatching) (hC : G.IsVertexCover C) :
    M.edgeSet.encard ≤ C.encard := by
  classical

  let f : ↥(M.verts ∩ C) → M.edgeSet := fun x ↦ hM.toEdge ⟨x, x.property.1⟩
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
    rcases hC (M.adj_sub he) with hx | hy
    · exact ⟨⟨x, he.fst_mem, hx⟩, hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he⟩
    · refine ⟨⟨y, he.snd_mem, hy⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (hM.toEdge_eq_toEdge_of_adj he).symm.trans (hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he)
  have hcard := Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf
  have henc : M.edgeSet.encard ≤ (M.verts ∩ C).encard := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Set.coe_ncard_eq_encard] using
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard : (Nat.card M.edgeSet : ℕ∞) ≤ Nat.card ↥(M.verts ∩ C))
  exact henc.trans (Set.encard_le_encard Set.inter_subset_right)



private lemma independentSubsetMinimumCoverHall {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {C S : Set V} (hc : G.IsVertexCover C)
    (hmin : C.encard = G.vertexCoverNum) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : G.IsIndepSet S) :
    S.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ S, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x).ncard := by
  classical
  let N := ⋃ x ∈ S, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x

  have hNC : N ⊆ Cᶜ := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy
    exact (G.between_isBipartiteWith disjoint_compl_right).mem_of_mem_adj (hSC hx) hxy
  have hdis : Disjoint (C \ S) N :=
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hn ↦ hNC hn hx.1

  have hcover : G.IsVertexCover ((C \ S) ∪ N) := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
    · by_cases hyC : y ∈ C
      · have hyS : y ∉ S := fun hy ↦ hS hxS hy hxy.ne hxy
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hyC, hyS⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x, hxS,
          ⟨hxy, Or.inl ⟨hSC hxS, hyC⟩⟩⟩))
    · by_cases hyS : y ∈ S
      · by_cases hxC : x ∈ C
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hxC, hxS⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨y, hyS,
            ⟨hxy.symm, Or.inl ⟨hSC hyS, hxC⟩⟩⟩))
      · rcases hc hxy with hx | hy
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hx, hxS⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hy, hyS⟩)
  have hbound : C.ncard ≤ ((C \ S) ∪ N).ncard := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), Set.coe_ncard_eq_encard, Set.coe_ncard_eq_encard, hmin]
    exact hcover.vertexCoverNum_le
  rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hdis] at hbound
  have hpartition := Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hSC
  dsimp only [N] at hbound
  omega



private lemma minimumCoverCutHall {V : Type u} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.IsBipartite) {C : Set V} (hc : G.IsVertexCover C)
    (hmin : C.encard = G.vertexCoverNum) :
    ∀ S ⊆ C, S.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ S, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x).ncard := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := hG.exists_isBipartiteWith
  intro S hSC

  have hleft : G.IsIndepSet (S ∩ A) := by
    intro x hx y hy hne hxy
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB.disjoint hy.2 (hAB.mem_of_mem_adj hx.2 hxy)
  have hright : G.IsIndepSet (S \ A) := by
    intro x hx y hy hne hxy
    rcases hAB.mem_of_adj hxy with h | h
    · exact hx.2 h.1
    · exact hy.2 h.2
  have hl := independentSubsetMinimumCoverHall hc hmin
    (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left hSC) hleft
  have hr := independentSubsetMinimumCoverHall hc hmin
    (Set.Subset.trans Set.sdiff_subset hSC) hright
  let N₁ := ⋃ x ∈ S ∩ A, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x
  let N₂ := ⋃ x ∈ S \ A, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x

  have hdis : Disjoint N₁ N₂ := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro y hy₁ hy₂
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy₁
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy₂
    have hyB := hAB.mem_of_mem_adj hx.2 hxy.1
    rcases hAB.mem_of_adj hzy.1 with h | h
    · exact hz.2 h.1
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB.disjoint h.2 hyB
  have hN : (⋃ x ∈ S, (G.between C Cᶜ).neighborSet x) = N₁ ∪ N₂ := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_sdiff, N₁, N₂]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
      by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · exact Or.inl ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxA⟩, hxy⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxA⟩, hxy⟩
    · rintro (⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ | ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩)
      · exact ⟨x, hx.1, hxy⟩
      · exact ⟨x, hx.1, hxy⟩
  rw [hN, Set.ncard_union_eq hdis]
  have hpartition := Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset (Set.inter_subset_left : S ∩ A ⊆ S)
  have hdiff : S \ (S ∩ A) = S \ A := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    tauto
  rw [hdiff] at hpartition
  exact hpartition ▸ Nat.add_le_add hr hl |>.trans_eq (Nat.add_comm _ _)



private lemma independentMatchedSetEncardLeEdges {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {M : G.Subgraph} {S : Set V} (hM : M.IsMatching) (hS : G.IsIndepSet S)
    (hSat : S ⊆ M.verts) : S.encard ≤ M.edgeSet.encard := by
  classical
  let f : S → M.edgeSet := fun x ↦ hM.toEdge ⟨x, hSat x.property⟩

  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨z, hxz, _⟩ := hM (hSat x.property)
    have hy := hM.mem_coe_toEdge (hSat y.property)
    have heq := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
    have hxedge := congrArg Subtype.val (hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj hxz)
    rw [← heq, hxedge] at hy
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with hy | hy
    · exact Subtype.ext hy.symm
    · have hadj : G.Adj x y := hy.symm ▸ M.adj_sub hxz
      exact False.elim (hS x.property y.property hadj.ne hadj)
  exact ENat.card_le_card_of_injective hf


private lemma edgeSet_map_ofLE {V : Type u} {H G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (M : H.Subgraph) :
    (M.map (SimpleGraph.Hom.ofLE hHG)).edgeSet = M.edgeSet := by

  simp only [SimpleGraph.Subgraph.edgeSet_map, SimpleGraph.Hom.coe_ofLE,
    Sym2.map_id, Set.image_id]




theorem matchingSup_eq_vertexCoverNum {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsBipartite) :
    (⨆ (M : G.Subgraph) (_ : M.IsMatching), M.edgeSet.encard) = G.vertexCoverNum := by
  classical

  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine iSup_le fun M ↦ iSup_le fun hM ↦ ?_
    rw [SimpleGraph.vertexCoverNum]
    exact le_iInf fun C ↦ le_iInf fun hC ↦ matchingEncardLeCover hM hC
  ·
    obtain ⟨C, hmin, hc⟩ := G.vertexCoverNum_exists


    letI : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
    obtain ⟨N, hSat, hN⟩ := exists_isMatching_of_forall_ncard_le
      (G.between_isBipartiteWith (s := C) disjoint_compl_right)
      (minimumCoverCutHall hG hc hmin)
    have hCind : (G.between C Cᶜ).IsIndepSet C := by
      intro x hx y hy hne hxy
      rcases hxy.2 with h | h
      · exact h.2 hy
      · exact h.1 hx
    have hcount := independentMatchedSetEncardLeEdges hN hCind hSat
    rw [hmin] at hcount
    refine hcount.trans ?_
    have hmap := hN.map_ofLE G.between_le
    refine le_iSup_of_le (N.map (Hom.ofLE G.between_le)) ?_
    refine le_iSup_of_le hmap ?_
    rw [edgeSet_map_ofLE]



theorem exists_matching_encard_eq_vertexCoverNum {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsBipartite) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ M.edgeSet.encard = G.vertexCoverNum := by

  have hempty : (⊥ : G.Subgraph).IsMatching := by
    intro v hv
    exact False.elim hv
  have hnonempty : Nonempty {M : G.Subgraph // M.IsMatching} := ⟨⟨⊥, hempty⟩⟩
  have hsup : (⨆ M : {M : G.Subgraph // M.IsMatching}, M.val.edgeSet.encard) =
      G.vertexCoverNum := by
    rw [iSup_subtype, matchingSup_eq_vertexCoverNum G hG]

  have hfinite : (⨆ M : {M : G.Subgraph // M.IsMatching}, M.val.edgeSet.encard) < ⊤ := by
    rw [hsup]
    exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr vertexCoverNum_ne_top_of_finite
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := @ENat.exists_eq_iSup_of_lt_top _
    (fun M : {M : G.Subgraph // M.IsMatching} ↦ M.val.edgeSet.encard) hnonempty hfinite
  exact ⟨M.val, M.property, hM.trans hsup⟩

private lemma Equiv.Perm.signValEqOrderedPairProduct {n : ℕ}
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Units.val τ.sign =
      ∏ p ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).filter (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2)),
        (if τ p.1 < τ p.2 then (1 : ℤ) else -1) := by

  have pairMembership (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
      p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin n × Fin n ↦ p.1 < p.2)) ↔
        p.1 ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) ∧ p.2 ∈ Finset.Ioi p.1 := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_Ioi, true_and]
  rw [Finset.prod_finset_product _ Finset.univ Finset.Ioi pairMembership]

  have signProduct := congrArg Units.val τ.sign_eq_prod_prod_Ioi
  simpa only [Units.coe_prod, apply_ite, Units.val_one, Units.coe_neg_one] using signProduct


private lemma orderedPairProductEqPowInversions {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (∏ p ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × α)).filter (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2)),
      (if f p.1 < f p.2 then (1 : ℤ) else -1)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × α)).filter
        (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2 ∧ f p.2 < f p.1)).card := by

  have comparisonSigns :
      (∏ p ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × α)).filter (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2)),
        (if f p.1 < f p.2 then (1 : ℤ) else -1)) =
      ∏ p ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × α)).filter (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2)),
        (if f p.2 < f p.1 then (-1 : ℤ) else 1) := by
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
    intro p hp
    have ordered := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    by_cases reversed : f p.2 < f p.1
    · simp only [reversed, not_lt_of_gt reversed, if_false, if_true]
    · have forward : f p.1 < f p.2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt reversed) (hf.ne ordered.ne)
      simp only [reversed, forward, if_false, if_true]

  rw [comparisonSigns, ← Finset.prod_filter, Finset.prod_const, Finset.filter_filter]



theorem Equiv.Perm.sign_eq_pow_card {m : ℕ+} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) :
    Units.val σ.sign = (-1 : ℤ) ^
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m × Fin m)).filter
        (fun p ↦ p.1 < p.2 ∧ σ.symm p.2 < σ.symm p.1)).card := by

  calc
    Units.val σ.sign = Units.val (Equiv.Perm.sign σ.symm) :=
      congrArg Units.val (Equiv.Perm.sign_symm σ).symm
    _ = _ := Equiv.Perm.signValEqOrderedPairProduct σ.symm
    _ = _ := orderedPairProductEqPowInversions σ.symm σ.symm.injective

private lemma residual_sub (T : D → H) (x y : D) :
    residual T x - residual T y = ((x : H) - y) - (T x - T y) := by

  simp only [residual_apply]
  abel


private lemma normEnergyLeIffInner (a b : H) :
    (‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) ↔ ‖b‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ a b := by

  rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
  constructor
  · intro h
    linarith
  · intro h
    linarith


private lemma reflectionNormLeIffInner (a b : H) :
    (‖(2 : ℝ) • b - a‖ ≤ ‖a‖) ↔ ‖b‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ a b := by

  rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), norm_sub_sq_real,
    norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm b a]
  norm_num
  constructor
  · intro h
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    nlinarith



theorem firmlyNonexpansive_iff_residual [CompleteSpace H] (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    FirmlyNonexpansive T ↔ FirmlyNonexpansive (residual T) := by

  simp only [firmlyNonexpansive_iff, residual_apply, sub_sub_self]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro x
  apply forall_congr'
  intro y
  rw [add_comm]



theorem firmlyNonexpansive_iff_reflection [CompleteSpace H] (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    FirmlyNonexpansive T ↔ LipschitzWith 1 (fun x : D ↦ (2 : ℝ) • T x - x) := by

  have reflectionDifference (x y : D) :
      ((2 : ℝ) • T x - x) - ((2 : ℝ) • T y - y) =
        (2 : ℝ) • (T x - T y) - ((x : H) - y) := by
    rw [smul_sub]
    abel
  simp only [firmlyNonexpansive_iff, lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul,
    NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, residual_sub,
    reflectionDifference]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro x
  apply forall_congr'
  intro y
  exact (normEnergyLeIffInner _ _).trans (reflectionNormLeIffInner _ _).symm



theorem firmlyNonexpansive_iff_inner [CompleteSpace H] (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    FirmlyNonexpansive T ↔
      ∀ x y : D, ‖T x - T y‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ ((x : H) - y) (T x - T y) := by

  simp only [firmlyNonexpansive_iff, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, residual_sub]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro x
  apply forall_congr'
  intro y
  exact normEnergyLeIffInner _ _



theorem firmlyNonexpansive_iff_residual_inner [CompleteSpace H] (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    FirmlyNonexpansive T ↔
      ∀ x y : D, 0 ≤ inner ℝ (T x - T y) (residual T x - residual T y) := by

  rw [firmlyNonexpansive_iff_inner hD T]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro x
  apply forall_congr'
  intro y
  rw [residual_sub, inner_sub_right (T x - T y), real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    real_inner_comm (T x - T y)]
  exact sub_nonneg.symm


private lemma normAddSmulSq (a b : H) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖a + t • b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * t * inner ℝ a b + t ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by

  rw [norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    mul_pow, sq_abs]
  ring


private lemma innerNonnegIffNormLeSegment (a b : H) :
    (0 ≤ inner ℝ a b) ↔ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖a‖ ≤ ‖a + t • b‖ := by
  constructor
  · intro h t ht

    rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), normAddSmulSq]
    have linearNonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * t * inner ℝ a b :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (zero_le_two : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) ht.1) h
    have quadraticNonneg : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  · intro h

    by_contra hn
    have hc : inner ℝ a b < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have denominatorPositive : 0 < ‖b‖ ^ 2 + 1 := by positivity
    let t := min 1 (-inner ℝ a b / (‖b‖ ^ 2 + 1))
    have parameterPositive : 0 < t :=
      lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos (neg_pos.mpr hc) denominatorPositive)
    have parameterLeOne : t ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have parameterBound : t * (‖b‖ ^ 2 + 1) ≤ -inner ℝ a b :=
      (le_div_iff₀ denominatorPositive).mp (min_le_right _ _)
    have normBound := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg (a + t • b))).mpr
      (h t ⟨parameterPositive.le, parameterLeOne⟩)
    rw [normAddSmulSq] at normBound
    have slopeNegative : 2 * inner ℝ a b + t * ‖b‖ ^ 2 < 0 := by
      nlinarith [parameterBound]
    have productNonneg : 0 ≤ t * (2 * inner ℝ a b + t * ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [normBound]
    exact (not_le_of_gt (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg parameterPositive slopeNegative)) productNonneg



theorem firmlyNonexpansive_iff_segment [CompleteSpace H] (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    FirmlyNonexpansive T ↔
      ∀ x y : D, ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖T x - T y‖ ≤ ‖α • ((x : H) - y) + (1 - α) • (T x - T y)‖ := by

  have affineDifference (x y : D) (α : ℝ) :
      α • ((x : H) - y) + (1 - α) • (T x - T y) =
        (T x - T y) + α • (residual T x - residual T y) := by
    simp only [residual_sub, smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  rw [firmlyNonexpansive_iff_residual_inner hD T]
  simp only [affineDifference]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro x
  apply forall_congr'
  intro y
  exact innerNonnegIffNormLeSegment _ _

private lemma sUnionEmptySetUniv {X : Type u} (A : Set X) (S : Set (Set X))
    (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s = ∅ ∨ s = A ∨ s = Set.univ) :
    ⋃₀ S = ∅ ∨ ⋃₀ S = A ∨ ⋃₀ S = Set.univ := by
  classical

  by_cases hu : Set.univ ∈ S
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.subset_univ _)
      (Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hu)))
  by_cases ha : A ∈ S
  · right
    left
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.sUnion_subset ?_) (Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem ha)
    intro s hs
    rcases hS s hs with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Set.empty_subset A
    · exact Set.Subset.rfl
    · exact (hu hs).elim
  · left
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.sUnion_subset ?_) (Set.empty_subset _)
    intro s hs
    rcases hS s hs with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Set.Subset.rfl
    · exact (ha hs).elim
    · exact (hu hs).elim



lemma TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_singleton_iff {X : Type u} (A U : Set X) :
    IsOpen[generateFrom {A}] U ↔ U = ∅ ∨ U = A ∨ U = Set.univ := by
  constructor
  · intro h

    induction h with
    | basic s hs => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hs))
    | univ => exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    | inter s t _ _ hs ht =>
      rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl
      all_goals rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl
      all_goals simp only [Set.empty_inter, Set.inter_empty, Set.inter_self,
        Set.univ_inter, Set.inter_univ, eq_self, true_or, or_true]
    | sUnion S _ ih => exact sUnionEmptySetUniv A S ih
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact @isOpen_empty X (generateFrom {A})
    · rw [h]
      exact isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton A)
    · rw [h]
      exact @isOpen_univ X (generateFrom {A})



theorem unionNotTopology :
    ¬ ∃ t : TopologicalSpace (Fin 3),
      {s | IsOpen[t] s} =
        {s | IsOpen[generateFrom {({0} : Set (Fin 3))}] s} ∪
        {s | IsOpen[generateFrom {({1} : Set (Fin 3))}] s} := by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩

  have hzero : IsOpen[t] ({0} : Set (Fin 3)) :=
    (Set.ext_iff.mp ht _).mpr
      (Or.inl (isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hone : IsOpen[t] ({1} : Set (Fin 3)) :=
    (Set.ext_iff.mp ht _).mpr
      (Or.inr (isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hunion := (Set.ext_iff.mp ht _).mp (hzero.union hone)

  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, isOpen_generateFrom_singleton_iff] at hunion
  rcases hunion with (h | h | h) | (h | h | h)
  all_goals
    have hzeroMem := Set.ext_iff.mp h (0 : Fin 3)
    have honeMem := Set.ext_iff.mp h (1 : Fin 3)
    have htwoMem := Set.ext_iff.mp h (2 : Fin 3)
    simp at hzeroMem honeMem htwoMem



theorem interOpens {X : Type u} (t₁ t₂ : TopologicalSpace X) :
    {s | IsOpen[t₁ ⊔ t₂] s} = {s | IsOpen[t₁] s} ∩ {s | IsOpen[t₂] s} := by

  exact setOf_isOpen_sup t₁ t₂



instance TopologicalSpace.instT1Sup {X : Type u} (t₁ t₂ : TopologicalSpace X)
    [@T1Space X t₁] [@T1Space X t₂] : @T1Space X (t₁ ⊔ t₂) := by

  intro x

  refine (@isOpen_compl_iff X {x} (t₁ ⊔ t₂)).mp ?_
  exact (@isOpen_sup X t₁ t₂ {x}ᶜ).mpr

  refine (@t0Space_iff_exists_isOpen_xor_mem Bool (generateFrom {({b} : Set Bool)})).mpr ?_
  intro x y hxy

  refine ⟨{b}, isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _), ?_⟩
  cases b
  all_goals cases x

private lemma TopologicalSpace.supGenerateFromDistinctEqTop {X : Type u}

  constructor

    · exact Or.inl h
    · rcases hb with hb | hb | hb
      · exact Or.inl hb
      · exact (hAB (h.symm.trans hb)).elim
      · exact Or.inr hb
    · exact Or.inr h

    have hmem := Set.ext_iff.mp h false
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false, not_true_eq_false] at hmem

  intro h

private lemma WithTop.strongConvexOnOfJensen {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ)
    (hdom : Convex ℝ {x | f x ≠ ⊤})
    (hJ : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊤ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f (t • x + (1 - t) • y) ≤
        WithTop.some (t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f y).untopD 0 -
          σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)) :
    StrongConvexOn {x | f x ≠ ⊤} σ (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0) := by

  refine ⟨hdom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hba : b = 1 - a := by linarith

  have hz : f (a • x + b • y) ≠ ⊤ :=
    convex_iff_add_mem.mp hdom hx hy ha hb hab
  have hj := hJ x hx y hy a ⟨ha, ha1⟩
  rw [← hba] at hj
  have hreal := (WithTop.untopD_le_iff (a := 0) hz).2 hj

  calc
    (f (a • x + b • y)).untopD 0 ≤
        a * (f x).untopD 0 + b * (f y).untopD 0 -
          σ / 2 * a * b * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := hreal
    _ = a • (f x).untopD 0 + b • (f y).untopD 0 -
        a * b * (σ / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring




theorem strongConvex_iff {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    WithTop.StrongConvex σ f ↔
      Convex ℝ {x | f x ≠ ⊤} ∧
        ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊤ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          f (t • x + (1 - t) • y) ≤
            WithTop.some (t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f y).untopD 0 -
              σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf

    refine ⟨hf.convexDom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy t ht
    exact hf.le hx hy ht
  · rintro ⟨hdom, hJ⟩

    exact WithTop.StrongConvex.ofStrongConvexOn hσ
      (WithTop.strongConvexOnOfJensen σ f hdom hJ)

private lemma memSupportSubdifferentialIff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (S : Set E) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ z a, a ∈ S → inner ℝ a z ≤ f z)
    (hattain : ∀ z, ∃ a ∈ S, f z = inner ℝ a z) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ subdifferential (fun z ↦ (f z : EReal)) x ↔
      (∀ z, inner ℝ v z ≤ f z) ∧ inner ℝ v x = f x := by

  obtain ⟨a, ha, hazero⟩ := hattain 0
  have hzero : f 0 = 0 := hazero.trans (inner_zero_right a)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbx⟩ := hattain x
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hctwo⟩ := hattain ((2 : ℝ) • x)
  have htwo : f ((2 : ℝ) • x) = 2 * f x := by
    have hlow := hbound ((2 : ℝ) • x) b hb
    have hupp := hbound x c hc
    rw [inner_smul_right] at hlow hctwo
    rw [← hbx] at hlow
    linarith
  simp only [mem_subdifferential, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff,
    inner_sub_right]
  constructor
  · intro h

    have hz := h 0
    have ht := h ((2 : ℝ) • x)
    rw [inner_zero_right, hzero] at hz
    rw [inner_smul_right, htwo] at ht
    have hcontact : inner ℝ v x = f x := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, hcontact⟩
    intro z
    have hz := h z
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hdom, hcontact⟩ z
    rw [hcontact]
    linarith [hdom z]


private lemma dominatedByFiniteSupportIff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (S : Set E) (hS : S.Finite)
    (f : E → ℝ) (hbound : ∀ z a, a ∈ S → inner ℝ a z ≤ f z)
    (hattain : ∀ z, ∃ a ∈ S, f z = inner ℝ a z) (v : E) :
    (∀ z, inner ℝ v z ≤ f z) ↔ v ∈ convexHull ℝ S := by
  constructor
  · intro hdom

    by_contra hv
    obtain ⟨l, r, hl, hv⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point
      (convex_convexHull ℝ S) (hS.isClosed_convexHull ℝ) hv
    let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm l
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := hattain w
    have htest := hdom w
    have hsep := hl a (subset_convexHull ℝ S ha)
    rw [hfa, real_inner_comm w v, real_inner_comm w a,
      InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply] at htest
    linarith
  · intro hv z

    have hsubset : convexHull ℝ S ⊆ {a | inner ℝ z a ≤ f z} :=
      convexHull_min (fun a ha ↦ (real_inner_comm a z).trans_le (hbound z a ha))
        (convex_halfSpace_le (innerₗ E z).isLinear (f z))
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, real_inner_comm z v] using hsubset hv


lemma memFiniteSupportSubdifferentialIff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (S : Set E) (hS : S.Finite)
    (f : E → ℝ) (hbound : ∀ z a, a ∈ S → inner ℝ a z ≤ f z)
    (hattain : ∀ z, ∃ a ∈ S, f z = inner ℝ a z) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ subdifferential (fun z ↦ (f z : EReal)) x ↔
      v ∈ convexHull ℝ S ∧ inner ℝ v x = f x := by

  rw [memSupportSubdifferentialIff S f hbound hattain,
    dominatedByFiniteSupportIff S hS f hbound hattain]

end EReal

namespace FivePointPerm


def cycle : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 1 2


theorem cycle_apply (i : Fin 5) :
    cycle i = if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then 2 else if i = 2 then 0 else i := by

  fin_cases i
  all_goals decide


def swap : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := Equiv.swap 3 4


theorem swap_apply (i : Fin 5) :
    swap i = if i = 3 then 4 else if i = 4 then 3 else i := by

  fin_cases i
  all_goals decide


private lemma listedPermutationsMulMem {p q : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)}
    (hp : p ∈ ({1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap} :
      Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5))))
    (hq : q ∈ ({1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap} :
      Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)))) :
    p * q ∈ ({1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap} :
      Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5))) := by

  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp hq
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals decide


private lemma listedPermutationsInvMem {p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)}
    (hp : p ∈ ({1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap} :
      Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)))) :
    p⁻¹ ∈ ({1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap} :
      Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5))) := by

  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals decide


def subgroup : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) where
  carrier := {1, cycle, cycle⁻¹, swap, cycle * swap, cycle⁻¹ * swap}

  one_mem' := Set.mem_insert 1 _
  mul_mem' := listedPermutationsMulMem
  inv_mem' := listedPermutationsInvMem


theorem mem_subgroup (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) :
    p ∈ subgroup ↔ p = 1 ∨ p = cycle ∨ p = cycle⁻¹ ∨ p = swap ∨
      p = cycle * swap ∨ p = cycle⁻¹ * swap := by

  rfl


private lemma cycleAndSwapMem : cycle ∈ subgroup ∧ swap ∈ subgroup := by

  constructor
  · exact (mem_subgroup cycle).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
  · exact (mem_subgroup swap).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))))

end FivePointPerm



theorem fivePointSmul_apply (g : FivePointPerm.subgroup) (i : Fin 5) :
    g • i = (FivePointPerm.subgroup.subtype g) i := by

  rfl

namespace FivePointPerm


private lemma orbitZero :
    MulAction.orbit subgroup (0 : Fin 5) = ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 5)) := by

  ext j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, h⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hj
    have heval : p (0 : Fin 5) = j := h
    rw [← heval]
    rcases (mem_subgroup p).mp hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals decide
  · intro hj

    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hj
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self 0
    · refine MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨cycle, cycleAndSwapMem.1⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [fivePointSmul_apply]
      decide
    · refine MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr
        ⟨⟨cycle⁻¹, subgroup.inv_mem cycleAndSwapMem.1⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [fivePointSmul_apply]
      decide


private lemma orbitThree :
    MulAction.orbit subgroup (3 : Fin 5) = ({3, 4} : Set (Fin 5)) := by

  ext j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, h⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hj
    have heval : p (3 : Fin 5) = j := h
    rw [← heval]
    rcases (mem_subgroup p).mp hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals decide
  · intro hj

    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hj
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    · exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self 3
    · refine MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨swap, cycleAndSwapMem.2⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [fivePointSmul_apply]
      decide

end FivePointPerm



theorem fivePointOrbitFirstThree (i : Fin 5) (hi : i ∈ ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 5))) :
    MulAction.orbit FivePointPerm.subgroup i = ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 5)) := by

  rw [← FivePointPerm.orbitZero] at hi ⊢
  exact MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hi



theorem fivePointOrbitLastTwo (i : Fin 5) (hi : i ∈ ({3, 4} : Set (Fin 5))) :
    MulAction.orbit FivePointPerm.subgroup i = ({3, 4} : Set (Fin 5)) := by

  rw [← FivePointPerm.orbitThree] at hi ⊢
  exact MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hi

    G.degree v = Nat.card (G.neighborSet v) := by

  rw [← G.card_neighborSet_eq_degree, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]


private lemma SimpleGraph.Subgraph.cardDeleteVertex {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (H : G.Subgraph) (v : H.verts) :
    Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).verts + 1 = Nat.card H.verts ∧
      Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).coe.edgeSet + H.coe.degree v =
        Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet := by
  classical
  constructor
  ·
    simpa only [deleteVerts_verts, Nat.card_coe_set_eq] using
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one v.property
  ·
    have hcompl : {w : H.verts | (w : V) ∉ ({(v : V)} : Set V)} =
        ({v} : Set H.verts)ᶜ := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_compl_iff,
        Subtype.ext_iff]
    have hedge := Nat.card_congr (H.coeDeleteVertsIso {(v : V)}).mapEdgeSet
    rw [hcompl] at hedge
    have hind := H.coe.card_edgeFinset_induce_compl_singleton v
    rw [SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet] at hind
    have hdegree := H.coe.degree_le_card_edgeFinset (v := v)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hind hdegree
    rw [hind] at hedge
    simp only [SimpleGraph.degreeEqNatCardNeighborSet] at hedge hdegree ⊢
    omega


private lemma SimpleGraph.Subgraph.edgeVertexRatioLeDeleteVertex {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (H : G.Subgraph) (v : H.verts)
    (hpos : 0 < (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts)
    (hdegree : (H.coe.degree v : ℚ) ≤
      (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts) :
    (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts ≤
      (Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).coe.edgeSet : ℚ) /
        Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).verts := by
  classical

  have hedgepos : 0 < Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
    simp only [hz, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, lt_self_iff_false] at hpos
  have hnonempty := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hedgepos).1
  have htwo := H.coe.oneLtCardVertsOfEdge (Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mp hnonempty)
  obtain ⟨hverts, hedges⟩ := H.cardDeleteVertex v
  have hremain : 0 < Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).verts := by omega
  have hn : (0 : ℚ) < Nat.card H.verts := by exact_mod_cast (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one htwo)
  have hn' : (0 : ℚ) < Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).verts := by
    exact_mod_cast hremain

  have hv : (Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).verts : ℚ) + 1 =
      Nat.card H.verts := by exact_mod_cast hverts
  have he : (Nat.card (H.deleteVerts {(v : V)}).coe.edgeSet : ℚ) + H.coe.degree v =
      Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet := by exact_mod_cast hedges
  have hd := (le_div_iff₀ hn).mp hdegree
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hn hn').mpr
  nlinarith





theorem SimpleGraph.exists_subgraph_minDegree_gt {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.edgeSet.Nonempty) :
    ∃ H : G.Subgraph,
      (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts < (H.coe.minDegree : ℚ) ∧
      (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card V ≤
        (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts := by
  classical

  let admissible : Finset G.Subgraph := Finset.univ.filter fun H ↦
    (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card V ≤
      (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts
  have htop : (⊤ : G.Subgraph) ∈ admissible := by
    simp only [admissible, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      SimpleGraph.Subgraph.topEdgeVertexRatio, le_refl]
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hminimal⟩ := admissible.exists_min_image (fun H ↦ Nat.card H.verts)
    ⟨⊤, htop⟩
  have hdensity := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hH).2
  have hvertsG : 0 < Nat.card V := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (G.oneLtCardVertsOfEdge hG)
  have hedgesG : 0 < Nat.card G.edgeSet :=
    Nat.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mpr hG, inferInstance⟩
  have hpositiveG : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card V := by
    exact div_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hedgesG) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hvertsG)
  have hpositive := lt_of_lt_of_le hpositiveG hdensity
  refine ⟨H, ?_, hdensity⟩

  by_contra hstrict
  have hvertsH : 0 < Nat.card H.verts := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : Nat.card H.verts = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
    simp only [hz, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero, lt_self_iff_false] at hpositive
  have hnonempty := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hvertsH).1
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := @SimpleGraph.exists_minimal_degree_vertex H.verts H.coe _ _ hnonempty
  simp only [SimpleGraph.degreeEqNatCardNeighborSet] at hv
  have hdegree : (H.coe.degree v : ℚ) ≤
      (Nat.card H.coe.edgeSet : ℚ) / Nat.card H.verts := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.degreeEqNatCardNeighborSet, ← hv]
    exact le_of_not_gt hstrict
  have hdelete := H.edgeVertexRatioLeDeleteVertex v hpositive hdegree
  have hmem : H.deleteVerts {(v : V)} ∈ admissible :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hdensity.trans hdelete⟩
  have hmin := hminimal _ hmem
  have hcard := (H.cardDeleteVertex v).1
  omega

@[expose] public section



noncomputable def sqrtAbsMax (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EReal :=
  if 0 ≤ x 0 then
    max ((1 - Real.sqrt (x 0) : ℝ) : EReal) ((|x 1| : ℝ) : EReal)
  else ⊤


private lemma sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (hx : 0 ≤ x 0) :
    sqrtAbsMax x = ((max (1 - Real.sqrt (x 0)) |x 1| : ℝ) : EReal) := by

  simp only [sqrtAbsMax, if_pos hx]
  exact EReal.coe_strictMono.monotone.map_max.symm


private lemma sqrtAbsMax_le_coe_iff (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) :
    sqrtAbsMax x ≤ (r : EReal) ↔
      0 ≤ x 0 ∧ 1 - Real.sqrt (x 0) ≤ r ∧ |x 1| ≤ r := by

  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x 0
  · rw [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe x hx, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff, max_le_iff]
    simp only [hx, true_and]
  · simp [sqrtAbsMax, hx]



theorem sqrtAbsMax_proper :
    (∀ x, sqrtAbsMax x ≠ ⊥) ∧ ∃ x, sqrtAbsMax x ≠ ⊤ := by

  constructor
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x 0
    · rw [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe x hx]
      exact EReal.coe_ne_bot _
    · simp [sqrtAbsMax, hx]
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe 0 (le_refl 0)]
    exact EReal.coe_ne_top _


private lemma sqrtWeightedLe (u v a b : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a * Real.sqrt u + b * Real.sqrt v ≤ Real.sqrt (a * u + b * v) := by

  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  calc
    (a * Real.sqrt u + b * Real.sqrt v) ^ 2 =
        (a + b) * (a * (Real.sqrt u) ^ 2 + b * (Real.sqrt v) ^ 2) -
          a * b * (Real.sqrt u - Real.sqrt v) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ (a + b) * (a * u + b * v) := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hu, Real.sq_sqrt hv]
      exact sub_le_self _ (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hb) (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = a * u + b * v := by rw [hab, one_mul]



theorem sqrtAbsMax_convex :
    Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × ℝ | sqrtAbsMax p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} := by

  intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨hp₀, hp₁, hp₂⟩ := (sqrtAbsMax_le_coe_iff p.1 p.2).mp hp
  obtain ⟨hq₀, hq₁, hq₂⟩ := (sqrtAbsMax_le_coe_iff q.1 q.2).mp hq
  apply (sqrtAbsMax_le_coe_iff _ _).mpr
  simp only [Prod.smul_def, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
    PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hs := sqrtWeightedLe (p.1 0) (q.1 0) a b hp₀ hq₀ ha hb hab
  refine ⟨add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp₀) (mul_nonneg hb hq₀), ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hp₁),
      mul_nonneg hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hq₁)]
  · obtain ⟨hpneg, hppos⟩ := abs_le.mp hp₂
    obtain ⟨hqneg, hqpos⟩ := abs_le.mp hq₂
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hpneg),
        mul_nonneg hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hqneg)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hppos),
        mul_nonneg hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hqpos)]



theorem sqrtAbsMax_effectiveDomain :
    {x | sqrtAbsMax x ≠ ⊥ ∧ sqrtAbsMax x ≠ ⊤} =
      {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | 0 ≤ x 0} := by

  ext x
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x 0
  · simp [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe x hx, hx]
  · simp [sqrtAbsMax, hx]


private lemma mem_subdifferential_sqrtAbsMax_iff
    (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (hx : 0 ≤ x 0) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential sqrtAbsMax x ↔ ∀ z, 0 ≤ z 0 →
      max (1 - Real.sqrt (x 0)) |x 1| + inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤
        max (1 - Real.sqrt (z 0)) |z 1| := by

  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    have hz' := h z
    rwa [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe x hx, sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe z hz,
      ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hz'
  · intro h z
    by_cases hz : 0 ≤ z 0
    · rw [sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe x hx, sqrtAbsMax_eq_coe z hz,
        ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      exact h z hz
    · simp [sqrtAbsMax, hz]


private lemma sqrtTangentUpperBound (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt b ≤ Real.sqrt a + (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt a) := by

  have hden : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt a := by positivity
  have hdiff : Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a ≤ (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt a) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt ha.le, Real.sq_sqrt hb,
      sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a)]
  linarith


private lemma sqrtAbsMax_not_subdifferentiableAt_boundary
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (hzero : x 0 = 0) (hsmall : |x 1| < 1) :
    ¬ EReal.subdifferentiableAt sqrtAbsMax x := by

  rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hx : 0 ≤ x 0 := le_of_eq hzero.symm
  have hsupport := (mem_subdifferential_sqrtAbsMax_iff x v hx).mp hv
  have hden : 0 < |v 0| + 1 := by positivity
  have hmin : 0 < min (1 - |x 1|) (1 / (|v 0| + 1)) := by
    exact lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hsmall) (div_pos zero_lt_one hden)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htbound⟩ := exists_between hmin
  have htsmall : t < 1 - |x 1| := lt_of_lt_of_le htbound (min_le_left _ _)
  have htprod : t * (|v 0| + 1) < 1 :=
    (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp (lt_of_lt_of_le htbound (min_le_right _ _))
  have hlinear : 0 < 1 + v 0 * t := by
    nlinarith [neg_abs_le (v 0)]
  have hpositive := mul_pos ht hlinear
  have hz : 0 ≤ ((x + EuclideanSpace.single 0 (t ^ 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0 := by
    simp [PiLp.add_apply, hzero, sq_nonneg]
  have hineq := hsupport (x + EuclideanSpace.single 0 (t ^ 2)) hz
  have hbranch : |x 1| ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
  have hmax : max (1 - t) |x 1| = 1 - t := max_eq_left hbranch
  simp [PiLp.add_apply, hzero, Real.sqrt_sq ht.le, add_sub_cancel_left,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, max_eq_left hsmall.le, hmax] at hineq
  nlinarith




theorem sqrtAbsMax_subdifferentiableAt_iff (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hx : 0 ≤ x 0) :
    EReal.subdifferentiableAt sqrtAbsMax x ↔ ¬ (x 0 = 0 ∧ |x 1| < 1) := by

  constructor
  · intro h hbad
    exact sqrtAbsMax_not_subdifferentiableAt_boundary x hbad.1 hbad.2 h
  · intro hgood
    by_cases hactive : 1 - Real.sqrt (x 0) ≤ |x 1|
    · by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ x 1
      · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, ?_⟩
        apply (mem_subdifferential_sqrtAbsMax_iff x _ hx).mpr
        intro z hz
        rw [max_eq_right hactive, abs_of_nonneg hsign]
        simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul, PiLp.sub_apply]
        linarith [le_abs_self (z 1), le_max_right (1 - Real.sqrt (z 0)) |z 1|]
      · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 1 (-1), ?_⟩
        apply (mem_subdifferential_sqrtAbsMax_iff x _ hx).mpr
        intro z hz
        rw [max_eq_right hactive, abs_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hsign)]
        simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_neg, map_one, neg_mul,
          one_mul, PiLp.sub_apply]
        linarith [neg_abs_le (z 1), le_max_right (1 - Real.sqrt (z 0)) |z 1|]
    · have hpos : 0 < x 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        have hzero : x 0 = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hx
        have hsmall : |x 1| < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using lt_of_not_ge hactive
        exact hgood ⟨hzero, hsmall⟩
      refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 0 (-(2 * Real.sqrt (x 0))⁻¹), ?_⟩
      apply (mem_subdifferential_sqrtAbsMax_iff x _ hx).mpr
      intro z hz
      rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hactive)]
      simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_neg, map_inv₀,
        RCLike.conj_to_real, PiLp.sub_apply]
      have htangent := sqrtTangentUpperBound (x 0) (z 0) hpos hz
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at htangent
      nlinarith [le_max_left (1 - Real.sqrt (z 0)) |z 1|]

theorem mem_effectiveDomain {E : Type u} (f : E → EReal) (x : E) :
    x ∈ effectiveDomain f ↔ f x < ⊤ := by

  rfl


theorem mem_epigraph {E : Type u} (f : E → EReal) (p : E × ℝ) :
    p ∈ epigraph f ↔ f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal) := by

  rfl


theorem isPolyhedral_iff {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) :
    IsPolyhedral f ↔ ∃ (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : Fin r → ℝ),
      ∀ p : E × ℝ, f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal) ↔ ∀ j, a j p ≤ b j := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, a, b, h⟩
    refine ⟨r, a, b, ?_⟩
    intro p
    exact Set.ext_iff.mp h p
  · rintro ⟨r, a, b, h⟩
    exact ⟨r, a, b, Set.ext h⟩


private lemma coe_finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    ((∑ i ∈ s, a i : ℝ) : EReal) = ∑ i ∈ s, (a i : EReal) := by

  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, EReal.coe_zero]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, EReal.coe_add, ih]


private lemma finsetSum_ne_bot {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → EReal)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≠ ⊥) : ∑ i ∈ s, a i ≠ ⊥ := by

  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, ne_eq, EReal.zero_ne_bot, not_false_eq_true]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, EReal.add_ne_bot_iff]
    exact ⟨ha i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s),
      ih (fun j hj ↦ ha j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))⟩


private lemma finsetSum_ne_top_iff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → EReal)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≠ ⊥) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≠ ⊤ := by

  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, ne_eq, EReal.zero_ne_top, not_false_eq_true,
      Finset.notMem_empty, false_implies, implies_true]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    have hs : ∀ j ∈ s, a j ≠ ⊥ := fun j hj ↦ ha j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi,
      EReal.add_ne_top_iff_ne_top₂ (ha i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
        (finsetSum_ne_bot s a hs), ih hs]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp]
