private lemma mem_subdifferential_iff_epigraphSupport (f : E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) {x v : E} (hx : f x ≠ ⊤) :
    v ∈ subdifferential f x ↔
      ∀ z (r : ℝ), f z ≤ (r : EReal) → inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ r - (f x).toReal := by

  have hfinite := EReal.coe_toReal hx (h_noBot x)
  constructor
  · intro hv z r hr
    have h := (hv z).trans hr
    rw [← hfinite, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at h
    linarith
  · intro hv z

    by_cases hz : f z = ⊤
    · rw [hz]
      exact le_top
    · have h := hv z (f z).toReal (EReal.le_coe_toReal hz)
      rw [← hfinite, ← EReal.coe_toReal hz (h_noBot z), ← EReal.coe_add,
        EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      linarith


private lemma subgradientValue_ne_top (f : E → EReal)
    (h_nonempty : (effectiveDomain f).Nonempty) {x v : E}
    (hv : v ∈ subdifferential f x) : f x ≠ ⊤ := by

  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_nonempty
  intro hx
  have h := hv y
  rw [hx, EReal.top_add_coe] at h
  exact (mem_effectiveDomain f y).mp hy |>.not_ge h


private lemma epigraphProjection {X : Type*} (f : X → EReal) :
    Prod.fst '' epigraph f = effectiveDomain f := by

  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, r⟩, h, rfl⟩
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (EReal.coe_lt_top r)
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨(z, (f z).toReal), ?_, rfl⟩
    exact EReal.le_coe_toReal (ne_top_of_lt hz)


private lemma subdifferentialZero (x : E) :
    subdifferential (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : EReal)) x = {0} := by

  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have h := hv (x + v)
    rw [add_comm x v, _root_.add_sub_cancel_right] at h
    rw [zero_add, ← EReal.coe_zero] at h
    have hreal : inner ℝ v v ≤ 0 := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    exact (inner_self_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hreal real_inner_self_nonneg))
  · intro hv
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    subst v
    intro z
    simp only [inner_zero_left, EReal.coe_zero, add_zero, le_refl]


private lemma summandValue_ne_top (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥) (h_common : ∃ y, ∀ i, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i))
    {x v : E} (hv : v ∈ subdifferential (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) x) :
    ∀ i, f i x ≠ ⊤ := by

  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_common
  have hySum : y ∈ effectiveDomain (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) := by
    exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr ((EReal.finsetSum_ne_top_iff _ _
      (fun i _ ↦ h_noBot i y)).mpr (fun i _ ↦ ne_top_of_lt (hy i)))
  have hx := subgradientValue_ne_top (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) ⟨y, hySum⟩ hv
  exact fun i ↦ (EReal.finsetSum_ne_top_iff _ _
    (fun j _ ↦ h_noBot j x)).mp hx i (Finset.mem_univ i)


private lemma sumEpigraphSupport (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥) {x v : E} (hx : ∀ i, f i x ≠ ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ subdifferential (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) x)
    (z : E) (t : Fin m → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, f i z ≤ (t i : EReal)) :
    inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ ∑ i, (t i - (f i x).toReal) := by

  have hbase : (∑ i, ((f i x).toReal : EReal)) = ∑ i, f i x := by
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ EReal.coe_toReal (hx i) (h_noBot i x))
  have h := (hv z).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ ht i))
  dsimp only at h
  rw [← hbase, ← EReal.coe_finsetSum, ← EReal.coe_finsetSum, ← EReal.coe_add,
    EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  linarith


private lemma sum_mem_subdifferential_of_epigraphSupports (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥) {x v : E} (hx : ∀ i, f i x ≠ ⊤)
    (w : Fin m → E) (hw : ∑ i, w i = v)
    (hsupport : ∀ i z (r : ℝ), f i z ≤ (r : EReal) →
      inner ℝ (w i) (z - x) ≤ r - (f i x).toReal) :
    v ∈ ∑ i, subdifferential (f i) x := by

  refine (Set.mem_fintype_sum _ _).mpr ⟨w, ?_, hw⟩
  intro i
  exact (mem_subdifferential_iff_epigraphSupport (f i) (h_noBot i) (hx i)).mpr
    (hsupport i)

variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]


private lemma linearEpigraphFunctional (l : (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hvertical : l (0, 1) = -1) :
    ∃ w : E, ∀ z r, l (z, r) = inner ℝ w z - r := by

  refine ⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm
    (l.comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)).toContinuousLinearMap, ?_⟩
  intro z r
  have hpair : (z, r) = (z, 0) + r • ((0, 1) : E × ℝ) := by
    ext
    · simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.fst_add, smul_zero, add_zero]
    · simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
  calc
    l (z, r) = l (z, 0) + r * l (0, 1) := by
      rw [hpair, map_add, map_smul]
      rfl
    _ = inner ℝ ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm
        (l.comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)).toContinuousLinearMap) z - r := by
      rw [hvertical, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
      rw [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.inl_apply]
      simp only [mul_neg_one, sub_eq_add_neg]

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in

private lemma diagonalSupportVertical (l : Fin m → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E)
    (hdiagonal : ∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, l i (z, t i) =
      inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i) (i : Fin m) : l i (0, 1) = -1 := by

  classical
  have h := hdiagonal 0 (fun j ↦ if j = i then 1 else 0)
  simpa only [apply_ite, ← Prod.zero_eq_mk, map_zero,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, inner_zero_right, zero_sub] using h


private lemma sum_mem_subdifferential_of_linearSupports (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥) {x v : E} (hx : ∀ i, f i x ≠ ⊤)
    (l : Fin m → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i z (r : ℝ), f i z ≤ (r : EReal) →
      l i (z - x, r - (f i x).toReal) ≤ 0)
    (hdiagonal : ∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, l i (z, t i) =
      inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i) :
    v ∈ ∑ i, subdifferential (f i) x := by

  classical
  have hrepr : ∀ i, ∃ w : E, ∀ z r, l i (z, r) = inner ℝ w z - r :=
    fun i ↦ linearEpigraphFunctional (l i) (diagonalSupportVertical l v hdiagonal i)
  choose w hw using hrepr
  have hsum : ∑ i, w i = v := by
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro z
    have h := hdiagonal z 0
    simpa only [hw, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, sum_inner] using h
  refine sum_mem_subdifferential_of_epigraphSupports f h_noBot hx w hsum ?_
  intro i z r hr
  have h := hsupport i z r hr
  rw [hw] at h
  linarith


private def strictSupportHypograph {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (C : Set V) (x : V) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : Set (V × ℝ) :=
  {p | p.1 ∈ interior C ∧ p.2 < ℓ (p.1 - x)}


private lemma strictSupportHypograph_eq {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : Set V) (x : V) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    strictSupportHypograph C x ℓ =
      Prod.fst ⁻¹' interior C ∩
        (LinearMap.snd ℝ V ℝ - ℓ.comp (LinearMap.fst ℝ V ℝ)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio (-ℓ x) := by

  ext p
  simp only [strictSupportHypograph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff,
    Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply, map_sub]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, ht⟩
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hp, ht⟩
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    linarith


private lemma convex_strictSupportHypograph {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (x : V) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ (strictSupportHypograph C x ℓ) := by

  rw [strictSupportHypograph_eq]
  exact (hC.interior.linear_preimage (LinearMap.fst ℝ V ℝ)).inter
    ((convex_Iio (-ℓ x)).linear_preimage
      (LinearMap.snd ℝ V ℝ - ℓ.comp (LinearMap.fst ℝ V ℝ)))


private lemma isOpen_strictSupportHypograph {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (C : Set V) (x : V) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    IsOpen (strictSupportHypograph C x ℓ) := by

  exact (isOpen_interior.preimage continuous_fst).inter
    (isOpen_lt continuous_snd (ℓ.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp
      (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const)))


private lemma linearFunctionalProd_apply {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (F : StrongDual ℝ (V × ℝ)) (z : V) (t : ℝ) :
    F (z, t) = F (z, 0) + t * F (0, 1) := by

  have hpair : (z, t) = (z, 0) + t • ((0, 1) : V × ℝ) := by
    ext
    · simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero, add_zero]
    · simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
  rw [hpair, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]


private lemma continuous_le_at_endpoint {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (r b : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t < r, g t ≤ b) : g r ≤ b := by

  have hclosure : closure (Set.Iio r) ⊆ {t | g t ≤ b} :=
    closure_minimal h (isClosed_le hg continuous_const)
  have hr : r ∈ closure (Set.Iio r) := by
    simp only [closure_Iio, Set.mem_Iic, le_refl]
  exact hclosure hr


private lemma supportDecompositionOfInteriorFeasible {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] {C D : Set V}
    (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hD : Convex ℝ D) {x : V} (hxC : x ∈ C) (hxD : x ∈ D)
    (hqual : ∃ y, y ∈ interior C ∧ y ∈ D) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ z ∈ C ∩ D, ℓ (z - x) ≤ 0) :
    ∃ L M : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, L + M = ℓ ∧
      (∀ c ∈ C, L (c - x) ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ d ∈ D, M (d - x) ≤ 0) := by

  let U := strictSupportHypograph C x ℓ
  let S := U - (D ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ))
  have hconvex : Convex ℝ S :=
    (convex_strictSupportHypograph hC x ℓ).sub (hD.prod (convex_singleton 0))
  have hopen : IsOpen S := (isOpen_strictSupportHypograph C x ℓ).sub_right
  have hzero : (0 : V × ℝ) ∉ S := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq⟩
    have heq : p = q := sub_eq_zero.mp hpq
    subst p
    have hpos : 0 < ℓ (q.1 - x) := by
      simpa only [hq.2, Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq.2] using hp.2
    exact (hsupport q.1 ⟨interior_subset hp.1, hq.1⟩).not_gt hpos
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_open_point hconvex hopen hzero
  have hstrict : ∀ c ∈ interior C, ∀ d ∈ D, ∀ t < ℓ (c - x), F (c - d, t) < 0 := by
    intro c hc d hd t ht
    have hmem : (c - d, t) ∈ S := by
      refine ⟨(c, t), ⟨hc, ht⟩, (d, 0), ⟨hd, Set.mem_singleton 0⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_zero]
    simpa only [map_zero] using hF _ hmem
  obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyD⟩ := hqual

  let β := F (0, 1)
  have hβ : 0 < β := by
    have h := hstrict y hyC y hyD (min (ℓ (y - x)) 0 - 1)
      (sub_one_lt _ |>.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    rw [_root_.sub_self, linearFunctionalProd_apply F, ← Prod.zero_eq_mk, map_zero, zero_add] at h
    have ht : min (ℓ (y - x)) 0 - 1 < 0 :=
      (sub_one_lt _).trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    nlinarith
  have hboundary : ∀ c ∈ interior C, ∀ d ∈ D,
      F (c - d, ℓ (c - x)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro c hc d hd
    exact continuous_le_at_endpoint
      (F.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)) _ 0
      (fun t ht ↦ (hstrict c hc d hd t ht).le)
  let a : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := F.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ V ℝ)
  let L := ℓ + β⁻¹ • a
  let M := -(β⁻¹ • a)
  have hbound : ∀ c ∈ C, ∀ d ∈ D,
      a (c - d) + ℓ (c - x) * β ≤ 0 := by
    intro c hc d hd

    have hclosed : IsClosed {z | a (z - d) + ℓ (z - x) * β ≤ 0} :=
      isClosed_le
        ((a.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).add
          ((ℓ.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp
            (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have hext : closure (interior C) ⊆ {z | a (z - d) + ℓ (z - x) * β ≤ 0} := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hclosed
      intro z hz
      have h := hboundary z hz d hd
      rw [linearFunctionalProd_apply F] at h
      exact h
    apply hext
    rw [hC.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior ⟨y, hyC⟩]
    exact subset_closure hc
  refine ⟨L, M, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact add_neg_cancel_right ℓ (β⁻¹ • a)
  · intro c hc
    have h := hbound c hc x hxD
    have hmul : β * L (c - x) = a (c - x) + ℓ (c - x) * β := by
      dsimp only [L, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβ.ne', one_mul]
      ring
    have hprod := hmul.trans_le h
    nlinarith
  · intro d hd
    have h := hbound x hxC d hd
    rw [_root_.sub_self, map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, map_sub] at h
    have hmul : β * M (d - x) = a x - a d := by
      dsimp only [M, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [map_sub, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβ.ne', one_mul]
      ring
    have hprod := hmul.trans_le h
    nlinarith


private lemma exists_positive_linearRelation {ι V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V) (s : Finset ι) (hdep : ¬LinearIndepOn ℝ a (s : Set ι)) :
    ∃ g : ι → ℝ, (∑ i ∈ s, g i • a i) = 0 ∧ ∃ i ∈ s, 0 < g i := by

  obtain ⟨g, hg, i, hi, hgi⟩ := not_linearIndepOn_finset_iff.mp hdep
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hgi with hneg | hpos
  · refine ⟨fun j ↦ -g j, ?_, i, hi, neg_pos.mpr hneg⟩
    simp only [neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, hg, neg_zero]
  · exact ⟨g, hg, i, hi, hpos⟩


private lemma nonnegativeRepresentationErase {ι V : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V) (s : Finset ι) (μ : ι → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ i)
    (hdep : ¬LinearIndepOn ℝ a (s : Set ι)) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ ν : ι → ℝ, (∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ ν j) ∧
      (∑ j ∈ s.erase i, ν j • a j) = ∑ j ∈ s, μ j • a j := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨g, hg, k, hk, hgk⟩ := exists_positive_linearRelation a s hdep
  let positive := s.filter (fun j ↦ 0 < g j)
  have hne : positive.Nonempty := ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, hgk⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmin⟩ := positive.exists_min_image (fun j ↦ μ j / g j) hne
  have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hgi : 0 < g i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  let δ := μ i / g i
  let ν := fun j ↦ μ j - δ * g j
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := div_nonneg (hμ i his) hgi.le
  have hν : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ ν j := by
    intro j hj
    dsimp only [ν]
    rw [_root_.sub_nonneg]
    by_cases hgj : 0 < g j
    · exact (le_div_iff₀ hgj).mp (hmin j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj, hgj⟩))
    · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hδ (le_of_not_gt hgj)).trans (hμ j hj)
  have hzero : ν i = 0 := by
    dsimp only [ν, δ]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgi.ne', _root_.sub_self]
  refine ⟨i, his, ν, hν, ?_⟩

  calc
    (∑ j ∈ s.erase i, ν j • a j) = ∑ j ∈ s, ν j • a j := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s (fun j ↦ ν j • a j) his, hzero, zero_smul, add_zero]
    _ = (∑ j ∈ s, μ j • a j) - δ • (∑ j ∈ s, g j • a j) := by
      simp only [ν, sub_smul, mul_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.smul_sum]
    _ = ∑ j ∈ s, μ j • a j := by rw [hg, smul_zero, sub_zero]


private lemma nonnegativeRepresentationOnIndependentSubset {ι V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a : ι → V) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∀ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ i) →
      ∃ t ⊆ s, LinearIndepOn ℝ a (t : Set ι) ∧ ∃ ν : ι → ℝ,
        (∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ ν i) ∧ (∑ i ∈ t, ν i • a i) = ∑ i ∈ s, μ i • a i := by
  classical

  induction s using Finset.strongInductionOn with
  | _ s ih =>
    intro μ hμ
    by_cases hind : LinearIndepOn ℝ a (s : Set ι)
    · exact ⟨s, Finset.Subset.refl s, hind, μ, hμ, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, ν, hν, heq⟩ := nonnegativeRepresentationErase a s μ hμ hind
      obtain ⟨t, hts, htind, ξ, hξ, htξ⟩ := ih (s.erase i) (Finset.erase_ssubset hi) ν
        (fun j hj ↦ hν j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj))
      exact ⟨t, hts.trans (Finset.erase_subset i s), htind, ξ, hξ, htξ.trans heq⟩


private lemma isClosedIndependentNonnegativeSpan {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V) (ha : LinearIndependent ℝ a) :
    IsClosed ((Fintype.linearCombination ℝ a) '' {μ : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i}) := by

  have hemb : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (Fintype.linearCombination ℝ a) :=
    LinearMap.isClosedEmbedding_of_injective
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr ha.fintypeLinearCombination_injective)
  have horthant : IsClosed {μ : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i} := by
    simp only [Set.setOf_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter (fun i ↦ isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i))
  exact hemb.isClosedMap _ horthant


private lemma nonnegativeSpan_eq_iUnionIndependent {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a : ι → V) :
    {z | ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ z = ∑ i, μ i • a i} =
      ⋃ (s : Finset ι) (_ : LinearIndepOn ℝ a (s : Set ι)),
        (Fintype.linearCombination ℝ (fun i : s ↦ a i)) ''
          {μ : s → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i} := by
  classical

  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨μ, hμ, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨s, _, hs, ν, hν, heq⟩ := nonnegativeRepresentationOnIndependentSubset
      a Finset.univ μ (fun i _ ↦ hμ i)
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hs, ?_⟩⟩
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ ν i, fun i ↦ hν i i.property, ?_⟩
    rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Finset.univ_eq_attach,
      Finset.sum_attach s (fun i ↦ ν i • a i)]
    exact heq.trans hz.symm
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨s, hz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨hs, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
    let μ := fun i ↦ if hi : i ∈ s then ν ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
    refine ⟨μ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      dsimp only [μ]
      split_ifs with hi
      · exact hν ⟨i, hi⟩
      · exact le_rfl
    · rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
      symm
      calc
        (∑ i, μ i • a i) = ∑ i ∈ s, μ i • a i := by
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) ?_
          intro i _ hi
          simp only [μ, dif_neg hi, zero_smul]
        _ = ∑ i : s, ν i • a i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_attach s]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp only [μ, dif_pos i.property]


private lemma isClosedFiniteNonnegativeSpan {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (a : ι → V) :
    IsClosed {z | ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ z = ∑ i, μ i • a i} := by
  classical

  rw [nonnegativeSpan_eq_iUnionIndependent]
  refine isClosed_iUnion_of_finite (fun s ↦ ?_)
  refine isClosed_iUnion_of_finite (fun hs ↦ ?_)
  exact isClosedIndependentNonnegativeSpan (fun i : s ↦ a i) hs


private lemma convex_finiteNonnegativeSpan {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a : ι → V) :
    Convex ℝ {z | ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ z = ∑ i, μ i • a i} := by

  rintro z ⟨μ, hμ, rfl⟩ w ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩ r t hr ht _
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ r * μ i + t * ν i,
    fun i ↦ add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr (hμ i)) (mul_nonneg ht (hν i)), ?_⟩
  simp only [add_smul, mul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.smul_sum]


private lemma nonnegativeCombinationOfImplication {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∀ d, (∀ i, a i d ≤ 0) → ℓ d ≤ 0) ↔
      ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ ℓ = ∑ i, μ i • a i := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hℓ
    by_contra hrepr

    let e : (V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ V := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    let K : Set (StrongDual ℝ V) :=
      {z | ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ z = ∑ i, μ i • e (a i)}
    have hnot : e ℓ ∉ K := by
      rintro ⟨μ, hμ, heq⟩
      apply hrepr
      refine ⟨μ, hμ, e.injective ?_⟩
      simpa only [map_sum, map_smul] using heq
    obtain ⟨F, u, hK, hsep⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point
      (convex_finiteNonnegativeSpan (fun i ↦ e (a i)))
      (isClosedFiniteNonnegativeSpan (fun i ↦ e (a i))) hnot
    have hzero : (0 : StrongDual ℝ V) ∈ K := by
      refine ⟨0, fun _ ↦ le_rfl, ?_⟩
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hu : 0 < u := by simpa only [map_zero] using hK 0 hzero
    have hray : ∀ i (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t • e (a i) ∈ K := by
      intro i t ht
      refine ⟨fun j ↦ if j = i then t else 0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j
        dsimp only
        split_ifs
        · exact ht
        · exact le_rfl
      · simp only [ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hnonpos : ∀ i, F (e (a i)) ≤ 0 := by
      intro i
      by_contra h
      have hpos : 0 < F (e (a i)) := lt_of_not_ge h
      have hunonneg : 0 ≤ u + 1 := by linarith
      have ht : 0 ≤ (u + 1) / F (e (a i)) :=
        div_nonneg hunonneg hpos.le
      have hbound := hK _ (hray i _ ht)
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne'] at hbound
      linarith

    let g := F.toLinearMap.comp e.toLinearMap
    let d := (Module.evalEquiv ℝ V).symm g
    have heval : ∀ b : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, b d = F (e b) :=
      fun b ↦ Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply ℝ V b g
    have hd : ℓ d ≤ 0 := hℓ d (fun i ↦ (heval (a i)).trans_le (hnonpos i))
    rw [heval] at hd
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨μ, hμ, heq⟩ d hd

    rw [heq, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i _ ↦ ?_)
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hμ i) (hd i)


private lemma exists_feasible_positiveStep {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p d : V)
    (hp : ∀ i, a i p ≤ b i) (hd : ∀ i, a i p = b i → a i d ≤ 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ i, a i (p + t • d) ≤ b i := by
  classical

  have hnear : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ i,
      a i p ≠ b i → a i (p + t • d) < b i := by
    refine Filter.eventually_all.mpr (fun i ↦ ?_)
    by_cases hi : a i p = b i
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h ↦ (h hi).elim)
    · have hlt : a i p < b i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp i) hi
      have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ a i (p + t • d)) :=
        (a i).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
      have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {t : ℝ | a i (p + t • d) < b i} := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, zero_smul, add_zero] using hlt
      have hevent : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℝ), a i (p + t • d) < b i :=
        (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const).mem_nhds hmem
      exact hevent.mono (fun _ ht _ ↦ ht)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  have ht : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  have htball : ε / 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht]
    linarith
  refine ⟨ε / 2, ht, fun i ↦ ?_⟩

  by_cases hi : a i p = b i
  · rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hi]
    exact add_le_of_nonpos_right (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht.le (hd i hi))
  · exact (hball htball i hi).le


private lemma supportingFunctionalPolyhedral {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : V) (hp : ∀ i, a i p ≤ b i)
    (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ z, (∀ i, a i z ≤ b i) → ℓ (z - p) ≤ 0) :
    ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧ ℓ = ∑ i, μ i • a i ∧
      ∀ i, μ i * (b i - a i p) = 0 := by
  classical
  let activeNormal := fun i ↦ if a i p = b i then a i else 0
  have himp : ∀ d, (∀ i, activeNormal i d ≤ 0) → ℓ d ≤ 0 := by
    intro d hd
    have hactive : ∀ i, a i p = b i → a i d ≤ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      simpa only [activeNormal, if_pos hi] using hd i
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hfeasible⟩ := exists_feasible_positiveStep a b p d hp hactive

    have h := hsupport _ hfeasible
    rw [_root_.add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, heq⟩ := (nonnegativeCombinationOfImplication activeNormal ℓ).mp himp
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ if a i p = b i then μ i else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact hμ i
    · exact le_rfl
  · refine heq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ ?_))
    by_cases hi : a i p = b i
    · simp only [activeNormal, if_pos hi]
    · simp only [activeNormal, if_neg hi, smul_zero, zero_smul]
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : a i p = b i
    · simp only [hi, _root_.sub_self, mul_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hi, zero_mul]


private lemma supportingFunctionalFiniteIntersection {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ)
    (p : V) (hpC : p ∈ C) (hp : ∀ i, a i p ≤ b i)
    (hqual : ∃ y, y ∈ interior C ∧ ∀ i, a i y ≤ b i)
    (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ z ∈ C, (∀ i, a i z ≤ b i) → ℓ (z - p) ≤ 0) :
    ∃ L : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧
      ℓ = L + ∑ i, μ i • a i ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, L (c - p) ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, μ i * (b i - a i p) = 0 := by

  let D : Set V := {z | ∀ i, a i z ≤ b i}
  have hD : Convex ℝ D := by
    simp only [D, Set.setOf_forall]
    exact convex_iInter (fun i ↦ (convex_Iic (b i)).linear_preimage (a i))
  obtain ⟨L, M, hsum, hL, hM⟩ := supportDecompositionOfInteriorFeasible
    hC hD hpC hp hqual ℓ (fun z hz ↦ hsupport z hz.1 hz.2)
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, heq, hslack⟩ := supportingFunctionalPolyhedral a b p hp M hM
  exact ⟨L, μ, hμ, hsum.symm.trans (congrArg (L + ·) heq), hL, hslack⟩


private lemma intrinsicInterior_eq_directionImage {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : Set V) (p : V) (hp : p ∈ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    intrinsicInterior ℝ C =
      (fun v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction ↦ (v : V) + p) ''
        interior {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + p ∈ C} := by
  let p' : affineSpan ℝ C := ⟨p, hp⟩


  letI : Nonempty (affineSpan ℝ C) := ⟨p'⟩
  let e := (AffineIsometryEquiv.vaddConst ℝ p').toHomeomorph
  have hcoe : ∀ v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction, (e v : V) = (v : V) + p := by
    intro v
    simp only [e, AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_toHomeomorph,
      AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_vaddConst, AffineSubspace.coe_vadd, vadd_eq_add]
    rfl
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' ((↑) ⁻¹' C : Set (affineSpan ℝ C)) =
      {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + p ∈ C} := by
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hcoe]

  calc
    intrinsicInterior ℝ C = (↑) '' interior ((↑) ⁻¹' C : Set (affineSpan ℝ C)) := rfl
    _ = (↑) '' (e '' interior (e ⁻¹' ((↑) ⁻¹' C : Set (affineSpan ℝ C)))) := by
      rw [e.image_interior, e.image_preimage]
    _ = (fun v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction ↦ (v : V) + p) ''
        interior {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + p ∈ C} := by
      rw [hpre, Set.image_image]
      exact congrArg (· '' interior {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + p ∈ C})
        (funext hcoe)


private lemma convex_directionPreimage {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (p : V) :
    Convex ℝ {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + p ∈ C} := by

  intro u hu v hv a b ha hb hab
  have h := hC hu hv ha hb hab
  have heq : a • ((u : V) + p) + b • ((v : V) + p) =
      ((a • u + b • v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction) : V) + p := by
    simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, smul_add]
    rw [add_add_add_comm, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
  rwa [heq] at h


private lemma zero_mem_interior_directionPreimage {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] {C : Set V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C) :
    (0 : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction) ∈
      interior {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + x ∈ C} := by

  have hxspan := subset_affineSpan ℝ C (intrinsicInterior_subset hx)
  rw [intrinsicInterior_eq_directionImage C x hxspan] at hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := hx
  have hvzero : v = 0 := by
    ext
    exact add_right_cancel (heq.trans (zero_add x).symm)
  rwa [hvzero] at hv


private lemma combo_intrinsicInterior_self_mem {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) {x z : V}
    (hx : x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C) (hz : z ∈ C) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • x + b • z ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C := by

  have hxspan := subset_affineSpan ℝ C (intrinsicInterior_subset hx)
  let w : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction :=
    ⟨z - x, AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction (subset_affineSpan ℝ C hz) hxspan⟩
  have hw : w ∈ {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + x ∈ C} := by
    dsimp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, w]
    rwa [_root_.sub_add_cancel]
  have hcombo := (convex_directionPreimage hC x).combo_interior_self_mem_interior
    (zero_mem_interior_directionPreimage hx) hw ha hb hab
  rw [intrinsicInterior_eq_directionImage C x hxspan]
  refine ⟨b • w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [smul_zero, zero_add] using hcombo
  · simp only [Submodule.coe_smul, w]
    calc
      b • (z - x) + x = b • z - b • x + (a + b) • x := by
        rw [hab, one_smul, smul_sub]
      _ = a • x + b • z := by
        rw [add_smul]
        abel


private lemma exists_intrinsicInterior_rayExtension {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] {C : Set V} {y z : V} (hy : y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C)
    (hz : z ∈ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ y + t • (y - z) ∈ C := by

  have hyspan := subset_affineSpan ℝ C (intrinsicInterior_subset hy)
  let w : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction :=
    ⟨y - z, AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hyspan hz⟩
  let B := {v : (affineSpan ℝ C).direction | (v : V) + y ∈ C}
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ ↦ t • w) ⁻¹' interior B := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, zero_smul] using zero_mem_interior_directionPreimage hy
  have hnear : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t • w) ⁻¹' interior B ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    (isOpen_interior.preimage (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).mem_nhds hmem
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  have ht : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  have htball : ε / 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht]
    linarith
  have h := interior_subset (hball htball)
  refine ⟨ε / 2, ht, ?_⟩
  simpa only [B, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Submodule.coe_smul, w, add_comm] using h


private lemma intrinsicInteriorLinearImage_lift {V W : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W]
    {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) {y : W}
    (hy : y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (T '' C)) :
    ∃ x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C, T x = y := by

  obtain ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := intrinsicInterior_subset hy
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Set.Nonempty.intrinsicInterior hC ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hTp : T p ∈ affineSpan ℝ (T '' C) :=
    subset_affineSpan ℝ (T '' C) ⟨p, intrinsicInterior_subset hp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, q, hq, hTq⟩ := exists_intrinsicInterior_rayExtension hy hTp
  have hden : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
  have ha : 0 < t / (1 + t) := div_pos ht hden
  have hb : 0 ≤ 1 / (1 + t) := (div_pos zero_lt_one hden).le
  have hab : t / (1 + t) + 1 / (1 + t) = 1 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcoef : (1 / (1 + t)) * t = t / (1 + t) := by ring
  refine ⟨(t / (1 + t)) • p + (1 / (1 + t)) • q,
    combo_intrinsicInterior_self_mem hC hp hq ha hb hab, ?_⟩
  calc
    T ((t / (1 + t)) • p + (1 / (1 + t)) • q) =
        (t / (1 + t)) • T p + (1 / (1 + t)) • (y + t • (y - T p)) := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hTq]
    _ = (t / (1 + t) + 1 / (1 + t)) • y := by
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, hcoef, smul_sub, add_smul]
      abel
    _ = y := by rw [hab, one_smul]


private lemma supportingFunctionalRelativeFiniteIntersection {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ)
    (p : V) (hpC : p ∈ C) (hp : ∀ i, a i p ≤ b i)
    (hqual : ∃ y, y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C ∧ ∀ i, a i y ≤ b i)
    (ℓ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ z ∈ C, (∀ i, a i z ≤ b i) → ℓ (z - p) ≤ 0) :
    ∃ L : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ μ : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) ∧
      ℓ = L + ∑ i, μ i • a i ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, L (c - p) ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, μ i * (b i - a i p) = 0 := by
  let H := (affineSpan ℝ C).direction
  let C₀ : Set H := {v | (v : V) + p ∈ C}
  let a₀ := fun i ↦ (a i).comp H.subtype
  let b₀ := fun i ↦ b i - a i p
  have hpSpan := subset_affineSpan ℝ C hpC
  have hzeroC : (0 : H) ∈ C₀ := by simpa only [C₀, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Submodule.coe_zero,
    zero_add] using hpC
  have hzero : ∀ i, a₀ i (0 : H) ≤ b₀ i := by
    intro i
    simpa only [a₀, b₀, map_zero, _root_.sub_nonneg] using hp i

  obtain ⟨y, hy, hya⟩ := hqual
  rw [intrinsicInterior_eq_directionImage C p hpSpan] at hy
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwval⟩ := hy
  have hwfeasible : ∀ i, a₀ i w ≤ b₀ i := by
    intro i
    have h := hya i
    rw [← hwval, map_add] at h
    exact (_root_.le_sub_iff_add_le).mpr h
  have hsupport₀ : ∀ z ∈ C₀, (∀ i, a₀ i z ≤ b₀ i) →
      (ℓ.comp H.subtype) (z - 0) ≤ 0 := by
    intro z hz hza
    have hfeasible : ∀ i, a i ((z : V) + p) ≤ b i := by
      intro i
      rw [map_add]
      exact (_root_.le_sub_iff_add_le).mp (hza i)
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, sub_zero, _root_.add_sub_cancel_right]
      using hsupport ((z : V) + p) hz hfeasible
  obtain ⟨L₀, μ, hμ, heq, hL₀, hslack⟩ := supportingFunctionalFiniteIntersection
    (convex_directionPreimage hC p) a₀ b₀ 0 hzeroC hzero ⟨w, hw, hwfeasible⟩
    (ℓ.comp H.subtype) hsupport₀

  let L := ℓ - ∑ i, μ i • a i
  have hrestrict : ∀ z : H, L z = L₀ z := by
    intro z
    have h := congrArg (fun f : H →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ ↦ f z) heq
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    simp only [L, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simpa only [a₀, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply] using sub_eq_of_eq_add h
  refine ⟨L, μ, hμ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (sub_add_cancel ℓ (∑ i, μ i • a i)).symm
  · intro c hc
    let z : H := ⟨c - p, AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction
      (subset_affineSpan ℝ C hc) hpSpan⟩
    have hz : z ∈ C₀ := by
      dsimp only [C₀, Set.mem_setOf_eq, z]
      rwa [_root_.sub_add_cancel]
    have h := hL₀ z hz
    simpa only [sub_zero, ← hrestrict] using h
  · intro i
    simpa only [b₀, map_zero, sub_zero] using hslack i


private def productDirectionMap {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V) :
    ((i : ι) → (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction) →ₗ[ℝ] (ι → V) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun i ↦ (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction.subtype.comp (LinearMap.proj i))


private lemma norm_productDirectionMap {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V)
    (v : (i : ι) → (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction) :
    ‖productDirectionMap C v‖ = ‖v‖ := by

  rfl


private def productDirectionEmbedding {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V) :
    ((i : ι) → (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ι → V) :=
  { productDirectionMap C with norm_map' := norm_productDirectionMap C }


private lemma mem_intrinsicInterior_pi {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V) (p y : ι → V)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ C i) (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (C i)) :
    y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (Set.univ.pi C) := by
  classical
  let B := Set.univ.pi (fun i ↦
    {v : (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction | (v : V) + p i ∈ C i})
  let e := (AffineIsometryEquiv.vaddConst ℝ p).toAffineIsometry.comp
    (productDirectionEmbedding C).toAffineIsometry
  have heval : ∀ v i, e v i = (v i : V) + p i := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  have himage : e '' B = Set.univ.pi C := by

    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ i _
      exact hv i (Set.mem_univ i)
    · intro hz
      let v := fun i ↦ (⟨z i - p i, AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction
        (subset_affineSpan ℝ (C i) (hz i (Set.mem_univ i)))
        (subset_affineSpan ℝ (C i) (hp i))⟩ : (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction)
      refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i _
        dsimp only [v, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        rw [_root_.sub_add_cancel]
        exact hz i (Set.mem_univ i)
      · ext i
        rw [heval]
        exact _root_.sub_add_cancel (z i) (p i)
  have hlift : ∀ i, ∃ v : (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction,
      v ∈ interior {v : (affineSpan ℝ (C i)).direction | (v : V) + p i ∈ C i} ∧
        (v : V) + p i = y i := by
    intro i
    have h := hy i
    rw [intrinsicInterior_eq_directionImage (C i) (p i)
      (subset_affineSpan ℝ (C i) (hp i))] at h
    exact h
  choose v hv hval using hlift
  have hvint : v ∈ interior B := by
    rw [interior_pi_set Set.finite_univ]
    exact fun i _ ↦ hv i

  rw [← himage, e.intrinsicInterior_image]
  refine ⟨v, interior_subset_intrinsicInterior hvint, ?_⟩
  ext i
  exact hval i


private lemma submodule_finiteEquations {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] (A : Submodule ℝ V) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ a : Fin r → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ z, z ∈ A ↔ ∀ j, a j z = 0 := by

  let B := Module.finBasis ℝ (V ⧸ A)
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ (V ⧸ A), fun j ↦ (B.coord j).comp A.mkQ, ?_⟩
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz j
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mpr hz, map_zero]
  · intro hz
    have hq : A.mkQ z = 0 := B.forall_coord_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mp hq


private lemma submodule_finiteHalfspaces {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] (A : Submodule ℝ V) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ a : Fin r × Bool → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ z, z ∈ A ↔ ∀ j, a j z ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ A, ∀ j, a j z = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨r, a, ha⟩ := submodule_finiteEquations A
  let signed := fun j : Fin r × Bool ↦ if j.2 then a j.1 else -(a j.1)
  refine ⟨r, signed, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    rw [ha]
    constructor
    · intro hz j
      dsimp only [signed]
      split_ifs
      · exact (hz j.1).le
      · rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hz j.1, neg_zero]
    · intro hz j
      have hpos := hz (j, true)
      have hneg := hz (j, false)
      simp only [signed, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, LinearMap.neg_apply] at hpos hneg
      linarith
  · intro z hz j
    have hj := (ha z).mp hz j.1
    dsimp only [signed]
    split_ifs
    · exact hj
    · rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hj, neg_zero]


private lemma sum_coordinateRestrictions {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (L : (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ι → V) :
    (∑ i, (L.comp (LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i)) (q i)) = L q := by

  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.single_apply]
  rw [← map_sum, LinearMap.sum_single_apply]


private lemma productSupport_coordinate {ι V : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V) (p : ι → V)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ C i) (L : (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ q, (∀ i, q i ∈ C i) → L (q - p) ≤ 0) (i : ι) {z : V} (hz : z ∈ C i) :
    L ((LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i) (z - p i)) ≤ 0 := by

  have hq : ∀ j, Function.update p i z j ∈ C j := by
    intro j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa only [Function.update_self] using hz
    · simpa only [Function.update_of_ne h] using hp j
  have hdiff : Function.update p i z - p = Pi.single i (z - p i) := by
    ext j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Function.update_self, Pi.single_eq_same]
    · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Function.update_of_ne h, Pi.single_eq_of_ne h, _root_.sub_self]
  simpa only [LinearMap.single_apply, hdiff] using hL _ hq


private lemma coordinateNormal_single {ι V : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (i j : ι) (z : V) :
    (a.comp (LinearMap.proj j)) ((LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i) z) =
      if j = i then a z else 0 := by

  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.single_apply,
      Pi.single_eq_same, if_true]
  · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.single_apply,
      Pi.single_eq_of_ne h, map_zero, if_neg h]


private lemma weightedCoordinateSupport {ι J V : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (C : ι → Set V) (p : ι → V)
    (coord : J → ι) (a : J → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b μ : J → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) (hslack : ∀ j, μ j * (b j - a j (p (coord j))) = 0)
    (hC : ∀ j z, z ∈ C (coord j) → a j z ≤ b j) (i : ι) {z : V} (hz : z ∈ C i) :
    (∑ j, μ j • (a j).comp (LinearMap.proj (coord j)))
      ((LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i) (z - p i)) ≤ 0 := by

  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coordinateNormal_single]
  refine Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j _ ↦ ?_)
  by_cases h : coord j = i
  · rw [if_pos h, map_sub]
    have hzC : z ∈ C (coord j) := by simpa only [h] using hz
    have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC j z hzC) (hμ j)
    have hs := hslack j
    rw [h] at hs
    nlinarith
  · rw [if_neg h, mul_zero]


private lemma supportingFunctionalProductRestriction {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (C : ι → Set V) (hC : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (C i)) (P : Finset ι)
    (hpoly : ∀ i ∈ P, ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ a : Fin r → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ b : Fin r → ℝ,
      ∀ z, z ∈ C i ↔ ∀ j, a j z ≤ b j)
    (A : Submodule ℝ (ι → V)) (p : ι → V) (hpA : p ∈ A) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ C i)
    (y : ι → V) (hyA : y ∈ A)
    (hyP : ∀ i ∈ P, y i ∈ C i)
    (hyRi : ∀ i, i ∉ P → y i ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (C i))
    (ℓ : (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ q ∈ A, (∀ i, q i ∈ C i) → ℓ (q - p) ≤ 0) :
    ∃ l : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ C i, l i (z - p i) ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ A, ∑ i, l i (q i) = ℓ q := by
  classical

  let B := fun i ↦ if i ∈ P then Set.univ else C i
  have hB : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (B i) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [B]
    split_ifs
    · exact convex_univ
    · exact hC i
  have hpB : ∀ i, p i ∈ B i := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [B]
    split_ifs
    · exact Set.mem_univ _
    · exact hp i
  have hyB : ∀ i, y i ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (B i) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [B]
    split_ifs with hi
    · apply interior_subset_intrinsicInterior
      simp only [interior_univ, Set.mem_univ]
    · exact hyRi i hi
  have hpres : ∀ i : P, ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ a : Fin r → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ b : Fin r → ℝ,
      ∀ z, z ∈ C i ↔ ∀ j, a j z ≤ b j := fun i ↦ hpoly i i.property
  choose r a b hab using hpres
  let J := (i : P) × Fin (r i)
  obtain ⟨s, e, he, hezero⟩ := submodule_finiteHalfspaces A
  let normals : (Fin s × Bool) ⊕ J → (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    Sum.elim e (fun j ↦ (a j.1 j.2).comp (LinearMap.proj j.1.val))
  let offsets : (Fin s × Bool) ⊕ J → ℝ := Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun j ↦ b j.1 j.2)
  have hconstraints : ∀ q, (∀ k, normals k q ≤ offsets k) ↔
      q ∈ A ∧ ∀ i ∈ P, q i ∈ C i := by
    intro q
    constructor
    · intro hq
      exact ⟨(he q).mpr (fun j ↦ hq (.inl j)),
        fun i hi ↦ (hab ⟨i, hi⟩ (q i)).mpr (fun j ↦ hq (.inr ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, j⟩))⟩
    · rintro ⟨hqA, hqP⟩ k
      cases k with
      | inl j => exact (he q).mp hqA j
      | inr j => exact (hab j.1 (q j.1.val)).mp (hqP j.1 j.1.property) j.2
  have hqualified : y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (Set.univ.pi B) :=
    mem_intrinsicInterior_pi B p y hpB hyB
  have hfeasible : ∀ k, normals k p ≤ offsets k :=
    (hconstraints p).mpr ⟨hpA, fun i _ ↦ hp i⟩
  have hsupportB : ∀ q ∈ Set.univ.pi B, (∀ k, normals k q ≤ offsets k) →
      ℓ (q - p) ≤ 0 := by
    intro q hq hqa
    obtain ⟨hqA, hqP⟩ := (hconstraints q).mp hqa
    refine hsupport q hqA (fun i ↦ ?_)
    by_cases hi : i ∈ P
    · exact hqP i hi
    · simpa only [B, if_neg hi] using hq i (Set.mem_univ i)
  obtain ⟨L, μ, hμ, heq, hL, hslack⟩ := supportingFunctionalRelativeFiniteIntersection
    (convex_pi (fun i _ ↦ hB i)) normals offsets p (fun i _ ↦ hpB i) hfeasible
    ⟨y, hqualified, (hconstraints y).mpr ⟨hyA, hyP⟩⟩ ℓ hsupportB
  let R : (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ∑ j : J, μ (.inr j) • (a j.1 j.2).comp (LinearMap.proj j.1.val)
  have hR : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ C i, R ((LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i) (z - p i)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro i z hz
    exact weightedCoordinateSupport C p (fun j : J ↦ j.1.val)
      (fun j ↦ a j.1 j.2) (fun j ↦ b j.1 j.2) (fun j ↦ μ (.inr j))
      (fun j ↦ hμ (.inr j)) (fun j ↦ hslack (.inr j))
      (fun j z hz ↦ (hab j.1 z).mp hz j.2) i hz
  have hrestriction : ∀ q ∈ A, (L + R) q = ℓ q := by
    intro q hq
    have hvanish : (∑ j : Fin s × Bool, μ (.inl j) * e j q) = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ ↦ ?_)
      rw [hezero q hq j, mul_zero]
    have h := congrArg (fun f : (ι → V) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ ↦ f q) heq
    simpa only [normals, R, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl,
      Sum.elim_inr, hvanish, zero_add] using h.symm

  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (L + R).comp (LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : ι ↦ V) i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i z hz
    have hzB : z ∈ B i := by
      dsimp only [B]
      split_ifs
      · exact Set.mem_univ _
      · exact hz
    have hcoord := productSupport_coordinate B p hpB L (fun q hq ↦ hL q (fun i _ ↦ hq i)) i hzB
    exact add_nonpos hcoord (hR i z hz)
  · intro q hq
    exact (sum_coordinateRestrictions (L + R) q).trans (hrestriction q hq)


private lemma epigraphQualificationHeights (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (hconvex : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (epigraph (f i))) (P : Finset (Fin m)) (y : E)
    (hyP : ∀ i ∈ P, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i))
    (hyRi : ∀ i, i ∉ P → y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (effectiveDomain (f i))) :
    ∃ t : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i ∈ P, (y, t i) ∈ epigraph (f i)) ∧
      ∀ i, i ∉ P → (y, t i) ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (epigraph (f i)) := by
  classical
  have hlift : ∀ i, ∃ r : ℝ, (i ∈ P → (y, r) ∈ epigraph (f i)) ∧
      (i ∉ P → (y, r) ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (epigraph (f i))) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ P
    · refine ⟨(f i y).toReal, fun _ ↦ EReal.le_coe_toReal (ne_top_of_lt (hyP i hi)), ?_⟩
      exact fun h ↦ (h hi).elim
    · have hprojection : (LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ) '' epigraph (f i) =
          effectiveDomain (f i) := epigraphProjection (f i)
      have hyImage : y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ ((LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ) '' epigraph (f i)) := by
        rw [hprojection]
        exact hyRi i hi
      obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := intrinsicInteriorLinearImage_lift (hconvex i)
        (LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ) hyImage
      have hpair : (y, p.2) = p := by
        ext
        · exact heq.symm
        · rfl
      refine ⟨p.2, fun h ↦ (hi h).elim, ?_⟩
      intro _
      rwa [hpair]
  choose t htP htRi using hlift
  exact ⟨t, htP, htRi⟩


private def diagonalEpigraphMap : (E × (Fin m → ℝ)) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → E × ℝ) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun i ↦ (LinearMap.fst ℝ E (Fin m → ℝ)).prod
    ((LinearMap.proj i).comp (LinearMap.snd ℝ E (Fin m → ℝ))))

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in

private lemma diagonalEpigraphMap_apply (z : E) (t : Fin m → ℝ) :
    diagonalEpigraphMap (z, t) = fun i ↦ (z, t i) := by

  rfl


private lemma splitSumEpigraphSupport (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    {x : E} (hx : ∀ i, f i x ≠ ⊤)
    (hconvex : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (epigraph (f i))) (P : Finset (Fin m))
    (hpoly : ∀ i ∈ P, IsPolyhedral (f i)) (y : E)
    (hyP : ∀ i ∈ P, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i))
    (hyRi : ∀ i, i ∉ P → y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (effectiveDomain (f i)))
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (v : E)
    (hsupport : ∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, f i z ≤ (t i : EReal)) →
      inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ ∑ i, (t i - (f i x).toReal)) :
    ∃ l : Fin m → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ i z (r : ℝ), f i z ≤ (r : EReal) →
        l i (z - x, r - (f i x).toReal) ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, l i (z, t i) = inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i := by
  classical
  let p := fun i ↦ (x, (f i x).toReal)
  let A := (diagonalEpigraphMap (E := E) (m := m)).range
  let i₀ : Fin m := ⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm⟩
  let ℓ : (Fin m → E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E v).toLinearMap.comp
      ((LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).comp (LinearMap.proj i₀)) -
      ∑ i, (LinearMap.snd ℝ E ℝ).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  have hdiagonal : ∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ℓ (fun i ↦ (z, t i)) =
      inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i := by

    intro z t
    simp only [ℓ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
      LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
  have hpA : p ∈ A := ⟨(x, fun i ↦ (f i x).toReal), diagonalEpigraphMap_apply _ _⟩
  have hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ epigraph (f i) := fun i ↦ EReal.le_coe_toReal (hx i)
  obtain ⟨t, htP, htRi⟩ := epigraphQualificationHeights f hconvex P y hyP hyRi
  have hyA : (fun i ↦ (y, t i)) ∈ A := ⟨(y, t), diagonalEpigraphMap_apply _ _⟩
  have hpolyEpi : ∀ i ∈ P, ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ a : Fin r → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∃ b : Fin r → ℝ, ∀ z, z ∈ epigraph (f i) ↔ ∀ j, a j z ≤ b j := by
    intro i hi
    exact (EReal.isPolyhedral_iff (f i)).mp (hpoly i hi)
  have hprodSupport : ∀ q ∈ A, (∀ i, q i ∈ epigraph (f i)) → ℓ (q - p) ≤ 0 := by
    rintro q ⟨⟨z, r⟩, hq⟩ hfeasible
    rw [diagonalEpigraphMap_apply] at hq
    subst q
    have hdiff : (fun i ↦ (z, r i)) - p =
        fun i ↦ (z - x, r i - (f i x).toReal) := rfl
    rw [hdiff, hdiagonal, _root_.sub_nonpos]
    exact hsupport z r hfeasible
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hrestrict⟩ := supportingFunctionalProductRestriction
    (fun i ↦ epigraph (f i)) hconvex P hpolyEpi A p hpA hp
    (fun i ↦ (y, t i)) hyA htP htRi ℓ hprodSupport

  refine ⟨l, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i z r hr
    exact hl i (z, r) hr
  · intro z r
    have hA : (fun i ↦ (z, r i)) ∈ A := ⟨(z, r), diagonalEpigraphMap_apply _ _⟩
    exact (hrestrict _ hA).trans (hdiagonal z r)



theorem sumSubdifferentialSubset (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥)
    (h_nonempty : ∀ i, (effectiveDomain (f i)).Nonempty)
    (h_convex : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (epigraph (f i))) (x : E) :
    (∑ i, subdifferential (f i) x) ⊆
      subdifferential (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) x := by

  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (Set.mem_fintype_sum _ _).mp hv
  intro z
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ hw i z)

  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_inner, EReal.coe_finsetSum] using h



theorem subdifferentialSum (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥)
    (h_nonempty : ∀ i, (effectiveDomain (f i)).Nonempty)
    (h_convex : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (epigraph (f i)))
    (h_ri : ∃ y, ∀ i, y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (effectiveDomain (f i))) (x : E) :
    subdifferential (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) x = ∑ i, subdifferential (f i) x := by

  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ (sumSubdifferentialSubset f h_noBot h_nonempty h_convex x)
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_ri
  have hyDom : ∀ i, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i) :=
    fun i ↦ intrinsicInterior_subset (hy i)
  have hx := summandValue_ne_top f h_noBot ⟨y, hyDom⟩ hv

  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_zero, subdifferentialZero, Set.mem_zero,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hv

  have hsupport := sumEpigraphSupport f h_noBot hx hv
  have hsplit : ∃ l : Fin m → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ i z (r : ℝ), f i z ≤ (r : EReal) →
        l i (z - x, r - (f i x).toReal) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, l i (z, t i) = inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i) := by

    refine splitSumEpigraphSupport f hx h_convex ∅ ?_ y ?_ ?_ hm v hsupport
    · intro i hi
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty i hi).elim
    · intro i hi
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty i hi).elim
    · exact fun i _ ↦ hy i
  obtain ⟨l, hlSupport, hlDiagonal⟩ := hsplit
  exact sum_mem_subdifferential_of_linearSupports f h_noBot hx l hlSupport hlDiagonal



theorem subdifferentialSumMixed (f : Fin m → E → EReal)
    (h_noBot : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ ⊥)
    (h_nonempty : ∀ i, (effectiveDomain (f i)).Nonempty)
    (h_convex : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (epigraph (f i))) (P : Finset (Fin m))
    (h_poly : ∀ i ∈ P, IsPolyhedral (f i))
    (h_qual : ∃ y, (∀ i ∈ P, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) ∧
      (∀ i, i ∉ P → y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (effectiveDomain (f i)))) (x : E) :
    subdifferential (fun z ↦ ∑ i, f i z) x = ∑ i, subdifferential (f i) x := by

  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ (sumSubdifferentialSubset f h_noBot h_nonempty h_convex x)
  intro v hv
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, hyPoly, hyRi⟩ := h_qual
  have hyDom : ∀ i, y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ P
    · exact hyPoly i hi
    · exact intrinsicInterior_subset (hyRi i hi)
  have hx := summandValue_ne_top f h_noBot ⟨y, hyDom⟩ hv

  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_zero, subdifferentialZero, Set.mem_zero,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hv
  have hsupport := sumEpigraphSupport f h_noBot hx hv
  have hsplit : ∃ l : Fin m → (E × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ i z (r : ℝ), f i z ≤ (r : EReal) →
        l i (z - x, r - (f i x).toReal) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ z (t : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, l i (z, t i) = inner ℝ v z - ∑ i, t i) := by

    exact splitSumEpigraphSupport f hx h_convex P h_poly y hyPoly hyRi hm v hsupport
  obtain ⟨l, hlSupport, hlDiagonal⟩ := hsplit
  exact sum_mem_subdifferential_of_linearSupports f h_noBot hx l hlSupport hlDiagonal

theorem supportFunction_le_iff (C : Set E) (xStar : E) (a : EReal) :

theorem supportFunction_eq_of_isMaxOn (C : Set E) (xStar x : E) (hx : x ∈ C)
