theorem doorSpace_iff (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    DoorSpace X ↔ ∀ s : Set X, IsOpen s ∨ IsClosed s := by

  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.isOpen_or_isClosed, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩



instance instDoorSpaceOfDiscrete (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X] :
    DoorSpace X := by

  exact ⟨fun s ↦ Or.inl (isOpen_discrete s)⟩



theorem doorSpaceIndiscrete_iff (X : Type u) :
    @DoorSpace X (⊤ : TopologicalSpace X) ↔ Subsingleton X := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro x y

    have singleton_cases : ({x} : Set X) = ∅ ∨ ({x} : Set X) = Set.univ := by
      rcases h.isOpen_or_isClosed {x} with hopen | hclosed
      · exact (TopologicalSpace.isOpen_top_iff _).mp hopen
      · exact (@IndiscreteTopology.isClosed_iff X ⊤ inferInstance _).mp hclosed
    rcases singleton_cases with hempty | huniv
    · have hx : x ∈ (∅ : Set X) := hempty ▸ Set.mem_singleton x
      exact hx.elim
    · have hy : y ∈ ({x} : Set X) := huniv.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ y
      exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy).symm
  · intro h
    refine @DoorSpace.mk X ⊤ ?_
    intro s

    exact @Subsingleton.set_cases X h
      (fun s ↦ IsOpen[⊤] s ∨ IsClosed[⊤] s)
      (Or.inl (@isOpen_empty X ⊤)) (Or.inl (@isOpen_univ X ⊤)) s


private lemma existsInfiniteCoinfinite (X : Type u) [Infinite X] :
    ∃ s : Set X, s.Infinite ∧ sᶜ.Infinite := by
  let e := Infinite.natEmbedding X

  have even_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n)) := by
    intro m n h
    have heq := e.injective h
    omega
  have odd_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n + 1)) := by
    intro m n h
    have heq := e.injective h
    omega
  refine ⟨Set.range (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n)),
    Set.infinite_range_of_injective even_injective, ?_⟩
  refine (Set.infinite_range_of_injective odd_injective).mono ?_
  rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩ ⟨m, hm⟩
  have heq := e.injective hm
  omega



theorem not_doorSpaceCofinite (X : Type u) [Infinite X] :
    ¬ @DoorSpace X (TopologicalSpace.cofinite : TopologicalSpace X) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc⟩ := existsInfiniteCoinfinite X

  rcases h.isOpen_or_isClosed s with hopen | hclosed
  · exact hc (hopen hs.nonempty)
  · have hfinite : (sᶜ)ᶜ.Finite := hclosed.isOpen_compl hc.nonempty
    exact hs (compl_compl s ▸ hfinite)


private lemma doorSpecializationCommonCoordinate {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (hdoor : DoorSpace X) {x y z w : X} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hfirst : x ⤳ y) (hsecond : z ⤳ w) : x = z ∨ y = w := by
  classical
  by_cases hxz : x = z
  · exact Or.inl hxz
  by_cases hyw : y = w
  · exact Or.inr hyw

  rcases hdoor.isOpen_or_isClosed {y, z} with hopen | hclosed
  · have hx := hfirst.mem_open hopen (Set.mem_insert y {z})
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    exact False.elim (hx.elim hxy hxz)
  · have hw := hsecond.mem_closed hclosed (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y (Set.mem_singleton z))
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw
    exact False.elim (hw.elim (Ne.symm hyw) (Ne.symm hzw))


private lemma relationCommonCoordinateCenter {X : Type u} [Nonempty X]
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (h : ∀ a b c d, R a b → R c d → a = c ∨ b = d) :
    ∃ p : X, (∀ a b, R a b → a = p) ∨ (∀ a b, R a b → b = p) := by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ a b, R a b
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hex
    by_cases hsource : ∀ c d, R c d → c = a
    · exact ⟨a, Or.inl hsource⟩

    push Not at hsource
    obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hca⟩ := hsource
    have hdb : d = b := (h c d a b hcd hab).resolve_left hca
    refine ⟨b, Or.inr ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    rcases h x y a b hxy hab with hxa | hyb
    · rcases h x y c d hxy hcd with hxc | hyd
      · exact False.elim (hca (hxc.symm.trans hxa))
      · exact hyd.trans hdb
    · exact hyb
  · obtain ⟨p⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
    refine ⟨p, Or.inl ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    exact False.elim (hex ⟨a, b, hab⟩)


private lemma isOpen_iff_of_specializationTarget {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [AlexandrovDiscrete X] (p : X)
    (hp : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → x ⤳ y → y = p) (U : Set X) :
    IsOpen U ↔ (p ∈ U → {x | x ≠ p ∧ x ⤳ p} ⊆ U) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hopen hmem x hx
    exact hx.2.mem_open hopen hmem
  · intro hU

    refine isOpen_iff_forall_specializes.mpr ?_
    intro x y hxy hy
    by_cases heq : x = y
    · exact heq ▸ hy
    · have hyp := hp x y heq hxy
      subst y
      exact hU hy ⟨heq, hxy⟩


private lemma isOpen_iff_of_specializationSource {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [AlexandrovDiscrete X] (p : X)
    (hp : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → x ⤳ y → x = p) (U : Set X) :
    IsOpen U ↔ ((U ∩ {y | y ≠ p ∧ p ⤳ y}).Nonempty → p ∈ U) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro hopen ⟨y, hy, hleaf⟩
    exact hleaf.2.mem_open hopen hy
  · intro hU

    refine isOpen_iff_forall_specializes.mpr ?_
    intro x y hxy hy
    by_cases heq : x = y
    · exact heq ▸ hy
    · have hxp := hp x y heq hxy
      subst x
      exact hU ⟨y, hy, Ne.symm heq, hxy⟩







theorem doorSpaceFour_iff (t : TopologicalSpace (Fin 4)) :
    @DoorSpace (Fin 4) t ↔
      ∃ (p : Fin 4) (A : Set (Fin 4)), p ∉ A ∧
        ((∀ U : Set (Fin 4), IsOpen[t] U ↔ (p ∈ U → A ⊆ U)) ∨
         (∀ U : Set (Fin 4), IsOpen[t] U ↔ ((U ∩ A).Nonempty → p ∈ U))) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hdoor

    have hcoordinate (a b c d : Fin 4)
        (hab : a ≠ b ∧ @Specializes _ t a b)
        (hcd : c ≠ d ∧ @Specializes _ t c d) : a = c ∨ b = d := by
      exact doorSpecializationCommonCoordinate hdoor hab.1 hcd.1 hab.2 hcd.2
    obtain ⟨p, hsource | htarget⟩ := relationCommonCoordinateCenter
      (fun a b ↦ a ≠ b ∧ @Specializes _ t a b) hcoordinate
    · refine ⟨p, {y | y ≠ p ∧ @Specializes _ t p y}, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
      · exact fun hp ↦ hp.1 rfl
      · intro U
        exact @isOpen_iff_of_specializationSource _ t inferInstance p
          (fun x y hne hxy ↦ hsource x y ⟨hne, hxy⟩) U
    · refine ⟨p, {x | x ≠ p ∧ @Specializes _ t x p}, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
      · exact fun hp ↦ hp.1 rfl
      · intro U
        exact @isOpen_iff_of_specializationTarget _ t inferInstance p
          (fun x y hne hxy ↦ htarget x y ⟨hne, hxy⟩) U
  · rintro ⟨p, A, _hpA, htarget | hsource⟩
    · refine ⟨?_⟩
      intro U

      by_cases hpU : p ∈ U
      · right
        refine isOpen_compl_iff.mp ((htarget Uᶜ).mpr ?_)
        intro hpcompl
        exact False.elim (hpcompl hpU)
      · left
        exact (htarget U).mpr (fun hp ↦ False.elim (hpU hp))
    · refine ⟨?_⟩
      intro U

      by_cases hpU : p ∈ U
      · left
        exact (hsource U).mpr (fun _ ↦ hpU)
      · right
        exact isOpen_compl_iff.mp ((hsource Uᶜ).mpr (fun _ ↦ hpU))

import Mathlib.Topology.Bases

universe u

open TopologicalSpace



private lemma topologyLEOfBasisRefinement {X : Type u}
    {τ₁ τ₂ : TopologicalSpace X} {𝓑₁ 𝓑₂ : Set (Set X)}
    (h₁ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₁ 𝓑₁)
    (h₂ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₂ 𝓑₂)
    (href : ∀ B ∈ 𝓑₁, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₂, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) :
    τ₂ ≤ τ₁ := by

  rw [@IsTopologicalBasis.eq_generateFrom X τ₁ 𝓑₁ h₁]
  refine le_generateFrom ?_
  intro B hB
  exact h₂.isOpen_iff.mpr (href B hB)




theorem topology_eq_iff_mutualRefinement {X : Type u} [Nonempty X]
    {τ₁ τ₂ : TopologicalSpace X} {𝓑₁ 𝓑₂ : Set (Set X)}
    (h₁ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₁ 𝓑₁)
    (h₂ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₂ 𝓑₂) :
    τ₁ = τ₂ ↔
      (∀ B ∈ 𝓑₁, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₂, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) ∧
      (∀ B ∈ 𝓑₂, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₁, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) := by
  constructor
  · intro hτ
    subst τ₂

    constructor
    · intro B hB x hx
      exact h₂.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx (h₁.isOpen hB)
    · intro B hB x hx
      exact h₁.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx (h₂.isOpen hB)
  · rintro ⟨href₁, href₂⟩

    exact le_antisymm (topologyLEOfBasisRefinement h₂ h₁ href₂)
      (topologyLEOfBasisRefinement h₁ h₂ href₁)

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Data.EReal.Operations

@[expose] public section

universe u



def epsilonSubdifferential {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (ε : ℝ) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {v | ∀ z, f x - Real.toEReal ε + Real.toEReal (inner ℝ v (z - x)) ≤ f z}


theorem mem_epsilonSubdifferential {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (ε : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ epsilonSubdifferential f ε x ↔
      ∀ z, f x - Real.toEReal ε + Real.toEReal (inner ℝ v (z - x)) ≤ f z := by

  rfl


theorem mem_epsilonSubdifferential_coe {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (g : E → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ epsilonSubdifferential (fun y => Real.toEReal (g y)) ε x ↔
      ∀ z, (g x - ε) + inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ g z := by

  rw [mem_epsilonSubdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro h z
    exact (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff).mp <| by
      simpa only [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add] using h z
  · intro h z
    have hz : (↑((g x - ε) + inner ℝ v (z - x)) : EReal) ≤ ↑(g z) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (h z)
    simpa only [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add] using hz

public import Mathlib.Order.BooleanAlgebra.Basic

public section

universe u

namespace BooleanAlgebra




structure Axioms {B : Type u} (sup inf : B → B → B) (I O : B) : Prop where

  sup_comm (a b : B) : sup a b = sup b a

  inf_comm (a b : B) : inf a b = inf b a

  sup_assoc (a b c : B) : sup a (sup b c) = sup (sup a b) c

  inf_assoc (a b c : B) : inf a (inf b c) = inf (inf a b) c

  inf_sup (a b c : B) : inf a (sup b c) = sup (inf a b) (inf a c)

  sup_inf (a b c : B) : sup a (inf b c) = inf (sup a b) (sup a c)

  sup_zero (a : B) : sup a O = a

  inf_one (a : B) : inf a I = a

  exists_compl (a : B) : ∃ a', sup a a' = I ∧ inf a a' = O

namespace Axioms


def ofBooleanAlgebra (B : Type u) [BooleanAlgebra B] :
    Axioms (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b) (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b) ⊤ ⊥ where

  sup_comm := _root_.sup_comm
  inf_comm := _root_.inf_comm
  sup_assoc := fun a b c ↦ (_root_.sup_assoc a b c).symm
  inf_assoc := fun a b c ↦ (_root_.inf_assoc a b c).symm
  inf_sup := inf_sup_left
  sup_inf := sup_inf_left
  sup_zero := sup_bot_eq
  inf_one := inf_top_eq

  exists_compl := fun a ↦ ⟨aᶜ, sup_compl_eq_top, inf_compl_eq_bot'⟩


theorem identity_spec {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    (∀ a, sup a O = a) ∧ (∀ a, inf a I = a) := by

  exact ⟨h.sup_zero, h.inf_one⟩



private lemma operationIdempotence {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a : B) : sup a a = a ∧ inf a a = a := by

  obtain ⟨c, hcSup, hcInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  constructor
  · calc
      sup a a = inf (sup a a) I := (h.inf_one _).symm
      _ = inf (sup a a) (sup a c) := congrArg (inf (sup a a)) hcSup.symm
      _ = sup a (inf a c) := (h.sup_inf a a c).symm
      _ = sup a O := congrArg (sup a) hcInf
      _ = a := h.sup_zero a
  · calc
      inf a a = sup (inf a a) O := (h.sup_zero _).symm
      _ = sup (inf a a) (inf a c) := congrArg (sup (inf a a)) hcInf.symm
      _ = inf a (sup a c) := (h.inf_sup a a c).symm
      _ = inf a I := congrArg (inf a) hcSup
      _ = a := h.inf_one a



private lemma absorbingBounds {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a : B) : sup a I = I ∧ inf a O = O := by

  obtain ⟨c, hcSup, hcInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  constructor
  · calc
      sup a I = sup a (sup a c) := congrArg (sup a) hcSup.symm
      _ = sup (sup a a) c := h.sup_assoc a a c
      _ = sup a c := congrArg (fun x ↦ sup x c) (operationIdempotence h a).1
      _ = I := hcSup
  · calc
      inf a O = inf a (inf a c) := congrArg (inf a) hcInf.symm
      _ = inf (inf a a) c := h.inf_assoc a a c
      _ = inf a c := congrArg (fun x ↦ inf x c) (operationIdempotence h a).2
      _ = O := hcInf



private lemma absorption {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a b : B) :
    sup a (inf a b) = a ∧ inf a (sup a b) = a := by

  constructor
  · calc
      sup a (inf a b) = sup (inf a I) (inf a b) :=
        congrArg (fun x ↦ sup x (inf a b)) (h.inf_one a).symm
      _ = inf a (sup I b) := (h.inf_sup a I b).symm
      _ = inf a I := congrArg (inf a) ((h.sup_comm I b).trans (absorbingBounds h b).1)
      _ = a := h.inf_one a
  · calc
      inf a (sup a b) = inf (sup a O) (sup a b) :=
        congrArg (fun x ↦ inf x (sup a b)) (h.sup_zero a).symm
      _ = sup a (inf O b) := (h.sup_inf a O b).symm
      _ = sup a O := congrArg (sup a) ((h.inf_comm O b).trans (absorbingBounds h b).2)
      _ = a := h.sup_zero a



@[implicit_reducible]
private def latticeFromAxioms {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) : Lattice B :=

  @Lattice.mk' B ⟨sup⟩ ⟨inf⟩ h.sup_comm (fun a b c ↦ (h.sup_assoc a b c).symm)
    h.inf_comm (fun a b c ↦ (h.inf_assoc a b c).symm)
    (fun a b ↦ (absorption h a b).1) (fun a b ↦ (absorption h a b).2)



private lemma latticeFromAxiomsOperations {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    ((latticeFromAxioms h).sup, (latticeFromAxioms h).inf) = (sup, inf) := by

  rfl



private lemma complementsExist {B : Type u} [Lattice B] [BoundedOrder B]
    (h : Axioms (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b) (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b) ⊤ ⊥) (a : B) :
    ∃ b : B, IsCompl a b := by

  obtain ⟨b, hbSup, hbInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  exact ⟨b, IsCompl.of_eq hbInf hbSup⟩



private lemma booleanAlgebraOfComplementedOperations {B : Type u}
    [DistribLattice B] [BoundedOrder B] [ComplementedLattice B] :
    let b := DistribLattice.booleanAlgebraOfComplemented B
    (b.sup, b.inf, b.top, b.bot) =
      ((fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b), (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b), (⊤ : B), (⊥ : B)) := by

  rfl



theorem existsBooleanAlgebra {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    ∃ b : BooleanAlgebra B, (b.sup, b.inf, b.top, b.bot) = (sup, inf, I, O) := by



  letI : Lattice B := latticeFromAxioms h


  letI : DistribLattice B :=
    { latticeFromAxioms h with
      le_sup_inf := fun a b c ↦ le_of_eq (h.sup_inf a b c).symm }


  letI : BoundedOrder B :=
    { top := I
      bot := O
      le_top := fun a ↦ sup_eq_right.mp (absorbingBounds h a).1
      bot_le := fun a ↦ sup_eq_right.mp ((h.sup_comm O a).trans (h.sup_zero a)) }


  letI : ComplementedLattice B := ⟨complementsExist h⟩

  refine ⟨DistribLattice.booleanAlgebraOfComplemented B, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ((fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b), (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b), (⊤ : B), (⊥ : B)) :=
      booleanAlgebraOfComplementedOperations
    _ = (sup, inf, I, O) :=
      congrArg (fun p : (B → B → B) × (B → B → B) ↦ (p.1, p.2, I, O))
        (latticeFromAxiomsOperations h)

end Axioms

end BooleanAlgebra

namespace Real



private lemma negMulLog_add_mul_log_le_sub {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    negMulLog a + a * log b ≤ b - a := by

  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (negMulLog_le_one_sub_self (div_nonneg ha hb.le)) hb.le
  have hproduct := negMulLog_mul (a / b) b
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ a (ne_of_gt hb)] at hproduct
  have hterm : a / b * negMulLog b = -(a * log b) := by
    simp only [negMulLog, ← mul_assoc, mul_neg, div_mul_cancel₀ a (ne_of_gt hb),
      neg_mul]
  rw [hterm] at hproduct
  have hright : b * (1 - a / b) = b - a := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ a (ne_of_gt hb)]
  rw [hright] at hbound
  linarith


private lemma sumExpDivPos {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) : 0 < ∑ i, exp (s i / μ) := by

  obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := hι
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ ↦ exp_pos (s i / μ)) ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_univ i₀⟩


private lemma logSoftmax {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (i : ι) :
    log (softmax μ s i) = s i / μ - log (∑ j, exp (s j / μ)) := by

  rw [softmax, log_div (exp_ne_zero _) (ne_of_gt (sumExpDivPos hι s μ)), log_exp]


private lemma entropyRegularizedObjective_eq_logPartition_add
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι) (s v : ι → ℝ)
    (μ : ℝ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (hv : ∑ i, v i = 1) :
    entropyRegularizedObjective s μ v = μ * log (∑ i, exp (s i / μ)) +
      μ * ∑ i, (negMulLog (v i) + v i * log (softmax μ s i)) := by

  have hscore (i : ι) : v i * s i = μ * (v i * log (softmax μ s i)) +
      (μ * log (∑ j, exp (s j / μ))) * v i := by
    rw [logSoftmax hι s μ i]
    field_simp [hμ]
    ring

  rw [entropyRegularizedObjective,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ hscore i), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hv, mul_one, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring


private lemma entropyRegularizedObjectiveAtSoftmax {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (hι : Nonempty ι) (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    entropyRegularizedObjective s μ (softmax μ s) = μ * log (∑ i, exp (s i / μ)) := by

  rw [entropyRegularizedObjective_eq_logPartition_add hι s (softmax μ s) μ
    (ne_of_gt hμ) (softmax_mem_stdSimplex hι s μ hμ).2]
  simp only [negMulLog, neg_mul, neg_add_cancel, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero,
    add_zero]

end Real


public theorem softmax_maximizes {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    Real.softmax μ s ∈ stdSimplex ℝ ι ∧
      IsMaxOn (Real.entropyRegularizedObjective s μ) (stdSimplex ℝ ι)
        (Real.softmax μ s) := by

  have hsoft := Real.softmax_mem_stdSimplex hι s μ hμ
  refine ⟨hsoft, isMaxOn_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hresidual : ∑ i, (Real.negMulLog (v i) +
      v i * Real.log (Real.softmax μ s i)) ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (Real.softmax μ s i - v i) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ Real.negMulLog_add_mul_log_le_sub (hv.1 i)
          (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.sumExpDivPos hι s μ)))
      _ = 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsoft.2, hv.2, sub_self]

  calc
    Real.entropyRegularizedObjective s μ v =
        μ * Real.log (∑ i, Real.exp (s i / μ)) +
          μ * ∑ i, (Real.negMulLog (v i) + v i * Real.log (Real.softmax μ s i)) :=
      Real.entropyRegularizedObjective_eq_logPartition_add hι s v μ (ne_of_gt hμ) hv.2
    _ ≤ μ * Real.log (∑ i, Real.exp (s i / μ)) :=
      add_le_of_nonpos_right (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hμ.le hresidual)
    _ = Real.entropyRegularizedObjective s μ (Real.softmax μ s) :=
      (Real.entropyRegularizedObjectiveAtSoftmax hι s μ hμ).symm


public theorem softmax_value {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    Real.entropyRegularizedObjective s μ (Real.softmax μ s) =
      μ * Real.log (∑ i, Real.exp (s i / μ)) := by

  exact Real.entropyRegularizedObjectiveAtSoftmax hι s μ hμ

variable {V : Type u} {E : Type v}





def IsEdgeConnected (G : Graph V E) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : Set E, F.encard < k → ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.deleteEdges F).Adj x y


private lemma deleteEdgesInterEdgeSet (G : Graph V E) (F : Set E) :
    G.deleteEdges (F ∩ G.edgeSet) = G.deleteEdges F := by

  simp only [← restrict_edgeSet_sdiff_eq_deleteEdges, Set.sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff]



theorem isEdgeConnected_iff_deleteEdges (G : Graph V E)
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite) (k : ℕ) :
    G.IsEdgeConnected k ↔
      ∀ F : Set E, F ⊆ G.edgeSet → F.ncard < k →
        ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
          Relation.ReflTransGen (G.deleteEdges F).Adj x y := by
  constructor
  · intro h F hF hcard

    have hfinite := h_edges.subset hF
    have hencard : F.encard < k := by
      rw [← hfinite.cast_ncard_eq, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
      exact hcard
    exact h F hencard
  · intro h F hcard x hx y hy

    have hfinite := h_edges.subset (Set.inter_subset_right : F ∩ G.edgeSet ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    have hencard : (F ∩ G.edgeSet).encard < k :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.encard_le_encard Set.inter_subset_left) hcard
    have hncard : (F ∩ G.edgeSet).ncard < k := by
      rwa [← hfinite.cast_ncard_eq, ENat.coe_lt_coe] at hencard

    simpa only [deleteEdgesInterEdgeSet] using
      h (F ∩ G.edgeSet) Set.inter_subset_right hncard x hx y hy

end Graph

private lemma extendColoringValid {W α : Type*} (F : SimpleGraph W) (v : W)
    (C : (F.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Coloring α) (c : α)
    (hc : ∀ w : {w : W | w ≠ v}, F.Adj v w → C w ≠ c) :
    ∀ {x y : W}, F.Adj x y →
      Function.extend Subtype.val C (fun _ ↦ c) x ≠
        Function.extend Subtype.val C (fun _ ↦ c) y := by

  have hret (w : {w : W | w ≠ v}) :
      Function.extend Subtype.val C (fun _ ↦ c) w = C w :=
    Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply C (fun _ ↦ c) w
  have hnot : ¬∃ w : {w : W | w ≠ v}, w.val = v := by
    rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    exact w.property hw
  have hdel : Function.extend Subtype.val C (fun _ ↦ c) v = c :=
    Function.extend_apply' C (fun _ ↦ c) v hnot
  intro x y hadj

  by_cases hx : x = v
  · subst x
    simpa only [hdel, hret ⟨y, hadj.ne'⟩] using (hc ⟨y, hadj.ne'⟩ hadj).symm
  · by_cases hy : y = v
    · subst y
      simpa only [hret ⟨x, hx⟩, hdel] using hc ⟨x, hx⟩ hadj.symm
    · simpa only [hret ⟨x, hx⟩, hret ⟨y, hy⟩] using
        C.valid (v := ⟨x, hx⟩) (w := ⟨y, hy⟩) hadj


private lemma colorableOfInduceNeOfNeighborNcardLt {W : Type*} [Finite W]
    (F : SimpleGraph W) (v : W) {n : ℕ}
    (hC : (F.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Colorable n)
    (hdegree : (F.neighborSet v).ncard < n) : F.Colorable n := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := hC
  have hpos : 0 < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hdegree
  let d : Fin n := ⟨0, hpos⟩
  let e : W → Fin n := Function.extend Subtype.val C (fun _ ↦ d)

  have hcard : (e '' F.neighborSet v).ncard < (Set.univ : Set (Fin n)).ncard := by
    simpa only [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin] using
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.ncard_image_le (f := e)) hdegree
  obtain ⟨c, _, hc⟩ := Set.exists_mem_notMem_of_ncard_lt_ncard hcard
  have hfresh (w : {w : W | w ≠ v}) (hw : F.Adj v w) : C w ≠ c := by
    intro heq
    apply hc
    refine ⟨w.val, hw, ?_⟩
    exact (Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply C (fun _ ↦ d) w).trans heq

  exact ⟨Coloring.mk _ (extendColoringValid F v C c hfresh)⟩


private lemma Subgraph.colorableDeleteVertsOfMinimalNoncolorable
    {V : Type*} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : G.Subgraph} {n : ℕ}
    (hmin : MinimalFor (fun K : G.Subgraph ↦ ¬K.coe.Colorable n)
      (fun K ↦ K.verts.ncard) H) (v : H.verts) :
    (H.deleteVerts {v.val}).coe.Colorable n := by
  classical

  have hstrict : H.verts \ {v.val} ⊂ H.verts := by
    refine ⟨Set.sdiff_subset, ?_⟩
    intro hsub
    have hv := hsub v.property
    exact hv.2 (Set.mem_singleton v.val)
  have hcard : (H.deleteVerts {v.val}).verts.ncard < H.verts.ncard :=
    Set.ncard_lt_ncard hstrict
  by_contra hnot
  exact (not_le_of_gt hcard) (hmin.le_of_le hnot hcard.le)


private lemma Subgraph.neighborNcardGeOfMinimalNoncolorable
    {V : Type*} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : G.Subgraph} {n : ℕ}
    (hmin : MinimalFor (fun K : G.Subgraph ↦ ¬K.coe.Colorable n)
      (fun K ↦ K.verts.ncard) H) (v : H.verts) :
    n ≤ (H.coe.neighborSet v).ncard := by
  classical

  have hset : {w : H.verts | w.val ∉ ({v.val} : Set V)} = {w | w ≠ v} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, ne_eq, Subtype.ext_iff]
  have hdeleted : (H.coe.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Colorable n := by
    rw [← hset]
    exact (colorable_congr (H.coeDeleteVertsIso {v.val})).mp
      (Subgraph.colorableDeleteVertsOfMinimalNoncolorable hmin v)

  by_contra hdegree
  exact hmin.prop (colorableOfInduceNeOfNeighborNcardLt H.coe v hdeleted
    (lt_of_not_ge hdegree))

end SimpleGraph




public theorem SimpleGraph.existsSubgraphDegreeGe {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hχ : G.chromaticNumber = (k : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ H : G.Subgraph, H.coe.chromaticNumber = (k : ℕ∞) ∧
      ∀ v : H.verts, k - 1 ≤ (H.coe.neighborSet v).ncard := by
  classical
  have hsucc : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
  have hχsucc : G.chromaticNumber = ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    simpa only [← Nat.cast_add_one, hsucc] using hχ
  obtain ⟨hcolor, hnot⟩ :=
    SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber_eq_iff_colorable_not_colorable.mp hχsucc

  have hex : ∃ H : G.Subgraph, ¬H.coe.Colorable (k - 1) := by
    refine ⟨⊤, ?_⟩
    intro hc
    exact hnot (hc.of_hom SimpleGraph.Subgraph.topIso.symm.toHom)
  obtain ⟨H, hmin⟩ := exists_minimalFor_of_wellFoundedLT
    (fun H : G.Subgraph ↦ ¬H.coe.Colorable (k - 1)) (fun H ↦ H.verts.ncard) hex
  refine ⟨H, ?_, SimpleGraph.Subgraph.neighborNcardGeOfMinimalNoncolorable hmin⟩

  have hHχ : H.coe.chromaticNumber = ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 :=
    SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber_eq_iff_colorable_not_colorable.mpr
      ⟨hcolor.of_hom H.hom, hmin.prop⟩
  simpa only [← Nat.cast_add_one, hsucc] using hHχ

namespace MaxForm

variable {E1 : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E1]
variable {E2 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℝ E2]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E2]



noncomputable def objective (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) : E1 → ℝ :=
  fun x ↦ fhat x + sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2)


lemma objective_apply (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (x : E1) :
    objective Q2 fhat phi A x = fhat x + sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2) := by

  rfl


theorem objective_congr {Q1 : Set E1} {Q2 : Set E2} {fhat ghat : E1 → ℝ}
    {phi psi : E2 → ℝ} (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hf : Set.EqOn fhat ghat Q1) (hphi : Set.EqOn phi psi Q2) :
    Set.EqOn (objective Q2 fhat phi A) (objective Q2 ghat psi A) Q1 := by

  intro x hx
  have himage : (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2 =
      (fun u ↦ A x u - psi u) '' Q2 := by
    refine Set.image_congr ?_
    intro u hu
    rw [hphi hu]
  rw [objective_apply, objective_apply, hf hx, himage]


noncomputable def optimalValue (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) : ℝ :=
  sInf (objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1)


lemma optimalValue_def (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) :
    optimalValue Q1 Q2 fhat phi A = sInf (objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1) := by

  rfl


private lemma continuousPairing (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) :
    Continuous (fun p : E1 × E2 ↦ A p.1 p.2) := by

  let B : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap.comp A

  exact (B.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd


private lemma bddAboveDualImage (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hQ : IsCompact Q)
    (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q) (x : E1) :
    BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q) := by

  exact hQ.bddAbove_image ((A x).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousOn.sub hphi)


private lemma continuousDualSup (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hQ : IsCompact Q)
    (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q) :
    Continuous (fun x ↦ sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) := by

  have hpayoff : Continuous (fun p : E1 × Q ↦ A p.1 p.2 - phi p.2) :=
    ((continuousPairing A).comp
      (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))).sub
      (hphi.restrict.comp continuous_snd)

  have hsup := (isCompact_iff_isCompact_univ.mp hQ).continuous_sSup
    (f := fun x (u : Q) ↦ A x u - phi u) hpayoff

  simp only [Set.image_univ] at hsup
  simpa only [Set.image_eq_range] using hsup


private lemma convexDualSup (S : Set E1) (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hQ : Q.Nonempty)
    (hbdd : ∀ x ∈ S, BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) :
    ConvexOn ℝ S (fun x ↦ sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) := by
  refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab

  refine csSup_le (hQ.image _) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hleft := le_csSup (hbdd x hx) (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) hu)
  have hright := le_csSup (hbdd y hy) (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun u ↦ A y u - phi u) hu)
  have hpenalty : (a + b) * phi u = phi u := by
    rw [hab, one_mul]
  have haffine : A (a • x + b • y) u - phi u =
      a * (A x u - phi u) + b * (A y u - phi u) := by
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith only [hpenalty]

  calc
    A (a • x + b • y) u - phi u =
        a * (A x u - phi u) + b * (A y u - phi u) := haffine
    _ ≤ a * sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q) +
        b * sSup ((fun u ↦ A y u - phi u) '' Q) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleft ha)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright hb)


theorem continuousOn_objective (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2) (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q2)
    (hfhat : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) :
    ContinuousOn (objective Q2 fhat phi A) Q1 := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩

  exact hfhat.add (continuousDualSup Q2 phi A hcompact hphi).continuousOn


theorem convexOn_objective (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2) (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q2)
    (hfhat : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Q1 (objective Q2 fhat phi A) := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩
  have hbdd : ∀ x ∈ Q1, BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2) :=
    fun x _ ↦ bddAboveDualImage Q2 phi A hcompact hphi x

  exact hfhat.add (convexDualSup Q1 Q2 phi A hfhat.1 hQ2_nonempty hbdd)

end MaxForm

private lemma neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hmax : ∀ (x y : V) (q : G.Walk x y), q.IsPath → q.length ≤ p.length) :
    ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support := by
  classical

  intro w hw
  by_contra hmissing
  have hlong := hmax w b (cons hw.symm p) (hp.cons hmissing)
  simp only [length_cons] at hlong
  omega


private lemma degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} [Fintype (G.neighborSet a)] (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hcover : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support) : G.degree a ≤ p.length := by
  classical

  have hsubset : insert a (G.neighborFinset a) ⊆ p.support.toFinset := by
    intro w hw
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hw with rfl | hw
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr p.start_mem_support
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (hcover w ((G.mem_neighborFinset a w).mp hw))
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (G.notMem_neighborFinset_self a),
    G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcard
  have hsupport := List.toFinset_card_le p.support
  rw [length_support] at hsupport
  omega



private lemma existsAdjGetVertGe {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} [Fintype (G.neighborSet a)] (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hcover : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hdegree : k ≤ G.degree a) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, k ≤ i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧ G.Adj a (p.getVert i) := by
  classical

  by_contra hnone
  have hprefix : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ (p.take (k - 1)).support := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨i, hiw, hilength⟩ := mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp (hcover w hw)
    have hi : i ≤ k - 1 := by
      by_contra hlarge
      have hki : k ≤ i := by omega
      exact hnone ⟨i, hki, hilength, hiw.symm ▸ hw⟩
    have hmem := (p.take (k - 1)).getVert_mem_support i
    simpa only [take_getVert, Nat.min_eq_right hi, hiw] using hmem
  have hbound := (p.take (k - 1)).degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport hprefix
  rw [take_length] at hbound
  have hmin : min (k - 1) p.length ≤ k - 1 := Nat.min_le_left _ _
  omega


private lemma isCycleConsReverseOfIsPath {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} (q : G.Walk a b) (hq : q.IsPath) (hlength : 2 ≤ q.length)
    (h : G.Adj a b) : (cons h q.reverse).IsCycle := by

  refine isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [tail_cons]
    exact (isPath_copy _ _ _).mpr hq.reverse
  · simp only [length_cons, length_reverse]
    omega

end SimpleGraph.Walk



theorem existsPath_length_minDegree {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V] :
    ∃ (u v : V) (p : G.Walk u v), p.IsPath ∧ p.length = G.minDegree := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hmax⟩ := Walk.exists_isPath_forall_isPath_length_le_length G
  have hcover := p.neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength hp hmax
  have hlength : G.minDegree ≤ p.length :=
    (G.minDegree_le_degree a).trans (p.degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport hcover)

  refine ⟨a, p.getVert G.minDegree, p.take G.minDegree, hp.take _, ?_⟩
  rw [Walk.take_length, Nat.min_eq_left hlength]




theorem existsCycle_length_ge_minDegree {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    ∃ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle ∧ G.minDegree + 1 ≤ c.length := by

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    have hzero := G.minDegree_of_subsingleton
    omega
  | inr hnonempty =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hmax⟩ := Walk.exists_isPath_forall_isPath_length_le_length G
    have hcover := p.neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength hp hmax
    have hpositive : 0 < G.minDegree := by omega

    obtain ⟨i, hδi, hi, hadj⟩ :=
      p.existsAdjGetVertGe hcover G.minDegree hpositive (G.minDegree_le_degree a)
    have hprefixLength : (p.take i).length = i := by
      rw [Walk.take_length, Nat.min_eq_left hi]
    have htwo : 2 ≤ (p.take i).length := by
      rw [hprefixLength]
      exact hδ.trans hδi
    refine ⟨a, Walk.cons hadj (p.take i).reverse,
      (p.take i).isCycleConsReverseOfIsPath (hp.take i) htwo hadj, ?_⟩
    simp only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_reverse, hprefixLength]
    omega

private lemma finiteLinearStep {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, b i = 0 → a i ≤ 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, t * a i ≤ b i := by
  classical

  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, fun i hi ↦ False.elim (Finset.notMem_empty i hi)⟩
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := ih
      (fun j hj ↦ hb j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
      (fun j hj ↦ ha j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
    have hbi := hb i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)
    have hai := ha i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)
    by_cases hsign : a i ≤ 0
    · refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with hji | hj
      · rw [hji]
        exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht.le hsign).trans hbi
      · exact hstep j hj
    · have hapos : 0 < a i := lt_of_not_ge hsign
      have hbpos : 0 < b i := lt_of_le_of_ne hbi (Ne.symm fun hz ↦ hsign (hai hz))
      refine ⟨min t (b i / a i), lt_min ht (div_pos hbpos hapos), ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with hji | hj
      · rw [hji]
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right t (b i / a i)) hapos.le).trans
          (le_of_eq (div_mul_cancel₀ (b i) hapos.ne'))
      · by_cases hjpos : 0 ≤ a j
        · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left t (b i / a i)) hjpos).trans
            (hstep j hj)
        · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
            (le_min ht.le (div_nonneg hbpos.le hapos.le)) (le_of_not_ge hjpos)).trans
            (hb j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))


private lemma linearProductApply {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (a : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E) (t : ℝ) :
    a (z, t) = a (z, 0) + a (0, 1) * t := by

  have hp : (z, t) = (z, 0) + t • (0, 1) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · simp
  rw [hp, map_add, map_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm t]



private lemma polyhedralEpigraphModel
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (r : ℝ) (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hp : Set.IsPolyhedral {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ |
      f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ),
      (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ), f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i) ∧
      (∀ i, c i ≤ 0) ∧
      ∃ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i ∧ c i < 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hp
  let u := fun i ↦ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).symm
    ((a i).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ))
  let c := fun i ↦ a i (0, 1)
  have hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ), f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔
      ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i := by
    intro z t
    have hhorizontal : ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z = a i (z, 0) := by
      intro i
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    have hsplit : ∀ i, a i (z, t) = inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t := by
      intro i
      rw [linearProductApply, hhorizontal]
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hsplit] using ha (z, t)
  have hbase : ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r ≤ b i :=
    (hmodel x r).mp hr.le

  have hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ 0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra hsign
    have hpos : 0 < c i := lt_of_not_ge hsign
    let s := (b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r + 1) / c i
    have hnumerator : 0 < b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r + 1 := by
      linarith [hbase i]
    have hs : 0 < s := div_pos hnumerator hpos
    have hheight : f x ≤ ((r + s : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [hr, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      linarith
    have hrow := (hmodel x (r + s)).mp hheight i
    have hmul : s * c i = b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r + 1 :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne'
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨m, u, c, b, hmodel, hc, ?_⟩

  by_contra hactive
  push Not at hactive
  have hslack : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, 0 ≤ b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r := by
    intro i hi
    linarith [hbase i]
  have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ,
      b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r = 0 → -c i ≤ 0 := by
    intro i hi heq
    have he : inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i := by linarith
    linarith [hactive i he]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := finiteLinearStep Finset.univ (fun i ↦ -c i)
    (fun i ↦ b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r) hslack hzero
  have hdown : f x ≤ ((r - t : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    refine (hmodel x (r - t)).mpr ?_
    intro i
    have hi := hstep i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    nlinarith
  rw [hr, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hdown
  linarith


private lemma normalizedRowSubgradient
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (r c b : ℝ) (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hrow : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ), f z ≤ (t : EReal) → inner ℝ u z + c * t ≤ b)
    (hactive : inner ℝ u x + c * r = b) (hc : c < 0) :
    (-c)⁻¹ • u ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x := by
  intro z
  rw [hr]

  refine EReal.le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp ?_
  intro q hq
  have hz := hrow z q hq.le
  have hinner : (-c) * inner ℝ ((-c)⁻¹ • u) (z - x) =
      inner ℝ u z - inner ℝ u x := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_right, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc.ne), one_mul]
  rw [← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
  nlinarith



private lemma secantRealBound (a : EReal) (r t q : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (a - (r : EReal)) / (t : EReal) ≤ (q : EReal) ↔
      a ≤ ((r + t * q : ℝ) : EReal) := by

  rw [EReal.div_le_iff_le_mul (EReal.coe_pos.mpr ht) (EReal.coe_ne_top t),
    EReal.sub_le_iff_le_add (.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot r)) (.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top r)),
    ← EReal.coe_mul, ← EReal.coe_add, add_comm (t * q) r]


private lemma subgradientLeDirectionalDeriv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x v d : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hv : v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x) :
    (inner ℝ v d : EReal) ≤ EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d := by

  refine le_iInf fun t ↦ ?_
  rw [hr, EReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (EReal.coe_pos.mpr t.property)
    (EReal.coe_ne_top t.val),
    EReal.le_sub_iff_add_le (.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot r)) (.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top r))]
  have hbound := hv (x + t.val • d)
  simpa only [hr, add_sub_cancel_left, inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
    ← EReal.coe_mul, ← EReal.coe_add, mul_comm, add_comm] using hbound


private lemma directionalDerivZero
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : f x = (r : EReal)) :
    EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x 0 = 0 := by

  simp only [EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv, smul_zero, add_zero, hr,
    ← EReal.coe_sub, sub_self, EReal.coe_zero, EReal.zero_div, iInf_const]



private lemma activeRowsRay {m : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ) (r q : ℝ)
    (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i) :
    (∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i →
      inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q ≤ 0) ↔
      ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ f (x + t • d) ≤ ((r + t * q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  classical
  have hbase := (hmodel x r).mp hr.le
  constructor
  · intro hactive

    have hslack : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, 0 ≤ b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r := by
      intro i hi
      linarith [hbase i]
    have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r = 0 →
        inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q ≤ 0 := by
      intro i hi heq
      have he : inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i := by linarith
      exact hactive i he
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := finiteLinearStep Finset.univ
      (fun i ↦ inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q)
      (fun i ↦ b i - inner ℝ (u i) x - c i * r) hslack hzero
    refine ⟨t, ht, (hmodel _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hi := hstep i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ i heq

    have hi := (hmodel _ _).mp hstep i
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right] at hi
    nlinarith



private lemma directionalDerivLeActive {m : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ) (r q : ℝ)
    (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i) :
    EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d ≤ (q : EReal) ↔
      ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i →
        inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q ≤ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hderiv i hactive

    have hnear : ∀ q' : ℝ, q < q' → inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q' ≤ 0 := by
      intro q' hq'
      have hlt : EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d < (q' : EReal) :=
        hderiv.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hq')
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp hlt
      have hbound := (secantRealBound (f (x + t.val • d)) r t.val q'
        t.property).mp (hr ▸ ht.le)
      exact (activeRowsRay f x d u c b r q' hr hmodel).mpr
        ⟨t.val, t.property, hbound⟩ i hactive

    by_contra hpositive
    have hpos : 0 < inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q := lt_of_not_ge hpositive
    obtain ⟨e, he, hsmall⟩ := exists_pos_mul_lt hpos (-c i)
    have hrow := hnear (q + e) (lt_add_of_pos_right q he)
    nlinarith
  · intro hactive
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := (activeRowsRay f x d u c b r q hr hmodel).mp hactive

    have hslope := (secantRealBound (f (x + t • d)) r t q ht).mpr hstep
    rw [← hr] at hslope
    exact (iInf_le (fun s : {s : ℝ // 0 < s} ↦
      (f (x + s.val • d) - f x) / (s.val : EReal)) ⟨t, ht⟩).trans hslope


private noncomputable def epigraphRow
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (u : E) (c : ℝ) :
    E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ u).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ) +
    c • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E ℝ


private lemma epigraphRow_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (u : E) (c : ℝ) (p : E × ℝ) :
    epigraphRow u c p = inner ℝ u p.1 + c * p.2 := by

  rfl



private lemma zeroRowAddSubgradient
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (r b t : ℝ) (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hrow : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (q : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (q : EReal) → inner ℝ u z ≤ b)
    (hactive : inner ℝ u x = b) (hv : v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    v + t • u ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x := by
  intro z

  refine EReal.le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp ?_
  intro q hq
  have hz := hrow z q hq.le
  have hbase := (hv z).trans hq.le
  rw [hr, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hbase ⊢
  rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  simp only [inner_sub_right] at hbase ⊢
  nlinarith



private lemma supportBoundActive {m : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ) (r q : ℝ)
    (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ 0) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hv : v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x)
    (hbound : EReal.supportFunction (EReal.subdifferential f x) d < (q : EReal)) :
    ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i →
      inner ℝ (u i) d + c i * q ≤ 0 := by
  intro i hi
  by_cases hneg : c i < 0
  ·
    have hw := normalizedRowSubgradient f x (u i) r (c i) (b i) hr
      (fun z t hz ↦ (hmodel z t).mp hz i) hi hneg
    have hvalue : (inner ℝ ((-c i)⁻¹ • u i) d : EReal) < (q : EReal) :=
      (le_iSup_of_le ((-c i)⁻¹ • u i) (le_iSup (fun _ : (-c i)⁻¹ • u i ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↦
        (inner ℝ ((-c i)⁻¹ • u i) d : EReal)) hw)).trans_lt hbound
    have hreal := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp hvalue
    have hinner : (-c i) * inner ℝ ((-c i)⁻¹ • u i) d = inner ℝ (u i) d := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hneg.ne),
        one_mul]
    nlinarith
  ·
    have hzero : c i = 0 := le_antisymm (hc i) (le_of_not_gt hneg)
    have hactive : inner ℝ (u i) x = b i := by simpa only [hzero, zero_mul, add_zero] using hi
    have hrow : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
        f z ≤ (t : EReal) → inner ℝ (u i) z ≤ b i := by
      intro z t hz
      simpa only [hzero, zero_mul, add_zero] using (hmodel z t).mp hz i
    rw [hzero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    by_contra hdir
    have hpos : 0 < inner ℝ (u i) d := lt_of_not_ge hdir
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hlarge⟩ := exists_pos_lt_mul hpos (q - inner ℝ v d)
    have hw := zeroRowAddSubgradient f x (u i) v r (b i) t hr hrow hactive hv ht.le
    have hvalue : (inner ℝ (v + t • u i) d : EReal) < (q : EReal) :=
      (le_iSup_of_le (v + t • u i) (le_iSup (fun _ : v + t • u i ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↦
        (inner ℝ (v + t • u i) d : EReal)) hw)).trans_lt hbound
    have hreal := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp hvalue
    rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left] at hreal
    linarith



private lemma scalarFeasible {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c d : ι → ℝ) :
    (∃ t : ℝ, ∀ i, c i * t ≤ d i) ↔
      (∀ i, c i = 0 → 0 ≤ d i) ∧
      ∀ i j, c i < 0 → 0 < c j → d i / c i ≤ d j / c j := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    constructor
    · intro i hi
      simpa only [hi, zero_mul] using ht i
    · intro i j hi hj
      exact ((div_le_iff_of_neg' hi).mpr (ht i)).trans
        ((le_div_iff₀' hj).mpr (ht j))
  · rintro ⟨hzero, hpairs⟩

    have hinterval : ∃ t : ℝ, (∀ i, c i < 0 → d i / c i ≤ t) ∧
        ∀ j, 0 < c j → t ≤ d j / c j := by
      by_cases hneg : (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ c i < 0).Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, hmax⟩ := (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ c i < 0).exists_max_image
          (fun i ↦ d i / c i) hneg
        refine ⟨d i / c i, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j hj
          exact hmax j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩)
        · intro j hj
          exact hpairs i j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2 hj
      ·
        by_cases hpos : (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ 0 < c i).Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ 0 < c i).exists_min_image
            (fun i ↦ d i / c i) hpos
          refine ⟨d j / c j, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            exact False.elim (hneg ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩)
          · intro i hi
            exact hmin i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)
        · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            exact False.elim (hneg ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩)
          · intro i hi
            exact False.elim (hpos ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩)
    obtain ⟨t, hlower, hupper⟩ := hinterval
    refine ⟨t, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases lt_trichotomy (c i) 0 with hi | hi | hi
    · exact (div_le_iff_of_neg' hi).mp (hlower i hi)
    · simpa only [hi, zero_mul] using hzero i hi
    · exact (le_div_iff₀' hi).mp (hupper i hi)


private lemma polyhedralOfFiniteRows
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [Fintype ι]
    (s : Set E) (a : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ∀ i, a i x ≤ b i) : Set.IsPolyhedral s := by
  classical

  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  refine ⟨Fintype.card ι, (fun i ↦ a (e.symm i)), (fun i ↦ b (e.symm i)), ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [h]
  exact e.symm.surjective.forall


private lemma polyhedralPreimage
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (s : Set F) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) (g : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral (g ⁻¹' s) := by

  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨m, (fun i ↦ (a i).comp g), b, fun x ↦ ha (g x)⟩



private lemma scalarProjectionPolyhedral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s : Set (E × ℝ)) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral {x | ∃ t : ℝ, (x, t) ∈ s} := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hs
  let c := fun i ↦ a i (0, 1)
  let L := fun i ↦ (a i).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)
  let I := {i : Fin m // c i = 0} ⊕
    ({i : Fin m // c i < 0} × {j : Fin m // 0 < c j})
  let A : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ := Sum.elim (fun i ↦ L i.val)
    (fun ij ↦ (c ij.2.val)⁻¹ • L ij.2.val - (c ij.1.val)⁻¹ • L ij.1.val)
  let B : I → ℝ := Sum.elim (fun i ↦ b i.val)
    (fun ij ↦ b ij.2.val / c ij.2.val - b ij.1.val / c ij.1.val)
  refine polyhedralOfFiniteRows _ A B ?_
  intro x

  have hsplit : ∀ i t, a i (x, t) = L i x + c i * t := by
    intro i t
    exact linearProductApply (a i) x t
  have hfeasible : (∃ t : ℝ, (x, t) ∈ s) ↔
      (∀ i, c i = 0 → L i x ≤ b i) ∧
      ∀ i j, c i < 0 → 0 < c j →
        (b i - L i x) / c i ≤ (b j - L j x) / c j := by
    have hrows : (∃ t : ℝ, (x, t) ∈ s) ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, ∀ i, c i * t ≤ b i - L i x := by
      simp only [ha, hsplit, le_sub_iff_add_le, add_comm]
    rw [hrows, scalarFeasible]
    simp only [sub_nonneg]
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hfeasible]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hp⟩ i
    rcases i with i | ⟨i, j⟩
    · exact hz i.val i.property
    · have hij := hp i.val j.val i.property j.property
      simp only [A, B, Sum.elim_inr, sub_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        ← div_eq_inv_mul, sub_div] at hij ⊢
      linarith
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro i hi
      exact h (Sum.inl ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · intro i j hi hj
      have hij := h (Sum.inr (⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩))
      simp only [A, B, Sum.elim_inr, sub_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        ← div_eq_inv_mul, sub_div] at hij ⊢
      linarith


private noncomputable def prependCoordinate
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (k : ℕ) :
    (E × (Fin k → ℝ)) × ℝ →L[ℝ] E × (Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E (Fin k → ℝ)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (E × (Fin k → ℝ)) ℝ)).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.finCons
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (E × (Fin k → ℝ)) ℝ)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (Fin k → ℝ)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (E × (Fin k → ℝ)) ℝ)))


private lemma prependCoordinate_apply
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (k : ℕ)
    (x : E) (y : Fin k → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    prependCoordinate E k ((x, y), t) = (x, Fin.cons t y) := by

  rfl


private lemma finiteProjectionPolyhedral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (k : ℕ)
    (s : Set (E × (Fin k → ℝ))) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral {x | ∃ y : Fin k → ℝ, (x, y) ∈ s} := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>

    have hset : {x | ∃ y : Fin 0 → ℝ, (x, y) ∈ s} =
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E).prod (0 : E →L[ℝ] Fin 0 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' s := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        have hyzero : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [hyzero] at hy
        exact hy
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨0, hx⟩
    rw [hset]
    exact polyhedralPreimage s hs _
  | succ k ih =>

    have hpre := polyhedralPreimage s hs (prependCoordinate E k)
    have hscalar := scalarProjectionPolyhedral _ hpre
    have hremaining := ih _ hscalar
    have hset : {x | ∃ y : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ, (x, y) ∈ s} =
        {x | ∃ y : Fin k → ℝ, ∃ t : ℝ,
          prependCoordinate E k ((x, y), t) ∈ s} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        refine ⟨Fin.tail y, y 0, ?_⟩
        simpa only [prependCoordinate_apply, Fin.cons_self_tail] using hy
      · rintro ⟨y, t, ht⟩
        exact ⟨Fin.cons t y, ht⟩
    rw [hset]
    exact hremaining


private lemma polyhedralInter
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s t : Set E) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) (ht : Set.IsPolyhedral t) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral (s ∩ t) := by
  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨k, c, d, hc⟩ := ht

  refine polyhedralOfFiniteRows _ (Sum.elim a c) (Sum.elim b d) ?_
  intro x
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, ha, hc, Sum.forall, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]


private lemma polyhedralIsClosed
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s : Set E) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) : IsClosed s := by
  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hs
  have hset : s = ⋂ i, {x | a i x ≤ b i} := by
    ext x
    simpa only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using ha x

  rw [hset]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i ↦ isClosed_le (a i).continuous continuous_const


private lemma polyhedralKernel
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (g : E →L[ℝ] F) : Set.IsPolyhedral {x | g x = 0} := by
  classical
  let basis := Module.finBasis ℝ F
  let a := fun i ↦ (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (basis.coord i)).comp g

  refine polyhedralOfFiniteRows _
    (fun i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ F) × Bool ↦ if i.2 then a i.1 else -a i.1)
    (fun _ ↦ 0) ?_
  intro x
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← basis.forall_coord_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    have hi : a i.1 x = 0 := hx i.1
    cases i.2
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_apply, hi, neg_zero, le_refl]
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, hi, le_refl]
  · intro hx i
    have hp : a i x ≤ 0 := hx (i, true)
    have hn : -(a i x) ≤ 0 := hx (i, false)
    exact le_antisymm hp (neg_nonpos.mp hn)


private noncomputable def finiteCombinationMap
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → F) : (Fin m → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F :=
  ∑ i, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).smulRight (a i)


private lemma finiteCombinationMap_apply
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → F) (v : Fin m → ℝ) :
    finiteCombinationMap a v = ∑ i, v i • a i := by

  simp only [finiteCombinationMap, sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]


private lemma finiteConePolyhedral
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → F) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral {w | ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) ∧ w = ∑ i, v i • a i} := by
  let N : Set (F × (Fin m → ℝ)) := {p | ∀ i, 0 ≤ p.2 i}
  let G := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ F (Fin m → ℝ) -
    (finiteCombinationMap a).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ F (Fin m → ℝ))
  have hN : Set.IsPolyhedral N := by
    refine polyhedralOfFiniteRows _
      (fun i ↦ -((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ F (Fin m → ℝ)))) (fun _ ↦ 0) ?_
    intro p
    simp only [N, Set.mem_setOf_eq, neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, neg_nonpos]
    rfl
  have hG : Set.IsPolyhedral {p | G p = 0} := polyhedralKernel G
  have hprojection := finiteProjectionPolyhedral m _ (polyhedralInter N _ hN hG)
  have hset : {w | ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) ∧ w = ∑ i, v i • a i} =
      {w | ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (w, v) ∈ N ∩ {p | G p = 0}} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, N, G, sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, finiteCombinationMap_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    rfl

  rw [hset]
  exact hprojection


private lemma generatorRayMemFiniteCone
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) ∧ t • a i = ∑ j, v j • a j := by
  classical

  refine ⟨Pi.single i t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa only [Pi.single_eq_same] using ht
    · simp only [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), le_refl]
  · simp only [Pi.single_apply, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
      if_pos]



private lemma dualFunctionalEvaluation
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (F : (V →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ∃ y : V, ∀ a : V →L[ℝ] ℝ, a y = F a := by
  let g : Module.Dual ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ V) :=
    F.toLinearMap.comp LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap

  refine ⟨(Module.evalEquiv ℝ V).symm g, ?_⟩
  intro a
  exact Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply ℝ V a.toLinearMap g



private lemma finiteHalfspaceImplication
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → V →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ell : V →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∀ y, (∀ i, a i y ≤ 0) → ell y ≤ 0) ↔
      ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) ∧ ell = ∑ i, v i • a i := by
  constructor
  · intro himp
    let K : Set (V →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
      {w | ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) ∧ w = ∑ i, v i • a i}
    have hpoly : Set.IsPolyhedral K := finiteConePolyhedral a

    by_contra hnot
    obtain ⟨F, s, hFs, hsep⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed
      hpoly.convex (polyhedralIsClosed K hpoly) hnot
    have hzero : (0 : V →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∈ K := by
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        exact le_rfl
      · simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hs : s < 0 := by simpa only [map_zero] using hsep 0 hzero
    have hrows : ∀ i, 0 ≤ F (a i) := by
      intro i
      by_contra hneg
      have hpos : 0 < -F (a i) := neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hneg)
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hlarge⟩ := exists_pos_lt_mul hpos (-s)
      have hray := hsep (t • a i) (generatorRayMemFiniteCone a i t ht.le)
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hray
      nlinarith

    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := dualFunctionalEvaluation F
    have hprimal : ∀ i, a i (-y) ≤ 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [map_neg, hy]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (hrows i)
    have hcontradiction := himp (-y) hprimal
    rw [map_neg, hy] at hcontradiction
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ y hy

    simp only [sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_nonpos fun i hi ↦ mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hv i) (hy i)


private lemma polyhedralAffinePreimage
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (s : Set F) (hs : Set.IsPolyhedral s) (g : E →L[ℝ] F) (z : F) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral {x | g x + z ∈ s} := by
  obtain ⟨m, a, b, ha⟩ := hs

  refine ⟨m, (fun i ↦ (a i).comp g), (fun i ↦ b i - a i z), ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ha, map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    le_sub_iff_add_le]


private noncomputable def horizontalRowMap
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] :
    E →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (E × ℝ) E ℝ).flip
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ)).comp (innerSL ℝ)


private lemma horizontalRowMap_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (v : E) (p : E × ℝ) : horizontalRowMap E v p = inner ℝ v p.1 := by

  rfl


private lemma horizontalRowMap_addVertical
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (v : E) :
    horizontalRowMap E v + epigraphRow (0 : E) (-1) = epigraphRow v (-1) := by

  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro p
  simp only [add_apply, horizontalRowMap_apply, epigraphRow_apply, inner_zero_left, zero_add]



private lemma subgradientActiveImplication {m : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      ∀ p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ,
        (∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i → epigraphRow (u i) (c i) p ≤ 0) →
        epigraphRow v (-1) p ≤ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hv p hp

    have hactive : ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i →
        inner ℝ (u i) p.1 + c i * p.2 ≤ 0 := hp
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := (activeRowsRay f x p.1 u c b r p.2 hr hmodel).mp hactive
    have hsub := (hv (x + t • p.1)).trans hstep
    rw [hr, add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_right, ← EReal.coe_add,
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hsub
    rw [epigraphRow_apply]
    nlinarith
  · intro himp z

    refine EReal.le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp ?_
    intro q hq
    have hactive : ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i →
        epigraphRow (u i) (c i) (z - x, q - r) ≤ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      have hz := (hmodel z q).mp hq.le i
      rw [epigraphRow_apply, inner_sub_right]
      nlinarith
    have hbound := himp (z - x, q - r) hactive
    rw [epigraphRow_apply] at hbound
    rw [hr, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    linarith


private lemma polyhedralSubdifferentialOfFiniteRows {m : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c b : Fin m → ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : f x = (r : EReal))
    (hmodel : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
      f z ≤ (t : EReal) ↔ ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) z + c i * t ≤ b i) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by
  classical
  let a : Fin m → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun i ↦
    if inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i then epigraphRow (u i) (c i) else 0
  let K := {w | ∃ t : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ w = ∑ i, t i • a i}
  have hrows : ∀ p, (∀ i, a i p ≤ 0) ↔
      ∀ i, inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i → epigraphRow (u i) (c i) p ≤ 0 := by
    intro p
    refine forall_congr' fun i ↦ ?_
    by_cases hi : inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i
    · simp only [a, hi, if_pos, true_implies]
    · simp only [a, hi, if_false, false_implies, zero_apply, le_refl]
  have hmem : ∀ v, v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      horizontalRowMap _ v + epigraphRow (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (-1) ∈ K := by
    intro v

    have hfarkas := finiteHalfspaceImplication a (epigraphRow v (-1))
    simp only [hrows] at hfarkas
    rw [horizontalRowMap_addVertical]
    exact (subgradientActiveImplication f x v u c b r hr hmodel).trans hfarkas
  have hset : EReal.subdifferential f x =
      {v | horizontalRowMap _ v + epigraphRow (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (-1) ∈ K} := by
    ext v
    exact hmem v

  rw [hset]
  exact polyhedralAffinePreimage K (finiteConePolyhedral a) _ _



theorem subdifferentiableAt_of_polyhedralEpigraph
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hpolyhedral : Set.IsPolyhedral
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    EReal.subdifferentiableAt f x := by

  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  obtain ⟨m, u, c, b, hmodel, hc, i, hactive, hneg⟩ :=
    polyhedralEpigraphModel f x r hr hpolyhedral
  refine ⟨(-c i)⁻¹ • u i, ?_⟩
  exact normalizedRowSubgradient f x (u i) r (c i) (b i) hr
    (fun z t hz ↦ (hmodel z t).mp hz i) hactive hneg




theorem subdifferential_polyhedral
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hpolyhedral : Set.IsPolyhedral
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by

  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  obtain ⟨m, u, c, b, hmodel, hc, hnegative⟩ :=
    polyhedralEpigraphModel f x r hr hpolyhedral
  exact polyhedralSubdifferentialOfFiniteRows f x u c b r hr hmodel




theorem convexDirectionalDeriv_proper
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hpolyhedral : Set.IsPolyhedral
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    (∀ d, EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d ≠ ⊥) ∧
      ∃ d, EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d < ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := subdifferentiableAt_of_polyhedralEpigraph f x hpolyhedral hfinite
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  constructor
  · intro d

    have hbound := subgradientLeDirectionalDeriv f x v d r hr hv
    exact ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot (EReal.coe_ne_bot _) hbound
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [directionalDerivZero f x r hr]
    exact EReal.coe_lt_top 0



theorem convexDirectionalDeriv_polyhedral
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hpolyhedral : Set.IsPolyhedral
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    Set.IsPolyhedral {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ |
      EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  obtain ⟨m, u, c, b, hmodel, hc, hnegative⟩ :=
    polyhedralEpigraphModel f x r hr hpolyhedral

  refine ⟨m, (fun i ↦ if inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i then
    epigraphRow (u i) (c i) else 0), (fun _ ↦ 0), ?_⟩
  intro p
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, directionalDerivLeActive f x p.1 u c b r p.2 hr hmodel]
  refine forall_congr' fun i ↦ ?_
  by_cases hi : inner ℝ (u i) x + c i * r = b i
  · simp only [hi, if_pos, true_implies, epigraphRow_apply]
  · simp only [hi, if_false, false_implies, zero_apply, le_refl]




theorem convexDirectionalDeriv_eq_supportFunction
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal) (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hpolyhedral : Set.IsPolyhedral
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    EReal.convexDirectionalDeriv f x d =
      EReal.supportFunction (EReal.subdifferential f x) d := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := subdifferentiableAt_of_polyhedralEpigraph f x hpolyhedral hfinite
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  obtain ⟨m, u, c, b, hmodel, hc, hnegative⟩ :=
    polyhedralEpigraphModel f x r hr hpolyhedral
  apply le_antisymm
  ·
    refine EReal.le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp ?_
    intro q hq
    exact (directionalDerivLeActive f x d u c b r q hr hmodel).mpr
      (supportBoundActive f x d u c b r q hr hmodel hc v hv hq)
  ·
    exact (EReal.supportFunction_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
      (fun w hw ↦ subgradientLeDirectionalDeriv f x w d r hr hw)

  classical

    Cardinal.mk M.verts = 2 * Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet := by

  calc
    Cardinal.mk M.verts = Cardinal.mk (Σ e : M.edgeSet, {v // hM.toEdge v = e}) :=
      (Cardinal.mk_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv hM.toEdge)).symm
    _ = Cardinal.sum (fun _ : M.edgeSet ↦ (2 : Cardinal)) := by
      rw [Cardinal.mk_sigma]

private lemma existsLargerFiber {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (f : V → W) (s t : Finset V)
    (hlt : s.card < t.card) :
    ∃ c, (s.filter (fun v ↦ f v = c)).card < (t.filter (fun v ↦ f v = c)).card := by
  classical

  let cs := (s ∪ t).image f
  have hs : (s : Set V).MapsTo f cs := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem f (Finset.mem_union_left t hv)
  have ht : (t : Set V).MapsTo f cs := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem f (Finset.mem_union_right s hv)
  by_contra! h
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := cs) (fun c _ ↦ h c)
  rw [← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise ht,
    ← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hs] at hsum
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hsum


private lemma existsPairOfEvenSurplus (s t : Finset V) (hs : Even s.card)

  classical

  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
  have hinter := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_right : t ∩ s ⊆ s)
  have hsplit := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter t s
  have hdiff : 1 < (t \ s).card := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hne⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hdiff
  exact ⟨x, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1, y, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).1,
    hne, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).2, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).2⟩


private lemma matchingInUnionComponent {M N : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (c : (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).ConnectedComponent) :
    (M.induce (M.verts ∩ c.supp)).IsMatching := by

  refine matchingInduceClosed hM c.supp ?_
  intro v w hvw hv
  exact c.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hv (Or.inl hvw)


private lemma componentIntersectionFinset {H : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq H.ConnectedComponent] {s : Set V}
    (hs : s.Finite) (c : H.ConnectedComponent) :
    (hs.subset Set.inter_subset_left : (s ∩ c.supp).Finite).toFinset =
      hs.toFinset.filter (fun v ↦ H.connectedComponentMk v = c) := by
  classical

  ext v
  simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_inter_iff, Finset.mem_filter,
    ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]



private lemma existsUnmatchedPairInUnion {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hME : M.edgeSet.Finite) (hNE : N.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hlt : Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ x y, x ∉ M.support ∧ y ∉ M.support ∧ x ≠ y ∧
      (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).Reachable x y := by
  classical

  have hMV := matchingFiniteVerts hM hME
  have hNV := matchingFiniteVerts hN hNE
  have hmcard := matchingCardVerts hM
  have hncard := matchingCardVerts hN
  rw [finiteSetCard hMV, finiteSetCard hME] at hmcard
  rw [finiteSetCard hNV, finiteSetCard hNE] at hncard
  have hmnat : hMV.toFinset.card = 2 * hME.toFinset.card := by
    exact Nat.cast_inj.mp (hmcard.trans (Nat.cast_mul 2 _).symm)
  have hnnat : hNV.toFinset.card = 2 * hNE.toFinset.card := by
    exact Nat.cast_inj.mp (hncard.trans (Nat.cast_mul 2 _).symm)
  rw [finiteSetCard hME, finiteSetCard hNE, Nat.cast_lt] at hlt
  have hvlt : hMV.toFinset.card < hNV.toFinset.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := existsLargerFiber
    (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).connectedComponentMk _ _ hvlt

  have hMc := matchingInUnionComponent (N := N) hM c
  have hNc : (N.induce (N.verts ∩ c.supp)).IsMatching := by
    refine matchingInduceClosed hN c.supp ?_
    intro v w hvw hv
    exact c.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hv (Or.inr hvw)
  have hcm := matchingFiniteEven hMc (hMV.subset Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hcn := matchingFiniteEven hNc (hNV.subset Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hcm' := (congrArg (fun s : Finset V ↦ Even s.card)
    (componentIntersectionFinset hMV c)).mp hcm
  have hcn' := (congrArg (fun s : Finset V ↦ Even s.card)
    (componentIntersectionFinset hNV c)).mp hcn
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hxm, hym⟩ := existsPairOfEvenSurplus _ _ hcm' hcn' hc
  have hxC : x ∈ c.supp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hyC : y ∈ c.supp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  refine ⟨x, y, ?_, ?_, hxy, c.reachable_of_mem_supp hxC hyC⟩
  · rw [hM.support_eq_verts]
    intro hxM
    exact hxm (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hMV.mem_toFinset.mpr hxM, hxC⟩)
  · rw [hM.support_eq_verts]
    intro hyM
    exact hym (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hMV.mem_toFinset.mpr hyM, hyC⟩)



private lemma augmentingPathOfUnionReachable {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∉ M.support) (hy : y ∉ M.support) (hne : x ≠ y)
    (hr : (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).Reachable x y) :
    ∃ p : G.Path x y, IsAugmenting M p := by

  have hle : M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe ≤ G :=
    sup_le M.spanningCoe_le N.spanningCoe_le
  refine hr.elim_path fun q ↦ ?_
  let p : G.Path x y := ⟨q.val.mapLe hle, q.property.mapLe hle⟩
  refine ⟨p, IsAugmenting.ofAlternatingFrom M p
    (ofIsAlternating Set.univ M p ⟨Set.mem_univ x, hx⟩ ?_) hy hne⟩
  intro v w z hwz hvw hvz
  exact matchingSupIsAlternating hM hN hwz
    ((Walk.adj_toSubgraph_mapLe hle).mp hvw).adj_sub
    ((Walk.adj_toSubgraph_mapLe hle).mp hvz).adj_sub


private lemma matchingToEdgeOfMem {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (v : M.verts) (e : M.edgeSet) (hv : v.val ∈ e.val) : hM.toEdge v = e := by

  rcases e with ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hv with hx | hy
  · subst x
    exact hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he
  · subst y
    exact (hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he.symm).trans (Subtype.ext (Sym2.eq_swap ..))



private lemma matchingCardLeVerts {M N : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hcover : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, N.Adj x y → x ∈ M.support ∨ y ∈ M.support) :
    Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet ≤ Cardinal.mk M.verts := by
  classical

  have hchoose : ∀ e : N.edgeSet, ∃ v : V, v ∈ M.verts ∧ v ∈ e.val := by
    rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
    rcases hcover he with hx | hy
    · exact ⟨x, hM.support_eq_verts ▸ hx, Sym2.mem_mk_left ..⟩
    · exact ⟨y, hM.support_eq_verts ▸ hy, Sym2.mem_mk_right ..⟩
  choose f hfM hfE using hchoose
  let F : N.edgeSet → M.verts := fun e ↦ ⟨f e, hfM e⟩
  refine Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective (f := F) ?_
  intro e e' hee'
  have hval : f e = f e' := congrArg Subtype.val hee'
  have heN := N.mem_verts_of_mem_edge e.property (hfE e)
  have heN' : f e ∈ e'.val := hval.symm ▸ hfE e'
  exact (matchingToEdgeOfMem hN ⟨f e, heN⟩ e (hfE e)).symm.trans
    (matchingToEdgeOfMem hN ⟨f e, heN⟩ e' heN')


private lemma existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hlt : Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ (x y : V) (p : G.Path x y), IsAugmenting M p := by
  classical

  by_cases hcover : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, N.Adj x y → x ∈ M.support ∨ y ∈ M.support
  · have hbound := matchingCardLeVerts hM hN hcover
    rw [matchingCardVerts hM] at hbound
    by_cases hME : M.edgeSet.Finite
    · have hNE : N.edgeSet.Finite := by
        apply Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt hbound ?_
        rw [finiteSetCard hME, ← Nat.cast_ofNat, ← Nat.cast_mul]
        exact Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hr⟩ := existsUnmatchedPairInUnion hM hN hME hNE hlt
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := augmentingPathOfUnionReachable hM hN hx hy hxy hr
      exact ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩
    ·
      have hinf : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet := by
        exact le_of_not_gt (fun h ↦ hME (Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp h))
      rw [Cardinal.mul_eq_right hinf
        (Cardinal.ofNat_le_aleph0.trans hinf) (OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero 2)] at hbound
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt hlt) hbound)
  · push Not at hcover
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ := hcover
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := augmentingPathOfUnionReachable hM hN hx hy hxy.ne
      (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable (Or.inr hxy))
    exact ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩



private lemma alternatingWalkEndpointParts {M : G.Subgraph} {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) :
    p.IsPath → p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe →
    y ∉ M.support → ¬p.Nil →
    ∀ (A B : Set V), G.IsBipartiteWith A B → x ∈ A →
      (¬M.Adj x p.snd → y ∈ B) ∧ (M.Adj x p.snd → y ∈ A) := by

  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _ _ hnil
    exact False.elim (hnil Walk.nil_nil)
  | @cons x z y hxz q ih =>
    intro hp halt hend _ A B hAB hx
    have hz := hAB.mem_of_mem_adj hx hxz
    cases q with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨fun _ ↦ hz, ?_⟩
      intro hM
      exact False.elim (hend ⟨x, hM.symm⟩)
    | @cons z w y hzw r =>
      have hqp := (Walk.cons_isPath_iff hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).mp hp
      have hqa : (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating
          M.spanningCoe := halt.mono (Subgraph.spanningCoe_le_of_le le_sup_right)
      have htail := ih hqp.1 hqa hend Walk.not_nil_cons B A hAB.symm hz
      simp only [Walk.snd_cons] at htail
      have hxw : x ≠ w := by
        intro hxw
        apply hqp.2
        rw [hxw, Walk.support_cons]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem z r.start_mem_support
      have hzx : (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph.Adj z x :=
        ((Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph_adj_snd Walk.not_nil_cons).symm
      have hzw' : (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph.Adj z w := by
        apply (le_sup_right : (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph ≤
          (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph).2
        simpa only [Walk.snd_cons] using
          (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph_adj_snd Walk.not_nil_cons
      have hphase := halt hxw hzx hzw'
      constructor
      · intro hfirst
        apply htail.2
        by_contra hnext
        exact hfirst (hphase.mpr hnext).symm
      · intro hfirst
        exact htail.1 (hphase.mp hfirst.symm)


private lemma augmentingPathBipartiteEndpoints {A B : Set V}
    (hAB : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) {M : G.Subgraph} {x y : V}
    {p : G.Path x y} (h : IsAugmenting M p) :
    (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ B) ∨ (x ∈ B ∧ y ∈ A) := by

  have hnil : ¬p.val.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne h.nontrivial
  have hfirst : ¬M.Adj x p.val.snd := by
    intro hx
    exact h.start_mem.2 ⟨p.val.snd, hx⟩
  rcases hAB.mem_of_adj (p.val.adj_snd hnil) with hparts | hparts
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hparts.1, (alternatingWalkEndpointParts p.val p.property
      h.alternating h.end_unmatched hnil A B hAB hparts.1).1 hfirst⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hparts.1, (alternatingWalkEndpointParts p.val p.property
      h.alternating h.end_unmatched hnil B A hAB.symm hparts.1).1 hfirst⟩




theorem existsAugmentingPath_bipartite (A B : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_matching : M.IsMatching)
    (h_suboptimal : ∃ N : G.Subgraph,
      N.IsMatching ∧ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ B, ∃ p : G.Path x y, IsAugmenting M p := by

  obtain ⟨N, hN, hlt⟩ := h_suboptimal
  obtain ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩ := existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt h_matching hN hlt
  rcases augmentingPathBipartiteEndpoints h_bipartite hp with hparts | hparts
  · exact ⟨x, hparts.1, y, hparts.2, p, hp⟩
  · exact ⟨y, hparts.2, x, hparts.1, p.reverse, hp.reverse⟩




theorem existsAugmentingPath (M : G.Subgraph) (h_matching : M.IsMatching)
    (h_suboptimal : ∃ N : G.Subgraph,
      N.IsMatching ∧ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ (x y : V) (p : G.Path x y), IsAugmenting M p := by

  obtain ⟨N, hN, hlt⟩ := h_suboptimal
  exact existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt h_matching hN hlt

variable {V : Type u} {E : Type v}



structure IsTree (G : Graph V E) : Prop where

  vertexSet_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty

  connected : ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet, Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y

  edge_isBridge : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y


def isTreeOfBridges (G : Graph V E) (h_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty)
    (h_connected : ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
      Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y)
    (h_bridges : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
      ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y) :
    G.IsTree :=
  { vertexSet_nonempty := h_nonempty
    connected := h_connected
    edge_isBridge := h_bridges }


theorem isTree_iff (G : Graph V E) :
    G.IsTree ↔ G.vertexSet.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet, Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
        ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.vertexSet_nonempty, h.connected, h.edge_isBridge⟩
  · rintro ⟨h_nonempty, h_connected, h_bridges⟩
    exact isTreeOfBridges G h_nonempty h_connected h_bridges


def crossEdges (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) : Set E :=
  {e | ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ ¬P.Rel x y}


theorem mem_crossEdges (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) (e : E) :
    e ∈ G.crossEdges P ↔ ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ ¬P.Rel x y := by

  rfl


theorem crossEdges_subset (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    G.crossEdges P ⊆ G.edgeSet := by

  rintro e ⟨x, y, hxy, hne⟩
  exact hxy.edge_mem
