theorem projection_inner_le_zero {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x z : H) (hz : z ∈ C) :
    inner ℝ (x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x)
      (z - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x) ≤ 0 := by

  have hp_mem : projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x ∈ C :=
    projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hp_min : ‖x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x‖ =
      ⨅ w : C, ‖x - w‖ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, infDist_eq_iInf] using
      dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  exact (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hCconvex hp_mem).mp hp_min z hz


theorem projection_nonexpansive {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x y : H) :
    ‖projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y‖ ≤
      ‖x - y‖ := by

  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  let q := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_mem : p ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hq_mem : q ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_vi : inner ℝ (x - p) (q - p) ≤ 0 :=
    projection_inner_le_zero C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x q hq_mem
  have hq_vi : inner ℝ (y - q) (p - q) ≤ 0 :=
    projection_inner_le_zero C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y p hp_mem
  have hp_vi' : 0 ≤ inner ℝ (x - p) (p - q) := by
    have hneg : q - p = -(p - q) := by abel
    rw [hneg, inner_neg_right] at hp_vi
    linarith
  have hdecomp : x - y = (x - p) - (y - q) + (p - q) := by
    abel
  have hinner : inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) =
      inner ℝ (x - p) (p - q) - inner ℝ (y - q) (p - q) + ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hdecomp, inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hnorm_sq_le : ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) := by
    rw [hinner]
    nlinarith
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm (x - y) (p - q)
  have hprod : ‖p - q‖ * ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc
      ‖p - q‖ * ‖p - q‖ = ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) := hnorm_sq_le
      _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ * ‖p - q‖ := (le_abs_self _).trans hcs

  by_cases hzero : ‖p - q‖ = 0
  · have hzero' : ‖projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x -
        projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y‖ = 0 := by
      simpa [p, q] using hzero
    simp [hzero']
  · have hpos : 0 < ‖p - q‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hzero)
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hprod hpos


theorem infDist_sq_remainder_bound {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x y : H) :
    |(infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x) (y - x)| ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by

  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  let q := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_mem : p ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hq_mem : q ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hdx : infDist x C = ‖x - p‖ := by
    simpa only [p, dist_eq_norm] using
      (dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x).symm
  have hdy : infDist y C = ‖y - q‖ := by
    simpa only [q, dist_eq_norm] using
      (dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y).symm
  have hcompare_y : (infDist y C) ^ 2 ≤ dist y p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (infDist_nonneg) dist_nonneg).mpr (infDist_le_dist_of_mem hp_mem)
  have hsplit_y : y - p = (x - p) + (y - x) := by
    abel
  have hexpand_y : dist y p ^ 2 =
      ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hsplit_y, norm_add_sq_real]
  have hupper : (infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hdx]
    have hcompare_y' := hcompare_y
    rw [hexpand_y] at hcompare_y'
    linarith

  have hcompare_x : (infDist x C) ^ 2 ≤ dist x q ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (infDist_nonneg) dist_nonneg).mpr (infDist_le_dist_of_mem hq_mem)
  have hsplit_x : x - q = (y - q) - (y - x) := by
    abel
  have hexpand_x : dist x q ^ 2 =
      ‖y - q‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (y - q) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hsplit_x, norm_sub_sq_real]
  have hinner_diff : inner ℝ (y - q) (y - x) - inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) =
      inner ℝ (p - q) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hsplit : (y - q) - (x - p) = (p - q) + (y - x) := by
      abel
    rw [← inner_sub_left, hsplit, inner_add_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hproj : ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := projection_nonexpansive C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x y
      _ = ‖y - x‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
  have hinner_lower : -(‖p - q‖ * ‖y - x‖) ≤ inner ℝ (p - q) (y - x) :=
    neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm (p - q) (y - x))
  have hproj_mul : ‖p - q‖ * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ * ‖y - x‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hproj (norm_nonneg _)
  have hlower : -‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) := by
    rw [hdx, hdy]
    have hcompare_x' := hcompare_x
    rw [hdx, hexpand_x] at hcompare_x'
    nlinarith [hcompare_x', hinner_diff, hinner_lower, hproj_mul]

  rw [abs_le]
  exact ⟨hlower, hupper⟩


theorem hasGradientAt_infDist_sq {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : H) :
    HasGradientAt (fun y : H ↦ (Metric.infDist y C) ^ 2)
      (2 • (x - Metric.projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x)) x := by

  rw [hasGradientAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : H) hε] with h hh
  have hball : dist h 0 < ε := by simpa using hh
  have hnorm : ‖h‖ < ε := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hball
  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hrem := infDist_sq_remainder_bound C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x (x + h)
  have hnat : (2 : ℝ) • (x - p) = 2 • (x - p) :=
    Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ 2 (x - p)
  have hsmul : inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h = 2 * inner ℝ (x - p) h := by
    rw [← hnat]
    exact real_inner_smul_left (x - p) h 2
  have hrem' : |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h| ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
          inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h| =
        |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
          2 * inner ℝ (x - p) h| := by rw [hsmul]
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by simpa only [p, add_sub_cancel_left] using hrem
  have hbound : ‖(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h‖ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hrem'
  calc
    ‖(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
        inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h‖ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := hbound
    _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg h]

end Metric

private lemma SimpleGraph.Reachable.existsAdjacentLowerDist
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {root v : V}
    (hv : G.Reachable root v) (hne : v ≠ root) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ G.dist root w < G.dist root v := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hv.symm.exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, rfl⟩ := p.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hne
  refine ⟨w, hadj, ?_⟩
  calc
    G.dist root w = G.dist w root := G.dist_comm
    _ ≤ q.length := G.dist_le q
    _ < (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj q).length := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    _ = G.dist v root := hp
    _ = G.dist root v := G.dist_comm


private lemma SimpleGraph.connectedInduceOfDecreasingRank
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : Set V} {root : V}
    (rank : V → ℕ) (hroot : root ∈ s)
    (hstep : ∀ v ∈ s, v ≠ root → ∃ w ∈ s, G.Adj v w ∧ rank w < rank v) :
    (G.induce s).Connected := by

  have reachesRoot : ∀ k (v : s), rank v = k →
      (G.induce s).Reachable v ⟨root, hroot⟩ := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro v hv
      by_cases heq : v.val = root
      · have hvroot : v = ⟨root, hroot⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
        rw [hvroot]
      · obtain ⟨w, hw, hadj, hrank⟩ := hstep v v.property heq
        have hlt : rank w < k := by
          rwa [← hv]
        have hedge : (G.induce s).Adj v ⟨w, hw⟩ := SimpleGraph.induce_adj.mpr hadj
        exact hedge.reachable.trans (ih (rank w) hlt ⟨w, hw⟩ rfl)

  refine (SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable _).mpr ⟨⟨root, hroot⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v
  exact (reachesRoot (rank v) v rfl).symm


private lemma SimpleGraph.Connected.connectedInduceImageIicOfMonotoneDist
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected) (root : V)
    {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ V) (hmono : Monotone (fun j ↦ G.dist root (e j)))
    (i : Fin n) : (G.induce (e '' Set.Iic i)).Connected := by

  have hroot : root ∈ e '' Set.Iic i := by
    rcases le_total (e.symm root) i with hle | hle
    · exact ⟨e.symm root, hle, e.apply_symm_apply root⟩
    · have hdist := hmono hle
      simp only [e.apply_symm_apply, SimpleGraph.dist_self, Nat.le_zero] at hdist
      exact ⟨i, Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl, (hG.dist_eq_zero_iff.mp hdist).symm⟩
  refine SimpleGraph.connectedInduceOfDecreasingRank (G.dist root) hroot ?_

  intro v hv hne
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, hdist⟩ := (hG root (e j)).existsAdjacentLowerDist hne
  have hdistIndex : G.dist root (e (e.symm w)) < G.dist root (e j) := by
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hdist
  have hindex : e.symm w < j := hmono.reflect_lt hdistIndex
  exact ⟨w, ⟨e.symm w, hindex.le.trans hj, e.apply_symm_apply w⟩, hadj, hdist⟩





theorem SimpleGraph.Connected.existsConnectedEnumeration
    {V : Type u} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Nat.card V) ≃ V, ∀ i : Fin (Nat.card V),
      (G.induce (e '' Set.Iic i)).Connected := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨root⟩ := hG.nonempty
  let e₀ := (Finite.equivFin V).symm
  let f := fun j ↦ G.dist root (e₀ j)
  let e := (Tuple.sort f).trans e₀
  have hmono : Monotone (fun j ↦ G.dist root (e j)) := Tuple.monotone_sort f

  exact ⟨e, fun i ↦ hG.connectedInduceImageIicOfMonotoneDist root e hmono i⟩

theorem SimpleGraph.Path.ofIsAlternating_spec (A : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (p : G.Path x y) (hstart : x ∈ A \ M.support)
    (halt : (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe) :
    (ofIsAlternating A M p hstart halt).start_mem = hstart ∧
      (ofIsAlternating A M p hstart halt).alternating = halt := by

  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩


private lemma SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternating_iff_consecutive (p : G.Path x y)
    (H : SimpleGraph V) :
    (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating H ↔
      ∀ i : ℕ, i + 1 < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (H.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          ¬ H.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1))
            ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 2))) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro halt i hi

    have hi₀ : i ≤ (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hi₂ : i + 2 ≤ (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hne : (p : G.Walk x y).getVert i ≠ (p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 2) := by
      intro heq
      have heqIndex := p.isPath.getVert_injOn hi₀ hi₂ heq
      omega
    have hi' : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hleft := ((p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph_adj_getVert hi').symm
    have hright := (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph_adj_getVert hi
    simpa only [H.adj_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using halt hne hleft hright
  · intro htoggle v w w' hne hvw hvw'

    have hnonempty := Walk.not_nil_of_adj_toSubgraph hvw
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjle⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp
      (Walk.mem_support_of_adj_toSubgraph hvw)
    have hw : w ∈ (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.neighborSet v := hvw
    have hw' : w' ∈ (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.neighborSet v := hvw'
    by_cases hjzero : j = 0
    · have hv : v = x := by simpa only [hjzero, Walk.getVert_zero] using hj.symm
      rw [hv, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_startpoint hnonempty] at hw hw'
      exact (hne ((Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw).trans
        (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw').symm)).elim
    by_cases hjend : j = (p : G.Walk x y).length
    · have hv : v = y := by simpa only [hjend, Walk.getVert_length] using hj.symm
      rw [hv, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_endpoint hnonempty] at hw hw'
      exact (hne ((Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw).trans
        (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw').symm)).elim

    have hjlt : j < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    rw [← hj, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal hjzero hjlt] at hw hw'
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw hw'
    have hpred : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
    have hsucc : j - 1 + 2 = j + 1 := by omega
    have hbound : j - 1 + 1 < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have ht := htoggle (j - 1) hbound
    rw [hpred, hsucc, H.adj_comm] at ht
    rw [← hj]
    rcases hw with hw | hw
    · rcases hw' with hw' | hw'
      · exact (hne (hw.trans hw'.symm)).elim
      · simpa only [hw, hw'] using ht
    · rcases hw' with hw' | hw'
      · simp only [hw, hw']
        exact not_not.symm.trans (not_congr ht).symm
      · exact (hne (hw.trans hw'.symm)).elim


private lemma SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges (M : G.Subgraph)
    (p : G.Path x y) (hunmatched : x ∉ M.support) :
    (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe ↔
      ∀ i : ℕ, i < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          Odd i) := by
  classical
  rw [isAlternating_iff_consecutive]
  simp only [Subgraph.spanningCoe_adj]
  constructor
  · intro htoggle i

    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      have hfirst : ¬ M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert 0)
          ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (0 + 1)) := by
        intro hadj
        rw [Walk.getVert_zero] at hadj
        exact hunmatched (M.mem_support.mpr ⟨_, hadj⟩)
      simp only [hfirst, Nat.not_odd_zero, iff_self]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hiprev : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
      have ht := htoggle i hi
      rw [ih hiprev] at ht
      rw [Nat.odd_add_one, Nat.add_assoc]
      exact not_not.symm.trans (not_congr ht).symm
  · intro hodd i hi

    have hiprev : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    rw [hodd i hiprev, hodd (i + 1) hi, Nat.odd_add_one, not_not]





theorem isAlternatingFrom_iff (A B : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_cover : A ∪ B = Set.univ)
    (h_matching : M.IsMatching) (p : G.Path x y) :
    IsAlternatingFrom A M p ↔ x ∈ A \ M.support ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, i < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          Odd i) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.start_mem, (p.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M h.start_mem.2).mp h.alternating⟩
  · rintro ⟨hstart, hodd⟩
    exact ofIsAlternating A M p hstart ((p.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M hstart.2).mpr hodd)


theorem SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternatingFrom_nil_iff (A : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph) :
    IsAlternatingFrom A M (Path.nil : G.Path x x) ↔ x ∈ A \ M.support := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.start_mem
  · intro hstart
    refine ofIsAlternating A M Path.nil hstart ?_
    refine (isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M Path.nil hstart.2).mpr ?_
    intro i hi
    simp only [Path.nil, Walk.length_nil] at hi
    omega

private lemma Walk.IsPath.eqOfLengthAddLtGirth {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} {p q : G.Walk a b} (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hlen : p.length + q.length < G.girth) : p = q := by

  obtain ⟨w, _, _, c, hc, hle⟩ := hp.exists_isCycle_length_le_add_of_ne hq hne
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlen) ((girth_le_length hc).trans hle)


private lemma Walk.IsPath.neighborInSupportEqPenultimate {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b x : V} {p : G.Walk a b} (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hlen : p.length + 1 < G.girth) (hx : G.Adj b x) (hmem : x ∈ p.support) :
    x = p.penultimate := by
  classical

  have heq : p.dropUntil x hmem = hx.symm.toWalk :=
    (hp.dropUntil hmem).eqOfLengthAddLtGirth (Walk.IsPath.of_adj hx.symm)
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.add_le_add_right (p.length_dropUntil_le_length hmem) 1) hlen)
  apply hp.eq_penultimate_of_mem_edges
  apply p.edges_dropUntil_subset_edges hmem
  rw [heq]
  simp


private lemma Walk.IsPath.degreeLeFreshCardAddOne {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V} {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hlen : p.length + 1 < G.girth) :
    G.degree b ≤ Fintype.card {x // G.Adj b x ∧ x ∉ p.support} + 1 := by
  classical

  have hsub : (G.neighborFinset b).erase p.penultimate ⊆
      Finset.univ.filter (fun x ↦ G.Adj b x ∧ x ∉ p.support) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hne, hadj⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset b x).mp hadj, ?_⟩⟩
    intro hmem
    exact hne (hp.neighborInSupportEqPenultimate hlen ((G.mem_neighborFinset b x).mp hadj) hmem)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have herase := Finset.pred_card_le_card_erase (s := G.neighborFinset b) (a := p.penultimate)
  rw [card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at herase
  rw [← Fintype.card_subtype] at hcard
  omega


private abbrev BoundedPaths {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (a : V) (r : ℕ) :=
  Σ b : V, {p : G.Path a b // p.val.length ≤ r}


private def boundedNil {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (a : V) (r : ℕ) :
    BoundedPaths G a r := ⟨a, ⟨Path.nil, Nat.zero_le r⟩⟩


private abbrev FreshNeighbors {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) := {x // G.Adj p.1 x ∧ x ∉ p.2.val.val.support}


private lemma boundedConcatLength {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) (x : FreshNeighbors p) :
    (p.2.val.val.concat x.property.1).length ≤ r + 1 := by

  rw [Walk.length_concat]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right p.2.property 1


private def boundedConcat {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) (x : FreshNeighbors p) : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) :=
  ⟨x.val, ⟨⟨p.2.val.val.concat x.property.1,
    p.2.val.property.concat x.property.2 x.property.1⟩, boundedConcatLength p x⟩⟩


private lemma boundedConcatInjective {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun z : Σ p : BoundedPaths G a r, FreshNeighbors p ↦
      boundedConcat z.1 z.2) := by

  rintro ⟨⟨b, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpr⟩⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ ⟨⟨c, ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hqr⟩⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩ heq
  have hxy : x = y := congrArg Sigma.fst heq
  subst y
  have hw : p.concat hx.1 = q.concat hy.1 :=
    congrArg (fun z : {p : G.Path a x // p.val.length ≤ r + 1} ↦ z.val.val)
      (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp heq).2)
  obtain ⟨hbc, hpq⟩ := Walk.concat_inj hw
  subst c
  simp only [Walk.copy_rfl_rfl] at hpq
  subst q
  rfl


private def boundedStep {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Option (Σ p : BoundedPaths G a r, FreshNeighbors p) → BoundedPaths G a (r + 1)
  | none => boundedNil G a (r + 1)
  | some z => boundedConcat z.1 z.2


private lemma boundedStepInjective {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (boundedStep (G := G) (a := a) (r := r)) := by

  intro x y h
  cases x with
  | none =>
    cases y with
    | none => rfl
    | some z =>
      have hl := congrArg (fun p : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) ↦ p.2.val.val.length) h
      simp [boundedStep, boundedNil, boundedConcat, Walk.length_concat] at hl
  | some z =>
    cases y with
    | none =>
      have hl := congrArg (fun p : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) ↦ p.2.val.val.length) h
      simp [boundedStep, boundedNil, boundedConcat, Walk.length_concat] at hl
    | some w => exact congrArg some (boundedConcatInjective h)


private lemma freshNilCard {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (a : V) (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors (boundedNil G a r)) = G.degree a := by

  rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  apply Fintype.card_of_subtype
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hadj := (G.mem_neighborFinset a x).mp hx
    refine ⟨hadj, ?_⟩
    simpa only [boundedNil, Path.nil, Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] using hadj.ne'
  · intro hx
    exact (G.mem_neighborFinset a x).mpr hx.1


private lemma boundedPathCountLowerBound {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) (a : V) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < G.girth) :
    3 * 2 ^ r ≤ Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a r) + 2 := by
  classical

  induction r with
  | zero =>
    have hpos := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (Nonempty.intro (boundedNil G a 0))
    norm_num only [pow_zero, mul_one]
    omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have hkg : k < G.girth := by omega
    have hprev := ih hkg
    have hbranch : ∀ p : BoundedPaths G a k, 2 ≤ Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) := by
      intro p
      have hlen : p.2.val.val.length + 1 < G.girth := by
        have hpr := p.2.property
        omega
      have hdeg := hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree p.1)
      have hfresh : G.degree p.1 ≤ Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) + 1 :=
        p.2.val.property.degreeLeFreshCardAddOne hlen
      omega
    have hroot : 2 < Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors (boundedNil G a k)) := by
      rw [freshNilCard]
      have htwo : 2 < (3 : ℕ) := by decide
      exact htwo.trans_le (hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree a))
    have hsum : 2 * Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a k) <
        ∑ p : BoundedPaths G a k, Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) := by
      have hs := Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun p _ ↦ hbranch p)
        ⟨boundedNil G a k, Finset.mem_univ _, hroot⟩
      simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hs
    have hstep := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _
      (boundedStepInjective (G := G) (a := a) (r := k))
    rw [Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_sigma] at hstep
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega


private lemma threeMulTwoPowLeCardAddTwo {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) (a : V) (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 * r < G.girth) :
    3 * 2 ^ r ≤ Fintype.card V + 2 := by
  classical

  have hinj : Function.Injective (Sigma.fst : BoundedPaths G a r → V) := by
    rintro ⟨b, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩ ⟨c, ⟨q, hq⟩⟩ heq
    dsimp at heq
    subst c
    have hlen : p.val.length + q.val.length < G.girth := by omega
    have hpq := p.property.eqOfLengthAddLtGirth q.property hlen
    have hpath : p = q := Subtype.ext hpq
    subst q
    rfl
  have hcount : Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a r) ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  have hrg : r < G.girth := by omega
  have hgrowth := boundedPathCountLowerBound G hδ a r hrg
  omega


private lemma twoPowGirthLtCardSq {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    2 ^ G.girth < (Fintype.card V) ^ 2 := by
  classical

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    have hz := G.minDegree_of_subsingleton
    omega
  | inr hnonempty =>
    have hn := G.minDegree_lt_card
    have hn4 : 4 ≤ Fintype.card V := by omega
    by_cases hnEq : Fintype.card V = 4
    ·
      have htop : G = ⊤ := by
        rw [eq_top_iff_forall_isUniversal]
        intro v
        apply (G.degree_eq_card_sub_one v).mp
        have hdeg := G.degree_lt_card_verts v
        have hlo := hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree v)
        omega
      have hcard : 3 ≤ ENat.card V := by
        rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hnEq]
        norm_num
      rw [htop, girth_top hcard, hnEq]
      norm_num
    · have hn5 : 5 ≤ Fintype.card V := by omega
      by_cases hg : G.girth ≤ 4
      · have htwo : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ) := by decide
        have hpow := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hg
        norm_num at hpow
        nlinarith
      ·
        let r := (G.girth - 1) / 2
        have hr : 2 * r < G.girth := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        have hr2 : 2 ≤ r := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        have hgr : G.girth ≤ 2 * r + 2 := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        obtain ⟨a⟩ := hnonempty
        have hbound := threeMulTwoPowLeCardAddTwo G hδ a r hr
        have htwo : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ) := by decide
        have hfour := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hr2
        norm_num at hfour
        have hstrict : 2 * 2 ^ r < Fintype.card V := by omega
        have hpowers := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hgr
        have hnormalize : 2 ^ (2 * r + 2) = (2 * 2 ^ r) ^ 2 := by
          rw [pow_add, mul_comm 2 r, pow_mul]
          ring
        rw [hnormalize] at hpowers
        nlinarith

end SimpleGraph




theorem SimpleGraph.girthLtTwoLogbCard {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    (G.girth : ℝ) < 2 * Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by

  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ G.girth < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.twoPowGirthLtCardSq G hδ
  have hbase : 1 < (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have htwo : 0 < (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have hpos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ G.girth := pow_pos htwo _
  have hlog := Real.logb_lt_logb hbase hpos hpow
  simpa only [Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one hbase, mul_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hlog

theorem orbitEquivalence (G : Type u) [Group G] (X : Type v) [MulAction G X] :
    Equivalence (fun x y : X ↦ ∃ g : G, g • x = y) := by
  constructor

private lemma normalOfNonnegativeSubgradientMultiple {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (x w : E)
    (hxtop : f x ≠ ⊤) (hxbot : f x ≠ ⊥)
    (hw : w ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    ∀ z, f z ≤ f x → inner ℝ (c • w) (z - x) ≤ 0 := by
  intro z hz

  have hbound := (EReal.mem_subdifferential f x w).mp hw z |>.trans hz
  rw [← EReal.coe_toReal hxtop hxbot, ← EReal.coe_add,
    EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hbound
  have hinner : inner ℝ w (z - x) ≤ 0 := (add_le_iff_nonpos_right _).mp hbound

  rw [inner_smul_left]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hc hinner





theorem normalSublevel_iff {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (x v : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hnotbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) (hx : x ∈ interior {z | f z < ⊤})
    (hnotmin : ∃ z, f z < f x) :
    (∀ z, f z ≤ f x → inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ 0) ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ v ∈ c • EReal.subdifferential f x := by
  constructor
  · intro hnormal
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    ·
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ConvexAnalysis.subdifferentialNonemptyOfInterior
        f x hconvex hnotbot hx
      refine ⟨0, le_rfl, Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [zero_smul, hv]
    · obtain ⟨c, hc, hbound⟩ := ConvexAnalysis.sublevelNormalPositiveMultiplier
        f x v hconvex hnotbot hx hnotmin hv hnormal

      refine ⟨c, hc.le, Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨c⁻¹ • v, ?_,
        smul_inv_smul₀ hc.ne' v⟩⟩
      refine (EReal.mem_subdifferential f x (c⁻¹ • v)).mpr ?_
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = ⊤
      · rw [hz]
        exact le_top
      · have hfinite : f x < ⊤ := interior_subset (s := {z : E | f z < ⊤}) hx
        have hxval := EReal.coe_toReal hfinite.ne (hnotbot x)
        have hzval := EReal.coe_toReal hz (hnotbot z)
        have h := hbound z (f z).toReal hzval.ge
        have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_mul] at hscaled
        rw [inner_smul_left, ← hxval, ← hzval, ← EReal.coe_add,
          EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
        simpa only [starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, add_comm] using
          le_sub_iff_add_le.mp hscaled
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hv⟩

    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hv with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hfinite : f x < ⊤ := interior_subset (s := {z : E | f z < ⊤}) hx
    exact normalOfNonnegativeSubgradientMultiple f x w
      (ne_of_lt hfinite) (hnotbot x) hw c hc

private lemma SimpleGraph.girth_le_add_length_of_distinct_paths {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} {p q : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hne : p ≠ q) :

private lemma SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.length_eq_dist_of_two_mul_length_le_girth
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hshort : 2 * p.length ≤ G.girth) : p.length = G.dist a b := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqLength⟩ := p.reachable.exists_path_of_dist

  by_contra hle
  have hne : p ≠ q := by

private lemma SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.exists_path_length_eq_half {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {c : G.Walk a a} (hc : c.IsCycle) :
    ∃ (b : V) (p : G.Walk a b), p.IsPath ∧ p.length = c.length / 2 := by

  have hlength : (c.dropLast.take (c.length / 2)).length = c.length / 2 := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.take_length, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_dropLast]
    have hthree := hc.three_le_length

theorem SimpleGraph.egirth_le_two_mul_ediam_add_one {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hcycle : ¬ G.IsAcyclic) :
    G.egirth ≤ 2 * G.ediam + 1 := by

  obtain ⟨a, c, hc, hmin⟩ := SimpleGraph.exists_egirth_eq_length.mpr hcycle
  have hgirth : G.girth = c.length := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.girth, hmin, ENat.toNat_coe]
  obtain ⟨b, p, hp, hpLength⟩ := hc.exists_path_length_eq_half
  have hshort : 2 * p.length ≤ G.girth := by
    rw [hpLength, hgirth]
    omega
  have hgeo := hp.length_eq_dist_of_two_mul_length_le_girth hshort

  have hdiam : (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) ≤ G.ediam := by
    calc
      (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) = (G.dist a b : ℕ∞) := by rw [← hgeo, hpLength]
      _ = G.edist a b := p.reachable.coe_dist_eq_edist
      _ ≤ G.ediam := SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam
  have hround : c.length ≤ 2 * (c.length / 2) + 1 := by omega

  calc
    G.egirth = (c.length : ℕ∞) := hmin
    _ ≤ 2 * (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hround
    _ ≤ 2 * G.ediam + 1 := by gcongr


theorem SimpleGraph.girth_le_two_mul_diam_add_one {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hconn : G.Connected) (hcycle : ¬ G.IsAcyclic) :
    G.girth ≤ 2 * G.diam + 1 := by

  have hfinite : G.ediam ≠ ⊤ :=
    (@SimpleGraph.connected_iff_ediam_ne_top V G hconn.nonempty _).mp hconn
  have hdiam : (G.diam : ℕ∞) = G.ediam := ENat.coe_toNat hfinite
  have hbound : G.egirth ≤ (2 * G.diam + 1 : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, hdiam] using
      G.egirth_le_two_mul_ediam_add_one hcycle
  exact ENat.toNat_le_of_le_coe hbound

theorem isSmoothOn_iff (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) :
    IsSmoothOn f L D ↔
      (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x) ∧

        ‖gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ ≤
          (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩ := IsSmoothOn.spec f L D h
    refine ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hgradient.dist_le_mul x hx y hy
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩
    refine ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, ?_⟩
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hgradient x hx y hy



theorem IsSmoothOn.subset_interior_dom (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) : D ⊆ interior {x | f x ≠ ⊤} := by

  intro x hx
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
  simpa only [Filter.Eventually] using h.finiteNearby x hx






theorem isSmoothOn_univ_iff (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) :
    IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ ↔
      (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) ∧
      LipschitzWith L (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f)) := by


  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩ := IsSmoothOn.spec f L Set.univ h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      exact (hfinite x (Set.mem_univ x)).self_of_nhds
    · intro x
      exact hdifferentiable x (Set.mem_univ x)
    · apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      exact hgradient.dist_le_mul x (Set.mem_univ x) y (Set.mem_univ y)
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hfinite y
    · intro x hx
      exact hdifferentiable.differentiableAt
    · apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x hx y hy
      exact hgradient.dist_le_mul x y

end WithTop

theorem alternatingForm_eq_zero_of_finrank_lt

variable {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}


theorem isCutVertex_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) :
    G.isCutVertex v ↔ ∃ (a b : V) (ha : a ≠ v) (hb : b ≠ v),
      G.Reachable a b ∧ ¬ (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ := by

  rfl


private lemma noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeletion (hG : G.Preconnected) (v : V) :
    ¬ G.isCutVertex v ↔ (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Preconnected := by

  constructor
  · intro h a b
    by_contra hab
    exact h ⟨a, b, a.property, b.property, hG a b, hab⟩
  · intro h hcut
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, _, hab⟩ := hcut
    exact hab (h ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩)

namespace Subgraph


theorem isBlock_iff (B : G.Subgraph) :
    B.IsBlock ↔ Maximal (fun K : G.Subgraph ↦
      K.Connected ∧ ∀ v : K.verts, ¬ K.coe.isCutVertex v) B := by

  constructor
  · intro hB
    exact ⟨⟨hB.connected, hB.noCutVertex⟩, fun K hK hBK ↦
      hB.maximal K hK.1 hK.2 hBK⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hconn, hcut⟩, hmax⟩
    exact ⟨hconn, hcut, fun K hK hcutK hBK ↦ hmax ⟨hK, hcutK⟩ hBK⟩


theorem IsBlock.ofConnected_eq {B : G.Subgraph} (hB : B.IsBlock) :
    IsBlock.ofConnected hB.connected hB.noCutVertex hB.maximal = hB := by

  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _


private lemma subtypeDeletionSet (s : Set V) (z : s) :
    {w : s | w ≠ z} = {w : s | w.val ∉ ({z.val} : Set V)} := by

  ext w
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, ne_eq, Subtype.ext_iff]


private lemma noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeleteVerts {H : G.Subgraph} (hH : H.Connected) :
    (∀ v : H.verts, ¬ H.coe.isCutVertex v) ↔
      ∀ z : V, (H.deleteVerts {z}).Preconnected := by

  constructor
  · intro h z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ H.verts
    · have hp := (noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeletion hH.coe.preconnected ⟨z, hz⟩).mp
        (h ⟨z, hz⟩)
      refine Subgraph.preconnected_iff.mpr ((H.coeDeleteVertsIso {z}).preconnected_iff.mpr ?_)
      rwa [subtypeDeletionSet] at hp
    · rw [deleteVerts, Set.sdiff_singleton_eq_self hz, induce_self_verts]
      exact hH.preconnected
  · intro h z
    refine (noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeletion hH.coe.preconnected z).mpr ?_
    have hp := (H.coeDeleteVertsIso {z.val}).preconnected_iff.mp
      (Subgraph.preconnected_iff.mp (h z))
    rw [subtypeDeletionSet]
    exact hp


private lemma walkToSubgraph_le_deleteVerts_iff {H : G.Subgraph} {a b z : V}
    (p : G.Walk a b) :
    p.toSubgraph ≤ H.deleteVerts {z} ↔ p.toSubgraph ≤ H ∧ z ∉ p.support := by

  constructor
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨hp.trans deleteVerts_le, ?_⟩
    intro hz
    exact (hp.1 (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mpr hz)).2 rfl
  · rintro ⟨hp, hz⟩
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      refine ⟨hp.1 hx, ?_⟩
      intro hxz
      subst x
      exact hz (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp hx)
    · intro x y hxy
      refine deleteVerts_adj.mpr ⟨hp.1 (p.toSubgraph.edge_vert hxy), ?_,
        hp.1 (p.toSubgraph.edge_vert hxy.symm), ?_, hp.2 hxy⟩
      · intro hxz
        subst x
        exact hz (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp (p.toSubgraph.edge_vert hxy))
      · intro hyz
        subst y
        exact hz (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp (p.toSubgraph.edge_vert hxy.symm))


private lemma noCutVertex_iff_avoidingWalk {H : G.Subgraph} (hH : H.Connected) :
    (∀ v : H.verts, ¬ H.coe.isCutVertex v) ↔
      ∀ z a b : V, a ∈ H.verts → b ∈ H.verts → a ≠ z → b ≠ z →
        ∃ p : G.Walk a b, p.toSubgraph ≤ H ∧ z ∉ p.support := by

  rw [noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeleteVerts hH]
  constructor
  · intro h z a b ha hb haz hbz
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (preconnected_iff_forall_exists_walk_subgraph _).mp (h z)
      ⟨ha, haz⟩ ⟨hb, hbz⟩
    exact ⟨p, (walkToSubgraph_le_deleteVerts_iff p).mp hp⟩
  · intro h z
    refine (preconnected_iff_forall_exists_walk_subgraph _).mpr ?_
    intro a b ha hb
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h z a b ha.1 hb.1 ha.2 hb.2
    exact ⟨p, (walkToSubgraph_le_deleteVerts_iff p).mpr hp⟩



private lemma reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk {H : G.Subgraph} {a b z : V}
    (ha : a ∈ (H.deleteVerts {z}).verts) (hb : b ∈ (H.deleteVerts {z}).verts)
    (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.toSubgraph ≤ H) (hz : z ∉ p.support) :
    (H.deleteVerts {z}).coe.Reachable ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ := by

  have hle := (walkToSubgraph_le_deleteVerts_iff p).mpr ⟨hp, hz⟩
  exact Reachable.map (Subgraph.inclusion hle)
    (p.toSubgraph_connected ⟨a, p.start_mem_verts_toSubgraph⟩
      ⟨b, p.end_mem_verts_toSubgraph⟩)


private lemma pathVertexReachesEndpointAvoiding {a b x z : V} (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hxz : x ≠ z) :
    ∃ t, (t = a ∨ t = b) ∧ t ≠ z ∧
      ∃ q : G.Walk x t, q.toSubgraph ≤ p.toSubgraph ∧ z ∉ q.support := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨q, r, _, _, hqr⟩ := hp.mem_support_iff_exists_append.mp hx
  have hqle : q.toSubgraph ≤ p.toSubgraph := by
    rw [hqr, Walk.toSubgraph_append]
    exact le_sup_left
  have hrle : r.toSubgraph ≤ p.toSubgraph := by
    rw [hqr, Walk.toSubgraph_append]
    exact le_sup_right
  by_cases hzq : z ∈ q.support
  · have hzr : z ∉ r.support := by
      intro hzr
      rw [hqr] at hp
      exact hp.ne_of_mem_support_of_append hxz.symm hzq hzr rfl
    have hbz : b ≠ z := by
      intro hbz
      exact hzr (hbz ▸ r.end_mem_support)
    exact ⟨b, Or.inr rfl, hbz, r, hrle, hzr⟩
  · have haz : a ≠ z := by
      intro haz
      exact hzq (haz ▸ q.start_mem_support)
    refine ⟨a, Or.inl rfl, haz, q.reverse, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Walk.toSubgraph_reverse] using hqle
    · simpa only [Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using hzq


private lemma connectedNoCutSupOfAvoidingPath {H K : G.Subgraph}
    (hH : H.Connected) (hK : K.Connected)
    (hcutH : ∀ x : H.verts, ¬ H.coe.isCutVertex x)
    (hcutK : ∀ x : K.verts, ¬ K.coe.isCutVertex x)
    {v a b : V} (hvH : v ∈ H.verts) (hvK : v ∈ K.verts)
    (ha : a ∈ H.verts) (hb : b ∈ K.verts)
    (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hvp : v ∉ p.support) :
    (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).Connected ∧
      ∀ x : (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).verts,
        ¬ (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).coe.isCutVertex x := by
  classical

  have hHK : (H ⊔ K).Connected := connected_sup hH.preconnected hK.preconnected
    ⟨v, hvH, hvK⟩
  have hU : (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).Connected :=
    connected_sup hHK.preconnected p.toSubgraph_connected.preconnected
      ⟨a, Or.inl ha, p.start_mem_verts_toSubgraph⟩
  refine ⟨hU, (noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeleteVerts hU).mpr ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hHdel := (noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeleteVerts hH).mp hcutH z
  have hKdel := (noCutVertex_iff_preconnectedDeleteVerts hK).mp hcutK z

  by_cases hzv : z = v
  · subst z
    have hav : a ≠ v := by
      intro hav
      exact hvp (hav ▸ p.start_mem_support)
    have hbv : b ≠ v := by
      intro hbv
      exact hvp (hbv ▸ p.end_mem_support)
    have hHle : H.deleteVerts {v} ≤ (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {v} :=
      deleteVerts_mono (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
    have hKle : K.deleteVerts {v} ≤ (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {v} :=
      deleteVerts_mono (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
    have hpath := reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk
      (H := H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph) ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ha), hav⟩
      ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hb), hbv⟩ p le_sup_right hvp
    refine Subgraph.preconnected_iff.mpr ?_
    suffices ∀ x : ((H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {v}).verts,
        ((H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {v}).coe.Reachable
          ⟨a, ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ha), hav⟩⟩ x from
      fun x y ↦ (this x).symm.trans (this y)
    rintro ⟨x, ⟨(hx | hx) | hx, hxv⟩⟩
    · exact (hHdel ⟨a, ⟨ha, hav⟩⟩ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxv⟩⟩).map (inclusion hHle)
    · exact hpath.trans
        ((hKdel ⟨b, ⟨hb, hbv⟩⟩ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxv⟩⟩).map (inclusion hKle))
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, htv, q, hq, hvq⟩ := pathVertexReachesEndpointAvoiding p hp
        (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp hx) hxv
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact (reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk ⟨Or.inr hx, hxv⟩
          ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ha), hav⟩ q (hq.trans le_sup_right) hvq).symm
      · exact hpath.trans (reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk ⟨Or.inr hx, hxv⟩
          ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hb), hbv⟩ q (hq.trans le_sup_right) hvq).symm
  · have hvz : v ≠ z := Ne.symm hzv
    have hHle : H.deleteVerts {z} ≤ (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {z} :=
      deleteVerts_mono (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
    have hKle : K.deleteVerts {z} ≤ (H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {z} :=
      deleteVerts_mono (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
    refine Subgraph.preconnected_iff.mpr ?_
    suffices ∀ x : ((H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {z}).verts,
        ((H ⊔ K ⊔ p.toSubgraph).deleteVerts {z}).coe.Reachable
          ⟨v, ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hvH), hvz⟩⟩ x from
      fun x y ↦ (this x).symm.trans (this y)
    rintro ⟨x, ⟨(hx | hx) | hx, hxz⟩⟩
    · exact (hHdel ⟨v, ⟨hvH, hvz⟩⟩ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxz⟩⟩).map (inclusion hHle)
    · exact (hKdel ⟨v, ⟨hvK, hvz⟩⟩ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxz⟩⟩).map (inclusion hKle)
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, htz, q, hq, hzq⟩ := pathVertexReachesEndpointAvoiding p hp
        (p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp hx) hxz
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact ((hHdel ⟨v, ⟨hvH, hvz⟩⟩ ⟨t, ⟨ha, htz⟩⟩).map
          (inclusion hHle)).trans (reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk
            ⟨Or.inr hx, hxz⟩ ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ha), htz⟩ q
            (hq.trans le_sup_right) hzq).symm
      · exact ((hKdel ⟨v, ⟨hvK, hvz⟩⟩ ⟨t, ⟨hb, htz⟩⟩).map
          (inclusion hKle)).trans (reachableDeleteVertsOfWalk
            ⟨Or.inr hx, hxz⟩ ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hb), htz⟩ q
            (hq.trans le_sup_right) hzq).symm


private lemma existsChainMemberContaining {c : Set G.Subgraph} (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c)
    {a b : V} (ha : a ∈ (sSup c).verts) (hb : b ∈ (sSup c).verts) :
    ∃ H ∈ c, a ∈ H.verts ∧ b ∈ H.verts := by

  simp only [verts_sSup, Set.mem_iUnion] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨H, hH, ha⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := hb
  obtain hHK | hKH := hc.total hH hK
  · exact ⟨K, hK, hHK.1 ha, hb⟩
  · exact ⟨H, hH, ha, hKH.1 hb⟩


private lemma existsBlockAbove {H : G.Subgraph} (hH : H.Connected)
    (hcut : ∀ v : H.verts, ¬ H.coe.isCutVertex v) :
    ∃ B : G.Subgraph, H ≤ B ∧ B.IsBlock := by

  suffices ∃ B, H ≤ B ∧ Maximal (fun K : G.Subgraph ↦
      K.Connected ∧ ∀ v : K.verts, ¬ K.coe.isCutVertex v) B by
    obtain ⟨B, hHB, hB⟩ := this
    exact ⟨B, hHB, (isBlock_iff B).mpr hB⟩
  refine zorn_le_nonempty₀ _ ?_ H ⟨hH, hcut⟩
  intro c hcs hc K hK
  have hconn : (sSup c).Connected := by
    refine (connected_iff_forall_exists_walk_subgraph _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hcs hK).1.nonempty
      exact ⟨v, (le_sSup hK).1 hv⟩
    · intro a b ha hb
      obtain ⟨L, hL, haL, hbL⟩ := existsChainMemberContaining hc ha hb
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (preconnected_iff_forall_exists_walk_subgraph _).mp
        (hcs hL).1.preconnected haL hbL
      exact ⟨p, hp.trans (le_sSup hL)⟩
  refine ⟨sSup c, ⟨hconn, ?_⟩, fun L hL ↦ le_sSup hL⟩

  refine (noCutVertex_iff_avoidingWalk hconn).mpr ?_
  intro z a b ha hb haz hbz
  obtain ⟨L, hL, haL, hbL⟩ := existsChainMemberContaining hc ha hb
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hz⟩ := (noCutVertex_iff_avoidingWalk (hcs hL).1).mp
    (hcs hL).2 z a b haL hbL haz hbz
  exact ⟨p, hp.trans (le_sSup hL), hz⟩


private lemma noCutVertex_of_pair {W : Type*} {F : SimpleGraph W} {a b : W}
    (hpair : ∀ w, w = a ∨ w = b) (v : W) : ¬ F.isCutVertex v := by

  rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, _, hxy⟩
  have heq : x = y := by
    rcases hpair v with rfl | rfl
    · rcases hpair x with rfl | rfl
      · exact (hx rfl).elim
      · rcases hpair y with rfl | rfl
        · exact (hy rfl).elim
        · rfl
    · rcases hpair x with rfl | rfl
      · rcases hpair y with rfl | rfl
        · rfl
        · exact (hy rfl).elim
      · exact (hx rfl).elim
  subst y
  exact hxy (Reachable.refl _)


private lemma existsBlockContainingVertex (v : V) :
    ∃ B : G.Subgraph, B.IsBlock ∧ v ∈ B.verts := by

  have hcut : ∀ z : (G.singletonSubgraph v).verts,
      ¬ (G.singletonSubgraph v).coe.isCutVertex z := by
    intro z
    rintro ⟨a, b, ha, _, _, _⟩
    exact ha (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hblock⟩ := existsBlockAbove singletonSubgraph_connected hcut
  have hv : v ∈ (G.singletonSubgraph v).verts := Set.mem_singleton v
  exact ⟨B, hblock, hB.1 hv⟩


private lemma existsBlockContainingEdge {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ B : G.Subgraph, B.IsBlock ∧ a ∈ B.verts ∧ b ∈ B.verts := by

  have ha : a ∈ (G.subgraphOfAdj hab).verts := Set.mem_insert a {b}
  have hb : b ∈ (G.subgraphOfAdj hab).verts := Set.mem_insert_of_mem a (Set.mem_singleton b)
  have hcut : ∀ z : (G.subgraphOfAdj hab).verts,
      ¬ (G.subgraphOfAdj hab).coe.isCutVertex z := by
    intro z
    refine noCutVertex_of_pair (a := ⟨a, ha⟩) (b := ⟨b, hb⟩) ?_ z
    intro w
    have hw := w.property
    simp only [subgraphOfAdj_verts, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw
    exact hw.imp Subtype.ext Subtype.ext
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hblock⟩ := existsBlockAbove (subgraphOfAdj_connected hab) hcut
  exact ⟨B, hblock, hB.1 ha, hB.1 hb⟩


private lemma IsBlock.not_reachable_delete_of_ne {B C : G.Subgraph}
    (hB : B.IsBlock) (hC : C.IsBlock) (hBC : B ≠ C)
    {v a b : V} (hvB : v ∈ B.verts) (hvC : v ∈ C.verts)
    (ha : a ∈ B.verts) (hb : b ∈ C.verts) (hav : a ≠ v) (hbv : b ≠ v) :
    ¬ (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, hav⟩ ⟨b, hbv⟩ := by
  classical

  intro hab
  refine hab.elim_path ?_
  intro p
  have hp : (p.val.map (Embedding.induce _).toHom).IsPath :=
    p.property.map (Embedding.induce (G := G) _).injective
  have hvp : v ∉ (p.val.map (Embedding.induce _).toHom).support := by
    rw [Walk.support_map]
    intro hv
    obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact w.property hw
  obtain ⟨hconn, hcut⟩ := connectedNoCutSupOfAvoidingPath hB.connected hC.connected
    hB.noCutVertex hC.noCutVertex hvB hvC ha hb _ hp hvp
  have hUB := hB.maximal _ hconn hcut (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
  have hUC := hC.maximal _ hconn hcut (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
  exact hBC (le_antisymm ((le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left).trans hUC)
    ((le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left).trans hUB))


private lemma le_of_verts_subset_singleton {B C : G.Subgraph} {v : V}
    (hB : B.verts ⊆ {v}) (hv : v ∈ C.verts) : B ≤ C := by

  constructor
  · intro x hx
    have hxv := hB hx
    exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hxv) ▸ hv
  · intro x y hxy
    have hx := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hB (B.edge_vert hxy))
    have hy := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hB (B.edge_vert hxy.symm))
    subst x
    subst y
    exact (G.loopless.irrefl v (B.adj_sub hxy)).elim


private lemma IsBlock.exists_ne_of_ne {B C : G.Subgraph} (hB : B.IsBlock)
    (hC : C.IsBlock) (hBC : B ≠ C) {v : V} (hvC : v ∈ C.verts) :
    ∃ a ∈ B.verts, a ≠ v := by
  classical

  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hle : B ≤ C := le_of_verts_subset_singleton (fun a ha ↦ h a ha) hvC
  exact hBC (le_antisymm hle (hB.maximal C hC.connected hC.noCutVertex hle))


private lemma IsBlock.isCutVertex_of_ne {B C : G.Subgraph} (hB : B.IsBlock)
    (hC : C.IsBlock) (hBC : B ≠ C) {v : V}
    (hvB : v ∈ B.verts) (hvC : v ∈ C.verts) : G.isCutVertex v := by

  obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := hB.exists_ne_of_ne hC hBC hvC
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbv⟩ := hC.exists_ne_of_ne hB (Ne.symm hBC) hvB
  refine ⟨a, b, hav, hbv, ?_,
    hB.not_reachable_delete_of_ne hC hBC hvB hvC ha hb hav hbv⟩
  exact ((hB.connected ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨v, hvB⟩).map B.hom).trans
    ((hC.connected ⟨v, hvC⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩).map C.hom)

end Subgraph


theorem blockCutGraph_adj (G : SimpleGraph V) (x y : BlockCutVertex G) :
    G.blockCutGraph.Adj x y ↔
      match x, y with
      | .block B _, .cut v _ => v ∈ B.verts
      | .cut v _, .block B _ => v ∈ B.verts
      | _, _ => False := by

  cases x with
  | block B hB =>
    cases y with
    | block C hC => simp [blockCutGraph, fromRel_adj]
    | cut v hv => simp [blockCutGraph, fromRel_adj]
  | cut v hv =>
    cases y with
    | block B hB => simp [blockCutGraph, fromRel_adj]
    | cut w hw => simp [blockCutGraph, fromRel_adj]


theorem blockCutGraph_adj_block_cut (B : G.Subgraph) (hB : B.IsBlock)
    (v : V) (hv : G.isCutVertex v) :
    G.blockCutGraph.Adj (.block B hB) (.cut v hv) ↔ v ∈ B.verts := by

  exact blockCutGraph_adj G _ _


private lemma blockCutBlocksReachableOfCommonVertex {B C : G.Subgraph}
    (hB : B.IsBlock) (hC : C.IsBlock) {v : V}
    (hvB : v ∈ B.verts) (hvC : v ∈ C.verts) :
    G.blockCutGraph.Reachable (.block B hB) (.block C hC) := by
  classical

  by_cases hBC : B = C
  · subst C
    exact Reachable.refl _
  · have hv := hB.isCutVertex_of_ne hC hBC hvB hvC
    exact ((blockCutGraph_adj_block_cut B hB v hv).mpr hvB).reachable.trans
      ((blockCutGraph_adj_block_cut C hC v hv).mpr hvC).symm.reachable


private lemma blockCutBlocksReachable {B C : G.Subgraph} (hB : B.IsBlock)
    (hC : C.IsBlock) {a b : V} (ha : a ∈ B.verts) (hb : b ∈ C.verts)
    (hab : G.Reachable a b) :
    G.blockCutGraph.Reachable (.block B hB) (.block C hC) := by

  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hab
  induction p generalizing B with
  | nil => exact blockCutBlocksReachableOfCommonVertex hB hC ha hb
  | @cons a w b haw p ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD, haD, hwD⟩ := Subgraph.existsBlockContainingEdge haw
    exact (blockCutBlocksReachableOfCommonVertex hB hD ha haD).trans (ih hD hwD hb)


private lemma blockCutVertexReachesBlock (x : BlockCutVertex G) :
    ∃ (B : G.Subgraph) (hB : B.IsBlock),
      G.blockCutGraph.Reachable x (.block B hB) := by

  cases x with
  | block B hB => exact ⟨B, hB, Reachable.refl _⟩
  | cut v hv =>
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hvB⟩ := Subgraph.existsBlockContainingVertex v
    exact ⟨B, hB, ((blockCutGraph_adj_block_cut B hB v hv).mpr hvB).symm.reachable⟩


private lemma blockCutGraphConnected (hG : G.Connected) : G.blockCutGraph.Connected := by

  refine (SimpleGraph.connected_iff _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hx⟩ := blockCutVertexReachesBlock x
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hy⟩ := blockCutVertexReachesBlock y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hB.connected.nonempty
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hC.connected.nonempty
    exact hx.trans ((blockCutBlocksReachable hB hC ha hb (hG a b)).trans hy.symm)
  · obtain ⟨v⟩ := hG.nonempty
    obtain ⟨B, hB, _⟩ := Subgraph.existsBlockContainingVertex (G := G) v
    exact ⟨.block B hB⟩


private lemma reachableInduceOfAvoidingWalk {a b v : V} (ha : a ≠ v) (hb : b ≠ v)
    (p : G.Walk a b) (hv : v ∉ p.support) :
    (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ := by

  have hs : ∀ w ∈ p.support, w ∈ {w | w ≠ v} := by
    intro w hw hwv
    subst w
    exact hv hw
  exact (p.induce _ hs).reachable


private def blockCutCarrier (x : BlockCutVertex G) : Set V :=
  match x with
  | .block B _ => B.verts
  | .cut v _ => {v}


private lemma blockCutCarrierReachableAvoiding (x : BlockCutVertex G) {a b v : V}
    (ha : a ∈ blockCutCarrier x) (hb : b ∈ blockCutCarrier x)
    (hav : a ≠ v) (hbv : b ≠ v) :
    (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, hav⟩ ⟨b, hbv⟩ := by

  cases x with
  | block B hB =>
    obtain ⟨p, _, hv⟩ := (Subgraph.noCutVertex_iff_avoidingWalk hB.connected).mp
      hB.noCutVertex v a b ha hb hav hbv
    exact reachableInduceOfAvoidingWalk hav hbv p hv
  | cut w hw =>
    have haw : a = w := ha
    have hbw : b = w := hb
    subst a
    subst b
    exact Reachable.refl _


private lemma blockCutWalkReachableAvoiding {x y : BlockCutVertex G} {v : V}
    (hv : G.isCutVertex v) (p : G.blockCutGraph.Walk x y)
    (hp : (.cut v hv) ∉ p.support) {a b : V}
    (ha : a ∈ blockCutCarrier x) (hb : b ∈ blockCutCarrier y)
    (hav : a ≠ v) (hbv : b ≠ v) :
    (G.induce {w | w ≠ v}).Reachable ⟨a, hav⟩ ⟨b, hbv⟩ := by

  induction p generalizing a with
  | nil => exact blockCutCarrierReachableAvoiding _ ha hb hav hbv
  | @cons x z y hxz p ih =>
    have htail : (.cut v hv) ∉ p.support := by
      intro h
      exact hp (List.mem_cons_of_mem x h)
    cases x with
    | block B hB =>
      cases z with
      | block C hC => exact ((blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hxz).elim
      | cut w hw =>
        have hwv : w ≠ v := by
          intro heq
          subst w
          exact htail p.start_mem_support
        have hwB := (blockCutGraph_adj_block_cut B hB w hw).mp hxz
        have hstep := blockCutCarrierReachableAvoiding (.block B hB) ha hwB hav hwv
        exact hstep.trans (ih htail rfl hb hwv)
    | cut w hw =>
      cases z with
      | cut t ht => exact ((blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hxz).elim
      | block B hB =>
        have hwB := (blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hxz
        have haw : a = w := ha
        subst a
        exact ih htail hwB hb hav


private lemma pathEndNotMemDropLast {W : Type*} {F : SimpleGraph W} {a b : W}
    (p : F.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hn : ¬ p.Nil) : b ∉ p.dropLast.support := by

  have hnodup := hp.support_nodup
  rw [← p.support_dropLast_concat hn] at hnodup
  intro hb
  exact (List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup) hb (List.mem_singleton_self b)


private lemma not_blockCutCycleAtCut {v : V} (hv : G.isCutVertex v)
    (p : G.blockCutGraph.Walk (.cut v hv) (.cut v hv)) : ¬ p.IsCycle := by
  classical

  intro hc
  cases p with
  | nil => exact hc.not_nil Walk.nil_nil
  | @cons _ x _ h q =>
    cases x with
    | cut w hw => exact ((blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp h).elim
    | block B hB =>
      have hvB : v ∈ B.verts := (blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp h
      have hends : (.block B hB : BlockCutVertex G) ≠ .cut v hv := by
        intro heq
        cases heq
      have hq : ¬ q.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hends
      have hpq : q.IsPath := ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q h).mp hc).1
      have havoid : (.cut v hv) ∉ q.dropLast.support := pathEndNotMemDropLast q hpq hq
      have hadj := q.adj_penultimate hq
      have hne : (.block B hB : BlockCutVertex G) ≠ q.penultimate := by
        simpa only [Walk.snd_cons, Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil h q hq] using
          hc.snd_ne_penultimate
      generalize hCeq : q.penultimate = c at hadj hne
      cases c with
      | cut w hw => exact ((blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hadj).elim
      | block C hC =>
        have hvC : v ∈ C.verts := (blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hadj
        have hBC : B ≠ C := by
          intro heq
          subst C
          exact hne rfl
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := hB.exists_ne_of_ne hC hBC hvC
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hbv⟩ := hC.exists_ne_of_ne hB (Ne.symm hBC) hvB
        have hb' : b ∈ blockCutCarrier q.penultimate := by
          rw [hCeq]
          exact hb
        exact hB.not_reachable_delete_of_ne hC hBC hvB hvC ha hb hav hbv
          (blockCutWalkReachableAvoiding hv q.dropLast havoid ha hb' hav hbv)


private lemma blockCutGraphIsAcyclic (G : SimpleGraph V) : G.blockCutGraph.IsAcyclic := by
  classical

  intro x p hc
  cases x with
  | cut v hv => exact not_blockCutCycleAtCut hv p hc
  | block B hB =>
    have hadj := p.adj_snd hc.not_nil
    have hmem : p.snd ∈ p.support := p.getVert_mem_support 1
    generalize hxeq : p.snd = x at hadj hmem
    cases x with
    | block C hC => exact ((blockCutGraph_adj G _ _).mp hadj).elim
    | cut v hv => exact not_blockCutCycleAtCut hv (p.rotate _ hmem) (hc.rotate hmem)

end SimpleGraph

open SimpleGraph



theorem blockCutGraphIsTree {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected) :
    G.blockCutGraph.IsTree := by

  exact ⟨SimpleGraph.blockCutGraphConnected hG, SimpleGraph.blockCutGraphIsAcyclic G⟩

open DihedralGroup


private def DihedralGroup.squareVertexEquiv : DihedralGroup 4 → Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4)
  | r i => Equiv.addRight i
  | sr i => (Equiv.neg (ZMod 4)).trans (Equiv.addRight (-i))


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexEquiv_mul (a b : DihedralGroup 4) :
    squareVertexEquiv (a * b) = squareVertexEquiv a * squareVertexEquiv b := by

  cases a
  all_goals cases b
  all_goals
    ext x
    simp only [r_mul_r, r_mul_sr, sr_mul_r, sr_mul_sr, squareVertexEquiv,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight, Equiv.neg_apply]
    abel



def DihedralGroup.squarePerm : DihedralGroup 4 →* Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) :=

  MonoidHom.mk' squareVertexEquiv squareVertexEquiv_mul


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_r_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (r i) x = x + i := by

  rfl


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_sr_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (sr i) x = -x - i := by

  exact (sub_eq_add_neg (-x) i).symm


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_injective : Function.Injective squarePerm := by

  intro a b h
  have hzero := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 0) h
  have hone := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 1) h
  cases a
  all_goals cases b
  all_goals rename_i i j
  all_goals fin_cases i
  all_goals fin_cases j
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, squarePerm_sr_apply] at hzero hone
    revert hzero hone
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareCenterElements :
    {g : DihedralGroup 4 | g ∈ Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)} = {r 0, r 2} := by

  ext g
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Subgroup.mem_center_iff,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  cases g
  all_goals rename_i i
  all_goals fin_cases i
  all_goals decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareRotationConjugates (i : ZMod 4) :
    conjugatesOf (r i : DihedralGroup 4) = {r i, r (-i)} := by

  ext g
  simp only [conjugatesOf, Set.mem_setOf_eq, isConj_iff,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  cases g
  all_goals rename_i j
  all_goals fin_cases i
  all_goals fin_cases j
  all_goals decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareReflectionConjugates (i : ZMod 4) :
    conjugatesOf (sr i : DihedralGroup 4) = {sr i, sr (i + 2)} := by

  ext g
  simp only [conjugatesOf, Set.mem_setOf_eq, isConj_iff,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  cases g
  all_goals rename_i j
  all_goals fin_cases i
  all_goals fin_cases j
  all_goals decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareHalfTurn :
    squarePerm (r 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexReflection :
    squarePerm (sr 0) = Equiv.swap 1 3 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareOppositeVertexReflection :
    squarePerm (sr 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareQuarterTurn :
    squarePerm (r 1) = Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 0 1 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareEdgeReflection :
    squarePerm (sr 1) = Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareOppositeEdgeReflection :
    squarePerm (sr 3) = Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    decide



theorem DihedralGroup.squareCenterImage :
    squarePerm '' {g : DihedralGroup 4 | g ∈ Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)} =
      {1, Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3} := by

  rw [squareCenterElements, Set.image_pair, squareHalfTurn, ← one_def, map_one]



theorem DihedralGroup.squareVertexClassImage :
    squarePerm '' conjugatesOf (sr 0 : DihedralGroup 4) =
      {Equiv.swap 0 2, Equiv.swap 1 3} := by

  rw [squareReflectionConjugates, Set.image_pair]
  norm_num only [zero_add]
  rw [squareVertexReflection, squareOppositeVertexReflection, Set.pair_comm]




theorem DihedralGroup.squareRotationClassImage :
    squarePerm '' conjugatesOf (r 1 : DihedralGroup 4) =
      {(Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 0 1)⁻¹,
        Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 0 1} := by

  rw [squareRotationConjugates, Set.image_pair, ← inv_r, map_inv, squareQuarterTurn,
    Set.pair_comm]



theorem DihedralGroup.squareEdgeClassImage :
    squarePerm '' conjugatesOf (sr 1 : DihedralGroup 4) =
      {Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3, Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2} := by

  rw [squareReflectionConjugates, Set.image_pair]
  have hindex : (1 : ZMod 4) + 2 = 3 := by norm_num
  rw [hindex, squareEdgeReflection, squareOppositeEdgeReflection, Set.pair_comm]


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareClassCarrier (g : DihedralGroup 4) :
    (ConjClasses.mk g).carrier = conjugatesOf g := by

  rfl




theorem DihedralGroup.squareNoncenter :
    ConjClasses.noncenter (DihedralGroup 4) =
      {ConjClasses.mk (sr 0), ConjClasses.mk (r 1), ConjClasses.mk (sr 1)} := by

  ext c
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := ConjClasses.mk_surjective c
  simp only [ConjClasses.mem_noncenter, squareClassCarrier, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff, ConjClasses.mk_eq_mk_iff_isConj, isConj_iff]
  cases g with
  | r i =>
    rw [squareRotationConjugates]
    simp only [Set.Nontrivial, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    fin_cases i
    all_goals decide
  | sr i =>
    rw [squareReflectionConjugates]
    simp only [Set.Nontrivial, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    fin_cases i
    all_goals decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareCenterCard :
    Nat.card (Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)) = 2 := by

  have hdistinct : (r 0 : DihedralGroup 4) ≠ r 2 := by decide
  calc
    Nat.card (Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)) =
        Nat.card {g : DihedralGroup 4 | g ∈ Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)} := rfl
    _ = ({g : DihedralGroup 4 | g ∈ Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)} :
        Set (DihedralGroup 4)).ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq _
    _ = ({r 0, r 2} : Set (DihedralGroup 4)).ncard :=
      congrArg Set.ncard squareCenterElements
    _ = 2 := Set.ncard_pair hdistinct


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareReflectionConjugatesCard (i : ZMod 4) :
    (conjugatesOf (sr i : DihedralGroup 4)).ncard = 2 := by

  rw [squareReflectionConjugates]
  refine Set.ncard_pair ?_
  fin_cases i
  all_goals decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squareQuarterTurnConjugatesCard :
    (conjugatesOf (r 1 : DihedralGroup 4)).ncard = 2 := by

  rw [squareRotationConjugates]
  refine Set.ncard_pair ?_
  decide



theorem DihedralGroup.squareClassEquation :
    Nat.card (DihedralGroup 4) = Nat.card (Subgroup.center (DihedralGroup 4)) +
      (conjugatesOf (sr 0 : DihedralGroup 4)).ncard +
      (conjugatesOf (r 1 : DihedralGroup 4)).ncard +
      (conjugatesOf (sr 1 : DihedralGroup 4)).ncard := by

  rw [nat_card, squareCenterCard, squareReflectionConjugatesCard,
    squareQuarterTurnConjugatesCard, squareReflectionConjugatesCard]




theorem DihedralGroup.squareClassEquationNumerical :
    Nat.card (DihedralGroup 4) = 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 := by

  rw [nat_card]

namespace Real



public noncomputable def softmax {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (μ : ℝ) (s : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ :=
  fun i ↦ exp (s i / μ) / ∑ j, exp (s j / μ)


public noncomputable def entropyRegularizedObjective {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, v i * s i + μ * ∑ i, negMulLog (v i)


public theorem softmax_mem_stdSimplex {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (hι : Nonempty ι)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    softmax μ s ∈ stdSimplex ℝ ι := by

  obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := hι
  have hZ : 0 < ∑ j, exp (s j / μ) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ ↦ exp_pos (s j / μ)) ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_univ i₀⟩
  constructor
  ·
    intro i
    exact div_nonneg (exp_pos (s i / μ)).le hZ.le
  ·
    dsimp only [softmax]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hZ)

end Real

@[expose] public section

open scoped InnerProductSpace

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {f : H → EReal} {x : H}


theorem subdifferential_domain_subset (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f) :
    ∀ z, (Subdifferential.subdifferential f z).Nonempty → z ∈ Subdifferential.domain f := by

  intro z hz
  rcases hf.1 with ⟨y, hy⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hineq := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f z u).mp hu y
  change f z ≠ ⊤
  intro htop
  have htopLe : ⊤ ≤ f y := by
    simpa [htop] using hineq
  exact (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy (top_le_iff.mp htopLe)


theorem subdifferential_eq_support (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) :
    Subdifferential.subdifferential f x =
      {u | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
        (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  ext u
  constructor
  · intro hu y hy
    have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu y
    rw [EReal.le_sub_iff_add_le (Or.inl (hf.2 x)) (Or.inl hxTop)]
    simpa [add_comm] using hglobal
  · intro hu
    apply (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mpr
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f
    · have hle := hu y hy
      rw [EReal.le_sub_iff_add_le (Or.inl (hf.2 x)) (Or.inl hxTop)] at hle
      simpa [add_comm] using hle
    · have htop : f y = ⊤ := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy ((Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mpr hne)
      rw [htop]
      exact le_top


theorem isClosed_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) : IsClosed (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x) := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  have hreal (y : H) (hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) (u : H) :
      (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x ↔
        ⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y).toReal - (f x).toReal := by
    have hyTop : f y ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy
    have hfiniteY : f y = ((f y).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hyTop (hf.2 y)).symm
    have hfiniteX : f x = ((f x).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hxTop (hf.2 x)).symm
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX] at h
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub] at h
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    · intro h
      have hcoe : (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤
          (((f y).toReal - (f x).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h
      rw [EReal.coe_sub] at hcoe
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX]
      exact hcoe
  have hset :
      {u : H | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
          (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} =
        ⋂ y : {y : H // y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f},
          {u : H | ⟪y.1 - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal} := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hu y
      exact (hreal y.1 y.2 u).mp (hu y.1 y.2)
    · intro hu y hy
      exact (hreal y hy u).mpr (hu ⟨y, hy⟩)
  rw [subdifferential_eq_support hf hx, hset]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro y
  exact IsClosed.preimage (innerSL ℝ (y.1 - x)).continuous isClosed_Iic


theorem convex_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) : Convex ℝ (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x) := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  have hreal (y : H) (hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) (u : H) :
      (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x ↔
        ⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y).toReal - (f x).toReal := by
    have hyTop : f y ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy
    have hfiniteY : f y = ((f y).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hyTop (hf.2 y)).symm
    have hfiniteX : f x = ((f x).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hxTop (hf.2 x)).symm
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX] at h
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub] at h
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    · intro h
      have hcoe : (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤
          (((f y).toReal - (f x).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h
      rw [EReal.coe_sub] at hcoe
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX]
      exact hcoe
  have hset :
      {u : H | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
          (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} =
        ⋂ y : {y : H // y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f},
          {u : H | ⟪y.1 - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal} := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hu y
      exact (hreal y.1 y.2 u).mp (hu y.1 y.2)
    · intro hu y hy
      exact (hreal y hy u).mpr (hu ⟨y, hy⟩)
  rw [subdifferential_eq_support hf hx, hset]
  apply convex_iInter
  intro y
  exact (convex_Iic ((f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal)).linear_preimage
    (innerSL ℝ (y.1 - x)).toLinearMap


theorem lowerSemicontinuousAt_of_mem_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hsub : (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x).Nonempty) : LowerSemicontinuousAt f x := by

  rcases hsub with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxDomain := subdifferential_domain_subset hf x ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hxDomain
  have hxBot : f x ≠ ⊥ := hf.2 x
  have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu
  let g : H → ℝ := fun z => (f x).toReal + ⟪z - x, u⟫_ℝ
  have hminorant (z : H) : (g z : EReal) ≤ f z := by
    simp only [g, EReal.coe_add]
    rw [EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot]
    exact hglobal z
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact continuous_const.add <|
      (innerSLFlip ℝ u).continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  rw [lowerSemicontinuousAt_iff]
  intro a ha
  by_cases habot : a = ⊥
  · subst a
    filter_upwards [] with z
    exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr (hf.2 z)
  · have haTop : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha le_top)
    have hcastA : (a.toReal : EReal) = a := EReal.coe_toReal haTop habot
    have hcastX : ((f x).toReal : EReal) = f x := EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot
    have hreal : a.toReal < (f x).toReal := by
      rw [← hcastA, ← hcastX] at ha
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp ha
    have hAt : a.toReal < g x := by simpa [g] using hreal
    have hnear := hg.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hAt)
    filter_upwards [hnear] with z hz
    calc
      a = (a.toReal : EReal) := hcastA.symm
      _ < (g z : EReal) := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hz
      _ ≤ f z := hminorant z


theorem weakLowerSemicontinuousAt_of_mem_subdifferential
    (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hsub : (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x).Nonempty) :
    LowerSemicontinuousAt (f ∘ (toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm) (toWeakSpace ℝ H x) := by

  rcases hsub with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxDomain := subdifferential_domain_subset hf x ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hxDomain
  have hxBot : f x ≠ ⊥ := hf.2 x
  have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu
  let g : WeakSpace ℝ H → ℝ := fun z =>
    (f x).toReal + ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ
  have hminorant (z : WeakSpace ℝ H) : (g z : EReal) ≤ f ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := by
    simp only [g, EReal.coe_add]
    rw [EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot]
    exact hglobal ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z)
  have hEval : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
      ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z, u⟫_ℝ := by
    have hmapBase : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v := by
      change @Continuous (WeakSpace ℝ H) ((H →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
        (TopologicalSpace.induced
          (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ =>
            (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v) Pi.topologicalSpace)
        Pi.topologicalSpace _
      exact continuous_induced_dom
    have hmap : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => v ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := by
      have heq : (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
          fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => v ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z)) =
          (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ =>
            (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v) := by
        funext z v
        rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact hmapBase
    have heval : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        innerSL ℝ u ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) :=
      (continuous_apply (innerSL ℝ u)).comp hmap
    simpa only [innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_comm] using heval
  have hinner : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
      ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ := by
    have heq : (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z, u⟫_ℝ) -
          (fun _ : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪x, u⟫_ℝ) := by
      ext z
      rw [Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [inner_sub_left]
    rw [heq]
    exact hEval.sub (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪x, u⟫_ℝ)
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact continuous_const.add hinner
  rw [lowerSemicontinuousAt_iff]
  intro a ha
  by_cases habot : a = ⊥
  · subst a
    filter_upwards [] with z
    exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr (hf.2 ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z))
  · have haTop : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha le_top)
    have hcastA : (a.toReal : EReal) = a := EReal.coe_toReal haTop habot
    have hcastX : ((f x).toReal : EReal) = f x := EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot
    have ha' : a < f x := by simpa using ha
    have hreal : a.toReal < (f x).toReal := by
      rw [← hcastA, ← hcastX] at ha'
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp ha'
    have hAt : a.toReal < g (toWeakSpace ℝ H x) := by simpa [g] using hreal
    have hnear := hg.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hAt)
    filter_upwards [hnear] with z hz
    calc
      a = (a.toReal : EReal) := hcastA.symm
      _ < (g z : EReal) := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hz
      _ ≤ f ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := hminorant z

end

private lemma sumNeighborsSwap {V R : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (s t : Finset V) (f : V → V → R)
    (hclosed : ∀ a ∈ s, G.neighborFinset a ⊆ t) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, f a b) =
      ∑ b ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), f a b := by

  have hrow (a : V) (ha : a ∈ s) :
      G.neighborFinset a = t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj a := by
    ext b
    simp only [mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove]
    exact ⟨fun hab ↦ ⟨hclosed a ha ((G.mem_neighborFinset a b).mpr hab), hab⟩,
      fun hb ↦ hb.2⟩
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj a, f a b := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro a ha
      rw [hrow a ha]
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_sum_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_sum_bipartiteBelow G.Adj f


private lemma sumNeighborReciprocalDegrees_le_one {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] (b : V) (hb : 0 < G.degree b)
    (hdom : ∀ a, G.Adj b a → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a) :
    (∑ a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 := by

  have hbq : (0 : ℚ) < G.degree b := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hb
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree b : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro a ha
      exact inv_anti₀ hbq (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hdom a ((G.mem_neighborFinset b a).mp ha)))
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hbq.ne']


private lemma card_le_card_neighborBiUnion {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {A B : Set V} (hbip : G.IsBipartiteWith A B)
    (hpos : ∀ v, 0 < G.degree v)
    (hdeg : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, a ∈ A → b ∈ B → G.Adj a b → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a)
    (s : Finset V) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∈ A) :
    s.card ≤ (s.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a)).card := by
  let t := s.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a)

  have hclosed (a : V) (ha : a ∈ s) : G.neighborFinset a ⊆ t := by
    intro b hb
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
  have hrow (a : V) : (∑ _b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hpos a).ne')]
  have ht (b : V) (hb : b ∈ t) : b ∈ B := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hb
    exact hbip.mem_of_mem_adj (hs a ha) ((G.mem_neighborFinset a b).mp hab)

  have hincoming (b : V) (hb : b ∈ t) :
      (∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
        · intro a ha
          exact (G.mem_neighborFinset b a).mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2.symm
        · intro a _ _
          exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        refine sumNeighborReciprocalDegrees_le_one G b (hpos b) ?_
        intro a hba
        exact hdeg (hbip.symm.mem_of_mem_adj (ht b hb) hba) (ht b hb) hba.symm
  have hcard : (s.card : ℚ) ≤ t.card := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ _b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        simp only [hrow, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = ∑ b ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ :=
        sumNeighborsSwap G s t (fun a _ ↦ (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) hclosed
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ t, (1 : ℚ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hincoming
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact Nat.cast_le.mp hcard

end SimpleGraph






theorem existsMatchingOfDegreeLe {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    (A B : Set V) (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_cover : A ∪ B = Set.univ)
    (h_positive : ∀ v : V, 1 ≤ G.degree v)
    (h_degree : ∀ ⦃a b : V⦄, a ∈ A → b ∈ B → G.Adj a b → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ A ⊆ M.support := by
  classical

  have hhall (S : Set V) (hS : S ⊆ A) :
      S.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ S, G.neighborSet x).ncard := by
    rcases S.finite_or_infinite with hfinite | hinfinite
    · have hs (a : V) (ha : a ∈ hfinite.toFinset) : a ∈ A :=
        hS (hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp ha)
      have hcard := SimpleGraph.card_le_card_neighborBiUnion G h_bipartite
        (fun v ↦ h_positive v) h_degree hfinite.toFinset hs
      have hunion : (hfinite.toFinset.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a) : Set V) =
          ⋃ x ∈ S, G.neighborSet x := by
        simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, coe_neighborFinset, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card S hfinite, ← hunion, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
      exact hcard
    · rw [hinfinite.ncard]
      exact Nat.zero_le _

  obtain ⟨M, hA, hM⟩ := G.exists_isMatching_of_forall_ncard_le h_bipartite hhall
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  rwa [hM.support_eq_verts]

private lemma positiveSecant_le_coe_iff (a : EReal) (F r t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
