  · simp only [EReal.top_sub_coe, EReal.coe_mul_top_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht), top_le_iff, EReal.coe_ne_top]


private lemma coe_le_positiveSecant_iff (a : EReal) (F r t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (↑r : EReal) ≤ ↑(t⁻¹) * (a - ↑F) ↔ ↑(F + t * r) ≤ a := by

  cases a using EReal.rec
  · simp only [EReal.bot_sub, EReal.coe_mul_bot_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht), le_bot_iff, EReal.coe_ne_bot]
  · rename_i a
    rw [← coe_sub, ← coe_mul, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, le_div_iff₀ ht]
    constructor
    · intro h
      linarith
    · intro h
      linarith
  · simp only [EReal.top_sub_coe, EReal.coe_mul_top_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht), le_top]


private lemma positiveSecantMono (f : E → EReal) (x y : E)
    (hc : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ Real.toEReal p.2})
    (htop : f x ≠ ⊤) (hbot : f x ≠ ⊥) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (↑(t⁻¹) : EReal) * (f (x + t • y) - f x))
      (Set.Ioi 0) := by

  intro s hs t ht hst
  have htnonzero : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  apply EReal.le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp
  intro r hr
  have hx := EReal.coe_toReal htop hbot
  have hend : f (x + t • y) ≤ ↑((f x).toReal + t * r) := by
    apply (positiveSecant_le_coe_iff _ _ _ _ ht).mp
    simpa only [hx] using hr.le
  have hpoint := hc (x := (x, (f x).toReal))
      (y := (x + t • y, (f x).toReal + t * r)) hx.ge hend
      (_root_.sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one ht).mpr hst))
      (le_of_lt (_root_.div_pos hs ht)) (_root_.sub_add_cancel 1 (s / t))
  have hspace : (1 - s / t) • x + (s / t) • (x + t • y) = x + s • y := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, ← add_assoc, ← add_smul]
    simp only [_root_.sub_add_cancel, one_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ htnonzero]
  have hheight : (1 - s / t) * (f x).toReal +
      (s / t) * ((f x).toReal + t * r) = (f x).toReal + s * r := by
    field_simp [htnonzero]
    ring
  have hbound : f (x + s • y) ≤ ↑((f x).toReal + s * r) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.snd_add,
      Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, hspace, hheight] using hpoint
  rw [← hx]
  exact (positiveSecant_le_coe_iff _ _ _ _ hs).mpr hbound



theorem tendsto_directionalDeriv (f : E → EReal) (x y : E)
    (h_convex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ Real.toEReal p.2})
    (h_top : f x ≠ ⊤) (h_bot : f x ≠ ⊥) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.toEReal (t⁻¹) * (f (x + t • y) - f x))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (directionalDeriv f x y)) := by

  have hm := positiveSecantMono f x y h_convex h_top h_bot
  refine tendsto_order.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    exact ha.trans_le (iInf_le_of_le t (iInf_le_of_le ht le_rfl))
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨htpos, hta⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp ht
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds (eventually_lt_nhds htpos)] with s hs hst
    exact (hm hs htpos hst.le).trans_lt hta

end EReal


private lemma prodFunctional_apply (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E) (r : ℝ) :
    L (w, r) = L (w, 0) + r * L (0, 1) := by

  have hpair : (w, r) = (w, 0) + r • (0, 1) := by
    ext
    · simp
    · simp
  rw [hpair, map_add, map_smul]
  rfl


private lemma existsSpatialRepresentative [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ∃ u : E, ∀ w, inner ℝ u w = L (w, 0) := by

  refine ⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm
    (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)), ?_⟩
  intro w
  exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply


private lemma existsAffineMinorantAboveSegment [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (hc : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hclosed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hproper : ∀ w, f w ≠ ⊥) (x z : E) (F a b : ℝ)
    (hx : f x = ↑F) (ha : a < F)
    (hd : Disjoint (segment ℝ (x, a) (z, b))
      {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    ∃ (v : E) (c : ℝ), (∀ w, (↑(c + inner ℝ v w) : EReal) ≤ f w) ∧
      a < c + inner ℝ v x ∧ b < c + inner ℝ v z := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact (segment ℝ (x, a) (z, b)) := by
    rw [segment_eq_image]
    have hcont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ ↦ (1 - θ) • (x, a) + θ • (z, b)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact isCompact_Icc.image hcont
  obtain ⟨L, k, l, hleft, hkl, hright⟩ :=
    geometric_hahn_banach_compact_closed (convex_segment (x, a) (z, b)) hcompact hc hclosed hd
  have hstart := hleft (x, a) (left_mem_segment ℝ (x, a) (z, b))
  have hend := hleft (z, b) (right_mem_segment ℝ (x, a) (z, b))
  have hbase : l < L (x, F) := hright (x, F) hx.le
  have hβ : 0 < L (0, 1) := by
    rw [prodFunctional_apply] at hstart hbase
    by_contra h
    have hn := le_of_not_gt h
    have hm := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hn (sub_pos.mpr ha).le
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := existsSpatialRepresentative L

  have hformula (w : E) :
      k / L (0, 1) + inner ℝ (-(L (0, 1))⁻¹ • u) w =
        (k - L (w, 0)) / L (0, 1) := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, hu]
    ring
  refine ⟨-(L (0, 1))⁻¹ • u, k / L (0, 1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w
    rw [hformula]
    by_cases hw : f w = ⊤
    · rw [hw]
      exact le_top
    · have hwfinite := EReal.coe_toReal hw (hproper w)
      have hepi : f w ≤ (↑(f w).toReal : EReal) := hwfinite.ge
      have hsep := hright (w, (f w).toReal) hepi
      rw [prodFunctional_apply] at hsep
      rw [← hwfinite, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff, div_le_iff₀ hβ]
      nlinarith
  · rw [hformula, lt_div_iff₀ hβ]
    rw [prodFunctional_apply] at hstart
    linarith
  · rw [hformula, lt_div_iff₀ hβ]
    rw [prodFunctional_apply] at hend
    linarith


private lemma epsilonSupport_le_positiveSecant (f : E → EReal) (x y : E)
    (htop : f x ≠ ⊤) (hbot : f x ≠ ⊥) (ε t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    EReal.supportFunction (epsilonSubdifferential f ε x) y ≤
      ↑(t⁻¹) * (f (x + t • y) - f x) + (↑(ε / t) : EReal) := by

  rw [EReal.supportFunction_le_iff]
  intro v hv
  have hx := EReal.coe_toReal htop hbot
  have hvpoint := (mem_epsilonSubdifferential f ε x v).mp hv (x + t • y)
  rw [← hx, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add] at hvpoint
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_right] at hvpoint
  cases he : f (x + t • y) using EReal.rec
  · simp only [he, le_bot_iff, EReal.coe_ne_bot] at hvpoint
  · rename_i q
    rw [← hx, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_mul, ← EReal.coe_add,
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    rw [he, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hvpoint
    rw [real_inner_comm] at hvpoint
    rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, ← add_div, le_div_iff₀ ht]
    linarith
  · rw [← hx, EReal.top_sub_coe,
      EReal.coe_mul_top_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht), EReal.top_add_coe]
    exact le_top


private lemma segmentBelowEpigraph (f : E → EReal) (x y : E) (F ε r T : ℝ)
    (hx : f x = ↑F) (hε : 0 < ε) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hr : (↑r : EReal) ≤ EReal.directionalDeriv f x y) :
    Disjoint (segment ℝ (x, F - ε) (x + T • y, F - ε + T * r))
      {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} := by

  refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
  intro p hp hepi
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hp
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hp
  have hspace : (1 - s) • x + s • (x + T • y) = x + (s * T) • y := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, ← add_assoc, ← add_smul, sub_add_cancel, one_smul]
  have hheight : (1 - s) * (F - ε) + s * (F - ε + T * r) =
      F - ε + (s * T) * r := by
    ring
  have hupper : f (x + (s * T) • y) ≤ (↑(F - ε + (s * T) * r) : EReal) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
      Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, hspace, hheight] using hepi
  have hlower : (↑(F + (s * T) * r) : EReal) ≤ f (x + (s * T) • y) := by
    by_cases hzero : s * T = 0
    · simp only [hzero, zero_smul, add_zero, zero_mul, hx, le_refl]
    · have hpositive : 0 < s * T :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (mul_nonneg hs.1 hT.le) (Ne.symm hzero)
      apply (EReal.coe_le_positiveSecant_iff _ _ _ _ hpositive).mp
      rw [← hx]
      exact hr.trans (iInf_le_of_le (s * T) (iInf_le_of_le hpositive le_rfl))
  have hstrict : (↑(F - ε + (s * T) * r) : EReal) < ↑(F + (s * T) * r) := by
    rw [EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
    linarith
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hlower.trans hupper)) hstrict


private lemma mem_epsilonSubdifferential_of_affineMinorant (f : E → EReal)
    (x v : E) (F ε c : ℝ) (hx : f x = ↑F)
    (hm : ∀ z, (↑(c + inner ℝ v z) : EReal) ≤ f z)
    (hbase : F - ε ≤ c + inner ℝ v x) :
    v ∈ epsilonSubdifferential f ε x := by

  rw [mem_epsilonSubdifferential]
  intro z
  rw [hx, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add]
  refine le_trans (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr ?_) (hm z)
  rw [inner_sub_right]
  linarith


private lemma directionalDeriv_le_epsilonSupport [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x y : E)
    (hclosed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hc : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hproper : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) (htop : f x ≠ ⊤) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    EReal.directionalDeriv f x y ≤
      EReal.supportFunction (epsilonSubdifferential f ε x) y := by

  apply EReal.ge_of_forall_gt_iff_ge.mp
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨r, har, hrd⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real ha
  have hgap : 0 < r - a := sub_pos.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp har)
  have hεone : 0 < ε + 1 := by
    linarith
  let T := (ε + 1) / (r - a)
  have hT : 0 < T := div_pos hεone hgap
  have hlength : ε < T * (r - a) := by
    dsimp only [T]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgap.ne']
    linarith
  have hx : f x = (↑(f x).toReal : EReal) :=
    (EReal.coe_toReal htop (hproper x)).symm
  have hstart : (f x).toReal - ε < (f x).toReal := by
    linarith
  have hdisj := segmentBelowEpigraph f x y (f x).toReal ε r T hx hε hT hrd.le
  obtain ⟨v, c, hminor, hnear, hfar⟩ := existsAffineMinorantAboveSegment
    f hc hclosed hproper x (x + T • y) (f x).toReal
    ((f x).toReal - ε) ((f x).toReal - ε + T * r) hx hstart hdisj

  have hbase : c + inner ℝ v x ≤ (f x).toReal := by
    have h := hminor x
    rwa [hx, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at h
  have hslope : a < inner ℝ y v := by
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm y v] at hfar
    nlinarith
  have hv := mem_epsilonSubdifferential_of_affineMinorant f x v (f x).toReal ε c
    hx hminor hnear.le
  exact le_trans (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hslope.le)
    (le_iSup_of_le v (le_iSup_of_le hv le_rfl))




theorem tendsto_supportFunction_epsilonSubdifferential [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x y : E)
    (h_closed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ Real.toEReal p.2})
    (h_convex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ Real.toEReal p.2})
    (h_proper : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) (h_finite : f x ≠ ⊤) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun ε : ℝ ↦ EReal.supportFunction (epsilonSubdifferential f ε x) y)
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (EReal.directionalDeriv f x y)) := by

  refine tendsto_order.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact ha.trans_le
      (directionalDeriv_le_epsilonSupport f x y h_closed h_convex h_proper h_finite ε hε)
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hdb, hba⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real ha
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp hdb
    obtain ⟨htpos, htb⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp ht
    obtain ⟨q, htq, hqb⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real htb
    have hgap : 0 < b - q := sub_pos.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp hqb)
    have hδ : 0 < t * (b - q) := mul_pos htpos hgap
    filter_upwards [eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds (eventually_lt_nhds hδ)]
      with ε hε
    calc
      EReal.supportFunction (epsilonSubdifferential f ε x) y ≤
          ↑(t⁻¹) * (f (x + t • y) - f x) + ↑(ε / t) :=
        epsilonSupport_le_positiveSecant f x y h_finite (h_proper x) ε t htpos
      _ ≤ (↑q : EReal) + ↑(ε / t) := _root_.add_le_add htq.le le_rfl
      _ < ↑b := by
        rw [← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt',
          div_lt_iff₀ htpos]
        nlinarith
      _ < a := hba

@[expose] public section

open Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal

universe u

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

namespace WithTop






structure IsSmoothOn (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) : Prop where

  finiteNearby (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤

  differentiableAt (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x

  gradientLipschitz : LipschitzOnWith L (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f)) D

namespace IsSmoothOn



theorem gradientLipschitzOfHasGradientAt (g : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (G : E → E)
    (hgradient : ∀ x ∈ D, HasGradientAt g (G x) x)
    (hLipschitz : LipschitzOnWith L G D) :
    LipschitzOnWith L (gradient g) D := by

  apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [(hgradient x hx).gradient, (hgradient y hy).gradient]
  exact hLipschitz.dist_le_mul x hx y hy



theorem ofGradient (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (G : E → E)
    (hfinite : ∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤)
    (hgradient : ∀ x ∈ D, HasGradientAt (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) (G x) x)
    (hLipschitz : LipschitzOnWith L G D) : IsSmoothOn f L D where
  finiteNearby := hfinite
  differentiableAt := fun x hx => (hgradient x hx).differentiableAt
  gradientLipschitz := gradientLipschitzOfHasGradientAt _ _ _ _ hgradient hLipschitz


theorem spec (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) :
    (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x) ∧
    LipschitzOnWith L (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f)) D := by

  exact ⟨h.finiteNearby, h.differentiableAt, h.gradientLipschitz⟩


theorem mono (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D S : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) : IsSmoothOn f L S := by

  refine ⟨fun x hx => h.finiteNearby x (hSD hx),
    fun x hx => h.differentiableAt x (hSD hx), ?_⟩
  exact h.gradientLipschitz.mono hSD


theorem dualBound (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) (y : E) (hy : y ∈ D) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ := by

  calc
    ‖fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ =
        ‖InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E
          (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y)‖ := by
      rw [← toDual_gradient, ← toDual_gradient, ← map_sub]
    _ = ‖gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ := by
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ := by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using h.gradientLipschitz.dist_le_mul x hx y hy

end IsSmoothOn



def smoothOnClass (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) : Set (E → WithTop ℝ) :=
  {f | IsSmoothOn f L D}


@[simp] theorem mem_smoothOnClass (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) :
    f ∈ smoothOnClass L D ↔ IsSmoothOn f L D := by

  rfl


def smoothClass : Set (E → WithTop ℝ) :=
  {f | ∃ L : ℝ≥0, IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ}


@[simp] theorem mem_smoothClass (f : E → WithTop ℝ) :
    f ∈ smoothClass ↔ ∃ L : ℝ≥0, IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ := by

  rfl

end WithTop

private lemma normUnitHeightPair {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (x : E) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 : ℝ), x)‖ = Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by

  simp only [WithLp.prod_norm_eq_of_L2, WithLp.toLp_fst, WithLp.toLp_snd,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, one_pow]


private lemma unitHeightDistanceDecomposition {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hx : a ^ 2 = 1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) (hy : b ^ 2 = 1 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 = (a - b) ^ 2 +
      (a * b) * ((a⁻¹ - b⁻¹) ^ 2 + ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ^ 2) := by


  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 - 1 := by linarith
  have hynorm : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = b ^ 2 - 1 := by linarith
  simp only [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  rw [hxnorm, hynorm]
  field_simp [ha, hb]
  ring


private lemma normRadialSubLe {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hx : a ^ 2 = 1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) (hy : b ^ 2 = 1 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by

  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one ha)
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb)
  have hab : 1 ≤ a * b := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le ha hb
  refine (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
  calc
    ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (a * b) * ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ^ 2 :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg _) hab
    _ ≤ (a * b) * ((a⁻¹ - b⁻¹) ^ 2 + ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _))
        (le_trans zero_le_one hab)
    _ ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 +
        (a * b) * ((a⁻¹ - b⁻¹) ^ 2 + ‖a⁻¹ • x - b⁻¹ • y‖ ^ 2) :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := (unitHeightDistanceDecomposition x y a b ha0 hb0 hx hy).symm


private lemma lipschitzWithSqrtNormalized {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun x : E ↦ (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ • x) := by

  have hscale (z : E) : (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg zero_le_one (sq_nonneg _))
  have hlower (z : E) : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith [hscale z, Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2), sq_nonneg ‖z‖]
  refine LipschitzWith.mk_one (fun x y ↦ ?_)
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using normRadialSubLe x y
    (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2)) (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖y‖ ^ 2))
    (hlower x) (hlower y) (hscale x) (hscale y)

    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E ↦ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2)) := by

  let A : E →ᵃ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (ℝ × E) :=
    (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (ℝ × E)).symm.toAffineMap.comp
      ((AffineMap.const ℝ E (1 : ℝ)).prod (AffineMap.id ℝ E))
  have hA (x : E) : A x = WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 : ℝ), x) := rfl
  simpa only [Set.preimage_univ, Function.comp_def, hA, normUnitHeightPair] using
    (convexOn_univ_norm (E := WithLp 2 (ℝ × E))).comp_affineMap A




theorem sqrtOneAddNormSqSmooth (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    WithTop.IsSmoothOn (fun x : E ↦ (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) : WithTop ℝ))

  refine WithTop.IsSmoothOn.ofGradient _ _ _
    (fun x : E ↦ (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ • x) ?_ ?_

  · intro x _

  · intro x _
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, WithTop.untopD_coe] using

theorem Subgroup.mem_precomp (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v)
    (τ : Perm (X → Y)) :
    τ ∈ G.precomp Y ↔ ∃ σ ∈ G, ∀ f : X → Y, τ f = f ∘ σ := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨σ, hσ, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hτ⟩
    refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_⟩
    ext f x

private lemma Equiv.Perm.apply_zpow_invariant (σ : Perm X) (f : X → Y)
    (h : f ∘ σ = f) (k : ℤ) : ∀ x, f ((σ ^ k) x) = f x := by

  have hstep (x : X) : f (σ x) = f x := congrFun h x
  refine zpow_induction_left (P := fun τ : Perm X ↦ ∀ x, f (τ x) = f x) ?_ ?_ ?_ k
  · intro x
    rfl
  · intro τ hτ x
    exact (hstep (τ x)).trans (hτ x)
  · intro τ hτ x
    calc
      f ((σ⁻¹ * τ) x) = f (σ (σ⁻¹ (τ x))) := (hstep _).symm
      _ = f (τ x) := congrArg f (σ.apply_symm_apply (τ x))
      _ = f x := hτ x



theorem Equiv.Perm.fixedPoints_precomp_iff (σ : Perm X) (f : X → Y) :
    f ∈ Function.fixedPoints (fun g : X → Y ↦ g ∘ σ) ↔

  rw [Function.mem_fixedPoints_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy

    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hxy
    exact (σ.apply_zpow_invariant f h k x).symm
  · intro h

    funext x
    exact h (σ x) x (SameCycle.refl σ x).apply_left

      SameCycle.setoid σ ≤ Setoid.ker f := by

  rw [fixedPoints_precomp_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    exact h x y hxy
  · intro h x y hxy
    exact h hxy




theorem Equiv.Perm.mk_fixedPoints_precomp (σ : Perm X) (n : ℕ)
    (hcycles : Cardinal.mk (Quotient (SameCycle.setoid σ)) = (n : Cardinal.{u})) :
    Cardinal.mk (Function.fixedPoints (fun f : X → Y ↦ f ∘ σ)) =
      Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk Y) ^ (n : Cardinal.{max u v}) := by

  let e := (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
    (σ.fixedPoints_precomp_iff_sameCycle_le_ker (Y := Y))).trans
    (Setoid.liftEquiv (SameCycle.setoid σ))
  calc
    Cardinal.mk (Function.fixedPoints (fun f : X → Y ↦ f ∘ σ)) =
        Cardinal.mk (Quotient (SameCycle.setoid σ) → Y) := Cardinal.mk_congr e

    _ = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk Y) ^ (n : Cardinal.{max u v}) := by
      rw [Cardinal.mk_arrow, hcycles, Cardinal.lift_natCast]

theorem randomWalkSum {E : Type v} [MeasurableSpace E] [AddCommMonoid E]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → E) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)

theorem randomWalkCoordinate {m : ℕ} (w : RandomWalk μ (Fin m → ℝ))

private lemma SimpleGraph.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {c v : V} {n : ℕ} (hv : G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = (n : ℕ∞) := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := G.exists_walk_of_edist_eq_coe ((G.edist_comm).trans hv)
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | @cons v w c a p =>
    have hlength : p.length = n := by simpa using hp
    have hupper : G.edist c w ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [G.edist_comm, ← hlength]
      exact p.edist_le
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmn⟩ := ENat.le_coe_iff.mp hupper
    have htriangle := G.edist_triangle (u := c) (v := w) (w := v)
    rw [hv, hm, G.edist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr a.symm] at htriangle
    have hlower : n + 1 ≤ m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast htriangle
    have heq : m = n := by omega
    exact ⟨w, a, hm.trans (congrArg Nat.cast heq)⟩


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_forwardNeighbors_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {c v : V} {n d : ℕ} (hv : G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hdegree : (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞)) :
    {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp, hdist⟩ := G.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred hv
  have hsubset : {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} ⊆
      G.neighborSet v \ {p} := by
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨hw.1, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    have hfalse : (n : ℕ∞) = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp heq, hdist] using hw.2
    have : n = n + 2 := Nat.cast_injective hfalse
    omega
  calc
    _ ≤ (G.neighborSet v \ {p}).encard := Set.encard_mono hsubset
    _ = (G.neighborSet v).encard - 1 := Set.encard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hp
    _ ≤ (d : ℕ∞) - 1 := tsub_le_tsub_right hdegree 1
    _ = ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := (ENat.coe_sub d 1).symm


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_distanceLayer_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (c : V) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞))
    (n : ℕ) : {v | G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((d * (d - 1) ^ n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  classical

  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, mul_one,
      G.edist_eq_one_iff_adj, SimpleGraph.neighborSet] using hdegree c
  | succ n ih =>
    let layer := {v | G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}
    have hfinite : layer.Finite := Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe ih
    let forward := fun v => {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}
    have hcover : {w | G.edist c w = ((n + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} ⊆
        ⋃ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, forward v := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨v, hvw, hv⟩ := G.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred hw
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨v, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, hvw.symm, hw⟩⟩
    have hsum : (∑ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, (forward v).encard) ≤
        ∑ _v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro v hv
      exact G.encard_forwardNeighbors_le (hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hv) (hdegree v)
    calc
      _ ≤ (⋃ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, forward v).encard := Set.encard_mono hcover
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, (forward v).encard :=
        Finset.set_encard_biUnion_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hsum
      _ = layer.encard * ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← hfinite.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card]
      _ ≤ ((d * (d - 1) ^ n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
        mul_le_mul_left ih _
      _ = ((d * (d - 1) ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        simp only [pow_succ, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_closedDistance_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (c : V) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞))
    (k : ℕ) : {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, G.edist_eq_zero_iff,
      Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, add_zero, Nat.cast_one]
    simp only [Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton', Set.encard_singleton, le_refl]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hsplit : {v | G.edist c v ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} =
        {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)} ∪
        {v | G.edist c v = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} := by
      ext v
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
      constructor
      · intro hv
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hmk⟩ := ENat.le_coe_iff.mp hv
        rw [hm]
        have hm' : m ≤ k ∨ m = k + 1 := by omega
        exact hm'.imp (fun h => Nat.cast_le.mpr h) (fun h => congrArg Nat.cast h)
      · rintro (hv | hv)
        · exact hv.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_succ k))
        · exact hv.le
    rw [hsplit]
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := Set.encard_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i : ℕ) : ℕ∞) +
          ((d * (d - 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
        add_le_add ih (G.encard_distanceLayer_le c hdegree k)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]


private lemma mooreSum_mul_add_two (d k : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    (1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i) * (d - 2) + 2 =
      d * (d - 1) ^ k := by

  have hbase : d - 2 + 1 = d - 1 := by omega
  have hconstant : d - 2 + 2 = d := by omega
  have hgeom := geom_sum_mul_add (d - 2) k
  rw [hbase] at hgeom
  nlinarith





theorem SimpleGraph.card_mul_lt_of_radius_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {k d : ℕ} (hradius : G.radius ≤ (k : ℕ∞))
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞)) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    ENat.card V * ((d - 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < ((d * (d - 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    rw [G.radius_eq_top_of_isEmpty] at hradius
    exact (not_le_of_gt (ENat.coe_lt_top k) hradius).elim
  | inr hnonempty =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := G.exists_eccent_eq_radius
    have hall : {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)} = Set.univ := by
      apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
      intro v
      exact G.edist_le_eccent.trans (hc ▸ hradius)
    have hcard := G.encard_closedDistance_le c hdegree k
    rw [hall, Set.encard_univ] at hcard
    have hstrict : (1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i) * (d - 2) <
        d * (d - 1) ^ k := by
      have hdtwo : 2 ≤ d := by omega
      have hidentity := mooreSum_mul_add_two d k hdtwo
      omega
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_left hcard ((d - 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
      _ < _ := by exact_mod_cast hstrict


theorem SimpleGraph.card_lt_of_radius_le {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {k d : ℕ}
    (hradius : G.radius ≤ (k : ℕ∞)) (hdegree : G.maxDegree ≤ d) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℚ) < (d : ℚ) / ((d : ℚ) - 2) * ((d : ℚ) - 1) ^ k := by

  have hneighbors : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞) := by
    intro v
    rw [← Set.coe_fintypeCard, G.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
    exact_mod_cast (G.degree_le_maxDegree v).trans hdegree
  have hbound := G.card_mul_lt_of_radius_le hradius hneighbors hd
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card, ← Nat.cast_mul] at hbound
  have hnat : Fintype.card V * (d - 2) < d * (d - 1) ^ k :=
    ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp hbound
  have htwo : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  have hone : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  have hrat : (Fintype.card V : ℚ) * ((d : ℚ) - 2) <
      (d : ℚ) * ((d : ℚ) - 1) ^ k := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hpositive : (0 : ℚ) < (d : ℚ) - 2 := by
    have hcast : (3 : ℚ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    linarith
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ hpositive]
  exact hrat

private lemma Coloring.evenLength_iff_eq {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (c : G.Coloring Bool) {v w : V} (p : G.Walk v w) :
    Even p.length ↔ c v = c w := by

  induction p with
  | nil => simp only [Walk.length_nil, Even.zero]
  | @cons v w z hadj p ih =>

    have hcolor : c v = !c w := Bool.eq_not_iff.mpr (c.valid hadj)
    rw [Walk.length_cons, Nat.even_add_one, ih,
      hcolor, Bool.not_eq_iff]



private lemma coloringSeparatesEdgesOfReachableEq {V : Type u} {F G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hFG : F ≤ G) (hReach : F.Reachable = G.Reachable)
    (hNoOdd : ∀ (v : V) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle → ¬ Odd p.length)
    (c : F.Coloring Bool) : ∀ {v w : V}, G.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w := by
  intro v w hadj hcolor

  have hpath : F.Reachable v w := by
    rw [hReach]
    exact hadj.reachable
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := hpath.exists_path_of_dist

  have hMissing : s(w, v) ∉ (p.mapLe hFG).edges := by
    rw [Walk.edges_mapLe_eq_edges]
    intro hedge
    exact c.valid (p.adj_of_mem_edges hedge) hcolor.symm
  have hcycle : (Walk.cons hadj.symm (p.mapLe hFG)).IsCycle := by
    exact (Walk.cons_isCycle_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hp.mapLe hFG, hMissing⟩


  have hEven : Even p.length := (c.evenLength_iff_eq p).mpr hcolor
  have hNotOdd : ¬ Odd p.length := Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hEven

  have hLength : (p.mapLe hFG).length = p.length := p.length_map (Hom.ofLE hFG)
  apply hNoOdd w _ hcycle
  rw [Walk.length_cons, hLength]
  exact Nat.odd_add_one.mpr hNotOdd

end SimpleGraph



theorem isBipartite_iff_no_odd_cycle {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    G.IsBipartite ↔ ∀ (v : V) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle → ¬ Odd p.length := by
  constructor
  ·
    rintro ⟨c⟩ v p _
    let cBool : G.Coloring Bool := recolorOfEquiv G finTwoEquiv c
    exact Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr ((cBool.evenLength_iff_eq p).mpr rfl)
  ·
    intro hNoOdd
    obtain ⟨F, hFG, hF, hReach⟩ := G.exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le
    let c : F.Coloring Bool := recolorOfEquiv F finTwoEquiv hF.coloringTwo
    let extended : G.Coloring Bool :=
      Coloring.mk c (coloringSeparatesEdgesOfReachableEq hFG hReach hNoOdd c)
    exact ⟨recolorOfEquiv G finTwoEquiv.symm extended⟩

private lemma bipartiteAbove_eq_neighborFinset {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (t : Finset V) (x : V)
    (h : G.neighborFinset x ⊆ t) :
    t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj x = G.neighborFinset x := by

  ext y
  simp only [Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove, mem_neighborFinset]
  exact ⟨And.right, fun hxy ↦ ⟨h ((G.mem_neighborFinset x y).mpr hxy), hxy⟩⟩


private lemma card_bipartiteBelow_le_degree {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s : Finset V) (y : V) :
    (s.bipartiteBelow G.Adj y).card ≤ G.degree y := by

  rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree y]
  refine Finset.card_le_card ?_
  intro x hx
  exact (G.mem_neighborFinset y x).mpr ((Finset.mem_bipartiteBelow G.Adj).mp hx).2.symm


private lemma card_le_card_neighborUnion_of_regular {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k) (s : Finset V) :
    s.card ≤ (s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x)).card := by

  have hCount : s.card * k ≤ (s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x)).card * k := by
    refine Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul G.Adj ?_ ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hNeighbors : G.neighborFinset x ⊆ s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x) := by
        intro y hy
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
      rw [G.bipartiteAbove_eq_neighborFinset _ x hNeighbors,
        G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hRegular.degree_eq]
    · intro y _
      exact (G.card_bipartiteBelow_le_degree s y).trans (hRegular.degree_eq y).le

  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hCount hk


private lemma ncard_le_ncard_neighborUnion_of_regular {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k)
    (s : Set V) : s.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ s, G.neighborSet x).ncard := by
  classical

  rcases s.finite_or_infinite with hs | hs
  · have hCount := G.card_le_card_neighborUnion_of_regular hk hRegular hs.toFinset
    have hUnion : (hs.toFinset.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x) : Set V) =
        ⋃ x ∈ s, G.neighborSet x := by
      simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, coe_neighborFinset, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
    rw [← hUnion, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card s hs]
    exact hCount
  · rw [hs.ncard]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem existsPerfectMatchingOfRegularBipartite {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k)
    (hBipartite : G.IsBipartite) : ∃ M : Subgraph G, M.IsPerfectMatching := by

  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, hParts⟩ := hBipartite.exists_isBipartiteWith
  exact exists_isPerfectMatching_of_forall_ncard_le hParts
    (G.ncard_le_ncard_neighborUnion_of_regular hk hRegular)

theorem strongConvex_iff_convexOn_sub {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    WithTop.StrongConvex σ f ↔
      ConvexOn ℝ {x | f x ≠ ⊤} (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0 - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by

  rw [WithTop.StrongConvex.iff_onDomain, strongConvexOn_iff_convex]
  simp only [hσ, true_and]


private lemma untopDMapOfNeTop {α β : Type*} (φ : α → β) (a₀ : α) (b₀ : β)
    (z : WithTop α) (hz : z ≠ ⊤) :
    (WithTop.map φ z).untopD b₀ = φ (z.untopD a₀) := by

  lift z to α using hz
  simp only [WithTop.map_coe, WithTop.untopD_coe]





theorem strongConvex_iff_convexOn {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    WithTop.StrongConvex σ f ↔
      (let g : E → WithTop ℝ :=
        fun x ↦ WithTop.map (fun r : ℝ ↦ r - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (f x)
       ConvexOn ℝ {x | g x ≠ ⊤} (fun x ↦ (g x).untopD 0)) := by
  let g : E → WithTop ℝ :=
    fun x ↦ WithTop.map (fun r : ℝ ↦ r - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (f x)

  have domain_eq : {x | g x ≠ ⊤} = {x | f x ≠ ⊤} := by
    ext x
    exact not_congr WithTop.map_eq_top_iff

  have finite_eq : Set.EqOn (fun x ↦ (g x).untopD 0)
      (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0 - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) {x | f x ≠ ⊤} := by
    intro x hx
    exact untopDMapOfNeTop (fun r : ℝ ↦ r - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) 0 0 (f x) hx

  rw [strongConvex_iff_convexOn_sub σ f hσ]
  dsimp only
  rw [domain_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    exact hf.congr finite_eq.symm
  · intro hg
    exact hg.congr finite_eq

def translatedRealEpigraph {E : Type*} [Add E] (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (a : ℝ) :
    Set (E × ℝ) := {p | f (x + p.1) ≤ ((a + p.2 : ℝ) : EReal)}


lemma convexTranslatedRealEpigraph {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (a : ℝ)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    Convex ℝ (translatedRealEpigraph f x a) := by

  exact hconvex.translate_preimage_right (x, a)


lemma translatedRealEpigraphProjection {E : Type*} [Add E] (f : E → EReal)
    (x : E) (a : ℝ) (hnotbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) :
    Prod.fst '' translatedRealEpigraph f x a = {y | f (x + y) < ⊤} := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨z, r⟩, hp, rfl⟩

    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hp (EReal.coe_lt_top _)
  · intro hy

    refine ⟨(y, (f (x + y)).toReal - a), ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [translatedRealEpigraph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_sub_cancel,
      EReal.coe_toReal (ne_of_lt hy) (hnotbot _), le_refl]


lemma interiorTranslatedRealEpigraphProjection {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (a : ℝ) (hnotbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥)
    (hx : x ∈ interior {z | f z < ⊤}) :
    (0 : E) ∈ interior (Prod.fst '' translatedRealEpigraph f x a) := by

  rw [translatedRealEpigraphProjection f x a hnotbot]
  have hx' : x + 0 ∈ interior {z | f z < ⊤} := by simpa only [add_zero] using hx
  exact preimage_interior_subset_interior_preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id) hx'


lemma subdifferentialNonemptyOfInterior {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (x : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hnotbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) (hx : x ∈ interior {z | f z < ⊤}) :
    (EReal.subdifferential f x).Nonempty := by
  have hxtop : f x < ⊤ := interior_subset (s := {z | f z < ⊤}) hx
  have hxval := EReal.coe_toReal hxtop.ne (hnotbot x)
  let a := (f x).toReal
  let C := translatedRealEpigraph f x a
  have hzero : (0 : E × ℝ) ∈ C := by
    simp only [C, translatedRealEpigraph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.fst_zero,
      Prod.snd_zero, add_zero, a, hxval, le_refl]
  have hvertical : ∀ r : ℝ, (0, r) ∈ C → 0 ≤ r := by
    intro r hr

    have hr' : f x ≤ ((a + r : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      simpa only [C, translatedRealEpigraph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_zero] using hr
    rw [← hxval, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hr'
    exact (le_add_iff_nonneg_right _).mp hr'
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := existsLinearMinorantOfInteriorProjection C
    (convexTranslatedRealEpigraph f x a hconvex) hzero
    (interiorTranslatedRealEpigraphProjection f x a hnotbot hx) hvertical

  let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap L)
  refine ⟨w, (EReal.mem_subdifferential f x w).mpr ?_⟩
  intro z
  by_cases hz : f z = ⊤
  · rw [hz]
    exact le_top
  · have hzval := EReal.coe_toReal hz (hnotbot z)
    have hp : (z - x, (f z).toReal - a) ∈ C := by
      simp only [C, translatedRealEpigraph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_sub_cancel,
        hzval, le_refl]
    have hbound := hL _ hp
    have hinner : inner ℝ w (z - x) = L (z - x) :=
      InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    rw [hinner, ← hxval, ← hzval, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    simpa only [add_comm] using le_sub_iff_add_le.mp hbound

end ConvexAnalysis

private lemma lowerSemicontinuousOfClosedRealEpigraph {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {f : X → WithTop ℝ}
    (hf : IsClosed {p : X × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ WithTop.some p.2}) :
    LowerSemicontinuous f := by

  refine lowerSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage.mpr ?_
  intro c
  cases c with
  | top => simpa only [Set.preimage, Set.mem_Iic, le_top, Set.setOf_true] using isClosed_univ
  | coe c => exact hf.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)


private lemma isMinOnUntopD {X : Type*} {f : X → WithTop ℝ} {a : X}
    (hmin : IsMinOn f Set.univ a) :
    IsMinOn (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0) {x | f x ≠ ⊤} a := by

  intro x hx
  exact WithTop.untopD_mono hx (hmin (Set.mem_univ x))


private lemma radialLowerBoundOfBallLowerBound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {σ : ℝ} {f : E → WithTop ℝ}
    (hf : WithTop.StrongConvex σ f) {a x : E} (ha : f a ≠ ⊤) (hx : f x ≠ ⊤)
    {m : ℝ} (hball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall a 1, (m : WithTop ℝ) ≤ f z)
    (hr : 1 ≤ ‖x - a‖) :
    σ / 2 * (‖x - a‖ - 1) ≤ max ((f a).untopD 0) ((f x).untopD 0) - m := by

  let r := ‖x - a‖
  let t := 1 / r
  have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr
  have htpos : 0 < t := one_div_pos.mpr hrpos
  have htone : t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hrpos).mpr hr
  have htcomp : 0 ≤ 1 - t := sub_nonneg.mpr htone
  have hz : AffineMap.lineMap a x t ∈ Metric.closedBall a 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_lineMap_left, dist_eq_norm,
      norm_sub_rev, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos htpos]
    exact le_of_eq (one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hrpos))
  have hlow := hball _ hz
  have hupp := hf.le hx ha ⟨le_of_lt htpos, htone⟩
  rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, add_comm] at hlow
  have hreal := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp (hlow.trans hupp)
  have havg : t * (f x).untopD 0 + (1 - t) * (f a).untopD 0 ≤
      max ((f a).untopD 0) ((f x).untopD 0) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ t * max ((f a).untopD 0) ((f x).untopD 0) +
          (1 - t) * max ((f a).untopD 0) ((f x).untopD 0) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) htpos.le)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) htcomp)
      _ = _ := by ring

  have hrad : t * (1 - t) * ‖x - a‖ ^ 2 = r - 1 := by
    dsimp [t, r]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hrpos]
  have hcor : σ / 2 * t * (1 - t) * ‖x - a‖ ^ 2 = σ / 2 * (r - 1) := by
    calc
      _ = σ / 2 * (t * (1 - t) * ‖x - a‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun z ↦ σ / 2 * z) hrad
  rw [hcor] at hreal
  linarith


private lemma isCompactRealSublevel {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [ProperSpace E] {σ : ℝ} {f : E → WithTop ℝ}
    (hproper : ∃ a, f a ≠ ⊤) (hlsc : LowerSemicontinuous f)
    (hf : WithTop.StrongConvex σ f) (c : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {x | f x ≤ (c : WithTop ℝ)} := by

  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hproper
  have hacenter : a ∈ Metric.closedBall a (1 : ℝ) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one
  obtain ⟨b, _, hbmin⟩ := LowerSemicontinuousOn.exists_isMinOn
    ⟨a, hacenter⟩ (isCompact_closedBall a 1) (hlsc.lowerSemicontinuousOn _)
  let m := (f b).untopD 0
  have hball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall a 1, (m : WithTop ℝ) ≤ f z := by
    intro z hz
    exact (WithTop.coe_untopD_le _ _).trans (hbmin hz)
  let B := max ((f a).untopD 0) c
  let R := 1 + 2 * (B - m) / σ
  have hma : m ≤ (f a).untopD 0 :=
    WithTop.untopD_mono ha (hbmin hacenter)
  have hBm : 0 ≤ B - m := sub_nonneg.mpr (hma.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := zero_le_two
  have hR : 1 ≤ R := le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg htwo hBm)
    hf.modulus_pos.le)

  have hsubset : {x | f x ≤ (c : WithTop ℝ)} ⊆ Metric.closedBall a R := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
    by_cases hr : 1 ≤ ‖x - a‖
    · have hxfinite : f x ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top WithTop.coe_ne_top hx
      have hxc : (f x).untopD 0 ≤ c := WithTop.untopD_le hx
      have hrad := radialLowerBoundOfBallLowerBound hf ha hxfinite hball hr
      have hmax : max ((f a).untopD 0) ((f x).untopD 0) ≤ B :=
        max_le_max le_rfl hxc
      have hbound : (‖x - a‖ - 1) * σ ≤ 2 * (B - m) := by linarith
      have hdiv := (le_div_iff₀ hf.modulus_pos).mpr hbound
      dsimp [R]
      linarith
    · exact (le_of_not_ge hr).trans hR
  exact Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (hlsc.isClosed_preimage c)
    ((Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall a).mpr ⟨R, hsubset⟩)


private lemma strongConvexQuadraticLowerBound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {s : Set E} {g : E → ℝ} {σ : ℝ}
    (hf : StrongConvexOn s σ g) {a x : E} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hmin : IsMinOn g s a) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    σ / 2 * ‖x - a‖ ^ 2 ≤ g x - g a := by

  let A := σ / 2 * ‖x - a‖ ^ 2
  let d := g x - g a
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin hx)
  have hinterp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 → (1 - t) * A ≤ d := by
    intro t ht htone
    have hcomp : 0 ≤ 1 - t := sub_nonneg.mpr htone.le
    have hsum : t + (1 - t) = 1 := by ring
    have hz := convex_iff_add_mem.mp hf.1 hx ha ht.le hcomp hsum
    have hineq := (hmin hz).trans (hf.2 hx ha ht.le hcomp hsum)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hineq
    have hmul : t * ((1 - t) * A) ≤ t * d := by
      dsimp [A, d]
      nlinarith only [hineq]
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ ht).mp hmul

  by_contra h
  have hgap : d < A := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hA : 0 < A := lt_of_le_of_lt hd hgap
  let t := (A - d) / (2 * A)
  have hden : 0 < 2 * A := mul_pos two_pos hA
  have ht : 0 < t := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgap) hden
  have hnum : A - d < 2 * A := by linarith
  have htone : t < 1 := (div_lt_one hden).mpr hnum
  have hineq := hinterp t ht htone
  have hcancel : t * (2 * A) = A - d := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  nlinarith only [hineq, hcancel, hgap]





theorem existsUniqueMinimizer {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (hproper : ∃ x, f x ≠ ⊤)
    (hclosed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ WithTop.some p.2})
    (hstrong : WithTop.StrongConvex σ f) :
    ∃! xStar : E, f xStar ≠ ⊤ ∧ IsMinOn f Set.univ xStar := by

  have hlsc := lowerSemicontinuousOfClosedRealEpigraph hclosed
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hproper
  have hac : f a ≤ WithTop.some ((f a).untopD 0) :=
    (WithTop.untopD_le_iff ha).mp le_rfl
  obtain ⟨xStar, hxlevel, hxmin⟩ := LowerSemicontinuousOn.exists_isMinOn
    ⟨a, hac⟩ (isCompactRealSublevel ⟨a, ha⟩ hlsc hstrong ((f a).untopD 0))
    (hlsc.lowerSemicontinuousOn _)
  have hxStar : f xStar ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top WithTop.coe_ne_top hxlevel
  have hglobal : IsMinOn f Set.univ xStar := by
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : f x ≤ WithTop.some ((f a).untopD 0)
    · exact hxmin hx
    · exact hxlevel.trans (le_of_not_ge hx)

  refine ⟨xStar, ⟨hxStar, hglobal⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact (hstrong.onDomain.strictConvexOn hstrong.modulus_pos).eq_of_isMinOn
    (isMinOnUntopD hy.2) (isMinOnUntopD hglobal) hy.1 hxStar




theorem quadraticGrowth {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (σ : ℝ) (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (hproper : ∃ x, f x ≠ ⊤)
    (hclosed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ WithTop.some p.2})
    (hstrong : WithTop.StrongConvex σ f)
    (xStar : E) (hxStar : f xStar ≠ ⊤) (hmin : IsMinOn f Set.univ xStar)
    (x : E) (hx : f x ≠ ⊤) :
    σ / 2 * ‖x - xStar‖ ^ 2 ≤ (f x).untopD 0 - (f xStar).untopD 0 := by

  exact strongConvexQuadraticLowerBound hstrong.onDomain hxStar
    (isMinOnUntopD hmin) hx

private lemma effectiveDomainAdd {X : Type*} (f g : X → WithTop ℝ) :
    {x | (f + g) x ≠ ⊤} = {x | f x ≠ ⊤} ∩ {x | g x ≠ ⊤} := by

  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Pi.add_apply, WithTop.add_ne_top]


private lemma finitePartAddOnDomain {X : Type*} (f g : X → WithTop ℝ) :
    Set.EqOn (fun x ↦ ((f + g) x).untopD 0)
      (fun x ↦ (f x).untopD 0 + (g x).untopD 0)
      ({x | f x ≠ ⊤} ∩ {x | g x ≠ ⊤}) := by

  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hx.1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hx.2
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, ← ha, ← hb, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.untopD_coe]


private lemma strongConvexOnAddConvexOnInter {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {s t : Set E} {m : ℝ} {F G : E → ℝ}
    (hf : StrongConvexOn s m F) (hg : ConvexOn ℝ t G) :
    StrongConvexOn (s ∩ t) m (F + G) := by

  have hst : Convex ℝ (s ∩ t) := hf.1.inter hg.1
  have hF := (strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mp hf).subset Set.inter_subset_left hst
  have hG := hg.subset Set.inter_subset_right hst

  apply strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mpr
  refine (hF.add hG).congr ?_
  intro x _
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  ring




theorem strongConvexAddConvex {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {σ : ℝ} {f g : E → WithTop ℝ} (hf : WithTop.StrongConvex σ f)
    (hg : ConvexOn ℝ {x | g x ≠ ⊤} (fun x ↦ (g x).untopD 0)) :
    WithTop.StrongConvex σ (f + g) := by

  refine WithTop.StrongConvex.ofStrongConvexOn hf.modulus_pos ?_
  rw [effectiveDomainAdd]

  apply strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mpr
  refine (strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mp
    (strongConvexOnAddConvexOnInter hf.onDomain hg)).congr ?_
  intro x hx
  exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ ↦ r - σ / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (finitePartAddOnDomain f g hx).symm

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
variable {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]



structure OrthonormalRepresentation (G : SimpleGraph V) (E : Type v) [Fintype V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] where

  toFun : V → E

  norm_eq_one (i : V) : ‖toFun i‖ = 1

  inner_eq_zero (i j : V) (h : Gᶜ.Adj i j) : inner ℝ (toFun i) (toFun j) = 0

namespace OrthonormalRepresentation

variable {G : SimpleGraph V}


theorem spec (r : G.OrthonormalRepresentation E) :
    (∀ i, ‖r.toFun i‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, ¬(G.Adj i j ∨ i = j) → inner ℝ (r.toFun i) (r.toFun j) = 0) := by

  constructor
  · exact r.norm_eq_one
  · intro i j h
    exact r.inner_eq_zero i j
      ((G.compl_adj i j).mpr ⟨(not_or.mp h).2, (not_or.mp h).1⟩)


@[ext]
theorem ext {r s : G.OrthonormalRepresentation E}
    (h : ∀ i, r.toFun i = s.toFun i) : r = s := by

  cases r with
  | mk r rnorm rinner =>
    cases s with
    | mk s snorm sinner =>
      have vectors : r = s := funext h
      cases vectors
      rfl


noncomputable def standard (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    G.OrthonormalRepresentation (EuclideanSpace ℝ V) :=
  { toFun := fun i ↦ EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ i

    norm_eq_one := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ).orthonormal.norm_eq_one
    inner_eq_zero := fun i j h ↦
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ).orthonormal.inner_eq_zero
        ((G.compl_adj i j).mp h).1 }


theorem standard_toFun (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : V) :
    (standard G).toFun i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ i := by

  rfl


theorem standard_orthonormal (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (standard G).toFun := by

  have vectors : (standard G).toFun =
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ : V → EuclideanSpace ℝ V) :=
    funext (standard_toFun G)
  rw [vectors]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun V ℝ).orthonormal

end OrthonormalRepresentation

end SimpleGraph

def HasRightLineDerivAt (f : E → EReal) (d : EReal) (x y : E) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 d)



noncomputable def rightLineDeriv (f : E → EReal) (x y : E) : EReal :=
  Filter.limUnder (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal))

variable {f : E → EReal} {d e : EReal} {x y : E}


theorem HasRightLineDerivAt.unique (h : HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y)
    (h' : HasRightLineDerivAt f e x y) : d = e := by

  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h h'


theorem HasRightLineDerivAt.rightLineDeriv (h : HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y) :
    EReal.rightLineDeriv f x y = d := by

  apply tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_nhds_limUnder ⟨d, h⟩) h



theorem rightLineDeriv_spec (h : ∃ d, HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y) :
    HasRightLineDerivAt f (rightLineDeriv f x y) x y := by

  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h
  exact tendsto_nhds_limUnder ⟨d, hd⟩

end Module

section NormedSpace

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]



theorem hasRightLineDerivAt_congr {f g : E → EReal} {d : EReal} {x y : E}
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) :
    HasRightLineDerivAt f d x y ↔ HasRightLineDerivAt g d x y := by

  have hline : (fun t : ℝ ↦ f (x + t • y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (x + t • y)) := by
    have hpath : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ x + t • y) 0 := by fun_prop

    have hlimit : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ x + t • y) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 x) := by
      simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hpath.tendsto
    exact hfg.comp_tendsto hlimit
  have hbase : f x = g x := hfg.eq_of_nhds
  have hquot : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • y) - f x) / (t : EReal)) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ (g (x + t • y) - g x) / (t : EReal)) := by
    filter_upwards [hline.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t ht
    rw [ht, hbase]

  constructor
  · intro hf
    exact (tendsto_congr' hquot).mp hf
  · intro hg
    exact (tendsto_congr' hquot).mpr hg

end NormedSpace

end EReal



theorem HasLineDerivAt.erealRight {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {g : E → ℝ} {a : ℝ} {x y : E} (h : HasLineDerivAt ℝ g a x y) :
    EReal.HasRightLineDerivAt (fun z ↦ (g z : EReal)) (a : EReal) x y := by

  have hslope : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ • (g (x + t • y) - g x)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 a) :=
    h.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hcoerced : Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ ((t⁻¹ • (g (x + t • y) - g x) : ℝ) : EReal))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (a : EReal)) := EReal.tendsto_coe.mpr hslope
  have hrealquot (t : ℝ) : t⁻¹ • (g (x + t • y) - g x) =
      (g (x + t • y) - g x) / t := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  apply hcoerced.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with t
  rw [hrealquot t, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_div]

private lemma memSetIndicatorSubdifferentialIff (s : Set E) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ subdifferential (fun y ↦ if y ∈ s then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x ↔
      x ∈ s ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ 0 := by

  rw [mem_subdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : x ∈ s := by
      by_contra hx
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hs
      have hzineq := h z
      simp only [if_neg hx, if_pos hz, top_add_coe, top_le_iff] at hzineq
      exact zero_ne_top hzineq
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    have hzineq := h z
    simpa only [if_pos hx, if_pos hz, zero_add, EReal.coe_nonpos] using hzineq
  · rintro ⟨hx, h⟩ z

    by_cases hz : z ∈ s
    · simpa only [if_pos hx, if_pos hz, zero_add, EReal.coe_nonpos] using h z hz
    · simp only [if_pos hx, if_neg hz, le_top]


private lemma memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (hzero : (0 : E) ∈ K) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ subdifferential (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x ↔
      x ∈ K ∧ (∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0) ∧ inner ℝ x v = 0 := by

  have hnormal := memSetIndicatorSubdifferentialIff (K : Set E) ⟨0, hzero⟩ x v
  constructor
  · intro hsub
    obtain ⟨hx, h⟩ := hnormal.mp hsub

    have hzeroineq := h 0 hzero
    have hdoubleineq := h (x + x) (K.add_mem hx hx)
    simp only [zero_sub, inner_neg_right] at hzeroineq
    rw [inner_sub_right, inner_add_right] at hdoubleineq
    have hvx : inner ℝ v x = 0 := by
      linarith
    refine ⟨hx, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      have hzineq := h z hz
      rwa [inner_sub_right, hvx, sub_zero, real_inner_comm] at hzineq
    · rwa [real_inner_comm]
  · rintro ⟨hx, hpolar, horth⟩
    refine hnormal.mpr ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    intro z hz

    rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_comm z v, real_inner_comm x v, horth, sub_zero]
    exact hpolar z hz


private lemma innerDualNegSet (s : Set E) :
    (ProperCone.innerDual (-s) : Set E) = {v : E | ∀ z ∈ s, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0} := by

  ext v
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [ProperCone.mem_innerDual]
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    have hneg := h (Set.neg_mem_neg.mpr hz)
    simpa only [inner_neg_left, neg_nonneg] using hneg
  · intro h z hz

    have hneg := h (-z) (Set.mem_neg.mp hz)
    simpa only [inner_neg_left, neg_nonpos] using hneg


private lemma nonpositiveBipolarMembershipIff (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x : E) :
    (∀ v ∈ {w : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z w ≤ 0}, inner ℝ v x ≤ 0) ↔ x ∈ K := by

  lift K to ProperCone ℝ E using ⟨h_nonempty, h_closed⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdouble : x ∈ ProperCone.innerDual (ProperCone.innerDual (K : Set E) : Set E) := by
      rw [ProperCone.mem_innerDual]
      intro v hv
      have hpolar : -v ∈ {w : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z w ≤ 0} := by
        intro z hz
        have hzineq := ProperCone.mem_innerDual.mp hv hz
        simpa only [inner_neg_right, neg_nonpos] using hzineq
      have hneg := h (-v) hpolar
      simpa only [inner_neg_left, neg_nonpos] using hneg
    rwa [ProperCone.innerDual_innerDual] at hdouble
  · intro hx v hv

    simpa only [real_inner_comm] using hv x hx




theorem indicator_subdiff_polar_iff (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x xstar : E) :
    xstar ∈ subdifferential (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x ↔
      x ∈ subdifferential
        (fun y ↦ if y ∈ {v : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0} then (0 : EReal) else ⊤)
        xstar := by

  have hzero := ConvexCone.Pointed.of_nonempty_of_isClosed h_nonempty h_closed
  let D := ProperCone.innerDual (-(K : Set E))
  have hcarrier : ((D : ConvexCone ℝ E) : Set E) =
      {v : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0} := innerDualNegSet (K : Set E)

  have hdual :
      x ∈ subdifferential
        (fun y ↦ if y ∈ ((D : ConvexCone ℝ E) : Set E) then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) xstar ↔
      xstar ∈ ((D : ConvexCone ℝ E) : Set E) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ ((D : ConvexCone ℝ E) : Set E), inner ℝ z x ≤ 0) ∧
        inner ℝ xstar x = 0 :=
    memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff (D : ConvexCone ℝ E)
      D.pointed_toConvexCone xstar x
  rw [hcarrier, nonpositiveBipolarMembershipIff K h_nonempty h_closed] at hdual
  have hprimal := memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff K hzero x xstar

  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hx, hp, ho⟩ := hprimal.mp h
    exact hdual.mpr ⟨hp, hx, (real_inner_comm x xstar).trans ho⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hp, hx, ho⟩ := hdual.mp h
    exact hprimal.mpr ⟨hx, hp, (real_inner_comm xstar x).trans ho⟩



theorem indicator_subdiff_mem_cone (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x xstar : E)
    (h_subdiff : xstar ∈ subdifferential
      (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x) :
    x ∈ K := by

  exact ((memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff K
    (ConvexCone.Pointed.of_nonempty_of_isClosed h_nonempty h_closed) x xstar).mp h_subdiff).1



theorem indicator_subdiff_mem_polar (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x xstar : E)
    (h_subdiff : xstar ∈ subdifferential
      (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x) :
    xstar ∈ {v : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0} := by

  exact ((memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff K
    (ConvexCone.Pointed.of_nonempty_of_isClosed h_nonempty h_closed) x xstar).mp h_subdiff).2.1



theorem indicator_subdiff_inner (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x xstar : E)
    (h_subdiff : xstar ∈ subdifferential
      (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x) :
    inner ℝ x xstar = 0 := by

  exact ((memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff K
    (ConvexCone.Pointed.of_nonempty_of_isClosed h_nonempty h_closed) x xstar).mp h_subdiff).2.2




theorem mem_indicator_subdiff (K : ConvexCone ℝ E)
    (h_nonempty : (K : Set E).Nonempty) (h_closed : IsClosed (K : Set E)) (x xstar : E)
    (hx : x ∈ K) (h_polar : xstar ∈ {v : E | ∀ z ∈ K, inner ℝ z v ≤ 0})
    (h_inner : inner ℝ x xstar = 0) :
    xstar ∈ subdifferential (fun y ↦ if y ∈ K then (0 : EReal) else ⊤) x := by

  exact (memConeIndicatorSubdifferentialIff K
    (ConvexCone.Pointed.of_nonempty_of_isClosed h_nonempty h_closed) x xstar).mpr ⟨hx, h_polar, h_inner⟩

lemma convexHullInterLevelSet {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (S : Set E) (l : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ a ∈ S, l a ≤ m) :
    convexHull ℝ S ∩ {v | l v = m} = convexHull ℝ (S ∩ {a | l a = m}) := by

  let H := convexHull ℝ (S ∩ {a | l a = m})
  have hinvariant : Convex ℝ {v | l v ≤ m ∧ (l v = m → v ∈ H)} := by
    intro a ha b hb r s hr hs hrs
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hlevel : r * m + s * m = m := by rw [← add_mul, hrs, one_mul]
    have hle : r * l a + s * l b ≤ m := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.1),
        mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.1)]
    refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
    intro heq

    by_cases hrzero : r = 0
    · have hsone : s = 1 := by linarith
      have hbcontact : l b = m := by simpa only [hrzero, hsone, zero_mul, zero_add, one_mul] using heq
      simpa only [hrzero, hsone, zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul] using hb.2 hbcontact
    by_cases hszero : s = 0
    · have hrone : r = 1 := by linarith
      have hacontact : l a = m := by simpa only [hszero, hrone, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul] using heq
      simpa only [hszero, hrone, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul] using ha.2 hacontact
    have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr (Ne.symm hrzero)
    have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs (Ne.symm hszero)
    have hacontact : l a = m := by
      nlinarith [ha.1, mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.1)]
    have hbcontact : l b = m := by
      nlinarith [hb.1, mul_nonneg hr (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.1)]
    exact (convex_convexHull ℝ _) (ha.2 hacontact) (hb.2 hbcontact) hr hs hrs
  have hpropagate : convexHull ℝ S ⊆ {v | l v ≤ m ∧ (l v = m → v ∈ H)} :=
    convexHull_min (fun a ha ↦ ⟨hbound a ha,
      fun heq ↦ subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨ha, heq⟩⟩) hinvariant
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    exact (hpropagate hv.1).2 hv.2
  ·
    refine convexHull_min ?_ ((convex_convexHull ℝ S).inter
      (convex_hyperplane l.isLinear m))
    intro a ha
    exact ⟨subset_convexHull ℝ S ha.1, ha.2⟩

open DihedralGroup


def DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm : DihedralGroup 4 → Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4)
  | r i => Equiv.addLeft i
  | sr i => Equiv.subLeft (-i)


lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm_one :
    squareVertexPerm (1 : DihedralGroup 4) = 1 := by

  ext x
  simp only [one_def, squareVertexPerm, Equiv.coe_addLeft, zero_add,
    Equiv.Perm.one_apply]


lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm_mul (g h : DihedralGroup 4) :
    squareVertexPerm (g * h) = squareVertexPerm g * squareVertexPerm h := by

  cases g
  all_goals cases h
  all_goals
    ext x
    simp only [r_mul_r, r_mul_sr, sr_mul_r, sr_mul_sr, squareVertexPerm,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.coe_addLeft, Equiv.subLeft_apply]
    ring



def DihedralGroup.squarePerm : DihedralGroup 4 →* Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) where

  toFun := squareVertexPerm
  map_one' := squareVertexPerm_one
  map_mul' := squareVertexPerm_mul


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_r_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (r i) x = i + x := by

  rfl


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_sr_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (sr i) x = -i - x := by

  rfl



theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_injective : Function.Injective squarePerm := by

  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_one squarePerm).2 ?_
  intro g hg
  have hzero := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 0) hg
  cases g with
  | r i =>
    have hi : i = 0 := by
      simpa only [squarePerm_r_apply, add_zero, Equiv.Perm.one_apply] using hzero
    rw [hi, r_zero]
  | sr i =>
    have hi : i = 0 := by
      simpa only [squarePerm_sr_apply, sub_zero, Equiv.Perm.one_apply,
        neg_eq_zero] using hzero

    have hone := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 1) hg
    rw [squarePerm_sr_apply, hi] at hone
    have hne : (-1 : ZMod 4) ≠ 1 := by
      decide
    exact (hne hone).elim


private lemma DihedralGroup.squarePerm_rotationImages :
    squarePerm (r 0) = 1 ∧
    squarePerm (r 1) = ([0, 1, 2, 3] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm ∧
    squarePerm (r 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3 ∧
    squarePerm (r 3) = ([0, 3, 2, 1] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm := by

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    ext x
    fin_cases x
    all_goals
      simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, List.formPerm_cons_cons,
        List.formPerm_singleton, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.one_apply,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def]
      decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squarePerm_reflectionImages :
    squarePerm (sr 0) = Equiv.swap 1 3 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 1) = Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 3) = Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3 := by

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    ext x
    fin_cases x
    all_goals
      simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
      decide



theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_range :
    Set.range squarePerm =
      {1, Equiv.swap 0 2, Equiv.swap 1 3,
        ([0, 3, 2, 1] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm,
        ([0, 1, 2, 3] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm,
        Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3,
        Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2,
        Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3} := by

  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := squarePerm_rotationImages
  obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hs2, hs3⟩ := squarePerm_reflectionImages
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    cases g with
    | r i =>
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inl hr0
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hr1))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hr2))))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hr3)))
    | sr i =>
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs0))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs1))))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hs2)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs3)))))
  · intro hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp
    · exact ⟨r 0, hr0.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 2, hs2.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 0, hs0.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 3, hr3.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 1, hr1.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 3, hs3.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 1, hs1.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 2, hr2.trans hp.symm⟩



instance DihedralGroup.squareAction : MulAction (DihedralGroup 4) (ZMod 4) :=
  MulAction.compHom (ZMod 4) squarePerm


theorem DihedralGroup.squareAction_smul (g : DihedralGroup 4) (x : ZMod 4) :
    g • x = squarePerm g x := by

  rfl



theorem DihedralGroup.squareHalfTurn :
    squarePerm (r 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3 := by

  exact squarePerm_rotationImages.2.2.1


theorem DihedralGroup.squareHalfTurn_apply (x : ZMod 4) :
    (r 2 : DihedralGroup 4) • x = x + 2 := by

  rw [squareAction_smul, squarePerm_r_apply, add_comm]

private lemma innerLeSupportFunction (C : Set E) {y : E} (hy : y ∈ C) (z : E) :
    (inner ℝ y z : EReal) ≤ supportFunction C z := by

  exact le_sSup (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun y : E ↦ (inner ℝ y z : EReal)) hy)


private lemma supportFunctionZero (C : Set E) (hC : C.Nonempty) :
    supportFunction C 0 = 0 := by

  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hC
  refine le_antisymm ((supportFunction_le_iff C 0 0).2 ?_) ?_
  · intro z _
    simp only [inner_zero_right, coe_zero, le_refl]
  · simpa only [inner_zero_right, coe_zero] using innerLeSupportFunction C hy 0


private lemma supportFunctionAddLe (C : Set E) (a z : E) :
    supportFunction C (a + z) ≤ supportFunction C a + supportFunction C z := by

  refine (supportFunction_le_iff C (a + z) _).2 ?_
  intro y hy
  simpa only [inner_add_right, coe_add] using
    add_le_add (innerLeSupportFunction C hy a) (innerLeSupportFunction C hy z)


private lemma supportSubgradientIff (C : Set E) (hC : C.Nonempty) (a x : E) :
    x ∈ subdifferential (supportFunction C) a ↔
      supportFunction C a = (inner ℝ x a : EReal) ∧
        ∀ z : E, (inner ℝ x z : EReal) ≤ supportFunction C z := by
  rw [mem_subdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro h

    have hzero : supportFunction C a + ((-inner ℝ x a : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa only [zero_sub, inner_neg_right, supportFunctionZero C hC] using h 0
    have hupper : supportFunction C a ≤ (inner ℝ x a : EReal) := by
      apply (addLECancellable_coe (-inner ℝ x a)).add_le_add_iff_right.mp
      simpa only [← coe_add, add_neg_cancel, coe_zero] using hzero
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hC
    have htop : supportFunction C a ≠ ⊤ :=
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (coe_ne_top _) hupper
    have hbot : supportFunction C a ≠ ⊥ :=
      ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot (coe_ne_bot _) (innerLeSupportFunction C hy a)
    have hfinite := coe_toReal htop hbot

    have hdom (z : E) : (inner ℝ x z : EReal) ≤ supportFunction C z := by
      apply (addLECancellable_coe (supportFunction C a).toReal).add_le_add_iff_left.mp
      rw [hfinite]
      calc
        supportFunction C a + (inner ℝ x z : EReal) ≤ supportFunction C (a + z) := by
          simpa only [_root_.add_sub_cancel_left] using h (a + z)
        _ ≤ supportFunction C a + supportFunction C z := supportFunctionAddLe C a z
    exact ⟨le_antisymm hupper (hdom a), hdom⟩
  · rintro ⟨heq, hdom⟩ z

    have hinner : inner ℝ x a + inner ℝ x (z - a) = inner ℝ x z := by
      rw [inner_sub_right]
      exact add_sub_cancel _ _
    rw [heq, ← coe_add, hinner]
    exact hdom z


private lemma memOfInnerLeSupportFunction [CompleteSpace E] (C : Set E)
    (hclosed : IsClosed C) (hconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : E)
    (hdom : ∀ z : E, (inner ℝ x z : EReal) ≤ supportFunction C z) : x ∈ C := by

  by_contra hx
  obtain ⟨f, b, hsep, hxb⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point hconvex hclosed hx
  let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm f
  have hrepr (y : E) : inner ℝ y w = f y := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply

  have hbound : supportFunction C w ≤ (b : EReal) := by
    refine (supportFunction_le_iff C w _).2 ?_
    intro y hy
    rw [hrepr]
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe (hsep y hy).le
  have hle : f x ≤ b := by
    have hle := (hdom w).trans hbound
    rw [hrepr] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
  exact (not_le_of_gt hxb) hle

end EReal




theorem mem_subdifferential_supportFunction_iff
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (C : Set E) (hC : C.Nonempty) (hclosed : IsClosed C) (hconvex : Convex ℝ C)

    x ∈ EReal.subdifferential (EReal.supportFunction C) xStar ↔

  rw [EReal.supportSubgradientIff C hC]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨heq, hdom⟩
    have hx := EReal.memOfInnerLeSupportFunction C hclosed hconvex x hdom
    refine ⟨hx, isMaxOn_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hle := EReal.innerLeSupportFunction C hy xStar
    rw [heq] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
  · rintro ⟨hx, hmax⟩

    exact ⟨EReal.supportFunction_eq_of_isMaxOn C xStar x hx hmax,
      EReal.innerLeSupportFunction C hx⟩

def convexDirectionalDeriv (f : E → EReal) (x d : E) : EReal :=
  ⨅ t : {t : ℝ // 0 < t}, (f (x + t.val • d) - f x) / (t.val : EReal)


private lemma subDivReal_le_coe_iff (a : EReal) (r t c : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (a - (r : EReal)) / (t : EReal) ≤ (c : EReal) ↔
      a ≤ ((r + t * c : ℝ) : EReal) := by

  rw [div_le_iff_le_mul (EReal.coe_pos.mpr ht) (coe_ne_top t),
    sub_le_iff_le_add (.inl (coe_ne_bot r)) (.inl (coe_ne_top r)),
    ← coe_mul, ← coe_add, add_comm (t * c) r]



private lemma epigraphRayBound (f : E → EReal) (x d : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (r c s t : ℝ) (hx : f x ≤ (r : EReal)) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hb : f (x + t • d) ≤ ((r + t * c : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    f (x + s • d) ≤ ((r + s * c : ℝ) : EReal) := by

  have hratio : s / t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one₀ ht).mpr hst
  have hweights : 1 - s / t + s / t = 1 := _root_.sub_add_cancel 1 (s / t)
  have hpoint := hconvex (x := (x, r)) (y := (x + t • d, r + t * c)) hx hb (_root_.sub_nonneg.mpr hratio)
    (_root_.div_nonneg hs ht.le) hweights

  have hvector : (1 - s / t) • x + (s / t) • (x + t • d) = x + s • d := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, ← add_assoc, ← add_smul, hweights, one_smul,
      div_mul_cancel₀ s ht.ne']
  have hheight : (1 - s / t) * r + (s / t) * (r + t * c) = r + s * c := by
    calc
      (1 - s / t) * r + (s / t) * (r + t * c) = r + (s / t * t) * c := by
        ring
      _ = r + s * c := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ s ht.ne']
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add,
    Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul, hvector, hheight] using hpoint



private lemma positiveSecantMonotone (f : E → EReal) (x d : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • d) - f x) / (t : EReal)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hfinite
  intro s hs t ht hst
  rw [hr]

  refine le_of_forall_lt_iff_le.mp ?_
  intro c hc
  rw [subDivReal_le_coe_iff _ _ _ _ hs]
  have hb := (subDivReal_le_coe_iff (f (x + t • d)) r t c ht).mp hc.le
  exact epigraphRayBound f x d hconvex r c s t (le_of_eq hr) hs.le hst ht hb



theorem tendsto_convexDirectionalDeriv (f : E → EReal) (x d : E)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : E × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hfinite : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (f (x + t • d) - f x) / (t : EReal))
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (convexDirectionalDeriv f x d)) := by

  have hlimit := (positiveSecantMonotone f x d hconvex hfinite).tendsto_nhdsGT
    (OrderBot.bddBelow _)
  rw [sInf_image'] at hlimit
  exact hlimit




def supportFunction (s : Set E) (d : E) : EReal :=
  ⨆ v ∈ s, (inner ℝ v d : EReal)



theorem supportFunction_le_iff (s : Set E) (d : E) (c : EReal) :
    supportFunction s d ≤ c ↔ ∀ v ∈ s, (inner ℝ v d : EReal) ≤ c := by

  simp only [supportFunction, iSup_le_iff]

theorem subgradient_iff_supportsEpigraph (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (r : ℝ) (hfinite : f x = (r : EReal)) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      (let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun z ↦ r + inner ℝ v (z - x)
       h x = r ∧ ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),

  have coe_le_iff_forall_real_le (a : ℝ) (q : EReal) :
      (a : EReal) ≤ q ↔ ∀ t : ℝ, q ≤ (t : EReal) → a ≤ t := by
    cases q with
    | bot =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp at h
      · intro h
        have h' := h (a - 1) (by simp)
        linarith
    | coe b =>

      constructor
      · intro hab t hbt
        exact hab.trans hbt
      · intro h
        exact h b le_rfl

      simp

    · simp
    · intro z t hzt

      have hz' : ((r + inner ℝ v (z - x) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f z := by
        simpa [hfinite, ← EReal.coe_add] using hz
      exact (coe_le_iff_forall_real_le _ _).mp hz' t hzt
  · rintro ⟨_, hsupport⟩ z
    have hz : ((r + inner ℝ v (z - x) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f z :=

theorem isClosed_subdifferential (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    IsClosed (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by

  have constraintClosed (a b : EReal) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      IsClosed {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | a + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ b} := by
    cases a with
    | bot => simp
    | coe r =>
      cases b with
      | bot => simp
      | coe s =>
        have hset :
            {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | (r : EReal) + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ (s : EReal)} =
              {v | inner ℝ v w ≤ s - r} := by
          ext v
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
          constructor
          · intro hv
            linarith
          · intro hv
            linarith
        rw [hset]
        have hcontinuous : Continuous fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => inner ℝ v w := by
          simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply]
          exact continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i hi =>
            (PiLp.continuous_apply (p := 2) (β := fun _ : Fin n => ℝ) i).mul
              continuous_const
        exact isClosed_Iic.preimage hcontinuous
      | top => simp
    | top =>
      cases b with
      | bot => simp
      | coe s => simp
      | top => simp

  rw [EReal.subdifferential]
  have hset :
      {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ∀ z, f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} =
        ⋂ z, {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) |
          f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun z => constraintClosed (f x) (f z) (z - x)



theorem convex_subdifferential (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    Convex ℝ (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by

  have constraintConvex (a b : EReal) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      Convex ℝ {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | a + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ b} := by
    cases a with
    | bot =>
      simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
    | coe r =>
      cases b with
      | bot =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | coe s =>
        have hset :
            {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | (r : EReal) + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ (s : EReal)} =
              {v | inner ℝ v w ≤ s - r} := by
          ext v
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
          constructor
          · intro hv
            linarith
          · intro hv
            linarith
        rw [hset]
        have hlinear : IsLinearMap ℝ fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => inner ℝ v w :=
          ⟨fun v u => inner_add_left v u w,
            fun (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) => real_inner_smul_left v w c⟩
        exact convex_halfSpace_le hlinear (s - r)
      | top =>
        simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
    | top =>
      cases b with
      | bot =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | coe s =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | top =>
        simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))

  rw [EReal.subdifferential]
  have hset :
      {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ∀ z, f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} =
        ⋂ z, {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) |
          f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact convex_iInter fun z => constraintConvex (f x) (f z) (z - x)



theorem exists_empty_subdifferential :
    ∃ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)),
      Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} ∧
        EReal.subdifferential f x = ∅ := by

  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal := fun y => if y = 0 then 0 else ⊤
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hx0 := congrArg (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => y 0) hx
    simp [x] at hx0
  have hepi :
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} =
        ({0} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))) ×ˢ Set.Ici 0 := by
    ext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
    · simp [f, hp]
    · simp [f, hp]
  refine ⟨f, x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hepi]
    exact (convex_singleton (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))).prod (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
  · ext v
    rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hv
    have hz := hv (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    simp [f, hx] at hz



theorem exists_singleton_subdifferential :
    ∃ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)),
      Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} ∧
        EReal.subdifferential f x = {v} := by

  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal := fun _ => 0
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := 0
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := 0
  have hepi :
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} =
        Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0 := by
    ext p
    simp [f]
  refine ⟨f, x, v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hepi]
    exact convex_univ.prod (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
  · ext y
    rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hyy := hy y

      have hyzero : y = 0 := real_inner_self_nonpos.mp hnonpos
      simpa [v] using hyzero
    · intro hy
      subst y
      intro z
