theorem firmlyNonexpansive_to_lipschitzWith_one (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyNonexpansive T → LipschitzWith 1 T := by
  intro h

  apply LipschitzWith.mk_one
  intro x y
  have hres : 0 ≤ dist (RestrictedMap.residual T x) (RestrictedMap.residual T y) ^ 2 :=
    sq_nonneg _
  have hsquare : dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 ≤ dist x y ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 ≤
          dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 +
            dist (RestrictedMap.residual T x) (RestrictedMap.residual T y) ^ 2 :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right hres
      _ ≤ dist x y ^ 2 := h x y
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp hsquare


theorem lipschitzWith_one_to_quasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    LipschitzWith 1 T → RestrictedMap.Quasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x y hy

  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [hyT] using h.dist_le_mul x y


theorem firmlyNonexpansive_to_firmlyQuasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyNonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.FirmlyQuasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x y hy

  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [RestrictedMap.residual_apply, hyT, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using h x y


theorem firmlyQuasinonexpansive_to_strictlyQuasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyQuasinonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.StrictlyQuasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x hx y hy

  have hxT : T x ≠ x := by
    intro hxT
    exact hx ((RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mpr hxT)
  have hdisp : 0 < dist (T x) x := dist_pos.mpr hxT
  have hdisp_sq : 0 < dist (T x) x ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_pos hdisp hdisp
  have hstrict_sq : dist (T x) y ^ 2 < dist x y ^ 2 := by
    have hfirm := h x y hy
    nlinarith
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp hstrict_sq


theorem strictlyQuasinonexpansive_to_quasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.StrictlyQuasinonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.Quasinonexpansive T := by
  classical
  intro h x y hy

  by_cases hx : x ∈ RestrictedMap.fixedPoints T

    exact hx hy
  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [hyT] using h x y hxy

theorem maxFormObjective_spec
    {E1 : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E1]
    {E2 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℝ E2] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E2]
    (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ1_closed : IsClosed Q1) (hQ1_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q1)
    (hQ1_convex : Convex ℝ Q1) (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2)
    (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2) (hQ2_convex : Convex ℝ Q2)
    (hfhat_continuous : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) (hfhat_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat)
    (hphi_continuous : ContinuousOn phi Q2) (hphi_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q2 phi)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) :
    ∀ x ∈ Q1,
      IsGreatest ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2)
        (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A x - fhat x) := by
  intro x _

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩
  have hpayoff : ContinuousOn (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) Q2 :=
    (A x).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousOn.sub hphi_continuous

  simpa only [MaxForm.objective_apply, add_sub_cancel_left] using
    (hcompact.image_of_continuousOn hpayoff).isGreatest_sSup (hQ2_nonempty.image _)


theorem maxFormOptimalValue_spec

    (hQ1_closed : IsClosed Q1) (hQ1_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q1)
    (hQ1_convex : Convex ℝ Q1) (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2)
    (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2) (hQ2_convex : Convex ℝ Q2)
    (hfhat_continuous : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) (hfhat_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat)
    (hphi_continuous : ContinuousOn phi Q2) (hphi_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q2 phi)
    (hQ1_nonempty : Q1.Nonempty) (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) :
    IsLeast (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1)
      (MaxForm.optimalValue Q1 Q2 fhat phi A) := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q1 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ1_closed, hQ1_bounded⟩
  have hobjective : ContinuousOn (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A) Q1 :=
    MaxForm.continuousOn_objective Q1 Q2 fhat phi A hQ2_closed hQ2_bounded
      hQ2_nonempty hphi_continuous hfhat_continuous

  rw [MaxForm.optimalValue_def]
  exact (hcompact.image_of_continuousOn hobjective).isLeast_sInf (hQ1_nonempty.image _)

lemma existsSupportingMultiplier {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (C : Set (E × ℝ)) (ℓ : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hC : Convex ℝ C)
    (hzero : 0 ∈ C) (hup : (0, 1) ∈ C)
    (hdown : ∃ q ∈ C, q.2 < 0)
    (hslice : ∀ y, (y, 0) ∈ C → ℓ y ≤ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ p ∈ C, ℓ p.1 ≤ c * p.2 := by
  let K := ConvexCone.hull ℝ C
  have hKzero : K.Pointed := ConvexCone.subset_hull hzero
  let P := (⊤ : Submodule ℝ E).prod (⊥ : Submodule ℝ ℝ)
  let F := (-(ℓ.comp (LinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ))).toPMap P

  have hnonneg : ∀ p : F.domain, (p : E × ℝ) ∈ K.toPointedCone hKzero → 0 ≤ F p := by
    rintro ⟨⟨y, r⟩, hp⟩ hk
    have hr : r = 0 := hp.2
    subst r
    rcases (ConvexCone.mem_hull_of_convex hC).mp hk with ⟨t, ht, ⟨qy, qr⟩, hq, heq⟩
    have hheight : qr = 0 := by
      have he := congrArg Prod.snd heq
      simpa only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.snd, smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_zero, ht.ne', false_or] using he
    have hq' : (qy, 0) ∈ C := by
      simpa only [← hheight, Prod.eta] using hq
    have hle := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht.le (hslice qy hq')
    have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    simp only [Prod.smul_mk] at hfirst
    simp only [F, LinearMap.toPMap_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply, neg_nonneg]
    rw [← hfirst, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hle

  have hdense : ∀ p : E × ℝ, ∃ a : F.domain,
      (a : E × ℝ) + p ∈ K.toPointedCone hKzero := by
    rintro ⟨y, r⟩
    rcases lt_trichotomy r 0 with hr | hr | hr
    · rcases hdown with ⟨⟨qy, qr⟩, hq, hqr⟩
      let t := r / qr
      have ht : 0 < t := div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hr hqr
      refine ⟨⟨(t • qy - y, 0), ⟨Submodule.mem_top, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      have heq : (t • qy - y, (0 : ℝ)) + (y, r) = t • (qy, qr) := by
        ext
        · exact sub_add_cancel _ _
        · simpa only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.snd, Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, t]
            using (div_mul_cancel₀ r hqr.ne).symm
      rw [heq]
      exact K.smul_mem ht (ConvexCone.subset_hull hq)
    · subst r
      refine ⟨⟨(-y, 0), ⟨Submodule.mem_top, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, neg_add_cancel, add_zero, Prod.zero_eq_mk] using (K.toPointedCone hKzero).zero_mem
    · refine ⟨⟨(-y, 0), ⟨Submodule.mem_top, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      have hm := K.smul_mem hr (ConvexCone.subset_hull hup)
      simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, neg_add_cancel, zero_add, Prod.smul_mk,
        smul_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ConvexCone.mem_toPointedCone] using hm
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos⟩ := riesz_extension (K.toPointedCone hKzero) F hnonneg hdense
  have hhorizontal (y : E) : g (y, 0) = -ℓ y :=
    hg ⟨(y, 0), ⟨Submodule.mem_top, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩⟩
  have hformula (p : E × ℝ) : g p = -ℓ p.1 + p.2 * g (0, 1) := by
    calc
      g p = g ((p.1, 0) + p.2 • (0, 1)) := by simp only [Prod.smul_mk,
        smul_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, Prod.eta]
      _ = -ℓ p.1 + p.2 * g (0, 1) := by rw [map_add, map_smul, hhorizontal, smul_eq_mul]

  refine ⟨g (0, 1), hgpos _ (ConvexCone.subset_hull hup), ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have h := hgpos p (ConvexCone.subset_hull hp)
  rw [hformula, neg_add_eq_sub, sub_nonneg, mul_comm] at h
  exact h

end ConvexAnalysis

lemma dualPairing_le_norm_mul_norm {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) : s h ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖h‖ := by

  calc
    s h ≤ |s h| := le_abs_self (s h)
    _ = ‖s h‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs (s h)).symm
    _ ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖h‖ := s.le_opNorm h



lemma sqDiscrepancy_nonpos (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (a b : ℝ) :
    b * a - (1 / (2 * L)) * b ^ 2 ≤ (L / 2) * a ^ 2 := by

  field_simp [hL.ne']
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b - L * a)]


lemma dualQuadraticBound {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (s g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 ≤ g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by

  have hshift : s h = g h + (s - g) h := by
    rw [sub_apply]
    abel

  have hpair := dualPairing_le_norm_mul_norm (s - g) h
  have hquad := sqDiscrepancy_nonpos L hL ‖h‖ ‖s - g‖
  rw [hshift]
  linarith



lemma dualQuadratic_at_normingDual {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (g u : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) (hu₁ : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hu₂ : u h = ‖h‖) :
    (g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖(g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g‖ ^ 2 =
      g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by

  have heval : (g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) h = g h + L * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, hu₂]
    ring

  have hsub : ((g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g : StrongDual ℝ E) = (L * ‖h‖) • u := by
    abel

  have hnorm : ‖(g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g‖ = L * ‖h‖ := by
    rw [hsub]
    rw [norm_smul_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL.le (norm_nonneg h)) u]
    simp only [hu₁, mul_one]
  rw [heval, hnorm]
  field_simp [hL.ne']
  ring



lemma exists_dual_attaining {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    ∃ s : StrongDual ℝ E,
      s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 = g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : h = 0
  ·
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    simp [hz]
  ·
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := exists_dual_vector ℝ h ((norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr hz)
    refine ⟨g + (L * ‖h‖) • u, dualQuadratic_at_normingDual hL g u h hu₁ hu₂⟩












theorem fenchelConjSqNormEq {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 = ⨆ s : StrongDual ℝ E, s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 := by
  let F : StrongDual ℝ E → ℝ := fun s ↦ s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2

    rintro y ⟨s, rfl⟩

    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_dual_attaining hL g h

      _ ≤ ⨆ s : StrongDual ℝ E, F s := le_ciSup hbdd s
  ·


    letI : Nonempty (StrongDual ℝ E) := ⟨0⟩
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro s
    exact dualQuadraticBound hL s g h

private def interleavedCrown (n : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (Fin (2 * n)) :=
  SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun u v ↦ u.val % 2 ≠ v.val % 2 ∧ u.val / 2 ≠ v.val / 2)


private lemma interleavedCrown_adj (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (interleavedCrown n).Adj u v ↔
      u.val % 2 ≠ v.val % 2 ∧ u.val / 2 ≠ v.val / 2 := by

  simp only [interleavedCrown, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, h | h⟩
    · exact h
    · exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, Or.inl h⟩
    intro huv
    subst v
    exact h.1 rfl


private lemma pairedIndexSpec (n j p : ℕ) (hj : j < n) (hp : p < 2) :
    2 * j + p < 2 * n ∧ (2 * j + p) / 2 = j ∧ (2 * j + p) % 2 = p := by

  omega


private lemma interleavedCrownColorValid (n : ℕ) {u v : Fin (2 * n)}
    (h : (interleavedCrown n).Adj u v) : u.val / 2 + 1 ≠ v.val / 2 + 1 := by

  exact fun he ↦ (interleavedCrown_adj n u v).mp h |>.2 (Nat.add_right_cancel he)


private def interleavedCrownColor (n : ℕ) : (interleavedCrown n).Coloring ℕ :=
  .mk (fun v ↦ v.val / 2 + 1) (interleavedCrownColorValid n)


private lemma interleavedCrownColor_apply (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    interleavedCrownColor n v = v.val / 2 + 1 := by

  rfl


private lemma interleavedCrownIsBipartite (n : ℕ) : (interleavedCrown n).IsBipartite := by

  have partition : (interleavedCrown n).IsBipartiteWith
      {v | v.val % 2 = 0} {v | v.val % 2 = 1} := by
    constructor
    · rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro v hv hw
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv hw
      omega
    · intro u v huv
      have sides := ((interleavedCrown_adj n u v).mp huv).1
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      omega
  exact partition.isBipartite


private lemma interleavedCrownGreedy (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    IsLeast {k : ℕ | 0 < k ∧
      ∀ u : Fin (2 * n), u < v → (interleavedCrown n).Adj u v →
        interleavedCrownColor n u ≠ k} (interleavedCrownColor n v) := by
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rw [interleavedCrownColor_apply]
      exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _
    · intro u _ huv
      exact (interleavedCrownColor n).valid huv
  · intro k hk
    obtain ⟨positive, available⟩ := hk

    by_contra hle
    rw [interleavedCrownColor_apply] at hle
    have pairBound : k - 1 < n := by
      have := v.isLt
      omega
    have sideBound : 1 - v.val % 2 < 2 := by omega
    obtain ⟨indexBound, pairEq, sideEq⟩ :=
      pairedIndexSpec n (k - 1) (1 - v.val % 2) pairBound sideBound
    let u : Fin (2 * n) := ⟨2 * (k - 1) + (1 - v.val % 2), indexBound⟩
    have earlier : 2 * (k - 1) + (1 - v.val % 2) < v.val := by
      omega
    have adjacent : (interleavedCrown n).Adj u v := by
      rw [interleavedCrown_adj]
      dsimp only [u, Fin.val]
      rw [pairEq, sideEq]
      omega
    have colorEq : interleavedCrownColor n u = k := by
      rw [interleavedCrownColor_apply]
      dsimp only [u, Fin.val]
      rw [pairEq]
      omega
    exact available u earlier adjacent colorEq


private lemma interleavedCrownColor_range (n : ℕ) :
    Set.range (fun v ↦ interleavedCrownColor n v) = Set.Icc 1 n := by

  ext k
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, interleavedCrownColor_apply]
    have := v.isLt
    constructor
    · omega
    · omega
  · intro hk
    have pairBound : k - 1 < n := by
      obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hk
      omega
    obtain ⟨indexBound, pairEq, _⟩ := pairedIndexSpec n (k - 1) 0 pairBound (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)
    refine ⟨⟨2 * (k - 1) + 0, indexBound⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [interleavedCrownColor_apply]
    simp only [pairEq]
    have := hk.1
    omega





public theorem existsBipartiteGreedyColoring (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin (2 * n)), G.IsBipartite ∧
      ∃ c : G.Coloring ℕ,
        (∀ v : Fin (2 * n),
          IsLeast {k : ℕ | 0 < k ∧
            ∀ u : Fin (2 * n), u < v → G.Adj u v → c u ≠ k} (c v)) ∧
        Set.range (fun v ↦ c v) = Set.Icc 1 n := by

  exact ⟨interleavedCrown n, interleavedCrownIsBipartite n,
    interleavedCrownColor n, interleavedCrownGreedy n, interleavedCrownColor_range n⟩

private lemma intrinsicInteriorChartImage {E D : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace D] (C : Set E)
    (e : D ≃ₜ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    intrinsicInterior ℝ C = (Subtype.val ∘ e) '' interior ((Subtype.val ∘ e) ⁻¹' C) := by

  exact (image_interior_preimage_comp e e.isHomeomorph Subtype.val C).symm


private lemma intrinsicClosureChartImage {E D : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace D] (C : Set E)
    (e : D ≃ₜ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    intrinsicClosure ℝ C = (Subtype.val ∘ e) '' closure ((Subtype.val ∘ e) ⁻¹' C) := by

  exact (image_closure_preimage_comp e e.isHomeomorph Subtype.val C).symm


private lemma affineMapCombo {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W] (f : V →ᵃ[ℝ] W) (u v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    f (t • u + (1 - t) • v) = t • f u + (1 - t) • f v := by

  simpa only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, add_comm] using f.apply_lineMap v u t




theorem Convex.combo_mem_intrinsicInterior {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {C : Set E} (hC : Convex ℝ C)
    {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C) (hy : y ∈ closure C)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    t • x + (1 - t) • y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C := by

  obtain ⟨p, _, _⟩ := mem_intrinsicInterior.mp hx


  letI : Nonempty (affineSpan ℝ C) := ⟨p⟩
  let e := (AffineIsometryEquiv.constVSub ℝ p).symm
  let f := (affineSpan ℝ C).subtype.comp e.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap

  have interiorChart : intrinsicInterior ℝ C = f '' interior (f ⁻¹' C) :=
    intrinsicInteriorChartImage C e.toHomeomorph
  have closureChart : closure C = f '' closure (f ⁻¹' C) :=
    (intrinsicClosure_eq_closure ℝ C).symm.trans (intrinsicClosureChartImage C e.toHomeomorph)
  rw [interiorChart] at hx ⊢
  rw [closureChart] at hy
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hux⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvy⟩ := hy

  refine ⟨t • u + (1 - t) • v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hC.affine_preimage f).combo_interior_closure_mem_interior hu hv ht.1
      (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) (add_sub_cancel _ _)
  · rw [affineMapCombo, hux, hvy]

    have hne : x i ≠ y i := by
      have hm : i ∈ Finset.filter (fun j ↦ x j ≠ y j) Finset.univ := by
        rw [hi]
        exact Finset.mem_singleton_self i
      simpa using hm
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [Function.update_self]
      exact Bool.eq_not_iff.mpr (Ne.symm hne)
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
      by_contra h
      have hm : j ∈ Finset.filter (fun j ↦ x j ≠ y j) Finset.univ := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact Ne.symm h
      rw [hi, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
      exact hj hm
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hj]


private lemma cubeFlipInjective {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → Bool) :
    Function.Injective (fun i ↦ Function.update x i (!(x i))) := by

  intro i j h
  by_contra hij
  have he := congrFun h i
  simp [Function.update_of_ne hij] at he


theorem cubeDegree (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → Bool) : (cube d).degree x = d := by

  have hn : (cube d).neighborFinset x =
      Finset.univ.image (fun i ↦ Function.update x i (!(x i))) := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      cubeAdjIffUpdate]
    exact exists_congr fun i ↦ eq_comm
  rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hn,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (cubeFlipInjective x)]
  simp


private lemma cycleLengthLeCard {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a : V} {p : G.Walk a a} (hp : p.IsCycle) : p.length ≤ Fintype.card V := by

  have hb := hp.isPath_tail.length_lt
  rw [← p.length_tail_add_one hp.not_nil]
  omega


theorem circumference_le_iff {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (n : ℕ) :
    G.circumference ≤ n ↔ ∀ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle → p.length ≤ n := by
  classical


  letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have hb : BddAbove {k : ℕ | ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = k} := by
    refine ⟨Fintype.card V, ?_⟩
    rintro k ⟨a, p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact cycleLengthLeCard hp

  rw [circumference, csSup_le_iff' hb]
  constructor
  · intro h a p hp
    exact h p.length ⟨a, p, hp, rfl⟩
  · rintro h k ⟨a, p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact h a p hp


theorem circumference_eq_zero_iff {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    G.circumference = 0 ↔ G.IsAcyclic := by

  rw [← Nat.le_zero, circumference_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h a p hp
    have hb := h a p hp
    have hl := hp.three_le_length
    omega
  · intro h a p hp
    exact (h p hp).elim


theorem exists_cycle_length_eq_circumference {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (h_cycle : ¬ G.IsAcyclic) :
    ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = G.circumference := by
  classical

  have hn : ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle := by
    simpa only [IsAcyclic, not_forall, not_not] using h_cycle
  obtain ⟨a, p, hp⟩ := hn
  have hb := (circumference_le_iff G G.circumference).mp le_rfl
  have hnonempty : {k : ℕ | ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = k}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨p.length, a, p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hbounded : BddAbove {k : ℕ | ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a a), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = k} :=
    ⟨G.circumference, fun k ⟨b, q, hq, heq⟩ ↦ heq ▸ hb b q hq⟩
  exact Nat.sSup_mem hnonempty hbounded


private lemma hammingUpdateAddOne {d : ℕ} (x y : Fin d → Bool) (i : Fin d)
    (hi : x i ≠ y i) :
    hammingDist (Function.update x i (y i)) y + 1 = hammingDist x y := by

  have hs : Finset.filter (fun j ↦ Function.update x i (y i) j ≠ y j) Finset.univ =
      (Finset.filter (fun j ↦ x j ≠ y j) Finset.univ).erase i := by
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hj]
  have hm : i ∈ Finset.filter (fun j ↦ x j ≠ y j) Finset.univ := by simp [hi]
  simpa only [hammingDist, hs] using Finset.card_erase_add_one hm


private lemma hammingLeWalkLength {d : ℕ} {x y : Fin d → Bool}
    (p : (cube d).Walk x y) : hammingDist x y ≤ p.length := by

  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons x z y h p ih =>
    have ht := hammingDist_triangle x z y
    rw [(cube_adj d x z).mp h] at ht
    simp only [Walk.length_cons]
    omega


private lemma cubeEdistLeHamming (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x y : Fin d → Bool, hammingDist x y = n →
      (cube d).edist x y ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by

  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro x y hn
    by_cases hz : n = 0
    · have heq := hammingDist_eq_zero.mp (hn.trans hz)
      subst y
      simp [hz]
    · have hne : x ≠ y := hammingDist_ne_zero.mp (hn ▸ hz)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x i ≠ y i := Function.ne_iff.mp hne
      have hr := hammingUpdateAddOne x y i hi
      have hlt : hammingDist (Function.update x i (y i)) y < n := by omega
      have hadj : (cube d).Adj x (Function.update x i (y i)) := by
        rw [cubeAdjIffUpdate]
        refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
        have hy : y i = !(x i) := Bool.eq_not_iff.mpr (Ne.symm hi)
        rw [hy]
      calc
        (cube d).edist x y ≤ (cube d).edist x (Function.update x i (y i)) +
            (cube d).edist (Function.update x i (y i)) y := (cube d).edist_triangle
        _ ≤ 1 + (hammingDist (Function.update x i (y i)) y : ℕ∞) :=
          add_le_add (le_of_eq (edist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr hadj)) (ih _ hlt _ _ rfl)
        _ = (n : ℕ∞) := by
          rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add]
          congr 1
          omega


private lemma cubeEdist (d : ℕ) (x y : Fin d → Bool) :
    (cube d).edist x y = (hammingDist x y : ℕ∞) := by

  refine le_antisymm (cubeEdistLeHamming d _ x y rfl) ?_
  unfold edist
  refine le_iInf fun p ↦ ?_
  exact_mod_cast hammingLeWalkLength p


private lemma hammingCons {d : ℕ} (b c : Bool) (x y : Fin d → Bool) :
    hammingDist (Fin.cons b x : Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (Fin.cons c y) =
      (if b = c then 0 else 1) + hammingDist x y := by

  simp only [hammingDist, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  by_cases h : b = c
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]


private lemma cubeFaceAdj {d : ℕ} (b : Bool) {x y : Fin d → Bool}
    (h : (cube d).Adj x y) : (cube (d + 1)).Adj (Fin.cons b x) (Fin.cons b y) := by

  simpa only [cube_adj, hammingCons, ite_true, zero_add] using h


private lemma cubeCrossAdj {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → Bool) :
    (cube (d + 1)).Adj (Fin.cons false x) (Fin.cons true x) := by

  simp [cube_adj, hammingCons]


private def cubeFace (d : ℕ) (b : Bool) : cube d →g cube (d + 1) :=

  { toFun := fun x ↦ Fin.cons b x
    map_rel' := fun {_ _} h ↦ cubeFaceAdj b h }


private lemma cubeFacesDisjoint {d : ℕ} (x y : Fin d → Bool) :
    (Fin.cons false x : Fin (d + 1) → Bool) ≠ Fin.cons true y := by

  simp only [ne_eq, Fin.cons_inj, Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, not_false_eq_true]


private lemma cubeFaceInjective (d : ℕ) (b : Bool) : Function.Injective (cubeFace d b) := by

  exact Fin.cons_right_injective (α := fun _ : Fin (d + 1) ↦ Bool) b


private lemma cubeFaceCross (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → Bool) :
    (cube (d + 1)).Adj (cubeFace d false x) (cubeFace d true x) := by

  exact cubeCrossAdj x


private lemma cubeFaceNe (d : ℕ) (x y : Fin d → Bool) :
    cubeFace d false x ≠ cubeFace d true y := by

  exact cubeFacesDisjoint x y


private lemma cubeReflectedPath {d : ℕ} {a b : Fin d → Bool}
    (p : (cube d).Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) :
    ((p.map (cubeFace d false)).append
      (.cons (cubeFaceCross d b) (p.reverse.map (cubeFace d true)))).IsPath := by

  refine Walk.IsPath.mk' ?_
  rw [Walk.support_append, Walk.support_cons, List.tail_cons]
  refine List.nodup_append'.mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hp.map (cubeFaceInjective d false)).support_nodup
  · exact (hp.reverse.map (cubeFaceInjective d true)).support_nodup
  · rw [Walk.support_map, Walk.support_map]
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
    exact cubeFaceNe d v w heq.symm


private lemma cubeReflectedLength {d : ℕ} {a b : Fin d → Bool}
    (p : (cube d).Walk a b) :
    ((p.map (cubeFace d false)).append
      (.cons (cubeFaceCross d b) (p.reverse.map (cubeFace d true)))).length =
        p.length + (p.length + 1) := by

  simp only [Walk.length_append, Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_map, Walk.length_reverse]


private lemma cubeSpanningPath (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ a b : Fin d → Bool, ∃ p : (cube d).Walk a b,
      p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 1 = 2 ^ d ∧ (0 < d → (cube d).Adj a b) := by

  induction d with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun _ ↦ false, fun _ ↦ false, .nil, ?_, rfl, ?_⟩
    · exact Walk.IsPath.nil
    · omega
  | succ d ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hl, _⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨cubeFace d false a, cubeFace d true a,
      (p.map (cubeFace d false)).append
        (.cons (cubeFaceCross d b) (p.reverse.map (cubeFace d true))),
      cubeReflectedPath p hp, ?_, fun _ ↦ cubeFaceCross d a⟩
    rw [cubeReflectedLength, pow_succ]
    omega


private lemma cubeSpanningCycle (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ a : Fin d → Bool, ∃ p : (cube d).Walk a a, p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = 2 ^ d := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hl, ha⟩ := cubeSpanningPath d
  have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ d := by
    calc
      4 = 2 ^ 2 := rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ^ d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le 1)) hd
  have hpos : 0 < d := by omega
  refine ⟨b, .cons (ha hpos).symm p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Walk.isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length]
    constructor
    · simp only [Walk.getVert_cons_succ, Walk.tail_cons, Walk.isPath_copy]
      exact hp
    · simp only [Walk.length_cons]
      omega
  · simpa only [Walk.length_cons] using hl


private lemma cubeAcyclicOfSmall (d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) : (cube d).IsAcyclic := by

  intro a p hp
  have hb := cycleLengthLeCard hp
  have hl := hp.three_le_length
  have hd' : d = 0 ∨ d = 1 := by omega
  rcases hd' with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hb
    omega
  · simp at hb
    omega


private lemma cubeFlipDiff {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → Bool) (i j : Fin d) :
    Function.update x i (!(x i)) j ≠ x j ↔ j = i := by

  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j
    simp
  · simp [h]


private lemma cubeNoTriangle {d : ℕ} {x y z : Fin d → Bool}
    (hxy : (cube d).Adj x y) (hyz : (cube d).Adj y z) : ¬ (cube d).Adj x z := by

  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (cubeAdjIffUpdate x y).mp hxy
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (cubeAdjIffUpdate _ z).mp hyz
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Function.update_self, Bool.not_not, Function.update_idem,
      Function.update_eq_self]
    exact (cube d).irrefl
  · intro hxz
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (cubeAdjIffUpdate x _).mp hxz
    have hki : i = k := by
      apply (cubeFlipDiff x k i).mp
      rw [← hk, Function.update_of_ne hij, Function.update_self]
      simp
    have hkj : j = k := by
      apply (cubeFlipDiff x k j).mp
      rw [← hk, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
      simp
    exact hij (hki.trans hkj.symm)


private lemma cubeWalkLengthNeThree {d : ℕ} {a : Fin d → Bool}
    (p : (cube d).Walk a a) : p.length ≠ 3 := by

  intro hl
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hl
  | cons hab p =>
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons hbc p =>
      cases p with
      | nil => simp at hl
      | cons hca p =>
        have hz : p.length = 0 := by
          simp only [Walk.length_cons] at hl
          omega
        have hn := Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
        cases hn
        exact cubeNoTriangle hab hbc hca.symm


private lemma cubeCycleFourLe {d : ℕ} {a : Fin d → Bool}
    {p : (cube d).Walk a a} (hp : p.IsCycle) : 4 ≤ p.length := by

  have hl := hp.three_le_length
  have hn := cubeWalkLengthNeThree p
  omega


private lemma cubeSquare (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : Fin (k + 2) → Bool, ∃ p : (cube (k + 2)).Walk a a,
      p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = 4 := by

  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using cubeSpanningCycle 2 (le_refl 2)
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, p, hp, hl⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨cubeFace (k + 2) false a, p.map (cubeFace (k + 2) false),
      hp.map (cubeFaceInjective (k + 2) false), ?_⟩
    simpa only [Walk.length_map] using hl

end SimpleGraph

open SimpleGraph



theorem cubeAverageDegree (d : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : Fin d → Bool, ((cube d).degree x : ℚ)) /
      (Fintype.card (Fin d → Bool) : ℚ) = (d : ℚ) := by

  simp only [cubeDegree, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero)



theorem cubeEdgeCount (d : ℕ) :
    (cube d).edgeFinset.card = d * 2 ^ (d - 1) := by

  have h := (cube d).sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  simp only [cubeDegree, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul,
    Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  cases d with
  | zero => simpa using h.symm
  | succ k =>
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ] at h ⊢
    nlinarith



theorem cubeDiameter (d : ℕ) : (cube d).diam = d := by

  have hd : (cube d).ediam = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    refine le_antisymm (ediam_le_of_edist_le fun x y ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rw [cubeEdist]
      have hb : hammingDist x y ≤ d := by
        simpa using (hammingDist_le_card_fintype (x := x) (y := y))
      exact_mod_cast hb
    · have ha := (cube d).edist_le_ediam (u := fun _ ↦ false) (v := fun _ ↦ true)
      simpa [cubeEdist, hammingDist] using ha
  simpa only [diam, ENat.toNat_coe] using congrArg ENat.toNat hd



theorem cubeGirth (d : ℕ) :
    (cube d).egirth = if 2 ≤ d then 4 else ⊤ := by

  by_cases hd : 2 ≤ d
  · rw [if_pos hd]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_egirth.mpr fun a p hp ↦ ?_)
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hd
      rw [Nat.add_comm 2 k]
      obtain ⟨a, p, hp, hl⟩ := cubeSquare k
      have hb := egirth_le_length hp
      simpa only [hl, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hb
    · exact_mod_cast cubeCycleFourLe hp
  · rw [if_neg hd]
    have hsmall : d < 2 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hd
    exact (cubeAcyclicOfSmall d hsmall).egirth_eq_top



theorem cubeCircumference (d : ℕ) :
    (cube d).circumference = if 2 ≤ d then 2 ^ d else 0 := by

  by_cases hd : 2 ≤ d
  · rw [if_pos hd]
    refine le_antisymm ((circumference_le_iff _ _).mpr ?_) ?_
    · intro a p hp
      simpa using cycleLengthLeCard hp
    · obtain ⟨a, p, hp, hl⟩ := cubeSpanningCycle d hd
      rw [← hl]
      exact (circumference_le_iff _ _).mp le_rfl a p hp
  · rw [if_neg hd]
    exact (circumference_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (cubeAcyclicOfSmall d (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hd))

private lemma existsComponentOfClosedSet {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (U : Set α) (hconn : (H.induce U).Connected)
    (hclosed : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ v, H.Adj u v → v ∈ U) :
    ∃ C : H.ConnectedComponent, C.supp = U := by

  obtain ⟨u⟩ := hconn.nonempty
  refine ⟨H.connectedComponentMk u.val, Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have hr : H.Reachable u.val v :=
      (ConnectedComponent.exact hv).symm
    apply hr.mem_subgraphVerts (H := (⊤ : H.Subgraph).induce U) ?_ u.property
    intro x hx y hxy
    exact ⟨hx, hclosed x hx y hxy, hxy⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact ConnectedComponent.sound
      ((hconn.preconnected ⟨v, hv⟩ u).map (Embedding.induce U).toHom)


private def imageRestrictHom {α β : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α} {K : SimpleGraph β}
    (f : H →g K) : H →g K.induce (Set.range f) :=
  ⟨fun a ↦ ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩, f.map_rel⟩


private lemma existsComponentOfClosedImage {α β : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    {K : SimpleGraph β} (f : H →g K) (hconn : H.Connected)
    (hclosed : ∀ a b, K.Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f) :
    ∃ C : K.ConnectedComponent, C.supp = Set.range f := by

  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (imageRestrictHom f) := by
    rintro ⟨b, a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  refine existsComponentOfClosedSet _ (hconn.map (imageRestrictHom f) hsurj) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ b hab
  exact hclosed a b hab


private lemma existsOddComponentOfClosedImage {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {K : SimpleGraph β} (f : H →g K)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hconn : H.Connected) (hodd : Odd (Nat.card α))
    (hclosed : ∀ a b, K.Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f) :
    ∃ C : K.oddComponents, C.val.supp = Set.range f := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := existsComponentOfClosedImage f hconn hclosed

  have hcard : C.supp.ncard = Nat.card α := by
    rw [hC, Set.ncard_range_of_injective hf]
  have hoddC : Odd C.supp.ncard := hcard ▸ hodd
  exact ⟨⟨C, hoddC⟩, hC⟩


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_iso {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {K : SimpleGraph β} (e : H ≃g K) :
    H.oddComponents.ncard = K.oddComponents.ncard := by
  classical

  have hodd (C : H.ConnectedComponent) :
      Odd C.supp.ncard ↔ Odd (e.connectedComponentEquiv C).supp.ncard := by
    rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
      Nat.card_congr (ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp e C)]
  have himage : e.connectedComponentEquiv '' H.oddComponents = K.oddComponents := by
    ext D
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩
      exact (hodd C).mp hC
    · intro hD
      obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ := e.connectedComponentEquiv.surjective D
      exact ⟨C, (hodd C).mpr hD, rfl⟩
  rw [← himage, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ e.connectedComponentEquiv.injective]


private lemma topDeleteVerts_verts {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (A : Set α) :
    ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts A).verts = Aᶜ := by

  simp only [Subgraph.deleteVerts_verts, Subgraph.verts_top, ← Set.compl_eq_univ_sdiff]


private lemma topDeleteVerts_adj {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (A : Set α)
    (x y : ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts A).verts) :
    (H.induce Aᶜ).Adj (Equiv.setCongr (topDeleteVerts_verts H A) x)
      (Equiv.setCongr (topDeleteVerts_verts H A) y) ↔
      ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts A).coe.Adj x y := by

  simp only [induce_adj, Equiv.setCongr_apply, Subgraph.coe_adj,
    Subgraph.deleteVerts_adj, Subgraph.verts_top, Set.mem_univ, Subgraph.top_adj,
    true_and, x.property.2, y.property.2, not_false_eq_true]


private def topDeleteVertsIso {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (A : Set α) :
    ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts A).coe ≃g H.induce Aᶜ :=
  { toEquiv := Equiv.setCongr (topDeleteVerts_verts H A)
    map_rel_iff' := fun {x y} ↦ topDeleteVerts_adj H A x y }


private lemma existsInducedTutteObstruction {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hfree : H.IsMatchingFree) :
    ∃ A : Set α, A.ncard < (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by

  have hnot : ¬ ∃ M : H.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching := by
    rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    exact hfree M hM
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := not_forall.mp (fun h ↦ hnot (tutte.mpr h))
  have hviol : H.IsTutteViolator A := Classical.not_not.mp hA
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  simpa only [IsTutteViolator, oddComponents_ncard_iso (topDeleteVertsIso H A)] using hviol


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_induce_induce {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (U : Set α) (B : Set U) :
    ((H.induce U).induce B).oddComponents.ncard =
      (H.induce (Subtype.val '' B)).oddComponents.ncard := by

  let f : ((H.induce U).induce B) ↪g H :=
    (Embedding.induce U).comp (Embedding.induce B)
  have hrange : Set.range f = Subtype.val '' B := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v.val, v.property, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
  have hiso := oddComponents_ncard_iso f.isoInduceRange
  rwa [hrange] at hiso


private lemma imageComplementInComplement {α : Type*} (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    Subtype.val '' Bᶜ = (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B)ᶜ := by

  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ (hs | ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩)
    · exact y.property hs
    · exact hy (Subtype.val_injective hzy ▸ hz)
  · intro hx
    have hs : x ∉ S := fun h ↦ hx (Or.inl h)
    refine ⟨⟨x, hs⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hB
    exact hx (Or.inr ⟨⟨x, hs⟩, hB, rfl⟩)


private lemma ncard_union_complement_image {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B).ncard = S.ncard + B.ncard := by

  have hd : Disjoint S (Subtype.val '' B) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x hx ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact y.property hx
  rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_enlarge {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    (H.induce (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B)ᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by

  rw [oddComponents_ncard_induce_induce, imageComplementInComplement]


private noncomputable def oddDeficiency {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (S : Set α) : ℤ :=
  ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents.ncard : ℤ) - S.ncard


private lemma existsMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α] (H : SimpleGraph α) :
    ∃ S : Set α, (∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S) ∧
      ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := Set.exists_max_image Set.univ (oddDeficiency H)
    (Set.toFinite _) Set.univ_nonempty
  have hlevel : {S | oddDeficiency H S = oddDeficiency H R}.Nonempty := ⟨R, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := Set.exists_max_image _ Set.ncard (Set.toFinite _) hlevel
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro T
    rw [hS]
    exact hR T (Set.mem_univ T)
  · intro T hT
    exact hcard T (hT.trans hS)


private lemma not_mem_componentImage_of_mem_other {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) {D : H.ConnectedComponent} (hDC : D ≠ C)
    {v : α} (hv : v ∈ D.supp) : v ∉ Subtype.val '' A := by

  rintro ⟨a, ha, heq⟩
  exact hDC (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hv (heq ▸ a.property))


private def componentDeletionSurvivorHom {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (D : H.ConnectedComponent) (hDC : D ≠ C) :
    D.toSimpleGraph →g H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ :=
  ⟨fun v ↦ ⟨v.val, not_mem_componentImage_of_mem_other C A hDC v.property⟩, id⟩


private lemma componentDeletionSurvivorHom_val {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (D : H.ConnectedComponent) (hDC : D ≠ C)
    (v : D) : (componentDeletionSurvivorHom C A D hDC v).val = v.val := by

  rfl


private lemma oddComponentSurvivesComponentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C)
    (D : H.oddComponents) (hDC : D.val ≠ C) :
    ∃ E : (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' E.val.supp = D.val.supp := by
  let f := componentDeletionSurvivorHom C A D.val hDC
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : ((Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy)

  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab
    have hb : b.val ∈ D.val.supp := D.val.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨b.val, hb⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact componentDeletionSurvivorHom_val C A D.val hDC ⟨b.val, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf D.val.connected_toSimpleGraph
    D.property hclosed
  refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
  rw [hE]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact a.property
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨f ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma not_mem_componentImage {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (v : C) (hv : v ∉ A) :
    v.val ∉ Subtype.val '' A := by

  rintro ⟨w, hw, heq⟩
  exact hv (Subtype.val_injective heq ▸ hw)


private def componentDeleteHom {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) :
    (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ) →g H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ :=
  ⟨fun v ↦ ⟨v.val.val, not_mem_componentImage C A v.val v.property⟩, id⟩


private lemma componentDeleteHom_val {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (v : (Aᶜ : Set C)) :
    (componentDeleteHom C A v).val = v.val.val := by

  rfl


private lemma oddComponentLiftsComponentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C)
    (D : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents) :
    ∃ E : (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' E.val.supp =
        (fun x : (Aᶜ : Set C) ↦ x.val.val) '' D.val.supp := by
  let f := (componentDeleteHom C A).comp D.val.toSimpleGraph_hom
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : ((Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy)

  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab
    have hbC : b.val ∈ C.supp := C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.val.val.property hab
    let c : C := ⟨b.val, hbC⟩
    have hc : c ∉ A := by
      intro hcA
      exact b.property ⟨c, hcA, rfl⟩
    have hbD : (⟨c, hc⟩ : (Aᶜ : Set C)) ∈ D.val.supp :=
      D.val.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hbD⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact componentDeleteHom_val C A ⟨c, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf D.val.connected_toSimpleGraph
    D.property hclosed
  refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
  rw [hE]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val, a.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f ⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_componentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) :
    (H.oddComponents \ {C}).ncard + (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤
      (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by
  classical

  have hs (D : (H.oddComponents \ {C} : Set H.ConnectedComponent)) :=
    oddComponentSurvivesComponentDeletion C A ⟨D.val, D.property.1⟩ D.property.2
  choose f hf using hs
  choose g hg using oddComponentLiftsComponentDeletion C A
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro D E heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    rw [← hf D, ← hf E, heq]
  have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro D E heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    apply (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective).image_injective
    exact (hg D).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun F ↦ Subtype.val '' F.val.supp) heq).trans (hg E))
  have hfg (D : (H.oddComponents \ {C} : Set H.ConnectedComponent))
      (E : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents) : f D ≠ g E := by
    intro heq
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := E.val.nonempty_supp
    have hmem : v.val.val ∈ Subtype.val '' (g E).val.supp := by
      rw [hg E]
      exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    rw [← heq, hf D] at hmem
    exact D.property.2 (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hmem v.val.property)

  have hinj : Function.Injective (Sum.elim f g) := by
    intro x y hxy
    cases x with
    | inl D =>
      cases y with
      | inl E => exact congrArg Sum.inl (hfinj hxy)
      | inr E => exact (hfg D E hxy).elim
    | inr D =>
      cases y with
      | inl E => exact (hfg E D hxy.symm).elim
      | inr E => exact congrArg Sum.inr (hginj hxy)
  simpa only [Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_coe_set_eq] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (Sum.elim f g) hinj


private lemma componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard <
      A.ncard + if Odd C.supp.ncard then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  let B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α) := Subtype.val '' A
  let T : Set α := S ∪ Subtype.val '' B
  have hcard : T.ncard = S.ncard + A.ncard := by
    rw [ncard_union_complement_image, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]
  have hcount : ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C}).ncard +
      (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    oddComponents_ncard_componentDeletion C A
  have hflatten : (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    oddComponents_ncard_enlarge H S B
  have hremoved : ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C}).ncard +
      (if Odd C.supp.ncard then 1 else 0) = (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by
    split_ifs with hodd
    · exact Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hodd
    · have heq : (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C} =
          (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents := by
        exact Set.sdiff_singleton_eq_self hodd
      rw [heq, Nat.add_zero]

  by_contra! hbad
  have hge : oddDeficiency H S ≤ oddDeficiency H T := by
    unfold oddDeficiency
    rw [hcard, hflatten]
    omega
  have heq : oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S := le_antisymm (hmax T) hge
  have ht := htie T heq
  have hpos := hA.ncard_pos
  omega


private lemma oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) : Odd C.supp.ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := C.nonempty_supp
  let c : C := ⟨v, hv⟩
  by_contra hodd
  have hbound := componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C {c}
    (Set.singleton_nonempty c)
  simp only [Set.ncard_singleton, if_neg hodd, Nat.add_zero] at hbound
  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl ({c} : Set C)
  have hparity := odd_ncard_oddComponents (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({c}ᶜ : Set C))
  simp only [Set.ncard_singleton, Nat.card_coe_set_eq] at htotal hparity
  have hcardC : Nat.card C = C.supp.ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq C.supp
  rw [hcardC] at htotal
  simp only [Nat.odd_iff] at hodd hparity
  omega


private lemma oddComponents_lt_ncard_of_odd {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hodd : Odd (Nat.card α)) (A : Set α)
    (hle : (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤ A.ncard) :
    (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard < A.ncard := by

  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl A
  have hparity := odd_ncard_oddComponents (H.induce Aᶜ)
  simp only [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.odd_iff] at hparity
  simp only [Nat.odd_iff] at hodd
  omega


private lemma factorCriticalOfDeletionBounds {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hodd : Odd (Nat.card α))
    (hbound : ∀ A : Set α, A.Nonempty → (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard < A.ncard) :
    H.IsFactorCritical := by
  classical
  constructor
  · exact (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hodd.pos).1
  · intro M hM

    cases nonempty_fintype α
    apply (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd)
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hM.even_card
  · intro v

    by_contra! hfree
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := existsInducedTutteObstruction hfree
    let T : Set α := {v} ∪ Subtype.val '' A
    have hT : T.Nonempty := ⟨v, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have hcard : T.ncard = 1 + A.ncard := by
      rw [ncard_union_complement_image, Set.ncard_singleton]
    have hcount : (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
        ((H.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set α)).induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
      oddComponents_ncard_enlarge H {v} A
    have ht := hbound T hT
    rw [hcard, hcount] at ht
    omega


private lemma factorCriticalComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard) :
    ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical := by
  intro C
  have hodd := oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C
  have hcard : Nat.card C = C.supp.ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq C.supp
  have hoddCard : Odd (Nat.card C) := hcard.symm ▸ hodd
  refine factorCriticalOfDeletionBounds hoddCard ?_
  intro A hA

  have hbound := componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C A hA
  rw [if_pos hodd] at hbound
  exact oddComponents_lt_ncard_of_odd hoddCard A (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hbound)


private lemma oddComponentSurvivesRestoration {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (S : Set α) (X : Set S)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (hodd : Odd C.supp.ncard)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c) :
    ∃ D : (H.induce (S \ Subtype.val '' X)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' D.val.supp = Subtype.val '' C.supp := by
  classical
  let T := S \ Subtype.val '' X
  have hinc : Sᶜ ⊆ Tᶜ := Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr Set.sdiff_subset
  let f : C.toSimpleGraph →g H.induce Tᶜ :=
    (H.induceHomOfLE hinc).toHom.comp C.toSimpleGraph_hom
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : (Tᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy
  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce Tᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab

    have hb : b.val ∉ S := by
      intro hbs
      have hbX : b.val ∈ Subtype.val '' X := by
        by_contra hbX
        exact b.property ⟨hbs, hbX⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := hbX
      exact hno ⟨s, hs, a.val, a.property, heq.symm ▸ hab.symm⟩
    have hbC : (⟨b.val, hb⟩ : (Sᶜ : Set α)) ∈ C.supp :=
      C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨⟨b.val, hb⟩, hbC⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.induceHomOfLE_apply hinc ⟨b.val, hb⟩)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf C.connected_toSimpleGraph hodd hclosed
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  rw [hD]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val, a.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f ⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma componentNeighborhoodCardBound {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (hodd : ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, Odd C.supp.ncard) (X : Set S) :
    X.ncard ≤ {C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent |
      ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c}.ncard := by
  classical
  let N : Set (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    {C | ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c}
  let T := S \ Subtype.val '' X

  have hsurv (C : (Nᶜ : Set (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)) :=
    oddComponentSurvivesRestoration S X C.val (hodd C.val) C.property
  choose f hf using hsurv
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro C D heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    apply Subtype.val_injective.image_injective
    rw [← hf C, ← hf D, heq]
  have hsurvCard : Nᶜ.ncard ≤ (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hfinj
  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl N
  have hcard : T.ncard + X.ncard = S.ncard := by
    have hsubset : Subtype.val '' X ⊆ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact s.property
    simpa only [Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective] using
      Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hsubset
  have hallodd : (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents = Set.univ := by
    ext C
    exact iff_of_true (hodd C) (Set.mem_univ C)

  have hmaxT := hmax T
  unfold oddDeficiency at hmaxT
  rw [hallodd, Set.ncard_univ] at hmaxT
  have hbound : X.ncard ≤ N.ncard := by
    omega
  exact hbound


private lemma matchableToComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (hodd : ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, Odd C.supp.ncard) :
    H.matchableToComponents S := by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent
  let r (s : S) (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :=
    ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c
  have hhall : ∀ A : Finset S,
      A.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun C ↦ ∃ s ∈ A, r s C)).card := by
    intro A
    have hbound := componentNeighborhoodCardBound hmax hodd (A : Set S)
    have hN : {C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent |
        ∃ s : S, s ∈ (A : Set S) ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c} =
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun C ↦ ∃ s ∈ A, r s C) : Set _) := by
      ext C
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq, r]
    rwa [hN, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hbound

  obtain ⟨f, hfinj, hf⟩ :=
    (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective r).mp hhall
  exact (H.matchableToComponents_iff_exists_embedding S).mpr ⟨⟨f, hfinj⟩, hf⟩


private lemma existsMatchingOnImage {α β : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    {K : SimpleGraph β} (f : H →g K) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : ∃ M : H.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : K.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧ N.verts = Set.range f := by

  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h
  refine ⟨M.map f, hM.1.map f hf, ?_⟩
  rw [Subgraph.map_verts, hM.2.verts_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]


private lemma matchingFreeComponentHasExternalMatchingEdge {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (hfree : C.toSimpleGraph.IsMatchingFree) :
    ∃ s : S, ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ M.Adj c s := by
  classical

  by_contra! h
  let f : C.toSimpleGraph →g G :=
    (Embedding.induce Sᶜ).toHom.comp C.toSimpleGraph_hom
  apply hfree (M.comap f)
  rw [Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff]
  intro v
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, huniq⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (f v)
  have hw : w ∉ S := by
    intro hws
    exact h ⟨w, hws⟩ v.val v.property hvw
  have hwC : (⟨w, hw⟩ : (Sᶜ : Set V)) ∈ C.supp :=
    C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp v.property (M.adj_sub hvw)
  refine ⟨⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hwC⟩, ⟨M.adj_sub hvw, hvw⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact huniq _ hy.2


private lemma card_components_le_of_isPerfectMatching {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    (hfree : ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsMatchingFree) :
    Nat.card (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent ≤ Nat.card S := by
  classical

  have hex (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :=
    matchingFreeComponentHasExternalMatchingEdge hM C (hfree C)
  choose s c hc hadj using hex
  refine Nat.card_le_card_of_injective s ?_
  intro C D hCD
  have hvertex : c C = c D := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hM.1.eq_of_adj_right (hadj C) (hCD.symm ▸ hadj D)
  exact ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex (hc C) (hvertex.symm ▸ hc D)


private lemma existsMatchingOnComponentDelete {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {S : Set V} (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (c : (Sᶜ : Set V))
    (hc : c ∈ C.supp)
    (hdelete : ∀ v : C, ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph,
      M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧
      N.verts = (Subtype.val '' C.supp) \ {c.val} := by
  classical

  let v : C := ⟨c, hc⟩
  let f : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)) →g G :=
    (Embedding.induce Sᶜ).toHom.comp
      (C.toSimpleGraph_hom.comp (Embedding.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).toHom)
  have hf : Function.Injective f :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hverts⟩ := existsMatchingOnImage f hf (hdelete v)
  refine ⟨N, hN, hverts.trans ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨y.val.val, y.val.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    apply y.property
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext heq
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    have hyne : (⟨y, hy⟩ : C) ∈ ({v}ᶜ : Set C) := by
      intro heq
      apply hne
      exact congrArg (fun z : C ↦ z.val.val) heq
    exact ⟨⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyne⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma existsMatchingOnComponentPatch {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {S : Set V} (s : S) (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)
    (hattach : ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ G.Adj s c)
    (hdelete : ∀ v : C, ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph,
      M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧
      N.verts = {s.val} ∪ Subtype.val '' C.supp := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsc⟩ := hattach
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hverts⟩ := existsMatchingOnComponentDelete C c hc hdelete

  have hd : Disjoint (G.subgraphOfAdj hsc).support N.support := by
    rw [(Subgraph.IsMatching.subgraphOfAdj hsc).support_eq_verts,
      hN.support_eq_verts, subgraphOfAdj_verts, hverts]
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x (rfl | rfl) ⟨hx, hne⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := hx
      exact y.property (heq.symm ▸ s.property)
    · exact hne rfl
  refine ⟨G.subgraphOfAdj hsc ⊔ N, (Subgraph.IsMatching.subgraphOfAdj hsc).sup hN hd, ?_⟩
  rw [Subgraph.verts_sup, subgraphOfAdj_verts, hverts]
  have hcimage : c.val ∈ Subtype.val '' C.supp := ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · rintro ((hs | hcx) | ⟨hx, hne⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr (hcx.symm ▸ hcimage)
    · exact Or.inr hx
  · rintro (hs | hx)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hs)
    · by_cases hcx : x = c.val
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hcx)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, hcx⟩


private lemma existsPerfectMatchingOfComponentEquiv {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} (e : S ≃ (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)
    (hattach : ∀ s : S, ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ (e s).supp ∧ G.Adj s c)
    (hdelete : ∀ (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (v : C),
      ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching := by
  classical

  have hpatch (s : S) :=
    existsMatchingOnComponentPatch s (e s) (hattach s) (hdelete (e s))
  choose N hN hverts using hpatch
  have hd : Pairwise fun s t ↦ Disjoint (N s).support (N t).support := by
    intro s t hst
    rw [(hN s).support_eq_verts, (hN t).support_eq_verts, hverts s, hverts t]
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x (hs | ⟨c, hc, hcx⟩) (ht | ⟨d, hd, hdx⟩)
    · exact hst (Subtype.ext (hs.symm.trans ht))
    · exact d.property (hdx.trans hs ▸ s.property)
    · exact c.property (hcx.trans ht ▸ t.property)
    · have hcd : c = d := Subtype.ext (hcx.trans hdx.symm)
      exact hst (e.injective (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hc (hcd.symm ▸ hd)))
  refine ⟨⨆ s, N s, Subgraph.IsMatching.iSup hN hd, ?_⟩

  intro v
  rw [Subgraph.verts_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion]
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S
  · refine ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hverts]
    exact Or.inl rfl
  · let c : (Sᶜ : Set V) := ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := e.surjective ((G.induce Sᶜ).connectedComponentMk c)
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    rw [hverts]
    right
    refine ⟨c, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hs]
    exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem

end SimpleGraph




theorem SimpleGraph.existsFactorCriticalComponents {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∃ S : Set V, G.matchableToComponents S ∧
      ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical := by

  obtain ⟨S, hmax, htie⟩ := SimpleGraph.existsMaximalOddDeficiency G
  refine ⟨S, ?_, SimpleGraph.factorCriticalComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie⟩

  exact SimpleGraph.matchableToComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax
    (SimpleGraph.oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie)





theorem SimpleGraph.existsPerfectMatching_iff_card_eq {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (S : Set V) (hmatch : G.matchableToComponents S)
    (hcritical : ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical) :
    (∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) ↔
      Nat.card S = Nat.card (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (G.matchableToComponents_iff_exists_embedding S).mp hmatch
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hM⟩

    exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f f.injective)
      (SimpleGraph.card_components_le_of_isPerfectMatching hM
        (fun C ↦ (hcritical C).noPerfectMatching))
  · intro hcard

    have hbij : Function.Bijective f :=
      (Nat.bijective_iff_injective_and_card f).mpr ⟨f.injective, hcard⟩
    exact SimpleGraph.existsPerfectMatchingOfComponentEquiv (Equiv.ofBijective f hbij) hf
      (fun C ↦ (hcritical C).delete_hasPerfectMatching)

noncomputable def unitBallFunction (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : EReal :=
  if ‖x‖ ≤ 1 then ((-Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤


theorem unitBallFunction_eq_coe_profile_inside (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    unitBallFunction x = ((-Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : EReal) := by

  simp only [unitBallFunction, if_pos hx.le]


private lemma unitBallFunction_le_coe_iff (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (r : ℝ) :
    unitBallFunction x ≤ (r : EReal) ↔
      ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ -Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) ≤ r := by

  by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1
  · simp only [unitBallFunction, hx, ite_true, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff, true_and]
  · simp [unitBallFunction, hx]


private lemma weightedSqrtLeSqrtWeighted (u v a b : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a * Real.sqrt u + b * Real.sqrt v ≤ Real.sqrt (a * u + b * v) := by

  have hgap : a * u + b * v - (a * Real.sqrt u + b * Real.sqrt v) ^ 2 =
      a * b * (Real.sqrt u - Real.sqrt v) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ = (a + b) * (a * Real.sqrt u ^ 2 + b * Real.sqrt v ^ 2) -
          (a * Real.sqrt u + b * Real.sqrt v) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hab, one_mul, Real.sq_sqrt hu, Real.sq_sqrt hv]
      _ = _ := by ring
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hb) (sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt u - Real.sqrt v))]


private lemma convexOnNegSqrtUnitBallProfile :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1)
      (fun x ↦ -Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)) := by


  have hball := convex_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (1 : ℝ)
  have hsq := (convexOn_norm hball).pow (fun x _ ↦ norm_nonneg x) 2
  refine ⟨hball, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
  have hynorm : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy
  have hxrad : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hyrad : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
  have hnorm := hsq.2 hx hy ha hb hab
  have hroot := weightedSqrtLeSqrtWeighted _ _ a b hxrad hyrad ha hb hab
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hnorm hroot ⊢
  have hrad : a * (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) + b * (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) ≤
      1 - ‖a • x + b • y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hnorm]
  have hmono := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hrad
  linarith



theorem unitBallFunction_convex :
    Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ |
      unitBallFunction p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}  := by

  simpa only [unitBallFunction_le_coe_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    using (convexOnNegSqrtUnitBallProfile (n := n)).convex_epigraph


private lemma innerAddSqrtUnitBallLeOne (x z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    inner ℝ x z + Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by

  have hxrad : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hzrad : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hdist := sq_nonneg ‖x - z‖
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real] at hdist
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hxrad, Real.sq_sqrt hzrad,
    sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2))]



theorem unitBallFunction_subdifferentiable_inside (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    EReal.subdifferentiableAt unitBallFunction x  := by

  have hrad : 0 < 1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrad
  rw [EReal.subdifferentiableAt_iff]
  refine ⟨(Real.sqrt (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ • x, ?_⟩
  intro z
  by_cases hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1
  · rw [unitBallFunction_eq_coe_profile_inside x hx, unitBallFunction, if_pos hz,
      ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    simp only [real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos).mp
    have hlift := innerAddSqrtUnitBallLeOne x z hx.le hz
    have hsquare := Real.sq_sqrt hrad.le

    simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpos), one_mul]
    nlinarith
  · rw [unitBallFunction_eq_coe_profile_inside x hx, unitBallFunction, if_neg hz]
    exact le_top



private lemma differentiableNormSqReal {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : E ↦ ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by

  intro x
  have hinner : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : E × E ↦ inner ℝ p.1 p.2) (x, x) :=
    isBoundedBilinearMap_inner.differentiableAt (x, x)
  have hdiag : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E ↦ (y, y)) x :=
    differentiableAt_id.prodMk differentiableAt_id
  have hcomp := hinner.comp (f := fun y : E ↦ (y, y)) x hdiag
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using
    hcomp



theorem unitBallFunction_differentiable_inside (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (unitBallFunction y).toReal) x  := by


  have hrad : 0 < 1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hprofile : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦ -Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)) x :=
    ((differentiableAt_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub
      (differentiableNormSqReal x)).sqrt (ne_of_gt hrad) |>.neg
  apply hprofile.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, ‖y‖ < 1 :=
    continuous_norm.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const hx
  filter_upwards [hnear] with y hy
  rw [unitBallFunction_eq_coe_profile_inside y hy, EReal.toReal_coe]



private lemma existsRadialSqrtAboveLinear (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ t * c < Real.sqrt (1 - (1 - t) ^ 2) := by

  let t := (c ^ 2 + 1)⁻¹
  have hden : 0 < c ^ 2 + 1 := by positivity
  have ht : 0 < t := inv_pos.2 hden
  have hmul : t * (c ^ 2 + 1) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have htone : t ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht.le (sq_nonneg c)]
  have hmul2 : t ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 + 1) = t := by
    calc
      t ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 + 1) = t * (t * (c ^ 2 + 1)) := by ring
      _ = t := by rw [hmul, mul_one]
  refine ⟨t, ht, htone, Real.lt_sqrt_of_sq_lt ?_⟩
  nlinarith [hmul2]


private lemma notMemSubdifferentialOnUnitSphere (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) : v ∉ EReal.subdifferential unitBallFunction x := by

  intro hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htone, hroot⟩ := existsRadialSqrtAboveLinear (inner ℝ v x)
  have hnorm : ‖(1 - t) • x‖ = 1 - t := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr htone), hx, mul_one]
  have hinside : ‖(1 - t) • x‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hnorm]
    linarith
  have htest := (EReal.mem_subdifferential _ _ _).mp hv ((1 - t) • x)
  have hxle : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := hx.le
  rw [unitBallFunction, if_pos hxle, unitBallFunction, if_pos hinside,
    ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at htest
  simp only [hx, one_pow, sub_self, Real.sqrt_zero, neg_zero, zero_add, hnorm,
    inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right] at htest
  nlinarith



theorem unitBallFunction_subdifferential_empty_outside (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖) :
    EReal.subdifferential unitBallFunction x = ∅  := by

  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with heq | hlt
  · exact notMemSubdifferentialOnUnitSphere x v heq.symm hv
  · have htest := (EReal.mem_subdifferential _ _ _).mp hv 0
    have hout : ¬ ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := not_le.mpr hlt
    rw [unitBallFunction, if_neg hout, EReal.top_add_coe] at htest

    have hzero : unitBallFunction (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ((-1 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      simp [unitBallFunction]
    rw [hzero] at htest
    exact (not_le_of_gt (EReal.coe_lt_top (-1))) htest




theorem unitBallFunction_boundary_value (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) :
    unitBallFunction x = (0 : EReal)  := by

  simp [unitBallFunction, hx]

theorem continuous_iff_exists_open_image_subset {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (a : X) (U : Set Y), IsOpen U → f a ∈ U →
      ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ a ∈ V ∧ f '' V ⊆ U := by
  constructor
  · intro hf a U hU ha

    exact ⟨f ⁻¹' U, hU.preimage hf, ha, Set.image_preimage_subset f U⟩
  · intro h

    refine continuous_def.mpr ?_
    intro U hU
    refine isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr ?_
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨V, hV, haV, hVU⟩ := h a U hU ha
    exact mem_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨V, Set.image_subset_iff.mp hVU, hV, haV⟩

def domain {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) : Set H := {x | f x ≠ ⊤}


theorem mem_domain {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) (x : H) :
    x ∈ domain f ↔ f x ≠ ⊤ := Iff.rfl


def IsProper {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) : Prop :=
  (domain f).Nonempty ∧ ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥


theorem isProper_iff {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) :
    IsProper f ↔ (domain f).Nonempty ∧ ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥ := Iff.rfl


def subdifferential {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (f : H → EReal) (x : H) : Set H :=
  {u | ∀ y, f x + (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y}


theorem mem_subdifferential_iff {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (f : H → EReal) (x u : H) :
    u ∈ subdifferential f x ↔ ∀ y, f x + (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y := Iff.rfl

end Subdifferential

private instance kernelPowIsMarkov {S : Type u} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (κ : Kernel S S) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (n : ℕ) : IsMarkovKernel (κ ^ n) := by

  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero]
      exact (inferInstance : IsMarkovKernel (Kernel.id : Kernel S S))
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact @Kernel.IsMarkovKernel.comp S S S _ _ _ (κ ^ n) ih κ inferInstance


private lemma kernelOneApply {S : Type u} [MeasurableSpace S] (i : S) :
    (1 : Kernel S S) i = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac i := by

  exact Kernel.id_apply i


private lemma finiteLIntegralToReal {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure S) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : S → ENNReal) (hf : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ).toReal = ∑ x, (μ {x}).toReal * (f x).toReal := by

  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_fintype]
  have hfinite : ∀ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset S), f x * μ {x} ≠ ⊤ :=
    fun x _ ↦ ENNReal.mul_ne_top (hf x) (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top μ {x})
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum hfinite]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, mul_comm]


private lemma kernelPowSuccSingletonToReal {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S]
    (κ : Kernel S S) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (n : ℕ) (i j : S) :
    ((κ ^ (n + 1)) i {j}).toReal =
      ∑ k, ((κ ^ n) i {k}).toReal * (κ k {j}).toReal := by

  rw [Kernel.pow_succ_apply_eq_lintegral κ n i (measurableSet_singleton j)]
  exact finiteLIntegralToReal ((κ ^ n) i) (fun k ↦ κ k {j})
    (fun k ↦ MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top (κ k) {j})





theorem transitionMatrix_pow_apply {S : Type u} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S]
    (κ : Kernel S S) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (P : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i j, P i j = (κ i {j}).toReal) (n : ℕ) (i j : S) :
    (P ^ n) i j = ((κ ^ n) i {j}).toReal := by

  induction n generalizing i j with
  | zero =>
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        simp [kernelOneApply]
      · simp [kernelOneApply, hij]
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (P ^ (n + 1)) i j = ∑ k, (P ^ n) i k * P k j := by
          rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
        _ = ∑ k, ((κ ^ n) i {k}).toReal * (κ k {j}).toReal := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          rw [ih i k, hP k j]
        _ = ((κ ^ (n + 1)) i {j}).toReal :=
          (kernelPowSuccSingletonToReal κ n i j).symm

private lemma isBridgeIffNotConnectedDeleteEdge {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V}
    (hT : T.Connected) (e : Sym2 V) :
    T.IsBridge e ↔ ¬ (T.deleteEdges {e}).Connected := by
  classical

  cases e with
  | h x y =>
    constructor
    · intro hbridge hconnected
      exact (isBridge_iff.mp hbridge) (hconnected x y)
    · intro hdisconnected
      by_contra hbridge
      exact hdisconnected (hT.connected_delete_edge_of_not_isBridge hbridge)




theorem isTree_iff_edgeDeletion {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    T.IsTree ↔ T.Connected ∧ ∀ e ∈ T.edgeSet, ¬ (T.deleteEdges {e}).Connected := by

  rw [isTree_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hconnected, hacyclic⟩
    refine ⟨hconnected, ?_⟩
    intro e he
    exact (isBridgeIffNotConnectedDeleteEdge hconnected e).mp
      (isAcyclic_iff_forall_isBridge.mp hacyclic he)
  · rintro ⟨hconnected, hdelete⟩
    refine ⟨hconnected, isAcyclic_iff_forall_isBridge.mpr ?_⟩
    intro e he
    exact (isBridgeIffNotConnectedDeleteEdge hconnected e).mpr (hdelete e he)




theorem isTree_iff_edgeAddition {V : Type u} [Nonempty V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    T.IsTree ↔ T.IsAcyclic ∧
      ∀ x y : V, x ≠ y → ¬ T.Adj x y → ¬ (T ⊔ edge x y).IsAcyclic := by
  classical
  rw [isTree_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hconnected, hacyclic⟩
    refine ⟨hacyclic, ?_⟩

    intro x y hne hnadj hextension
    obtain heq | hadj := (isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_iff.mp hextension).2
      (hconnected x y)
    · exact hne heq
    · exact hnadj hadj
  · rintro ⟨hacyclic, hadd⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hacyclic⟩
    rw [connected_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, inferInstance⟩

    intro x y
    by_contra hnreach
    have hne : x ≠ y := by
      intro heq
      subst y
      exact hnreach (Reachable.refl x)
    have hnadj : ¬ T.Adj x y := fun hadj ↦ hnreach hadj.reachable
    exact hadd x y hne hnadj (hacyclic.sup_edge_of_not_reachable hnreach)

universe u

private lemma matrixQuadraticExpansion {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) (x : ι → R) :
    A.toQuadraticForm' x = ∑ k, ∑ j, A j k * x j * x k := by

  rw [Matrix.toQuadraticForm', LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply,
    Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  ac_rfl


private lemma quadraticFormMatrixReconstruction {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [Invertible (2 : R)] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : QuadraticForm R (ι → R)) : Q.toMatrix'.toQuadraticForm' = Q := by

  rw [Matrix.toQuadraticForm', QuadraticForm.toMatrix', Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_toMatrix']
  exact QuadraticMap.toQuadraticMap_associated R Q


private lemma quadraticFormMatrixExpansion {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [Invertible (2 : R)] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : QuadraticForm R (ι → R)) (x : ι → R) :
    Q x = ∑ k, ∑ j, Q.toMatrix' j k * x j * x k := by

  have expansion := matrixQuadraticExpansion Q.toMatrix' x
  rwa [quadraticFormMatrixReconstruction] at expansion




theorem quadraticForm_iff_existsMatrix {𝕜 : Type u} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (n : ℕ) (h_pos : 0 < n) (q : (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜) :
    (∃ Q : QuadraticForm 𝕜 (Fin n → 𝕜), ∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜, Q x = q x) ↔
      ∃ A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜, ∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜,
        q x = ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, A j k * x j * x k := by
  constructor
  ·
    rintro ⟨Q, hQ⟩
    refine ⟨Q.toMatrix', ?_⟩
    intro x
    exact (hQ x).symm.trans (quadraticFormMatrixExpansion Q x)
  ·
    rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
    refine ⟨A.toQuadraticForm', ?_⟩
    intro x
    exact (matrixQuadraticExpansion A x).trans (hA x).symm

private lemma hasFDerivAtSquaredNorm {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y : E ↦ ‖y‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ x) x := by

  have hbilinear := isBoundedBilinearMap_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := E)
  have hderiv := (hbilinear.hasFDerivAt (x, x)).comp (f := fun y : E ↦ (y, y)) x
    ((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id x))

  have hfunctional : (hbilinear.deriv (x, x)).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) =
      2 • innerSL ℝ x := by
    ext y
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, IsBoundedBilinearMap.deriv_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [real_inner_comm y x]
    ring
  rw [hfunctional] at hderiv
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using hderiv


lemma hasGradientAtSqrtOneAddNormSq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (x : E) :
    HasGradientAt (fun y : E ↦ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖y‖ ^ 2))
      ((Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ • x) x := by

  have hpos : 0 < 1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hderiv := ((hasFDerivAtSquaredNorm x).const_add 1).sqrt (ne_of_gt hpos)
  rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]

  have hfunctional : (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x) =
      InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E ((Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ • x) := by
    ext y
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply,
      InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_left, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hfunctional] at hderiv
  exact hderiv

universe u v

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v}


theorem strongProd_adj (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) (x y : α × β) :
    (G.strongProd H).Adj x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧ (G.Adj x.1 y.1 ∨ x.1 = y.1) ∧ (H.Adj x.2 y.2 ∨ x.2 = y.2) := by

  unfold strongProd
  rw [fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨hne, h⟩
    · exact ⟨hne, h.1.elim (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm) (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm),
        h.2.elim (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm) (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, h⟩
    exact ⟨hne, Or.inl h⟩


theorem strongPower_adj (G : SimpleGraph α) (k : ℕ) (x y : Fin k → α) :
    (G.strongPower k).Adj x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧ ∀ i, G.Adj (x i) (y i) ∨ x i = y i := by

  unfold strongPower
  rw [fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨hne, h⟩
    · refine ⟨hne, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      exact (h i).elim (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm) (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm)
  · rintro ⟨hne, h⟩
    exact ⟨hne, Or.inl h⟩



theorem strongProd_reflGen [Finite α] [Finite β]
    (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) (x y : α × β) :
    Relation.ReflGen (G.strongProd H).Adj x y ↔
      Relation.ReflGen G.Adj x.1 y.1 ∧ Relation.ReflGen H.Adj x.2 y.2 := by
  classical

  simp only [Relation.reflGen_iff, strongProd_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨_, hx, hy⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨hx.elim Or.inr (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm),
        hy.elim Or.inr (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · exact Or.inl hxy.symm
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxy, hx.elim (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm) Or.inl,
        hy.elim (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm) Or.inl⟩



theorem strongPower_reflGen [Finite α]
    (G : SimpleGraph α) (k : ℕ) (x y : Fin k → α) :
    Relation.ReflGen (G.strongPower k).Adj x y ↔
      ∀ i, Relation.ReflGen G.Adj (x i) (y i) := by
  classical

  simp only [Relation.reflGen_iff, strongPower_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨_, h⟩) i
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact (h i).elim Or.inr (fun h ↦ Or.inl h.symm)
  · intro h
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · exact Or.inl hxy.symm
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxy, fun i ↦ (h i).elim (fun h ↦ Or.inr h.symm) Or.inl⟩


theorem strongPower_cons_adj (G : SimpleGraph α) (k : ℕ)
    (a b : α) (x y : Fin k → α) :
    (G.strongPower (k + 1)).Adj (Fin.cons a x) (Fin.cons b y) ↔
      (G.strongProd (G.strongPower k)).Adj (a, x) (b, y) := by
  classical

  simp only [strongPower_adj, strongProd_adj, ne_eq, Fin.cons_inj, Prod.mk.injEq,
    Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]

  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp only [and_true, not_true_eq_false, or_true, implies_true]
  · simp only [hxy, not_false_eq_true, true_and, or_false]



theorem strongPower_indepNum_spec [Finite α] (G : SimpleGraph α) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Fin k → α),
      (G.strongPower k).IsMaximumIndepSet s ∧ s.card = (G.strongPower k).indepNum := by

  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (G.strongPower k).maximumIndepSet_exists
  exact ⟨s, hs, (G.strongPower k).maximumIndepSet_card_eq_indepNum s hs⟩
